[代號], [名稱], [盤中成交價] AS [現價], [盤中漲幅] AS [漲幅%], [盤中總量] AS [總量], [HitCount] AS [共振維度數], [ResonanceTag] AS [共振等級], [DimA_Status] AS [雙動能狀態], [DimB_Status] AS [OBV星號狀態], [DimC_Status] AS [價格星號狀態], [DimD_Status] AS [彩虹金叉狀態] FROM [stockchangedate].[dbo].[ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot] WHERE [HitCount] >= 3 AND ([HitCount] = 4 OR [DimA_DualMomentum] = 2) -- 4維全共振 或 雙動能剛由負翻正 ORDER BY [HitCount] DESC, [DimD_RainbowScore] DESC, [盤中總量] DESC; """ stocks = [] try: with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute(sql, (top_n,)) rows = cursor.fetchall() for r in rows: stocks.append({ "code": r[0].strip(), "name": r[1].strip(), "price": float(r[2]) if r[2] else 0, "change": float(r[3]) if r[3] else 0, "volume": int(r[4]) if r[4] else 0, "hit_count": int(r[5]) if r[5] else 0, "tag": r[6].strip() if r[6] else "", "dim_a": r[7].strip() if r[7] else "", "dim_b": r[8].strip() if r[8] else "", "dim_c": r[9].strip() if r[9] else "", "dim_d": r[10].strip() if r[10] else "" }) except Exception as e: print(f"❌ 撈取黑馬清單失敗: {e}") return stocks # ========================================== # 🛠️【3. 撈取個股詳細數據與 3-Way 離場勝率】 # ========================================== def get_stock_explain_data(stock_code): data = { "name": stock_code, "date": "最新", "price": 0, "obv": 0, "obv5": 0, "obv34": 0, "m5": 0, "m20": 0, "m60": 0, "f5": 0, "f20": 0, "score": 0, "score5": 0, "score20": 0, "exit_5ma_win": 0.0, "exit_5ma_ret": 0.0, "exit_10ma_win": 0.0, "exit_10ma_ret": 0.0, "exit_20ma_win": 0.0, "exit_20ma_ret": 0.0, "optimal_exit": "🔥 20MA 勝出 (預設波段防守)" } sql_allcross = """ SELECT TOP 1 名稱, 日期, 成交價, obv淨額, obv_ma5, obv_ma34, price_ma5, price_ma20, price_ma60, 三大法人_ma5, 三大法人_ma20 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live WHERE 代號 = ? ORDER BY 日期 DESC """ sql_score = """ SELECT TOP 1 ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, M.專家實戰總分), SCH.實戰總分_ma5, SCH.實戰總分_ma20 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory SCH ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(SCH.代號) AND M.日期 = SCH.日期 WHERE RTRIM(M.代號) = ? ORDER BY M.日期 DESC """ sql_3exits = """ SELECT WinRate_5MA, Return_5MA, WinRate_10MA, Return_10MA, WinRate_20MA, Return_20MA, OptimalExit FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits WHERE 代號 = ? """ try: with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute(sql_allcross, (stock_code.strip(),)) r = cursor.fetchone() if r: data["name"] = r[0].strip() if r[0] else stock_code data["date"] = str(r[1]).strip() if r[1] else "最新" data["price"] = float(r[2]) if r[2] else 0 data["obv"] = float(r[3]) if r[3] else 0 data["obv5"] = float(r[4]) if r[4] else 0 data["obv34"] = float(r[5]) if r[5] else 0 data["m5"] = float(r[6]) if r[6] else 0 data["m20"] = float(r[7]) if r[7] else 0 data["m60"] = float(r[8]) if r[8] else 0 data["f5"] = float(r[9]) if r[9] else 0 data["f20"] = float(r[10]) if r[10] else 0 cursor.execute(sql_score, (stock_code.strip(),)) rs = cursor.fetchone() if rs: data["score"] = float(rs[0]) if rs[0] else 0 data["score5"] = float(rs[1]) if rs[1] else data["score"] data["score20"] = float(rs[2]) if rs[2] else data["score"] cursor.execute(sql_3exits, (stock_code.strip(),)) r3 = cursor.fetchone() if r3: data["exit_5ma_win"] = float(r3[0]) if r3[0] else 0.0 data["exit_5ma_ret"] = float(r3[1]) if r3[1] else 0.0 data["exit_10ma_win"] = float(r3[2]) if r3[2] else 0.0 data["exit_10ma_ret"] = float(r3[3]) if r3[3] else 0.0 data["exit_20ma_win"] = float(r3[4]) if r3[4] else 0.0 data["exit_20ma_ret"] = float(r3[5]) if r3[5] else 0.0 data["optimal_exit"] = str(r3[6]).strip() if r3[6] else "🔥 20MA 勝出" except Exception as e: print(f"⚠️ 撈取 {stock_code} 詳細資料提醒: {e}") return data # ========================================== # 🛠️【4. Qwen-7B 生成解盤 ＋ 強行注入 3-Way 樹狀卡片】 # ========================================== def generate_explanation_with_pk(data): f5_val, f20_val = data['f5'], data['f20'] f5_str = f"買超 {f5_val:.1f} 張" if f5_val >= 0 else f"賣超 {abs(f5_val):.1f} 張" f20_str = f"買超 {f20_val:.1f} 張" if f20_val >= 0 else f"賣超 {abs(f20_val):.1f} 張" score_val, score20_val = data['score'], data['score20'] score_str = f"多頭正分 +{score_val:.2f} 分" if score_val >= 0 else f"空頭負分 {score_val:.2f} 分" score20_str = f"正分 +{score20_val:.2f} 分" if score20_val >= 0 else f"負分 {score20_val:.2f} 分" e5_win, e5_ret = data.get("exit_5ma_win", 0.0), data.get("exit_5ma_ret", 0.0) e10_win, e10_ret = data.get("exit_10ma_win", 0.0), data.get("exit_10ma_ret", 0.0) e20_win, e20_ret = data.get("exit_20ma_win", 0.0), data.get("exit_20ma_ret", 0.0) optimal_exit = data.get("optimal_exit", "🔥 20MA 勝出 (預設波段防守)") e5_ret_str = f"+{e5_ret:.2f}%" if e5_ret >= 0 else f"{e5_ret:.2f}%" e10_ret_str = f"+{e10_ret:.2f}%" if e10_ret >= 0 else f"{e10_ret:.2f}%" e20_ret_str = f"+{e20_ret:.2f}%" if e20_ret >= 0 else f"{e20_ret:.2f}%" pk_block = ( f"📊 該股歷史離場戰術實測 PK（站 5MA 買進）：\n" f"├─ 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {e5_win:.1f}% | 期望值 {e5_ret_str}\n" f"├─ ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {e10_win:.1f}% | 期望值 {e10_ret_str}\n" f"└─ 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {e20_win:.1f}% | 期望值 {e20_ret_str}\n" f"🎯 最適戰術建議：【{optimal_exit}】" ) prompt = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監。使用者正在看你發送的「一鍵四大圖表同步聯動共振圖」。 請解說【{data['name']} ({data['name']})】今日盤後資料： - 現價：{data['price']}元 | 5MA：{data['m5']}元 | 20MA：{data['m20']}元 | 60MA：{data['m60']}元 - 三大法人 5MA：{f5_str}，20MA：{f20_str} - 實戰總分：當前為 {score_str}，20日均分為 {score20_str} 請嚴格分成以下五大段，每段 60~90 字，精準一針見血： 📌 【圖一：價格與均線防守】 📌 【圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振】 📌 【圖二：OBV星號爆發解讀】 📌 【圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振】 📌 【指揮官實戰總結指引】（給出下營業日開盤目標價與防守價與本金凱利部位％配置建議） 請全部使用繁體中文回覆。""" try: r = requests.post(OLLAMA_URL, json={"model": MODEL_NAME, "prompt": prompt, "stream": False}, timeout=120) ai_response = r.json().get("response", "⚠️ AI 生成異常。") # 👑【強效注入】：在第五段標題下方，強行注入 100% 精準的 PK 樹狀文字卡片！ if "📌 【指揮官實戰總結" in ai_response: parts = ai_response.split("📌 【指揮官實戰總結") final_output = parts[0] + "📌 【指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n" + pk_block + "\n\n" + parts[1].replace("指引】", "").strip() else: final_output = ai_response + "\n\n📌 【指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n" + pk_block return final_output except Exception as e: return f"❌ 本地 AI 連線超時: {e}" # ========================================== # 🛠️【5. Telegram 訊息與圖片發送函數】 # ========================================== def send_telegram_text(text_msg): url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_TOKEN}/sendMessage" try: requests.post(url, json={"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID, "text": text_msg}, timeout=15) except Exception as e: print(f"❌ TG 發送文字失敗: {e}") def send_telegram_photo(photo_path, caption_text): url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_TOKEN}/sendPhoto" try: with open(photo_path, 'rb') as f: data = {'chat_id': TG_CHAT_ID, 'caption': caption_text} requests.post(url, files={'photo': f}, data=data, timeout=15) except Exception as e: print(f"❌ TG 發送圖片失敗: {e}") # ========================================== # 🛠️【6. # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆 本腳本為【Zen AI 盤後 13:35 多維共振黑馬自動化 Telegram 廣播機器人 V1.1】
# 每日 13:35 自動抓取「4維全共振」與「雙動能剛由負翻正」且「總量 >= 3,000/5,000張」之有量有價黑馬！

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import asyncio
import requests
import pyodbc

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【1. 設定區】
# ==========================================
SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchangedate"
CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={{SQL Server}};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'

TG_TOKEN = "8769891212:AAEPDZeQIMQEJYbDbYyIecYOV06szBRcbEw"   
TG_CHAT_ID = "-1003926900701"  # 🟢【Zen AI 量化戰情室】Telegram 群組 ID

OLLAMA_URL = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
MODEL_NAME = "qwen2.5:7b"

# 🎯【有量有價核心門檻】：成交總量門檻（可依盤勢彈性設為 3000 或 5000 張）
MIN_VOLUME = 3000   # 若大盤多頭活絡可調升為 5000
MIN_PRICE = 10.0    # 最低股價門檻，自動濾除雞蛋水餃股
TOP_N = 3           # 每日精選推播檔數 (3~5 檔)

STATIC_DIR = r"C:\test_c\static"
os.makedirs(STATIC_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【2. 資料庫撈取：抓取當天 3~5 檔頂級黑馬 (嚴格總量與價格過濾)】
# ==========================================
def get_top_resonance_stocks(top_n=TOP_N, min_vol=MIN_VOLUME, min_px=MIN_PRICE):
    """
    從快照表中抓取當天符合：
    1. 總量 >= 3,000 張 (或 5,000 張) 有量有價
    2. 成交價 >= 10 元 (排除極低價水餃股)
    3. 4 維全共振 或 雙動能剛由負翻正起漲
    """
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP (?)
        [代號], [名稱], [盤中成交價] AS [現價], [盤中漲幅] AS [漲幅%], [盤中總量] AS [總量],
        [HitCount] AS [共振維度數], [ResonanceTag] AS [共振等級],
        [DimA_Status] AS [雙動能狀態], [DimB_Status] AS [OBV星號狀態], [DimC_Status] AS [價格星號狀態], [DimD_Status] AS [彩虹金叉狀態]
    FROM [stockchangedate].[dbo].[ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot]
    WHERE [HitCount] >= 3
      AND [盤中總量] >= ?                               -- 🟢 總量門檻 (>= 3,000 / 5,000 張)
      AND [盤中成交價] >= ?                              -- 🟢 排除極端低價股
      AND ([HitCount] = 4 OR [DimA_DualMomentum] = 2)   -- 4維全共振 或 雙動能剛由負翻正
    ORDER BY [HitCount] DESC, [DimD_RainbowScore] DESC, [盤中總量] DESC;
    """
    stocks = []
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (top_n, min_vol, min_px))
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            for r in rows:
                stocks.append({
                    "code": r[0].strip(),
                    "name": r[1].strip(),
                    "price": float(r[2]) if r[2] else 0.0,
                    "change": float(r[3]) if r[3] else 0.0,
                    "volume": int(r[4]) if r[4] else 0,
                    "hit_count": int(r[5]) if r[5] else 0,
                    "tag": r[6].strip() if r[6] else "",
                    "dim_a": r[7].strip() if r[7] else "",
                    "dim_b": r[8].strip() if r[8] else "",
                    "dim_c": r[9].strip() if r[9] else "",
                    "dim_d": r[10].strip() if r[10] else ""
                })
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 撈取黑馬清單失敗: {e}")
    return stocks

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【3. 撈取個股詳細數據與 3-Way 離場勝率】
# ==========================================
def get_stock_explain_data(stock_code):
    data = {
        "name": stock_code, "date": "最新", "price": 0, "obv": 0, "obv5": 0, "obv34": 0, 
        "m5": 0, "m20": 0, "m60": 0, "f5": 0, "f20": 0, "score": 0, "score5": 0, "score20": 0,
        "exit_5ma_win": 0.0, "exit_5ma_ret": 0.0,
        "exit_10ma_win": 0.0, "exit_10ma_ret": 0.0,
        "exit_20ma_win": 0.0, "exit_20ma_ret": 0.0,
        "optimal_exit": "🔥 20MA 勝出 (預設波段防守)"
    }
    sql_allcross = """
    SELECT TOP 1 名稱, 日期, 成交價, obv淨額, obv_ma5, obv_ma34, price_ma5, price_ma20, price_ma60, 三大法人_ma5, 三大法人_ma20
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live WHERE 代號 = ? ORDER BY 日期 DESC
    """
    sql_score = """
    SELECT TOP 1 ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, M.專家實戰總分), SCH.實戰總分_ma5, SCH.實戰總分_ma20
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory SCH ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(SCH.代號) AND M.日期 = SCH.日期
    WHERE RTRIM(M.代號) = ? ORDER BY M.日期 DESC
    """
    sql_3exits = """
    SELECT WinRate_5MA, Return_5MA, WinRate_10MA, Return_10MA, WinRate_20MA, Return_20MA, OptimalExit
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits WHERE 代號 = ?
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql_allcross, (stock_code.strip(),))
            r = cursor.fetchone()
            if r:
                data["name"] = r[0].strip() if r[0] else stock_code
                data["date"] = str(r[1]).strip() if r[1] else "最新"
                data["price"] = float(r[2]) if r[2] else 0
                data["obv"] = float(r[3]) if r[3] else 0
                data["obv5"] = float(r[4]) if r[4] else 0
                data["obv34"] = float(r[5]) if r[5] else 0
                data["m5"] = float(r[6]) if r[6] else 0
                data["m20"] = float(r[7]) if r[7] else 0
                data["m60"] = float(r[8]) if r[8] else 0
                data["f5"] = float(r[9]) if r[9] else 0
                data["f20"] = float(r[10]) if r[10] else 0
                
            cursor.execute(sql_score, (stock_code.strip(),))
            rs = cursor.fetchone()
            if rs:
                data["score"] = float(rs[0]) if rs[0] else 0
                data["score5"] = float(rs[1]) if rs[1] else data["score"]
                data["score20"] = float(rs[2]) if rs[2] else data["score"]

            cursor.execute(sql_3exits, (stock_code.strip(),))
            r3 = cursor.fetchone()
            if r3:
                data["exit_5ma_win"] = float(r3[0]) if r3[0] else 0.0
                data["exit_5ma_ret"] = float(r3[1]) if r3[1] else 0.0
                data["exit_10ma_win"] = float(r3[2]) if r3[2] else 0.0
                data["exit_10ma_ret"] = float(r3[3]) if r3[3] else 0.0
                data["exit_20ma_win"] = float(r3[4]) if r3[4] else 0.0
                data["exit_20ma_ret"] = float(r3[5]) if r3[5] else 0.0
                data["optimal_exit"] = str(r3[6]).strip() if r3[6] else "🔥 20MA 勝出"
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 撈取 {stock_code} 詳細資料提醒: {e}")
    return data

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【4. Qwen-7B 生成解盤 ＋ 強行注入 3-Way 樹狀卡片】
# ==========================================
def generate_explanation_with_pk(data):
    f5_val, f20_val = data['f5'], data['f20']
    f5_str = f"買超 {f5_val:.1f} 張" if f5_val >= 0 else f"賣超 {abs(f5_val):.1f} 張"
    f20_str = f"買超 {f20_val:.1f} 張" if f20_val >= 0 else f"賣超 {abs(f20_val):.1f} 張"
    
    score_val, score20_val = data['score'], data['score20']
    score_str = f"多頭正分 +{score_val:.2f} 分" if score_val >= 0 else f"空頭負分 {score_val:.2f} 分"
    score20_str = f"正分 +{score20_val:.2f} 分" if score20_val >= 0 else f"負分 {score20_val:.2f} 分"

    e5_win, e5_ret = data.get("exit_5ma_win", 0.0), data.get("exit_5ma_ret", 0.0)
    e10_win, e10_ret = data.get("exit_10ma_win", 0.0), data.get("exit_10ma_ret", 0.0)
    e20_win, e20_ret = data.get("exit_20ma_win", 0.0), data.get("exit_20ma_ret", 0.0)
    optimal_exit = data.get("optimal_exit", "🔥 20MA 勝出 (預設波段防守)")

    e5_ret_str = f"+{e5_ret:.2f}%" if e5_ret >= 0 else f"{e5_ret:.2f}%"
    e10_ret_str = f"+{e10_ret:.2f}%" if e10_ret >= 0 else f"{e10_ret:.2f}%"
    e20_ret_str = f"+{e20_ret:.2f}%" if e20_ret >= 0 else f"{e20_ret:.2f}%"

    pk_block = (
        f"📊 該股歷史離場戰術實測 PK（站 5MA 買進）：\n"
        f"├─ 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {e5_win:.1f}% | 期望值 {e5_ret_str}\n"
        f"├─ ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {e10_win:.1f}% | 期望值 {e10_ret_str}\n"
        f"└─ 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {e20_win:.1f}% | 期望值 {e20_ret_str}\n"
        f"🎯 最適戰術建議：【{optimal_exit}】"
    )

    prompt = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監。使用者正在看你發送的「一鍵四大圖表同步聯動共振圖」。
請解說【{data['name']} ({data['name']})】今日盤後資料：
- 現價：{data['price']}元 | 5MA：{data['m5']}元 | 20MA：{data['m20']}元 | 60MA：{data['m60']}元
- 三大法人 5MA：{f5_str}，20MA：{f20_str}
- 實戰總分：當前為 {score_str}，20日均分為 {score20_str}

請嚴格分成以下五大段，每段 60~90 字，精準一針見血：
📌 【圖一：價格與均線防守】
📌 【圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振】
📌 【圖二：OBV星號爆發解讀】
📌 【圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振】
📌 【指揮官實戰總結指引】（給出下營業日開盤目標價與防守價與本金凱利部位％配置建議）
請全部使用繁體中文回覆。"""

    try:
        r = requests.post(OLLAMA_URL, json={"model": MODEL_NAME, "prompt": prompt, "stream": False}, timeout=120)
        ai_response = r.json().get("response", "⚠️ AI 生成異常。")
        
        # 👑【強效注入】：在第五段標題下方，強行注入 100% 精準的 PK 樹狀文字卡片
        if "📌 【指揮官實戰總結" in ai_response:
            parts = ai_response.split("📌 【指揮官實戰總結")
            final_output = parts[0] + "📌 【指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n" + pk_block + "\n\n" + parts[1].replace("指引】", "").strip()
        else:
            final_output = ai_response + "\n\n📌 【指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n" + pk_block
            
        return final_output
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 本地 AI 連線超時: {e}"

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【5. Telegram 訊息與圖片發送函數】
# ==========================================
def send_telegram_text(text_msg):
    url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_TOKEN}/sendMessage"
    try:
        requests.post(url, json={"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID, "text": text_msg}, timeout=15)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ TG 發送文字失敗: {e}")

def send_telegram_photo(photo_path, caption_text):
    url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_TOKEN}/sendPhoto"
    try:
        with open(photo_path, 'rb') as f:
            data = {'chat_id': TG_CHAT_ID, 'caption': caption_text}
            requests.post(url, files={'photo': f}, data=data, timeout=15)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ TG 發送圖片失敗: {e}")

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【6. Playwright 截圖 ＋ 多模態廣播主流程】
# ==========================================
async def capture_and_broadcast_stock(stock_code, stock_name, stock_info):
    data = get_stock_explain_data(stock_code)
    explain_text = generate_explanation_with_pk(data)

    today = datetime.datetime.now()
    one_year_ago = (today - datetime.timedelta(days=365)).strftime('%Y%m%d')
    timestamp_now = int(time.time() * 1000)

    url = f"https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/excelsql2.html?stock={stock_code.strip()}&start={one_year_ago}&_v={timestamp_now}"
    photo_filename = f"chart_{stock_code}_{timestamp_now}.png"
    output_path = os.path.join(STATIC_DIR, photo_filename)

    from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = await browser.new_context(
            viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 1300}, 
            ignore_https_errors=True,
            bypass_csp=True,
            extra_http_headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate"}
        )
        page = await context.new_page()

        try:
            await page.goto(url, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=60000)
            await asyncio.sleep(2.0)

            # 模擬點擊「⚡ 盤後聯動 (歷史)」按鈕
            btn_post = page.locator("#btn_query_post")
            if await btn_post.count() > 0 and await btn_post.is_visible():
                await btn_post.click()
            else:
                await page.evaluate("""
                    const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, input[type="button"], a'))
                        .find(el => el.textContent.includes('歷史') || el.textContent.includes('聯動'));
                    if (btn) btn.click();
                """)

            await asyncio.sleep(4.5)

            # 畫面淨化 (擷取四大圖表)
            await page.evaluate("""
                const p = document.getElementById('html-chart-price');
                const c = document.getElementById('html-chart-cross');
                const o = document.getElementById('html-chart-obv');
                const s = document.getElementById('html-chart-score');
                
                if (p && o && s) {
                    const container = document.createElement('div');
                    container.id = 'clean-charts-container';
                    container.style.backgroundColor = '#0c1827';
                    container.style.padding = '10px';
                    container.style.width = '100%';
                    
                    container.appendChild(p);
                    if (c) container.appendChild(c);
                    container.appendChild(o);
                    container.appendChild(s);
                    
                    document.body.insertBefore(container, document.body.firstChild);
                    document.querySelectorAll('body > *').forEach(el => {
                        if (el.id !== 'clean-charts-container') el.style.display = 'none';
                    });
                }
            """)
            await asyncio.sleep(2.0)
            await page.screenshot(path=output_path, full_page=True)
            print(f"✅ [{stock_code} {stock_name}] 四大圖表截圖完成！")

            # 推送照片與 AI 報告至 Telegram 群組
            caption_head = (
                f"📊 戰情室一鍵聯動圖表 (雙Y軸極致版)\n"
                f"股號: {stock_code} {stock_name}\n"
                f"現價: {stock_info['price']} 元 | 漲幅: {stock_info['change']}%\n"
                f"成交總量: {stock_info['volume']:,} 張\n"
                f"標籤: {stock_info['tag']}\n"
                f"產生時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')}"
            )
            
            if len(explain_text) <= 900:
                send_telegram_photo(output_path, f"{caption_head}\n\n{explain_text}")
            else:
                send_telegram_photo(output_path, caption_head)
                send_telegram_text(explain_text)

            print(f"🚀 [{stock_code} {stock_name}] 已成功播報至 Telegram 群組！")

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ [{stock_code}] 截圖播報失敗: {e}")
        finally:
            await browser.close()

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【7. 盤後播報總控制流程】
# ==========================================
async def main_broadcast():
    print("=" * 65)
    print(f"📡 【Zen AI 戰情室 13:35 盤後多維共振黑馬自動化廣播 V1.1】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 當前時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print(f"⚙️ 篩選標準: 總量 >= {MIN_VOLUME:,} 張 | 股價 >= {MIN_PRICE} 元 | 共振維度 >= 3")
    print("=" * 65)

    # 1. 刷新全市場多維共振快照
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            print("🔄 正在刷新全市場多維共振快照表...")
            cursor.execute("EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_RefreshMultiResonanceSnapshot;")
            conn.commit()
            print("✅ 快照表重構完成！")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 快照表重構提醒: {e}")

    # 2. 抓取當天前 3~5 檔頂級黑馬
    stocks = get_top_resonance_stocks(top_n=TOP_N, min_vol=MIN_VOLUME, min_px=MIN_PRICE)
    if not stocks:
        print(f"⚠️ 今日無符合「總量 >= {MIN_VOLUME:,} 張 且 3維以上共振」的黑馬個股，跳過播報。")
        return

    # 3. 發送盤後開場總覽導讀導言
    today_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d')
    header_msg = (
        f"📡【Zen AI 戰情室 13:35 盤後多維共振黑馬播報】\n"
        f"📅 日期：{today_str} 盤後結算\n"
        f"🔥 篩選門檻：總量 ≥ {MIN_VOLUME:,} 張 ✕ 有量有價 ✕ 3~4維全共振\n"
        f"🎯 今日精選 {len(stocks)} 檔主力焦點起漲黑馬：\n\n"
    )
    for idx, s in enumerate(stocks, 1):
        header_msg += f"{idx}. {s['code']} {s['name']} (現價:{s['price']}元 | 漲幅:{s['change']}% | 總量:{s['volume']:,}張) - {s['tag']}\n"
    
    header_msg += "\n----------------------------------------\n以下為各個股的高清四大圖表與 AI 操盤手戰術報告："
    send_telegram_text(header_msg)
    time.sleep(2)

    # 4. 逐一推播每檔個股圖表與 AI 報告
    for s in stocks:
        print(f"\n🎯 開始廣播個股: {s['code']} {s['name']} (總量:{s['volume']:,}張)...")
        await capture_and_broadcast_stock(s['code'], s['name'], s)
        time.sleep(3) # 間隔 3 秒避免 API 頻率限制

    print("\n🎉 🎉 今日 13:35 盤後多維共振黑馬廣播全數完成！")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main_broadcast())

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆 本腳本為【Zen AI 盤後 13:35 多維共振黑馬自動化 Telegram + Facebook 社團雙推播機器人 V1.2】
# 每日 13:35 自動抓取「4維全共振」與「雙動能翻正」且「總量 >= 3,000/5,000張」之黑馬，同步發送 TG 與 FB！

# 🛠️【1. 設定區】
# ==========================================
SERVER = "pc048000110"

CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={{SQL Server}};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'

# --- Telegram 設定 ---
ENABLE_TG = True
TG_TOKEN = "8769891212:AAEPDZeQIMQEJYbDbYyIecYOV06szBRcbEw"   
TG_CHAT_ID = "-1003926900701"  # 🟢【Zen AI 量化戰情室】TG 群組 ID

# --- Facebook 社團設定 ---
ENABLE_FB = True
FB_GROUP_ID = "1592528919074970"  # 🟢 您的 FB 社團 ID
FB_ACCESS_TOKEN = "請在此填入您的_FB_Page_or_User_Access_Token"  # 具有 publish 權限的 Token

# --- 本地 Ollama AI 設定 ---
OLLAMA_URL = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
MODEL_NAME = "qwen2.5:7b"

# --- 🎯 有量有價核心門檻 ---
MIN_VOLUME = 3000   # 成交總量門檻 (張)，可彈性設為 3000 或 5000
MIN_PRICE = 10.0    # 最低股價門檻 (排除極端低價水餃股)
TOP_N = 3           # 每日精選推播檔數 (3~5 檔)

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【2. 資料庫撈取：抓取當天 3~5 檔頂級黑馬】
# ==========================================
def get_top_resonance_stocks(top_n=TOP_N, min_vol=MIN_VOLUME, min_px=MIN_PRICE):
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP (?)
        [代號], [名稱], [盤中成交價] AS [現價], [盤中漲幅] AS [漲幅%], [盤中總量] AS [總量],
        [HitCount] AS [共振維度數], [ResonanceTag] AS [共振等級],
        [DimA_Status] AS [雙動能狀態], [DimB_Status] AS [OBV星號狀態], [DimC_Status] AS [價格星號狀態], [DimD_Status] AS [彩虹金叉狀態]
    FROM [stockchangedate].[dbo].[ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot]
    WHERE [HitCount] >= 3
      AND [盤中總量] >= ?                               -- 🟢 總量門檻 (>= 3,000 / 5,000 張)
      AND [盤中成交價] >= ?                              -- 🟢 排除極端低價股
      AND ([HitCount] = 4 OR [DimA_DualMomentum] = 2)   -- 4維全共振 或 雙動能剛由負翻正
    ORDER BY [HitCount] DESC, [DimD_RainbowScore] DESC, [盤中總量] DESC;
    """
    stocks = []
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (top_n, min_vol, min_px))
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            for r in rows:
                stocks.append({
                    "code": r[0].strip(),
                    "name": r[1].strip(),
                    "price": float(r[2]) if r[2] else 0.0,
                    "change": float(r[3]) if r[3] else 0.0,
                    "volume": int(r[4]) if r[4] else 0,
                    "hit_count": int(r[5]) if r[5] else 0,
                    "tag": r[6].strip() if r[6] else "",
                    "dim_a": r[7].strip() if r[7] else "",
                    "dim_b": r[8].strip() if r[8] else "",
                    "dim_c": r[9].strip() if r[9] else "",
                    "dim_d": r[10].strip() if r[10] else ""
                })
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 撈取黑馬清單失敗: {e}")
    return stocks

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【3. 撈取個股詳細數據與 3-Way 離場勝率】
# ==========================================
def get_stock_explain_data(stock_code):
    data = {
        "name": stock_code, "date": "最新", "price": 0, "obv": 0, "obv5": 0, "obv34": 0, 
        "m5": 0, "m20": 0, "m60": 0, "f5": 0, "f20": 0, "score": 0, "score5": 0, "score20": 0,
        "exit_5ma_win": 0.0, "exit_5ma_ret": 0.0,
        "exit_10ma_win": 0.0, "exit_10ma_ret": 0.0,
        "exit_20ma_win": 0.0, "exit_20ma_ret": 0.0,
        "optimal_exit": "🔥 20MA 勝出 (預設波段防守)"
    }
    sql_allcross = """
    SELECT TOP 1 名稱, 日期, 成交價, obv淨額, obv_ma5, obv_ma34, price_ma5, price_ma20, price_ma60, 三大法人_ma5, 三大法人_ma20
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live WHERE 代號 = ? ORDER BY 日期 DESC
    """
    sql_score = """
    SELECT TOP 1 ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, M.專家實戰總分), SCH.實戰總分_ma5, SCH.實戰總分_ma20
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory SCH ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(SCH.代號) AND M.日期 = SCH.日期
    WHERE RTRIM(M.代號) = ? ORDER BY M.日期 DESC
    """
    sql_3exits = """
    SELECT WinRate_5MA, Return_5MA, WinRate_10MA, Return_10MA, WinRate_20MA, Return_20MA, OptimalExit
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits WHERE 代號 = ?
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql_allcross, (stock_code.strip(),))
            r = cursor.fetchone()
            if r:
                data["name"] = r[0].strip() if r[0] else stock_code
                data["date"] = str(r[1]).strip() if r[1] else "最新"
                data["price"] = float(r[2]) if r[2] else 0
                data["obv"] = float(r[3]) if r[3] else 0
                data["obv5"] = float(r[4]) if r[4] else 0
                data["obv34"] = float(r[5]) if r[5] else 0
                data["m5"] = float(r[6]) if r[6] else 0
                data["m20"] = float(r[7]) if r[7] else 0
                data["m60"] = float(r[8]) if r[8] else 0
                data["f5"] = float(r[9]) if r[9] else 0
                data["f20"] = float(r[10]) if r[10] else 0
                
            cursor.execute(sql_score, (stock_code.strip(),))
            rs = cursor.fetchone()
            if rs:
                data["score"] = float(rs[0]) if rs[0] else 0
                data["score5"] = float(rs[1]) if rs[1] else data["score"]
                data["score20"] = float(rs[2]) if rs[2] else data["score"]

            cursor.execute(sql_3exits, (stock_code.strip(),))
            r3 = cursor.fetchone()
            if r3:
                data["exit_5ma_win"] = float(r3[0]) if r3[0] else 0.0
                data["exit_5ma_ret"] = float(r3[1]) if r3[1] else 0.0
                data["exit_10ma_win"] = float(r3[2]) if r3[2] else 0.0
                data["exit_10ma_ret"] = float(r3[3]) if r3[3] else 0.0
                data["exit_20ma_win"] = float(r3[4]) if r3[4] else 0.0
                data["exit_20ma_ret"] = float(r3[5]) if r3[5] else 0.0
                data["optimal_exit"] = str(r3[6]).strip() if r3[6] else "🔥 20MA 勝出"
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 撈取 {stock_code} 詳細資料提醒: {e}")
    return data

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【4. Qwen-7B 生成解盤 ＋ 注入 3-Way 樹狀卡片】
# ==========================================
def generate_explanation_with_pk(data):
    f5_val, f20_val = data['f5'], data['f20']
    f5_str = f"買超 {f5_val:.1f} 張" if f5_val >= 0 else f"賣超 {abs(f5_val):.1f} 張"
    f20_str = f"買超 {f20_val:.1f} 張" if f20_val >= 0 else f"賣超 {abs(f20_val):.1f} 張"
    
    score_val, score20_val = data['score'], data['score20']
    score_str = f"多頭正分 +{score_val:.2f} 分" if score_val >= 0 else f"空頭負分 {score_val:.2f} 分"
    score20_str = f"正分 +{score20_val:.2f} 分" if score20_val >= 0 else f"負分 {score20_val:.2f} 分"

    e5_win, e5_ret = data.get("exit_5ma_win", 0.0), data.get("exit_5ma_ret", 0.0)
    e10_win, e10_ret = data.get("exit_10ma_win", 0.0), data.get("exit_10ma_ret", 0.0)
    e20_win, e20_ret = data.get("exit_20ma_win", 0.0), data.get("exit_20ma_ret", 0.0)
    optimal_exit = data.get("optimal_exit", "🔥 20MA 勝出 (預設波段防守)")

    e5_ret_str = f"+{e5_ret:.2f}%" if e5_ret >= 0 else f"{e5_ret:.2f}%"
    e10_ret_str = f"+{e10_ret:.2f}%" if e10_ret >= 0 else f"{e10_ret:.2f}%"
    e20_ret_str = f"+{e20_ret:.2f}%" if e20_ret >= 0 else f"{e20_ret:.2f}%"

    pk_block = (
        f"📊 該股歷史離場戰術實測 PK（站 5MA 買進）：\n"
        f"├─ 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {e5_win:.1f}% | 期望值 {e5_ret_str}\n"
        f"├─ ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {e10_win:.1f}% | 期望值 {e10_ret_str}\n"
        f"└─ 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {e20_win:.1f}% | 期望值 {e20_ret_str}\n"
        f"🎯 最適戰術建議：【{optimal_exit}】"
    )

    prompt = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監。使用者正在看你發送的「一鍵四大圖表同步聯動共振圖」。
請解說【{data['name']} ({data['name']})】今日盤後資料：
- 現價：{data['price']}元 | 5MA：{data['m5']}元 | 20MA：{data['m20']}元 | 60MA：{data['m60']}元
- 三大法人 5MA：{f5_str}，20MA：{f20_str}
- 實戰總分：當前為 {score_str}，20日均分為 {score20_str}

請嚴格分成以下五大段，每段 60~90 字，精準一針見血：
📌 【圖一：價格與均線防守】
📌 【圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振】
📌 【圖二：OBV星號爆發解讀】
📌 【圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振】
📌 【指揮官實戰總結指引】（給出下營業日開盤目標價與防守價與本金凱利部位％配置建議）
請全部使用繁體中文回覆。"""

    try:
        r = requests.post(OLLAMA_URL, json={"model": MODEL_NAME, "prompt": prompt, "stream": False}, timeout=120)
        ai_response = r.json().get("response", "⚠️ AI 生成異常。")
        
        if "📌 【指揮官實戰總結" in ai_response:
            parts = ai_response.split("📌 【指揮官實戰總結")
            final_output = parts[0] + "📌 【指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n" + pk_block + "\n\n" + parts[1].replace("指引】", "").strip()
        else:
            final_output = ai_response + "\n\n📌 【指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n" + pk_block
            
        return final_output
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 本地 AI 連線超時: {e}"

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【5. TG & Facebook 社團廣播函數】
# ==========================================
def send_telegram_text(text_msg):
    if not ENABLE_TG or not TG_TOKEN:
        return
    url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_TOKEN}/sendMessage"
    try:
        requests.post(url, json={"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID, "text": text_msg}, timeout=15)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ TG 發送文字失敗: {e}")

def send_telegram_photo(photo_path, caption_text):
    if not ENABLE_TG or not TG_TOKEN:
        return
    url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_TOKEN}/sendPhoto"
    try:
        with open(photo_path, 'rb') as f:
            data = {'chat_id': TG_CHAT_ID, 'caption': caption_text}
            requests.post(url, files={'photo': f}, data=data, timeout=15)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ TG 發送圖片失敗: {e}")

def send_facebook_text(text_msg):
    """透過 Facebook Graph API 發布純文字貼文至社團"""
    if not ENABLE_FB or not FB_ACCESS_TOKEN or "請在此填入" in FB_ACCESS_TOKEN:
        return
    url = f"https://graph.facebook.com/v20.0/{FB_GROUP_ID}/feed"
    try:
        payload = {'message': text_msg, 'access_token': FB_ACCESS_TOKEN}
        r = requests.post(url, data=payload, timeout=20)
        res_json = r.json()
        if "id" in res_json:
            print(f"✅ FB 社團文字導讀發布成功！Post ID: {res_json['id']}")
        else:
            print(f"⚠️ FB 社團發布提醒: {res_json}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ FB 社團文字發布失敗: {e}")

def send_facebook_photo(photo_path, caption_text):
    """透過 Facebook Graph API 發布高清圖表與完整 AI 分析至社團"""
    if not ENABLE_FB or not FB_ACCESS_TOKEN or "請在此填入" in FB_ACCESS_TOKEN:
        return
    url = f"https://graph.facebook.com/v20.0/{FB_GROUP_ID}/photos"
    try:
        with open(photo_path, 'rb') as f:
            payload = {'caption': caption_text, 'access_token': FB_ACCESS_TOKEN}
            files = {'source': f}
            r = requests.post(url, data=payload, files=files, timeout=30)
            res_json = r.json()
            if "id" in res_json or "post_id" in res_json:
                print(f"✅ FB 社團圖文貼文發布成功！ID: {res_json.get('id', res_json.get('post_id'))}")
            else:
                print(f"⚠️ FB 社團圖文發布提醒: {res_json}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ FB 社團圖文發布失敗: {e}")

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【6. Playwright 截圖 ＋ 跨平台推播主流程】
# ==========================================
async def capture_and_broadcast_stock(stock_code, stock_name, stock_info):
    data = get_stock_explain_data(stock_code)
    explain_text = generate_explanation_with_pk(data)

    today = datetime.datetime.now()
    one_year_ago = (today - datetime.timedelta(days=365)).strftime('%Y%m%d')
    timestamp_now = int(time.time() * 1000)

    url = f"https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/excelsql2.html?stock={stock_code.strip()}&start={one_year_ago}&_v={timestamp_now}"
    photo_filename = f"chart_{stock_code}_{timestamp_now}.png"
    output_path = os.path.join(STATIC_DIR, photo_filename)

    from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = await browser.new_context(
            viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 1300}, 
            ignore_https_errors=True,
            bypass_csp=True,
            extra_http_headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate"}
        )
        page = await context.new_page()

        try:
            await page.goto(url, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=60000)
            await asyncio.sleep(2.0)

            btn_post = page.locator("#btn_query_post")
            if await btn_post.count() > 0 and await btn_post.is_visible():
                await btn_post.click()
            else:
                await page.evaluate("""
                    const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, input[type="button"], a'))
                        .find(el => el.textContent.includes('歷史') || el.textContent.includes('聯動'));
                    if (btn) btn.click();
                """)

            await asyncio.sleep(4.5)

            # 畫面淨化 (擷取四大圖表)
            await page.evaluate("""
                const p = document.getElementById('html-chart-price');
                const c = document.getElementById('html-chart-cross');
                const o = document.getElementById('html-chart-obv');
                const s = document.getElementById('html-chart-score');
                
                if (p && o && s) {
                    const container = document.createElement('div');
                    container.id = 'clean-charts-container';
                    container.style.backgroundColor = '#0c1827';
                    container.style.padding = '10px';
                    container.style.width = '100%';
                    
                    container.appendChild(p);
                    if (c) container.appendChild(c);
                    container.appendChild(o);
                    container.appendChild(s);
                    
                    document.body.insertBefore(container, document.body.firstChild);
                    document.querySelectorAll('body > *').forEach(el => {
                        if (el.id !== 'clean-charts-container') el.style.display = 'none';
                    });
                }
            """)
            await asyncio.sleep(2.0)
            await page.screenshot(path=output_path, full_page=True)
            print(f"✅ [{stock_code} {stock_name}] 四大圖表截圖完成！")

            caption_head = (
                f"📊 【Zen AI 量化戰情室】多維共振戰報\n"
                f"股號: {stock_code} {stock_name}\n"
                f"現價: {stock_info['price']} 元 | 漲幅: {stock_info['change']}%\n"
                f"成交總量: {stock_info['volume']:,} 張\n"
                f"標籤: {stock_info['tag']}\n"
                f"時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')}"
            )
            
            full_post_content = f"{caption_head}\n\n{explain_text}"

            # 1. 發送至 Telegram
            if len(explain_text) <= 900:
                send_telegram_photo(output_path, full_post_content)
            else:
                send_telegram_photo(output_path, caption_head)
                send_telegram_text(explain_text)

            # 2. 發送至 Facebook 社團
            send_facebook_photo(output_path, full_post_content)

            print(f"🚀 [{stock_code} {stock_name}] 已成功同步發送至 TG 群組 與 FB 社團！")

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ [{stock_code}] 截圖播報失敗: {e}")
        finally:
            await browser.close()

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【7. 盤後播報總控制流程】
# ==========================================
async def main_broadcast():
    print("=" * 65)
    print(f"📡 【Zen AI 戰情室 13:35 盤後多維共振黑馬雙平台廣播 V1.2】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 當前時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print(f"⚙️ 篩選標準: 總量 >= {MIN_VOLUME:,} 張 | 股價 >= {MIN_PRICE} 元 | 共振維度 >= 3")
    print("=" * 65)

    # 1. 刷新全市場多維共振快照
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            print("🔄 正在刷新全市場多維共振快照表...")
            cursor.execute("EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_RefreshMultiResonanceSnapshot;")
            conn.commit()
            print("✅ 快照表重構完成！")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 快照表重構提醒: {e}")

    # 2. 抓取符合總量門檻的頂級黑馬

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# login_fb.py - 一次性登入 FB 記錄 Session
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

USER_DATA_DIR = r"C:\test_c\fb_user_data"

async def first_time_login():
    print("🌐 正在開啟專屬瀏覽器，請在彈出的視窗中登入您的 Facebook 帳號...")
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        context = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
            user_data_dir=USER_DATA_DIR,
            headless=False,
            viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 800},
            args=["--disable-notifications"]
        )
        page = await context.new_page()
        await page.goto("https://www.facebook.com/groups/1592528919074970")
        
        print("👉 請在瀏覽器中完成登入。登入完成並看到社團首頁後，請回到此視窗按 Enter 結束...")
        input("✅ 登入完成後請按 [Enter] 鍵儲存並關閉：")
        await context.close()
        print("🎉 登入 Session 已永久儲存至 C:\\test_c\\fb_user_data！")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(first_time_login())

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆 本腳本為【Zen AI 盤後 13:35 多維共振黑馬 Telegram + Facebook 自動化推播 V2.0】

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import asyncio
import requests
import pyodbc
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【1. 設定區】
# ==========================================
SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchangedate"
CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={{SQL Server}};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'

# --- Telegram 設定 ---
ENABLE_TG = True
TG_TOKEN = "8769891212:AAEPDZeQIMQEJYbDbYyIecYOV06szBRcbEw"   
TG_CHAT_ID = "-1003926900701"

# --- Facebook 社團設定 (Playwright RPA 自動化) ---
ENABLE_FB = True
FB_GROUP_URL = "https://www.facebook.com/groups/1592528919074970"
FB_USER_DATA = r"C:\test_c\fb_user_data"

# --- 本地 Ollama AI 設定 ---
OLLAMA_URL = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
MODEL_NAME = "qwen2.5:7b"

# --- 🎯 有量有價核心門檻 ---
MIN_VOLUME = 3000   # 成交總量門檻 (張)
MIN_PRICE = 10.0    # 股價門檻 (排除極端低價水餃股)
TOP_N = 3           # 每日精選推播檔數 (3~5 檔)

STATIC_DIR = r"C:\test_c\static"
os.makedirs(STATIC_DIR, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(FB_USER_DATA, exist_ok=True)

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【2. 資料庫撈取：抓取當天頂級黑馬】
# ==========================================
def get_top_resonance_stocks(top_n=TOP_N, min_vol=MIN_VOLUME, min_px=MIN_PRICE):
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP (?)
        [代號], [名稱], [盤中成交價] AS [現價], [盤中漲幅] AS [漲幅%], [盤中總量] AS [總量],
        [HitCount] AS [共振維度數], [ResonanceTag] AS [共振等級],
        [DimA_Status] AS [雙動能狀態], [DimB_Status] AS [OBV星號狀態], [DimC_Status] AS [價格星號狀態], [DimD_Status] AS [彩虹金叉狀態]
    FROM [stockchangedate].[dbo].[ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot]
    WHERE [HitCount] >= 3
      AND [盤中總量] >= ?
      AND [盤中成交價] >= ?
      AND ([HitCount] = 4 OR [DimA_DualMomentum] = 2)
    ORDER BY [HitCount] DESC, [DimD_RainbowScore] DESC, [盤中總量] DESC;
    """
    stocks = []
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (top_n, min_vol, min_px))
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            for r in rows:
                stocks.append({
                    "code": r[0].strip(),
                    "name": r[1].strip(),
                    "price": float(r[2]) if r[2] else 0.0,
                    "change": float(r[3]) if r[3] else 0.0,
                    "volume": int(r[4]) if r[4] else 0,
                    "hit_count": int(r[5]) if r[5] else 0,
                    "tag": r[6].strip() if r[6] else "",
                    "dim_a": r[7].strip() if r[7] else "",
                    "dim_b": r[8].strip() if r[8] else "",
                    "dim_c": r[9].strip() if r[9] else "",
                    "dim_d": r[10].strip() if r[10] else ""
                })
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 撈取黑馬清單失敗: {e}")
    return stocks

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【3. 撈取個股詳細數據與 3-Way 離場勝率】
# ==========================================
def get_stock_explain_data(stock_code):
    data = {
        "name": stock_code, "date": "最新", "price": 0, "obv": 0, "obv5": 0, "obv34": 0, 
        "m5": 0, "m20": 0, "m60": 0, "f5": 0, "f20": 0, "score": 0, "score5": 0, "score20": 0,
        "exit_5ma_win": 0.0, "exit_5ma_ret": 0.0,
        "exit_10ma_win": 0.0, "exit_10ma_ret": 0.0,
        "exit_20ma_win": 0.0, "exit_20ma_ret": 0.0,
        "optimal_exit": "🔥 20MA 勝出 (預設波段防守)"
    }
    sql_allcross = """
    SELECT TOP 1 名稱, 日期, 成交價, obv淨額, obv_ma5, obv_ma34, price_ma5, price_ma20, price_ma60, 三大法人_ma5, 三大法人_ma20
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live WHERE 代號 = ? ORDER BY 日期 DESC
    """
    sql_score = """
    SELECT TOP 1 ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, M.專家實戰總分), SCH.實戰總分_ma5, SCH.實戰總分_ma20
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory SCH ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(SCH.代號) AND M.日期 = SCH.日期
    WHERE RTRIM(M.代號) = ? ORDER BY M.日期 DESC
    """
    sql_3exits = """
    SELECT WinRate_5MA, Return_5MA, WinRate_10MA, Return_10MA, WinRate_20MA, Return_20MA, OptimalExit
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits WHERE 代號 = ?
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql_allcross, (stock_code.strip(),))
            r = cursor.fetchone()
            if r:
                data["name"] = r[0].strip() if r[0] else stock_code
                data["date"] = str(r[1]).strip() if r[1] else "最新"
                data["price"] = float(r[2]) if r[2] else 0
                data["obv"] = float(r[3]) if r[3] else 0
                data["obv5"] = float(r[4]) if r[4] else 0
                data["obv34"] = float(r[5]) if r[5] else 0
                data["m5"] = float(r[6]) if r[6] else 0
                data["m20"] = float(r[7]) if r[7] else 0
                data["m60"] = float(r[8]) if r[8] else 0
                data["f5"] = float(r[9]) if r[9] else 0
                data["f20"] = float(r[10]) if r[10] else 0
                
            cursor.execute(sql_score, (stock_code.strip(),))
            rs = cursor.fetchone()
            if rs:
                data["score"] = float(rs[0]) if rs[0] else 0
                data["score5"] = float(rs[1]) if rs[1] else data["score"]
                data["score20"] = float(rs[2]) if rs[2] else data["score"]

            cursor.execute(sql_3exits, (stock_code.strip(),))
            r3 = cursor.fetchone()
            if r3:
                data["exit_5ma_win"] = float(r3[0]) if r3[0] else 0.0
                data["exit_5ma_ret"] = float(r3[1]) if r3[1] else 0.0
                data["exit_10ma_win"] = float(r3[2]) if r3[2] else 0.0
                data["exit_10ma_ret"] = float(r3[3]) if r3[3] else 0.0
                data["exit_20ma_win"] = float(r3[4]) if r3[4] else 0.0
                data["exit_20ma_ret"] = float(r3[5]) if r3[5] else 0.0
                data["optimal_exit"] = str(r3[6]).strip() if r3[6] else "🔥 20MA 勝出"
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 撈取 {stock_code} 詳細資料提醒: {e}")
    return data

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【4. Qwen-7B 生成解盤 ＋ 注入 3-Way 樹狀卡片】
# ==========================================
def generate_explanation_with_pk(data):
    f5_val, f20_val = data['f5'], data['f20']
    f5_str = f"買超 {f5_val:.1f} 張" if f5_val >= 0 else f"賣超 {abs(f5_val):.1f} 張"
    f20_str = f"買超 {f20_val:.1f} 張" if f20_val >= 0 else f"賣超 {abs(f20_val):.1f} 張"
    
    score_val, score20_val = data['score'], data['score20']
    score_str = f"多頭正分 +{score_val:.2f} 分" if score_val >= 0 else f"空頭負分 {score_val:.2f} 分"
    score20_str = f"正分 +{score20_val:.2f} 分" if score20_val >= 0 else f"負分 {score20_val:.2f} 分"

    e5_win, e5_ret = data.get("exit_5ma_win", 0.0), data.get("exit_5ma_ret", 0.0)
    e10_win, e10_ret = data.get("exit_10ma_win", 0.0), data.get("exit_10ma_ret", 0.0)
    e20_win, e20_ret = data.get("exit_20ma_win", 0.0), data.get("exit_20ma_ret", 0.0)
    optimal_exit = data.get("optimal_exit", "🔥 20MA 勝出 (預設波段防守)")

    e5_ret_str = f"+{e5_ret:.2f}%" if e5_ret >= 0 else f"{e5_ret:.2f}%"
    e10_ret_str = f"+{e10_ret:.2f}%" if e10_ret >= 0 else f"{e10_ret:.2f}%"
    e20_ret_str = f"+{e20_ret:.2f}%" if e20_ret >= 0 else f"{e20_ret:.2f}%"

    pk_block = (
        f"📊 該股歷史離場戰術實測 PK（站 5MA 買進）：\n"
        f"├─ 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {e5_win:.1f}% | 期望值 {e5_ret_str}\n"
        f"├─ ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {e10_win:.1f}% | 期望值 {e10_ret_str}\n"
        f"└─ 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {e20_win:.1f}% | 期望值 {e20_ret_str}\n"
        f"🎯 最適戰術建議：【{optimal_exit}】"
    )

    prompt = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監。使用者正在看你發送的「一鍵四大圖表同步聯動共振圖」。
請解說【{data['name']} ({data['name']})】今日盤後資料：
- 現價：{data['price']}元 | 5MA：{data['m5']}元 | 20MA：{data['m20']}元 | 60MA：{data['m60']}元
- 三大法人 5MA：{f5_str}，20MA：{f20_str}
- 實戰總分：當前為 {score_str}，20日均分為 {score20_str}

請嚴格分成以下五大段，每段 60~90 字，精準一針見血：
📌 【圖一：價格與均線防守】
📌 【圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振】
📌 【圖二：OBV星號爆發解讀】
📌 【圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振】
📌 【指揮官實戰總結指引】（給出下營業日開盤目標價與防守價與本金凱利部位％配置建議）
請全部使用繁體中文回覆。"""

    try:
        r = requests.post(OLLAMA_URL, json={"model": MODEL_NAME, "prompt": prompt, "stream": False}, timeout=120)
        ai_response = r.json().get("response", "⚠️ AI 生成異常。")
        
        if "📌 【指揮官實戰總結" in ai_response:
            parts = ai_response.split("📌 【指揮官實戰總結")
            final_output = parts[0] + "📌 【指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n" + pk_block + "\n\n" + parts[1].replace("指引】", "").strip()
        else:
            final_output = ai_response + "\n\n📌 【指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n" + pk_block
            
        return final_output
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 本地 AI 連線超時: {e}"

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【5. TG 訊息發送】
# ==========================================
def send_telegram_text(text_msg):
    if not ENABLE_TG or not TG_TOKEN:
        return
    url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_TOKEN}/sendMessage"
    try:
        requests.post(url, json={"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID, "text": text_msg}, timeout=15)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ TG 發送文字失敗: {e}")

def send_telegram_photo(photo_path, caption_text):
    if not ENABLE_TG or not TG_TOKEN:
        return
    url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_TOKEN}/sendPhoto"
    try:
        with open(photo_path, 'rb') as f:
            data = {'chat_id': TG_CHAT_ID, 'caption': caption_text}
            requests.post(url, files={'photo': f}, data=data, timeout=15)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ TG 發送圖片失敗: {e}")

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【6. Facebook 社團 Playwright RPA 自動發文函數】
# ==========================================
async def post_to_facebook_group(context, photo_path, post_text):
    if not ENABLE_FB:
        return
    try:
        fb_page = await context.new_page()
        await fb_page.goto(FB_GROUP_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=45000)
        await asyncio.sleep(3.0)

        # 點擊「在此建立公開貼文...」或「寫些什麼...」按鈕
        create_post_btn = fb_page.locator("div[role='button']:has-text('在此建立公開貼文'), div[role='button']:has-text('寫些什麼'), div[role='button']:has-text('建立貼文'), span:has-text('在想些什麼')").first
        if await create_post_btn.count() > 0:
            await create_post_btn.click()
            await asyncio.sleep(2.5)

            # 1. 上傳圖片
            file_input = fb_page.locator("input[type='file'][accept*='image']").first
            if await file_input.count() > 0:
                await file_input.set_input_files(photo_path)
                await asyncio.sleep(3.0)

            # 2. 填入分析解盤文字
            textbox = fb_page.locator("div[role='dialog'] div[contenteditable='true'][role='textbox']").first
            if await textbox.count() > 0:
                await textbox.click()
                await fb_page.keyboard.insert_text(post_text)
                await asyncio.sleep(2.0)

            # 3. 點擊「發佈」按鈕
            post_submit_btn = fb_page.locator("div[role='dialog'] div[role='button']:has-text('發佈'), div[role='dialog'] div[role='button']:has-text('發布'), div[role='dialog'] div[role='button']:has-text('Post')").first
            if await post_submit_btn.count() > 0:
                await post_submit_btn.click()
                await asyncio.sleep(5.0)  # 等待上傳發布完畢
                print(f"✅ Facebook 社團自動發文成功！")
            else:
                print("⚠️ 未找到 FB 發佈按鈕")
        else:
            print("⚠️ 未找到 FB 發文框，請確認 login_fb.py 是否已完成登入")
        
        await fb_page.close()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ FB 自動發文提醒: {e}")

# 🛠️【7. Playwright 截圖 ＋ 雙推播主流程】
# ==========================================
async def capture_and_broadcast_stock(context, stock_code, stock_name, stock_info):
    data = get_stock_explain_data(stock_code)
    explain_text = generate_explanation_with_pk(data)

    today = datetime.datetime.now()
    one_year_ago = (today - datetime.timedelta(days=365)).strftime('%Y%m%d')
    timestamp_now = int(time.time() * 1000)

    url = f"https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/excelsql2.html?stock={stock_code.strip()}&start={one_year_ago}&_v={timestamp_now}"
    photo_filename = f"chart_{stock_code}_{timestamp_now}.png"
    output_path = os.path.join(STATIC_DIR, photo_filename)

    page = await context.new_page()
    try:
        await page.goto(url, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=60000)
        await asyncio.sleep(2.0)

        btn_post = page.locator("#btn_query_post")
        if await btn_post.count() > 0 and await btn_post.is_visible():
            await btn_post.click()
        else:
            await page.evaluate("""
                const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, input[type="button"], a'))
                    .find(el => el.textContent.includes('歷史') || el.textContent.includes('聯動'));
                if (btn) btn.click();
            """)

        await asyncio.sleep(4.5)

        # 畫面淨化
        await page.evaluate("""
            const p = document.getElementById('html-chart-price');
            const c = document.getElementById('html-chart-cross');
            const o = document.getElementById('html-chart-obv');
            const s = document.getElementById('html-chart-score');
            if (p && o && s) {
                const container = document.createElement('div');
                container.id = 'clean-charts-container';
                container.style.backgroundColor = '#0c1827';
                container.style.padding = '10px';
                container.style.width = '100%';
                container.appendChild(p);
                if (c) container.appendChild(c);
                container.appendChild(o);
                container.appendChild(s);
                document.body.insertBefore(container, document.body.firstChild);
                document.querySelectorAll('body > *').forEach(el => {
                    if (el.id !== 'clean-charts-container') el.style.display = 'none';
                });
            }
        """)
        await asyncio.sleep(2.0)
        await page.screenshot(path=output_path, full_page=True)
        print(f"✅ [{stock_code} {stock_name}] 四大圖表截圖完成！")

        caption_head = (
            f"📊 【Zen AI 量化戰情室】多維共振戰報\n"
            f"股號: {stock_code} {stock_name}\n"
            f"現價: {stock_info['price']} 元 | 漲幅: {stock_info['change']}%\n"
            f"成交總量: {stock_info['volume']:,} 張\n"
            f"標籤: {stock_info['tag']}\n"
            f"時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')}"
        )
        full_content = f"{caption_head}\n\n{explain_text}"

        # 1. 發送 Telegram
        if len(explain_text) <= 900:
            send_telegram_photo(output_path, full_content)
        else:
            send_telegram_photo(output_path, caption_head)
            send_telegram_text(explain_text)
        print(f"🚀 [{stock_code} {stock_name}] TG 廣播完成！")

        # 2. 自動發布至 Facebook 社團
        await post_to_facebook_group(context, output_path, full_content)

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ [{stock_code}] 處理異常: {e}")
    finally:
        await page.close()

# 🛠️【8. 盤後播報總控制流程】
# ==========================================
async def main_broadcast():
    print("=" * 65)
    print(f"📡 【Zen AI 戰情室 13:35 盤後多維共振黑馬雙平台廣播 V2.0】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 當前時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print(f"⚙️ 篩選標準: 總量 >= {MIN_VOLUME:,} 張 | 股價 >= {MIN_PRICE} 元 | 共振維度 >= 3")
    print("=" * 65)

    # 1. 刷新快照
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            print("🔄 正在刷新全市場多維共振快照表...")
            cursor.execute("EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_RefreshMultiResonanceSnapshot;")
            conn.commit()
            print("✅ 快照表重構完成！")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 快照表重構提醒: {e}")

    # 2. 抓取標的
    stocks = get_top_resonance_stocks(top_n=TOP_N, min_vol=MIN_VOLUME, min_px=MIN_PRICE)
    if not stocks:
        print(f"⚠️ 今日無符合門檻之黑馬個股，跳過播報。")
        return

    # 3. 發送開場導言 (TG)
    today_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d')
    header_msg = (
        f"📡【Zen AI 戰情室 13:35 盤後多維共振黑馬播報】\n"
        f"📅 日期：{today_str} 盤後結算\n"
        f"🔥 篩選門檻：總量 ≥ {MIN_VOLUME:,} 張 ✕ 有量有價 ✕ 3~4維全共振\n"
        f"🎯 今日精選 {len(stocks)} 檔主力焦點起漲黑馬：\n\n"
    )
    for idx, s in enumerate(stocks, 1):
        header_msg += f"{idx}. {s['code']} {s['name']} (現價:{s['price']}元 | 漲幅:{s['change']}% | 總量:{s['volume']:,}張) - {s['tag']}\n"
    
    header_msg += "\n----------------------------------------\n以下為各個股的高清四大圖表與 AI 操盤手戰術報告："
    send_telegram_text(header_msg)

    # 4. 啟動 Playwright 執行截圖與 FB 社團發文
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        context = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
            user_data_dir=FB_USER_DATA,
            headless=False,  # 設為 False 便於發文並可防反爬蟲驗證
            viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 1100},
            args=["--disable-notifications", "--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled"]
        )

        for s in stocks:
            print(f"\n🎯 開始處理個股: {s['code']} {s['name']} (總量:{s['volume']:,}張)...")
            await capture_and_broadcast_stock(context, s['code'], s['name'], s)
            await asyncio.sleep(4.0)

        await context.close()

    print("\n🎉 🎉 今日 13:35 盤後黑馬 TG + FB 社團全自動推播大功告成！")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main_broadcast())

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 專為繞過 FB Arkose Labs 驗證碼設計的登入腳本
import os
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

USER_DATA_DIR = r"C:\test_c\fb_user_data"
os.makedirs(USER_DATA_DIR, exist_ok=True)

async def first_time_login():
    print("[1/3] 正在以【真實 Chrome 人類模式】啟動瀏覽器...")
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        # 🟢 channel="chrome" 調用電腦內建真實 Chrome，徹底解決轉圈圈與驗證碼卡死問題
        context = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
            user_data_dir=USER_DATA_DIR,
            channel="chrome",  # 若沒安裝 Chrome 可改成 "msedge"
            headless=False,
            viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 850},
            ignore_default_args=["--enable-automation"],  # 移除機器人特徵
            args=[
                "--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled",
                "--disable-notifications",
                "--no-sandbox"
            ]
        )
        
        # 覆寫 webdriver 屬性，確保 100% 偽裝為真實使用者
        page = await context.new_page()
        await page.add_init_script("""
            Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'webdriver', {
                get: () => undefined
            });
        """)
        
        print("[2/3] 前往 Facebook 社團頁面...")
        await page.goto("https://www.facebook.com/groups/1592528919074970")
        
        print("\n" + "=" * 60)
        print("👉 現在視窗為真實 Chrome，請在跳出的畫面中輸入帳密並完成登入。")
        print("👉 登入成功進入社團首頁後，回到此黑色視窗按 [Enter] 鍵即可！")
        print("=" * 60 + "\n")
        
        input("✅ 確認已登入完成請按 [Enter] 鍵儲存並關閉：")
        await context.close()
        print("\n🎉 恭喜！登入 Session 已成功永久儲存至 C:\\test_c\\fb_user_data！")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(first_time_login())

🧠 Gemini 的思考路徑：
Analyzing the Error Okay, I'm digging into this error message. It seems like the Playwright context is getting closed prematurely. The `TargetClosedError` points to the browser, context, or page being terminated unexpectedly. I'm focusing on why this is happening before the process completes. The downgrade utility error is a bit beyond my understanding at this time, I'll need to research that further. Pinpointing the Cause I've got a clearer picture now. The access denied errors stem from a version mismatch: the user's native Chrome (likely newer) created a user profile, and Playwright's older bundled Chromium tried to use it. This resulted in a downgrade error due to file locking. The root cause is Playwright's older Chromium trying to use the new Chrome profile. Specifying `channel="chrome"` in the `launch_persistent_context` seems like the cleanest way to resolve this by using the user's Chrome installation.
🤖 GEMINI
這個錯誤發生的原因非常明確： ### 🔍 錯誤原因（版本衝突 / Downgrade Error） * 剛才我們是用電腦上的 原生 Google Chrome (新版本) 登入並建立了 `fb_user_data` 資料夾。 * 隨後 Playwright 啟動時，預設使用了它內建的 舊版 Chromium (`chromium-1228`) 去讀取新版的 Profile，導致 Chrome 觸發保護機制崩潰報錯（`downgrade_utils.cc: 存取被拒`）。 ### 🛠️ 解決方法 只要在 Playwright 啟動時加上 `channel="chrome"`，讓 Playwright 直接調用您電腦上的同一支 Google Chrome，版本 100% 一致，就不會再發生任何衝突！ --- ### 📄 請更新 `auto_push_resonance.py` 完整代碼 請將 `auto_push_resonance.py` 替換為以下已修正版本：

def get_top_resonance_stocks(top_n=TOP_N, min_vol=MIN_VOLUME, min_px=MIN_PRICE):
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP (?)
        [代號], [名稱], [盤中成交價] AS [現價], [盤中漲幅] AS [漲幅%], [盤中總量] AS [總量],
        [HitCount] AS [共振維度數], [ResonanceTag] AS [共振等級],
        [DimA_Status] AS [雙動能狀態], [DimB_Status] AS [OBV星號狀態], [DimC_Status] AS [價格星號狀態], [DimD_Status] AS [彩虹金叉狀態]
    FROM [stockchangedate].[dbo].[ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot]
    WHERE [HitCount] >= 3
      AND [盤中總量] >= ?
      AND [盤中成交價] >= ?
      AND ([HitCount] = 4 OR [DimA_DualMomentum] = 2)
    ORDER BY [HitCount] DESC, [DimD_RainbowScore] DESC, [盤中總量] DESC;
    """
    stocks = []
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (top_n, min_vol, min_px))
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            for r in rows:
                stocks.append({
                    "code": r[0].strip(),
                    "name": r[1].strip(),
                    "price": float(r[2]) if r[2] else 0.0,
                    "change": float(r[3]) if r[3] else 0.0,
                    "volume": int(r[4]) if r[4] else 0,
                    "hit_count": int(r[5]) if r[5] else 0,
                    "tag": r[6].strip() if r[6] else "",
                    "dim_a": r[7].strip() if r[7] else "",
                    "dim_b": r[8].strip() if r[8] else "",
                    "dim_c": r[9].strip() if r[9] else "",
                    "dim_d": r[10].strip() if r[10] else ""
                })
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 撈取黑馬清單失敗: {e}")
    return stocks

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【3. 撈取個股詳細數據與 3-Way 離場勝率】
# ==========================================
def get_stock_explain_data(stock_code):
    data = {
        "name": stock_code, "date": "最新", "price": 0, "obv": 0, "obv5": 0, "obv34": 0, 
        "m5": 0, "m20": 0, "m60": 0, "f5": 0, "f20": 0, "score": 0, "score5": 0, "score20": 0,
        "exit_5ma_win": 0.0, "exit_5ma_ret": 0.0,
        "exit_10ma_win": 0.0, "exit_10ma_ret": 0.0,
        "exit_20ma_win": 0.0, "exit_20ma_ret": 0.0,
        "optimal_exit": "🔥 20MA 勝出 (預設波段防守)"
    }
    sql_allcross = """
    SELECT TOP 1 名稱, 日期, 成交價, obv淨額, obv_ma5, obv_ma34, price_ma5, price_ma20, price_ma60, 三大法人_ma5, 三大法人_ma20
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live WHERE 代號 = ? ORDER BY 日期 DESC
    """
    sql_score = """
    SELECT TOP 1 ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, M.專家實戰總分), SCH.實戰總分_ma5, SCH.實戰總分_ma20
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory SCH ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(SCH.代號) AND M.日期 = SCH.日期
    WHERE RTRIM(M.代號) = ? ORDER BY M.日期 DESC
    """
    sql_3exits = """
    SELECT WinRate_5MA, Return_5MA, WinRate_10MA, Return_10MA, WinRate_20MA, Return_20MA, OptimalExit
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits WHERE 代號 = ?
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql_allcross, (stock_code.strip(),))
            r = cursor.fetchone()
            if r:
                data["name"] = r[0].strip() if r[0] else stock_code
                data["date"] = str(r[1]).strip() if r[1] else "最新"
                data["price"] = float(r[2]) if r[2] else 0
                data["obv"] = float(r[3]) if r[3] else 0
                data["obv5"] = float(r[4]) if r[4] else 0
                data["obv34"] = float(r[5]) if r[5] else 0
                data["m5"] = float(r[6]) if r[6] else 0
                data["m20"] = float(r[7]) if r[7] else 0
                data["m60"] = float(r[8]) if r[8] else 0
                data["f5"] = float(r[9]) if r[9] else 0
                data["f20"] = float(r[10]) if r[10] else 0
                
            cursor.execute(sql_score, (stock_code.strip(),))
            rs = cursor.fetchone()
            if rs:
                data["score"] = float(rs[0]) if rs[0] else 0
                data["score5"] = float(rs[1]) if rs[1] else data["score"]
                data["score20"] = float(rs[2]) if rs[2] else data["score"]

            cursor.execute(sql_3exits, (stock_code.strip(),))
            r3 = cursor.fetchone()
            if r3:
                data["exit_5ma_win"] = float(r3[0]) if r3[0] else 0.0
                data["exit_5ma_ret"] = float(r3[1]) if r3[1] else 0.0
                data["exit_10ma_win"] = float(r3[2]) if r3[2] else 0.0
                data["exit_10ma_ret"] = float(r3[3]) if r3[3] else 0.0
                data["exit_20ma_win"] = float(r3[4]) if r3[4] else 0.0
                data["exit_20ma_ret"] = float(r3[5]) if r3[5] else 0.0
                data["optimal_exit"] = str(r3[6]).strip() if r3[6] else "🔥 20MA 勝出"
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 撈取 {stock_code} 詳細資料提醒: {e}")
    return data

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【4. Qwen-7B 生成解盤 ＋ 注入 3-Way 樹狀卡片】
# ==========================================
def generate_explanation_with_pk(data):
    f5_val, f20_val = data['f5'], data['f20']
    f5_str = f"買超 {f5_val:.1f} 張" if f5_val >= 0 else f"賣超 {abs(f5_val):.1f} 張"
    f20_str = f"買超 {f20_val:.1f} 張" if f20_val >= 0 else f"賣超 {abs(f20_val):.1f} 張"
    
    score_val, score20_val = data['score'], data['score20']
    score_str = f"多頭正分 +{score_val:.2f} 分" if score_val >= 0 else f"空頭負分 {score_val:.2f} 分"
    score20_str = f"正分 +{score20_val:.2f} 分" if score20_val >= 0 else f"負分 {score20_val:.2f} 分"

    e5_win, e5_ret = data.get("exit_5ma_win", 0.0), data.get("exit_5ma_ret", 0.0)
    e10_win, e10_ret = data.get("exit_10ma_win", 0.0), data.get("exit_10ma_ret", 0.0)
    e20_win, e20_ret = data.get("exit_20ma_win", 0.0), data.get("exit_20ma_ret", 0.0)
    optimal_exit = data.get("optimal_exit", "🔥 20MA 勝出 (預設波段防守)")

    e5_ret_str = f"+{e5_ret:.2f}%" if e5_ret >= 0 else f"{e5_ret:.2f}%"
    e10_ret_str = f"+{e10_ret:.2f}%" if e10_ret >= 0 else f"{e10_ret:.2f}%"
    e20_ret_str = f"+{e20_ret:.2f}%" if e20_ret >= 0 else f"{e20_ret:.2f}%"

    pk_block = (
        f"📊 該股歷史離場戰術實測 PK（站 5MA 買進）：\n"
        f"├─ 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {e5_win:.1f}% | 期望值 {e5_ret_str}\n"
        f"├─ ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {e10_win:.1f}% | 期望值 {e10_ret_str}\n"
        f"└─ 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {e20_win:.1f}% | 期望值 {e20_ret_str}\n"
        f"🎯 最適戰術建議：【{optimal_exit}】"
    )

    prompt = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監。使用者正在看你發送的「一鍵四大圖表同步聯動共振圖」。
請解說【{data['name']} ({data['name']})】今日盤後資料：
- 現價：{data['price']}元 | 5MA：{data['m5']}元 | 20MA：{data['m20']}元 | 60MA：{data['m60']}元
- 三大法人 5MA：{f5_str}，20MA：{f20_str}
- 實戰總分：當前為 {score_str}，20日均分為 {score20_str}

請嚴格分成以下五大段，每段 60~90 字，精準一針見血：
📌 【圖一：價格與均線防守】
📌 【圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振】
📌 【圖二：OBV星號爆發解讀】
📌 【圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振】
📌 【指揮官實戰總結指引】（給出下營業日開盤目標價與防守價與本金凱利部位％配置建議）
請全部使用繁體中文回覆。"""

    try:
        r = requests.post(OLLAMA_URL, json={"model": MODEL_NAME, "prompt": prompt, "stream": False}, timeout=120)
        ai_response = r.json().get("response", "⚠️ AI 生成異常。")
        
        if "📌 【指揮官實戰總結" in ai_response:
            parts = ai_response.split("📌 【指揮官實戰總結")
            final_output = parts[0] + "📌 【指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n" + pk_block + "\n\n" + parts[1].replace("指引】", "").strip()
        else:
            final_output = ai_response + "\n\n📌 【指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n" + pk_block
            
        return final_output
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 本地 AI 連線超時: {e}"

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【5. TG 訊息發送】
# ==========================================
def send_telegram_text(text_msg):
    if not ENABLE_TG or not TG_TOKEN:
        return
    url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_TOKEN}/sendMessage"
    try:
        requests.post(url, json={"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID, "text": text_msg}, timeout=15)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ TG 發送文字失敗: {e}")

def send_telegram_photo(photo_path, caption_text):
    if not ENABLE_TG or not TG_TOKEN:
        return
    url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_TOKEN}/sendPhoto"
    try:
        with open(photo_path, 'rb') as f:
            data = {'chat_id': TG_CHAT_ID, 'caption': caption_text}
            requests.post(url, files={'photo': f}, data=data, timeout=15)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ TG 發送圖片失敗: {e}")

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【6. Facebook 社團 Playwright 自動發文函數】
# ==========================================
async def post_to_facebook_group(context, photo_path, post_text):
    if not ENABLE_FB:
        return
    try:
        fb_page = await context.new_page()
        await fb_page.goto(FB_GROUP_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=45000)
        await asyncio.sleep(3.0)

        # 點擊「建立公開貼文」
        create_post_btn = fb_page.locator("div[role='button']:has-text('在此建立公開貼文'), div[role='button']:has-text('寫些什麼'), div[role='button']:has-text('建立貼文'), span:has-text('在想些什麼')").first
        if await create_post_btn.count() > 0:
            await create_post_btn.click()
            await asyncio.sleep(2.5)

            # 1. 上傳圖片
            file_input = fb_page.locator("input[type='file'][accept*='image']").first
            if await file_input.count() > 0:
                await file_input.set_input_files(photo_path)
                await asyncio.sleep(3.0)

            # 2. 填入文字
            textbox = fb_page.locator("div[role='dialog'] div[contenteditable='true'][role='textbox']").first
            if await textbox.count() > 0:
                await textbox.click()
                await fb_page.keyboard.insert_text(post_text)
                await asyncio.sleep(2.0)

            # 3. 點擊「發佈」
            post_submit_btn = fb_page.locator("div[role='dialog'] div[role='button']:has-text('發佈'), div[role='dialog'] div[role='button']:has-text('發布'), div[role='dialog'] div[role='button']:has-text('Post')").first
            if await post_submit_btn.count() > 0:
                await post_submit_btn.click()
                await asyncio.sleep(5.0)
                print(f"✅ Facebook 社團自動發文成功！")
            else:
                print("⚠️ 未找到 FB 發佈按鈕")
        else:
            print("⚠️ 未找到 FB 發文框，請確認是否已順利登入")
        
        await fb_page.close()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ FB 自動發文提醒: {e}")

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【7. Playwright 截圖 ＋ 雙推播主流程】
# ==========================================
async def capture_and_broadcast_stock(context, stock_code, stock_name, stock_info):
    data = get_stock_explain_data(stock_code)
    explain_text = generate_explanation_with_pk(data)

    today = datetime.datetime.now()
    one_year_ago = (today - datetime.timedelta(days=365)).strftime('%Y%m%d')
    timestamp_now = int(time.time() * 1000)

    url = f"https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/excelsql2.html?stock={stock_code.strip()}&start={one_year_ago}&_v={timestamp_now}"
    photo_filename = f"chart_{stock_code}_{timestamp_now}.png"
    output_path = os.path.join(STATIC_DIR, photo_filename)

    page = await context.new_page()
    try:
        await page.goto(url, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=60000)
        await asyncio.sleep(2.0)

        btn_post = page.locator("#btn_query_post")
        if await btn_post.count() > 0 and await btn_post.is_visible():
            await btn_post.click()
        else:
            await page.evaluate("""
                const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, input[type="button"], a'))
                    .find(el => el.textContent.includes('歷史') || el.textContent.includes('聯動'));
                if (btn) btn.click();
            """)

        await asyncio.sleep(4.5)

        # 畫面淨化
        await page.evaluate("""
            const p = document.getElementById('html-chart-price');
            const c = document.getElementById('html-chart-cross');
            const o = document.getElementById('html-chart-obv');
            const s = document.getElementById('html-chart-score');
            if (p && o && s) {
                const container = document.createElement('div');
                container.id = 'clean-charts-container';
                container.style.backgroundColor = '#0c1827';
                container.style.padding = '10px';
                container.style.width = '100%';
                container.appendChild(p);
                if (c) container.appendChild(c);
                container.appendChild(o);
                container.appendChild(s);
                document.body.insertBefore(container, document.body.firstChild);
                document.querySelectorAll('body > *').forEach(el => {
                    if (el.id !== 'clean-charts-container') el.style.display = 'none';
                });
            }
        """)
        await asyncio.sleep(2.0)
        await page.screenshot(path=output_path, full_page=True)
        print(f"✅ [{stock_code} {stock_name}] 四大圖表截圖完成！")

        caption_head = (
            f"📊 【Zen AI 量化戰情室】多維共振戰報\n"
            f"股號: {stock_code} {stock_name}\n"
            f"現價: {stock_info['price']} 元 | 漲幅: {stock_info['change']}%\n"
            f"成交總量: {stock_info['volume']:,} 張\n"
            f"標籤: {stock_info['tag']}\n"
            f"時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')}"
        )
        full_content = f"{caption_head}\n\n{explain_text}"

        # 1. 發送 Telegram
        if len(explain_text) <= 900:
            send_telegram_photo(output_path, full_content)
        else:
            send_telegram_photo(output_path, caption_head)
            send_telegram_text(explain_text)
        print(f"🚀 [{stock_code} {stock_name}] TG 廣播完成！")

        # 2. 自動發布至 Facebook 社團
        await post_to_facebook_group(context, output_path, full_content)

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ [{stock_code}] 處理異常: {e}")
    finally:
        await page.close()

# 🛠️【8. 盤後播報總控制流程】

    header_msg += "\n----------------------------------------\n以下為各個股的高清四大圖表與 AI 操盤手戰術報告："
    send_telegram_text(header_msg)

    # 4. 啟動 Playwright (指定本機真實 Chrome，杜絕降級衝突)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        context = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
            user_data_dir=FB_USER_DATA,
            channel="chrome",  # 🟢 關鍵修正：調用本機真實 Chrome
            headless=False,
            viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 1100},
            args=["--disable-notifications", "--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled"]
        )

        for s in stocks:
            print(f"\n🎯 開始處理個股: {s['code']} {s['name']} (總量:{s['volume']:,}張)...")
            await capture_and_broadcast_stock(context, s['code'], s['name'], s)
            await asyncio.sleep(4.0)

        await context.close()

    print("\n🎉 🎉 今日 13:35 盤後黑馬 TG + FB 社團全自動推播大功告成！")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main_broadcast())
