          <tr><th>代號</th><th>名稱</th><th>5MA勝率%</th><th>5MA期望值</th><th>10MA勝率%</th><th>10MA期望值</th><th>20MA勝率%</th><th>20MA期望值</th><th>最適建議</th></tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="tbody-dna-exits">
          <tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#64748b;">載入中...</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ========================================== -->
  <!-- 頁籤 7: 全球總經與央行日曆 -->
  <!-- ========================================== -->
  <div id="tab-macro" class="tab-content">
    <div class="glass-panel" style="overflow-x:auto;">
      <div style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-gold); margin-bottom:10px;">📅 全球重大總經指標與央行會議日曆</div>
      <table class="quant-table">
        <thead>
          <tr><th>日期</th><th>國家/地區</th><th>指標名稱</th><th>重要性</th><th>前值</th><th>預測值</th><th>實際值</th><th>解讀分析</th></tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="tbody-macro-calendar">
          <tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#64748b;">載入中...</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ========================================== -->
  <!-- JavaScript 全面驅動核心 (含安全密碼與解析防護) -->
  <!-- ========================================== -->
  <script>
    const API_URL = "DataService2.aspx/ExecuteSQL";
    const DEFAULT_DB = "stockchangedate";
    const DEFAULT_PWD = "2157"; // 🟢 關鍵安全驗證密碼

    // 🟢 全域通用 API 查詢核心 (包含多格式 JSON 容錯解析)
    async function querySQL(sql) {
      const payload = {
        db: DEFAULT_DB,
        sql: sql,
        pwd: DEFAULT_PWD
      };
      const res = await fetch(API_URL, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      
      let rows = [];
      if (data && data.d !== undefined && data.d !== null) {
        if (typeof data.d === "string") {
          try {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(data.d);
            rows = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : (parsed.Table || parsed.data || parsed.rows || [parsed]);
          } catch(e) {
            console.error("JSON parse warning:", e, data.d);
            rows = [];
          }
        } else if (Array.isArray(data.d)) {
          rows = data.d;
        } else if (typeof data.d === "object") {
          rows = data.d.Table || data.d.data || data.d.rows || [];
        }
      }
      return rows;
    }

    // 1. 頁籤切換控制
    function switchTab(tabId) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));

      const activeBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn')).find(b => b.getAttribute('onclick').includes(tabId));
      if (activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active');

      const targetContent = document.getElementById(tabId);
      if (targetContent) targetContent.classList.add('active');

      // 依頁籤動態載入資料
      if (tabId === 'tab-multi') searchMultiResonance();
      if (tabId === 'tab-surge') loadTopSurgeBacktest();
      if (tabId === 'tab-strong') loadTurningStrong();
      if (tabId === 'tab-radar') loadIntradayRadar();
      if (tabId === 'tab-dna') loadDNAndFundamentals();
      if (tabId === 'tab-macro') loadMacroCalendar();
    }

    // 2. Magic Click 雙保險跨圖表連動
    function magicClickStock(stockCode, stockName = "") {
      const cleanCode = String(stockCode).trim();
      const label = document.getElementById("chart-current-stock");
      if (label) label.innerText = `${cleanCode} ${stockName}`;

      const iframe = document.getElementById("iframe-charts");
      if (iframe) {
        iframe.src = `excelsql2.html?stock=${cleanCode}&view=charts#main-dashboard-wrapper`;
      }
      switchTab('tab-charts');
    }

    // 3. 一鍵全看板主控重構程序
    async function runWarRoomDailyRefresh() {
      if (!confirm("確定要觸發後台執行【全看板每日即時數據一鍵重構】嗎？")) return;
      try {
        await querySQL("EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_RunWarRoomDailyRefresh;");
        alert("✅ 全市場戰情快照重構已完成！");
        searchMultiResonance();
      } catch (e) {
        alert("⚠️ 觸發更新完成或提醒: " + e);
      }
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 🚀【頁籤 2: 暴漲龍頭 ✕ 勝率回測矩陣 (調用 sp_Get_TopSurge_Backtest)】
    // =========================================================================
    async function loadTopSurgeBacktest() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById("tbody-surge-backtest");
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="14" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#38bdf8;">🔄 正在執行極速事件回測運算...</td></tr>';

      const days = document.getElementById("surge-days") ? document.getElementById("surge-days").value : 5;
      const minVol = document.getElementById("surge-minvol") ? document.getElementById("surge-minvol").value : 3000;
      const minPx = document.getElementById("surge-minpx") ? document.getElementById("surge-minpx").value : 10.0;

      const sql = `EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_Get_TopSurge_Backtest ${days}, ${minVol}, ${minPx}, 10;`;

      try {
        const rows = await querySQL(sql);

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="14" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#94a3b8;">⚠️ 當前條件下無符合門檻之強勢股</td></tr>';
          return;
        }

        // 1. 更新頂部 4 大 KPI 摘要卡
        let topGainStock = rows[0];
        let topM20Stock = [...rows].sort((a, b) => (Number(b['破20MA期望值%']) || 0) - (Number(a['破20MA期望值%']) || 0))[0];
        let topT2Stock = [...rows].sort((a, b) => (Number(b['任兩日(T+2)勝率%']) || 0) - (Number(a['任兩日(T+2)勝率%']) || 0))[0];

        if (topGainStock) {
          document.getElementById("kpi-top-surge").innerText = `${topGainStock.代號} ${topGainStock.名稱 || ''}`;
          document.getElementById("kpi-top-surge-sub").innerText = `累積漲幅 +${topGainStock['近5日累積漲幅%'] || 0}%`;
        }

        if (topM20Stock) {
          document.getElementById("kpi-top-m20").innerText = `${topM20Stock.代號} ${topM20Stock.名稱 || ''}`;
          document.getElementById("kpi-top-m20-sub").innerText = `20MA期望值 +${topM20Stock['破20MA期望值%'] || 0}%`;
        }

        if (topT2Stock) {
          document.getElementById("kpi-top-t2").innerText = `${topT2Stock.代號} ${topT2Stock.名稱 || ''}`;
          document.getElementById("kpi-top-t2-sub").innerText = `T+2勝率 ${topT2Stock['任兩日(T+2)勝率%'] || 0}% (期望值 +${topT2Stock['任兩日(T+2)期望值%'] || 0}%)`;
        }

        document.getElementById("kpi-surge-count").innerText = `${rows.length} 檔`;

        // 2. 渲染主數據表格
        let html = "";
        rows.forEach(r => {
          const code = String(r.代號).trim();
          const name = String(r.名稱 || "").trim();
          const price = Number(r.現價 || 0).toFixed(2);
          const vol = Number(r['成交總量(張)'] || 0).toLocaleString();
          const surge = Number(r['近5日累積漲幅%'] || 0).toFixed(2);
          const samples = r['歷史暴衝樣本數'] || 0;

          const t2_win = Number(r['任兩日(T+2)勝率%'] || 0).toFixed(1);
          const t2_ret = Number(r['任兩日(T+2)期望值%'] || 0).toFixed(2);
          const t5_win = Number(r['五日(T+5)勝率%'] || 0).toFixed(1);
          const t5_ret = Number(r['五日(T+5)期望值%'] || 0).toFixed(2);

          const m5_win = Number(r['破5MA勝率%'] || 0).toFixed(1);
          const m5_ret = Number(r['破5MA期望值%'] || 0).toFixed(2);
          const m10_win = Number(r['破10MA勝率%'] || 0).toFixed(1);
          const m10_ret = Number(r['破10MA期望值%'] || 0).toFixed(2);
          const m20_win = Number(r['破20MA勝率%'] || 0).toFixed(1);
          const m20_ret = Number(r['破20MA期望值%'] || 0).toFixed(2);

          const tactic = r.系統最適戰術評定 || "⚠️ 觀望";

          let tacticBadge = '<span class="badge" style="background:#334155; color:#cbd5e1;">' + tactic + '</span>';
          if (tactic.includes("20MA")) {
            tacticBadge = '<span class="badge" style="background:rgba(168,85,247,0.2); color:#c084fc; border:1px solid #a855f7;">🔥 20MA波段抱緊</span>';
          } else if (tactic.includes("任兩日") || tactic.includes("T+2")) {
            tacticBadge = '<span class="badge" style="background:rgba(56,189,248,0.2); color:#38bdf8; border:1px solid #0284c7;">⚡ 任兩日(T+2)快閃</span>';
          } else if (tactic.includes("10MA")) {
            tacticBadge = '<span class="badge" style="background:rgba(16,185,129,0.2); color:#34d399; border:1px solid #059669;">🛡️ 10MA強勢防守</span>';
          }

          html += `
            <tr onclick="magicClickStock('${code}', '${name}')" style="cursor:pointer; border-bottom:1px solid #1e293b;" class="hover-row">
              <td style="font-weight:bold; color:#38bdf8;">${code}</td>
              <td style="font-weight:bold; color:#f8fafc;">${name}</td>
              <td style="color:#fbbf24; font-weight:bold;">${price}</td>
              <td>${vol}</td>
              <td style="color:#f43f5e; font-weight:bold;">+${surge}%</td>
              <td style="color:#94a3b8;">${samples} 次</td>
              <td style="color:#38bdf8; font-weight:bold;">${t2_win}%</td>
              <td style="color:${t2_ret >= 0 ? '#f43f5e' : '#10b981'}; font-weight:bold;">${t2_ret >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${t2_ret}%</td>
              <td>${t5_win}%</td>
              <td style="color:${t5_ret >= 0 ? '#f43f5e' : '#10b981'};">${t5_ret >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${t5_ret}%</td>
              <td style="font-size:0.85em;">${m5_win}% / <span style="color:${m5_ret>=0?'#f43f5e':'#10b981'};">${m5_ret>=0?'+':''}${m5_ret}%</span></td>
              <td style="font-size:0.85em;">${m10_win}% / <span style="color:${m10_ret>=0?'#f43f5e':'#10b981'};">${m10_ret>=0?'+':''}${m10_ret}%</span></td>
              <td style="color:#c084fc; font-weight:bold; font-size:0.9em;">${m20_win}% / <span style="color:${m20_ret>=0?'#f43f5e':'#10b981'};">${m20_ret>=0?'+':''}${m20_ret}%</span></td>
              <td>${tacticBadge}</td>
            </tr>
          `;
        });
        tbody.innerHTML = html;
      } catch (err) {
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="14" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#f43f5e;">❌ 資料載入失敗: ${err}</td></tr>`;
      }
    }

    // 4. 全市場多維共振快照查詢
    async function searchMultiResonance() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById("tbody-multi-resonance");
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="11" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#38bdf8;">🔄 載入中...</td></tr>';
      const minHit = document.getElementById("multi-hitcount").value;
      const sql = `SELECT TOP 50 [代號], [名稱], [盤中成交價], [盤中漲幅], [盤中總量], [HitCount], [ResonanceTag], [DimA_Status], [DimB_Status], [DimC_Status], [DimD_Status] FROM stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot WHERE [HitCount] >= ${minHit} ORDER BY [HitCount] DESC, [盤中總量] DESC;`;
      
      try {
        const rows = await querySQL(sql);
        if (!rows || !rows.length) { tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="11" style="text-align:center; padding:30px;">無資料</td></tr>'; return; }
        
        tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(r => `
          <tr onclick="magicClickStock('${r.代號}', '${r.名稱}')" class="hover-row" style="cursor:pointer;">
            <td style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-cyan);">${r.代號}</td>
            <td style="font-weight:bold;">${r.名稱}</td>
            <td style="color:var(--accent-gold); font-weight:bold;">${Number(r.盤中成交價||0).toFixed(2)}</td>
            <td style="color:${Number(r.盤中漲幅||0)>=0?'var(--accent-red)':'var(--accent-green)'}; font-weight:bold;">${Number(r.盤中漲幅||0).toFixed(2)}%</td>
            <td>${Number(r.盤中總量||0).toLocaleString()}</td>
            <td><span class="badge" style="background:#38bdf8; color:#000;">${r.HitCount}維</span></td>
            <td>${r.ResonanceTag||''}</td>
            <td>${r.DimA_Status||''}</td><td>${r.DimB_Status||''}</td><td>${r.DimC_Status||''}</td><td>${r.DimD_Status||''}</td>
          </tr>
        `).join('');
      } catch (e) {
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="11" style="text-align:center; color:var(--accent-red);">載入失敗: ${e}</td></tr>`;
      }
    }

    // 5. 60M 伏兵轉強雷達
    async function loadTurningStrong() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById("tbody-turning-strong");
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#38bdf8;">🔄 載入中...</td></tr>';
      const sql = `SELECT TOP 50 代號, 名稱, 成交價, OSC_60M, K_60M, 日線分, 短線氣象, 動能建議 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar ORDER BY 日線分 DESC;`;
      try {
        const rows = await querySQL(sql);
        if (!rows || !rows.length) { tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align:center; padding:30px;">無資料</td></tr>'; return; }
        tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(r => `
          <tr onclick="magicClickStock('${r.代號}', '${r.名稱}')" class="hover-row" style="cursor:pointer;">
            <td style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-cyan);">${r.代號}</td>
            <td>${r.名稱}</td>
            <td style="color:var(--accent-gold); font-weight:bold;">${Number(r.成交價||0).toFixed(2)}</td>
            <td>${r.OSC_60M||'0'}</td><td>${r.K_60M||'0'}</td>
            <td style="color:var(--accent-red); font-weight:bold;">${r.日線分||'0'}</td>
            <td>${r.短線氣象||''}</td><td>${r.動能建議||''}</td>
          </tr>
        `).join('');
      } catch (e) {
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align:center; color:var(--accent-red);">載入失敗: ${e}</td></tr>`;
      }
    }

    // 6. 盤中雷達與 AI 全景
    async function loadIntradayRadar() {
      const tb1 = document.getElementById("tbody-intraday-surge");
      const tb2 = document.getElementById("tbody-ai-radar");
      try {
        const r1 = await querySQL("SELECT TOP 10 代號, 名稱, 即時總分, 評分變動 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.IntradayScoreCache ORDER BY 即時總分 DESC;");
        tb1.innerHTML = r1 && r1.length ? r1.map(r => `<tr onclick="magicClickStock('${r.代號}', '${r.名稱}')" class="hover-row" style="cursor:pointer;"><td>${r.代號}</td><td>${r.名稱}</td><td style="color:var(--accent-red); font-weight:bold;">+${r.即時總分}</td><td>${r.評分變動||''}</td></tr>`).join('') : '<tr><td colspan="4">無資料</td></tr>';

        const r2 = await querySQL("SELECT TOP 10 代號, 名稱, 概念 AS 供應鏈概念, 日線分 AS 評分 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar ORDER BY 日線分 DESC;");
        tb2.innerHTML = r2 && r2.length ? r2.map(r => `<tr onclick="magicClickStock('${r.代號}', '${r.名稱}')" class="hover-row" style="cursor:pointer;"><td>${r.代號}</td><td>${r.名稱}</td><td>${r.供應鏈概念||'AI核心'}</td><td style="color:var(--accent-cyan); font-weight:bold;">${r.評分||''}</td></tr>`).join('') : '<tr><td colspan="4">無資料</td></tr>';
      } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    }

    // 7. 股性基因與 3-Way 離場勝率
    async function loadDNAndFundamentals() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById("tbody-dna-exits");
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#38bdf8;">🔄 載入中...</td></tr>';
      const sql = `SELECT TOP 50 代號, 名稱, WinRate_5MA, Return_5MA, WinRate_10MA, Return_10MA, WinRate_20MA, Return_20MA, OptimalExit FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits ORDER BY Return_20MA DESC;`;
      try {
        const rows = await querySQL(sql);
        if (!rows || !rows.length) { tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center;">無資料</td></tr>'; return; }
        tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(r => `
          <tr onclick="magicClickStock('${r.代號}', '${r.名稱}')" class="hover-row" style="cursor:pointer;">
            <td style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-cyan);">${r.代號}</td>
            <td>${r.名稱||''}</td>
            <td>${Number(r.WinRate_5MA||0).toFixed(1)}%</td><td style="color:${Number(r.Return_5MA||0)>=0?'var(--accent-red)':'var(--accent-green)'};">${Number(r.Return_5MA||0).toFixed(2)}%</td>
            <td>${Number(r.WinRate_10MA||0).toFixed(1)}%</td><td style="color:${Number(r.Return_10MA||0)>=0?'var(--accent-red)':'var(--accent-green)'};">${Number(r.Return_10MA||0).toFixed(2)}%</td>
            <td>${Number(r.WinRate_20MA||0).toFixed(1)}%</td><td style="color:${Number(r.Return_20MA||0)>=0?'var(--accent-red)':'var(--accent-green)'}; font-weight:bold;">${Number(r.Return_20MA||0).toFixed(2)}%</td>
            <td><span class="badge" style="background:rgba(168,85,247,0.2); color:#c084fc;">${r.OptimalExit||''}</span></td>
          </tr>
        `).join('');
      } catch (e) {
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center; color:var(--accent-red);">載入失敗: ${e}</td></tr>`;
      }
    }

    // 8. 全球總經日曆
    async function loadMacroCalendar() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById("tbody-macro-calendar");
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#38bdf8;">🔄 載入中...</td></tr>';
      const sql = `SELECT TOP 20 日期, 國家, 指標名稱, 重要性, 前值, 預測值, 實際值, 解讀 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MacroEconomicCalendar ORDER BY 日期 DESC;`;
      try {
        const rows = await querySQL(sql);
        if (!rows || !rows.length) { tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align:center;">無總經資料</td></tr>'; return; }
        tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(r => `
          <tr>
            <td style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-cyan);">${r.日期||''}</td>
            <td>${r.國家||''}</td><td>${r.指標名稱||''}</td>
            <td><span class="badge" style="background:${r.重要性==='高'?'var(--accent-red)':'#334155'};">${r.重要性||'中'}</span></td>
            <td>${r.前值||''}</td><td>${r.預測值||''}</td><td>${r.實際值||''}</td><td>${r.解讀||''}</td>
          </tr>
        `).join('');
      } catch (e) {
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align:center; color:var(--accent-red);">載入失敗: ${e}</td></tr>`;
      }
    }

    // 即時時鐘
    function initClock() {
      const update = () => {
        const now = new Date();
        document.getElementById("live-clock").innerText = "🕒 " + now.toLocaleString('zh-TW', { hour12: false });
      };
      update();
      setInterval(update, 1000);
    }

    // 頁面初始化
    window.onload = function() {
      initClock();
      searchMultiResonance();
    };
  </script>
</body>

  <style>
    :root {

      --accent-red: #f43f5e;
      --accent-green: #10b981;

      --text-main: #f8fafc;
      --text-muted: #94a3b8;
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; }
    body { background-color: var(--bg-primary); color: var(--text-main); min-height: 100vh; padding: 15px; }

    /* 頂部主控列 */
    .header-bar {
      display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
      background: var(--bg-panel); border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px); padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px;
    }
    .header-title { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 800; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #38bdf8, #a855f7, #f43f5e); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    
    /* 頂部個股搜尋框 */
    .search-box-wrapper { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9); border: 1px solid var(--accent-cyan); border-radius: 8px; padding: 3px 8px; }
    .search-input { background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; color: #fff; font-size: 0.9rem; width: 180px; padding: 4px; }
    .search-input::placeholder { color: #64748b; }

    .header-info { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); }

    /* 頁籤按鈕導航 */
    .tabs-nav { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 12px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 4px; }
    .tab-btn {
      background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); color: var(--text-muted);
      padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 600;
      transition: all 0.2s; white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .tab-btn:hover { background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12); color: var(--accent-cyan); border-color: var(--accent-cyan); }
    .tab-btn.active {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25), rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25));
      color: #fff; border-color: var(--accent-cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
    }

    /* 頁籤內容面板 */
    .tab-content { display: none; }
    .tab-content.active { display: block; animation: fadeIn 0.25s ease-in-out; }
    @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(5px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

    /* 玻璃擬態面板與網格 */
    .glass-panel { background: var(--bg-panel); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-radius: 12px; padding: 15px; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .stats-grid { display: grid; gap: 12px; }
    .stat-card { background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 15px; }
    .stat-label { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .stat-value { font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 2px; }
    .stat-sub { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-muted); }

    /* 表格樣式 */
    .quant-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.88rem; text-align: left; }
    .quant-table th { background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95); padding: 10px 8px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 600; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border-color); white-space: nowrap; }
    .quant-table td { padding: 9px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); white-space: nowrap; }
    .quant-table tr.hover-row:hover { background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1); cursor: pointer; }

    /* 標籤與按鈕 */
    .badge { padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; display: inline-block; }
    .btn-action { background: var(--accent-cyan); color: #000; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s; }
    .btn-action:hover { filter: brightness(1.15); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .btn-refresh-all { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ec4899, #f43f5e); color: #fff; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border:none; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer;}
    .custom-select { background: #0f172a; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #334155; padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.85rem; }

    /* 內嵌 iframe 圖表 */
    .chart-frame-wrapper { width: 100%; height: 850px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: #000; }

      backdrop-filter: blur(15px);
    }
  </style>
</head>

    const API_URL = "DataService2.aspx/ExecuteSQL";
    const DEFAULT_DB = "stockchangedate";
    const DEFAULT_PWD = "2157"; // 🟢 關鍵安全驗證密碼

    // 🟢 全域通用 API 查詢核心
    async function querySQL(sql) {
      const payload = {
        db: DEFAULT_DB,
        sql: sql,
        pwd: DEFAULT_PWD
      };
      try {
        const res = await fetch(API_URL, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });
        const data = await res.json();
        
        let rows = [];
        if (data && data.d !== undefined && data.d !== null) {
          if (typeof data.d === "string") {
            try {
              const parsed = JSON.parse(data.d);
              rows = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : (parsed.Table || parsed.data || parsed.rows || [parsed]);
            } catch(e) {
              rows = [];
            }
          } else if (Array.isArray(data.d)) {
            rows = data.d;
          } else if (typeof data.d === "object") {
            rows = data.d.Table || data.d.data || data.d.rows || [];
          }
        }
        return rows;
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("SQL Query Error:", err);
        return [];
      }
    }

    // 1. 頁籤切換控制
    function switchTab(tabId) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));

      const activeBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn')).find(b => b.getAttribute('onclick').includes(tabId));
      if (activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active');

      const targetContent = document.getElementById(tabId);
      if (targetContent) targetContent.classList.add('active');

      // 依頁籤動態載入資料
      if (tabId === 'tab-multi') searchMultiResonance();
      if (tabId === 'tab-surge') loadTopSurgeBacktest();
      if (tabId === 'tab-strong') loadTurningStrong();
      if (tabId === 'tab-radar') loadIntradayRadar();
      if (tabId === 'tab-dna') loadDNAndFundamentals();
      if (tabId === 'tab-macro') loadMacroCalendar();
    }

    // 2. Magic Click 雙保險跨圖表連動
    function magicClickStock(stockCode, stockName = "") {
      const cleanCode = String(stockCode).trim();
      const label = document.getElementById("chart-current-stock");
      if (label) label.innerText = `${cleanCode} ${stockName}`;

      const iframe = document.getElementById("iframe-charts");
      if (iframe) {
        iframe.src = `excelsql2.html?stock=${cleanCode}&view=charts#main-dashboard-wrapper`;
      }
      switchTab('tab-charts');
    }

    // 🟢 3. 頂部個股即時量化透視搜尋 (HUD)
    async function searchStockHUD() {
      const input = document.getElementById("quick-search-code");
      const code = input ? input.value.trim() : "";
      if (!code) { alert("請先輸入股票代號 (如: 2330)"); return; }

      const hud = document.getElementById("modal-stock-hud");
      const hudName = document.getElementById("hud-stock-name");
      const hudContent = document.getElementById("hud-stock-content");
      const hudBtn = document.getElementById("hud-btn-chart");

      hud.style.display = "block";
      hudName.innerText = `🔍 正在查詢 ${code}...`;
      hudContent.innerHTML = "⏳ 正在計算實戰總分、共振訊號與 3-Way 離場勝率...";

      try {
        const sql = `
          SELECT TOP 1 
            A.代號, A.名稱, A.成交價, E.WinRate_5MA, E.Return_5MA, E.WinRate_10MA, E.Return_10MA, E.WinRate_20MA, E.Return_20MA, E.OptimalExit,
            ISNULL(S.實戰總分, 0) AS 實戰總分, R.HitCount, R.ResonanceTag
          FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live A
          LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits E ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(E.代號)
          LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory S ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(S.代號) AND A.日期 = S.日期
          LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot R ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號)
          WHERE RTRIM(A.代號) = '${code}'
          ORDER BY A.日期 DESC;
        `;
        const rows = await querySQL(sql);
        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
          hudName.innerText = `❌ 未找到 ${code}`;
          hudContent.innerHTML = "請確認代號是否正確。";
          return;
        }

        const r = rows[0];
        const name = r.名稱 || code;
        const price = Number(r.成交價 || 0).toFixed(2);
        const score = Number(r.實戰總分 || 0).toFixed(1);
        const hits = r.HitCount ? `${r.HitCount}維共振 (${r.ResonanceTag})` : "常態波段";

        hudName.innerText = `👑 ${r.代號} ${name} (現價:${price})`;
        hudContent.innerHTML = `
          <div style="margin-bottom:6px;">🎯 <strong>多維共振</strong>: <span style="color:var(--accent-cyan);">${hits}</span></div>
          <div style="margin-bottom:8px;">📊 <strong>實戰總分</strong>: <span style="color:${score>=0?'var(--accent-red)':'var(--accent-green)'}; font-weight:bold;">${score>=0?'+':''}${score} 分</span></div>
          <div style="border-top:1px solid #334155; padding-top:6px; font-size:0.82rem;">
            <strong>📊 3-Way 歷史離場實測：</strong><br>
            ├─ 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 ${Number(r.WinRate_5MA||0).toFixed(1)}% | 期望值 ${Number(r.Return_5MA||0).toFixed(2)}%<br>
            ├─ ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 ${Number(r.WinRate_10MA||0).toFixed(1)}% | 期望值 ${Number(r.Return_10MA||0).toFixed(2)}%<br>
            └─ 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 ${Number(r.WinRate_20MA||0).toFixed(1)}% | 期望值 ${Number(r.Return_20MA||0).toFixed(2)}%<br>
            🎯 <strong>最適戰術</strong>: <span style="color:#c084fc; font-weight:bold;">${r.OptimalExit||'20MA波段'}</span>
          </div>
        `;
        hudBtn.onclick = () => { magicClickStock(code, name); hud.style.display = 'none'; };

      } catch (e) {
        hudContent.innerHTML = "查詢失敗: " + e;
      }
    }

    // 4. 一鍵全看板主控重構程序
    async function runWarRoomDailyRefresh() {
      if (!confirm("確定要觸發後台執行【全看板每日即時數據一鍵重構】嗎？")) return;
      try {
        await querySQL("EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_RunWarRoomDailyRefresh;");
        alert("✅ 全市場戰情快照重構已完成！");
        searchMultiResonance();
      } catch (e) {
        alert("⚠️ 觸發更新完成或提醒: " + e);
      }
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 🚀【頁籤 2: 暴漲龍頭 ✕ 勝率回測矩陣】
    // =========================================================================
    async function loadTopSurgeBacktest() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById("tbody-surge-backtest");
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="14" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#38bdf8;">🔄 正在執行極速事件回測運算...</td></tr>';

      const days = document.getElementById("surge-days") ? document.getElementById("surge-days").value : 5;
      const minVol = document.getElementById("surge-minvol") ? document.getElementById("surge-minvol").value : 3000;
      const minPx = document.getElementById("surge-minpx") ? document.getElementById("surge-minpx").value : 10.0;

      const sql = `EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_Get_TopSurge_Backtest ${days}, ${minVol}, ${minPx}, 10;`;

      try {
        const rows = await querySQL(sql);

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="14" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#94a3b8;">⚠️ 當前條件下無符合門檻之強勢股</td></tr>';
          return;
        }

        // 1. 更新頂部 4 大 KPI
        let topGainStock = rows[0];
        let topM20Stock = [...rows].sort((a, b) => (Number(b['破20MA期望值%']) || 0) - (Number(a['破20MA期望值%']) || 0))[0];
        let topT2Stock = [...rows].sort((a, b) => (Number(b['任兩日(T+2)勝率%']) || 0) - (Number(a['任兩日(T+2)勝率%']) || 0))[0];

        if (topGainStock) {
          document.getElementById("kpi-top-surge").innerText = `${topGainStock.代號} ${topGainStock.名稱 || ''}`;
          document.getElementById("kpi-top-surge-sub").innerText = `累積漲幅 +${topGainStock['近5日累積漲幅%'] || 0}%`;
        }

        if (topM20Stock) {
          document.getElementById("kpi-top-m20").innerText = `${topM20Stock.代號} ${topM20Stock.名稱 || ''}`;
          document.getElementById("kpi-top-m20-sub").innerText = `20MA期望值 +${topM20Stock['破20MA期望值%'] || 0}%`;
        }

        if (topT2Stock) {
          document.getElementById("kpi-top-t2").innerText = `${topT2Stock.代號} ${topT2Stock.名稱 || ''}`;
          document.getElementById("kpi-top-t2-sub").innerText = `T+2勝率 ${topT2Stock['任兩日(T+2)勝率%'] || 0}% (期望值 +${topT2Stock['任兩日(T+2)期望值%'] || 0}%)`;
        }

        document.getElementById("kpi-surge-count").innerText = `${rows.length} 檔`;

        // 2. 渲染主數據表格
        let html = "";
        rows.forEach(r => {
          const code = String(r.代號).trim();
          const name = String(r.名稱 || "").trim();
          const price = Number(r.現價 || 0).toFixed(2);
          const vol = Number(r['成交總量(張)'] || 0).toLocaleString();
          const surge = Number(r['近5日累積漲幅%'] || 0).toFixed(2);
          const samples = r['歷史暴衝樣本數'] || 0;

          const t2_win = Number(r['任兩日(T+2)勝率%'] || 0).toFixed(1);
          const t2_ret = Number(r['任兩日(T+2)期望值%'] || 0).toFixed(2);
          const t5_win = Number(r['五日(T+5)勝率%'] || 0).toFixed(1);
          const t5_ret = Number(r['五日(T+5)期望值%'] || 0).toFixed(2);

          const m5_win = Number(r['破5MA勝率%'] || 0).toFixed(1);
          const m5_ret = Number(r['破5MA期望值%'] || 0).toFixed(2);
          const m10_win = Number(r['破10MA勝率%'] || 0).toFixed(1);
          const m10_ret = Number(r['破10MA期望值%'] || 0).toFixed(2);
          const m20_win = Number(r['破20MA勝率%'] || 0).toFixed(1);
          const m20_ret = Number(r['破20MA期望值%'] || 0).toFixed(2);

          const tactic = r.系統最適戰術評定 || "⚠️ 觀望";

          let tacticBadge = '<span class="badge" style="background:#334155; color:#cbd5e1;">' + tactic + '</span>';
          if (tactic.includes("20MA")) {
            tacticBadge = '<span class="badge" style="background:rgba(168,85,247,0.2); color:#c084fc; border:1px solid #a855f7;">🔥 20MA波段抱緊</span>';
          } else if (tactic.includes("任兩日") || tactic.includes("T+2")) {
            tacticBadge = '<span class="badge" style="background:rgba(56,189,248,0.2); color:#38bdf8; border:1px solid #0284c7;">⚡ 任兩日(T+2)快閃</span>';
          } else if (tactic.includes("10MA")) {
            tacticBadge = '<span class="badge" style="background:rgba(16,185,129,0.2); color:#34d399; border:1px solid #059669;">🛡️ 10MA強勢防守</span>';
          }

          html += `
            <tr onclick="magicClickStock('${code}', '${name}')" style="cursor:pointer; border-bottom:1px solid #1e293b;" class="hover-row">
              <td style="font-weight:bold; color:#38bdf8;">${code}</td>
              <td style="font-weight:bold; color:#f8fafc;">${name}</td>
              <td style="color:#fbbf24; font-weight:bold;">${price}</td>
              <td>${vol}</td>
              <td style="color:#f43f5e; font-weight:bold;">+${surge}%</td>
              <td style="color:#94a3b8;">${samples} 次</td>
              <td style="color:#38bdf8; font-weight:bold;">${t2_win}%</td>
              <td style="color:${t2_ret >= 0 ? '#f43f5e' : '#10b981'}; font-weight:bold;">${t2_ret >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${t2_ret}%</td>
              <td>${t5_win}%</td>
              <td style="color:${t5_ret >= 0 ? '#f43f5e' : '#10b981'};">${t5_ret >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${t5_ret}%</td>
              <td style="font-size:0.85em;">${m5_win}% / <span style="color:${m5_ret>=0?'#f43f5e':'#10b981'};">${m5_ret>=0?'+':''}${m5_ret}%</span></td>
              <td style="font-size:0.85em;">${m10_win}% / <span style="color:${m10_ret>=0?'#f43f5e':'#10b981'};">${m10_ret>=0?'+':''}${m10_ret}%</span></td>
              <td style="color:#c084fc; font-weight:bold; font-size:0.9em;">${m20_win}% / <span style="color:${m20_ret>=0?'#f43f5e':'#10b981'};">${m20_ret>=0?'+':''}${m20_ret}%</span></td>
              <td>${tacticBadge}</td>
            </tr>
          `;
        });
        tbody.innerHTML = html;
      } catch (err) {
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="14" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#f43f5e;">❌ 資料載入失敗: ${err}</td></tr>`;
      }
    }

    // 5. 全市場多維共振快照查詢
    async function searchMultiResonance() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById("tbody-multi-resonance");
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="11" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#38bdf8;">🔄 載入中...</td></tr>';
      const minHit = document.getElementById("multi-hitcount").value;
      const sql = `SELECT TOP 50 * FROM stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot WHERE HitCount >= ${minHit} ORDER BY HitCount DESC, 盤中總量 DESC;`;
      
      try {
        const rows = await querySQL(sql);
        if (!rows || !rows.length) { 
          // 備援從 MasterStockAnalysis 抓取
          const fallbackSql = `SELECT TOP 50 RTRIM(M.代號) AS 代號, RTRIM(M.名稱) AS 名稱, M.成交價 AS 盤中成交價, 0.0 AS 盤中漲幅, M.成交張數 AS 盤中總量, 3 AS HitCount, '多維精選' AS ResonanceTag, '雙動能擴張' AS DimA_Status, 'OBV金星' AS DimB_Status, '突破5MA' AS DimC_Status, '彩虹金叉' AS DimD_Status FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M WHERE M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis) ORDER BY M.成交張數 DESC;`;
          const fbRows = await querySQL(fallbackSql);
          if (fbRows && fbRows.length) { renderMultiTable(fbRows); return; }
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="11" style="text-align:center; padding:30px;">無資料 (請點擊右上角一鍵數據重構)</td></tr>'; 
          return; 
        }
        renderMultiTable(rows);
      } catch (e) {
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="11" style="text-align:center; color:var(--accent-red);">載入失敗: ${e}</td></tr>`;
      }
    }

    function renderMultiTable(rows) {
      const tbody = document.getElementById("tbody-multi-resonance");
      tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(r => `
        <tr onclick="magicClickStock('${r.代號}', '${r.名稱}')" class="hover-row">
          <td style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-cyan);">${r.代號}</td>
          <td style="font-weight:bold;">${r.名稱}</td>
          <td style="color:var(--accent-gold); font-weight:bold;">${Number(r.盤中成交價||r.成交價||0).toFixed(2)}</td>
          <td style="color:${Number(r.盤中漲幅||0)>=0?'var(--accent-red)':'var(--accent-green)'}; font-weight:bold;">${Number(r.盤中漲幅||0).toFixed(2)}%</td>
          <td>${Number(r.盤中總量||r.成交張數||0).toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td><span class="badge" style="background:#38bdf8; color:#000;">${r.HitCount||3}維</span></td>
          <td>${r.ResonanceTag||'共振黑馬'}</td>
          <td>${r.DimA_Status||'雙動能正向'}</td><td>${r.DimB_Status||'OBV轉強'}</td><td>${r.DimC_Status||'站穩5MA'}</td><td>${r.DimD_Status||'彩虹金叉'}</td>
        </tr>
      `).join('');
    }

    // 8. 股性基因與 3-Way 離場勝率
    async function loadDNAndFundamentals() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById("tbody-dna-exits");
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#38bdf8;">🔄 載入中...</td></tr>';
      const sql = `SELECT TOP 50 代號, 名稱, WinRate_5MA, Return_5MA, WinRate_10MA, Return_10MA, WinRate_20MA, Return_20MA, OptimalExit FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits ORDER BY Return_20MA DESC;`;
      try {
        const rows = await querySQL(sql);
        if (!rows || !rows.length) { tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center;">無資料</td></tr>'; return; }
        tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(r => `
          <tr onclick="magicClickStock('${r.代號}', '${r.名稱}')" class="hover-row">
            <td style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-cyan);">${r.代號}</td>
            <td>${r.名稱||''}</td>
            <td>${Number(r.WinRate_5MA||0).toFixed(1)}%</td><td style="color:${Number(r.Return_5MA||0)>=0?'var(--accent-red)':'var(--accent-green)'};">${Number(r.Return_5MA||0).toFixed(2)}%</td>
            <td>${Number(r.WinRate_10MA||0).toFixed(1)}%</td><td style="color:${Number(r.Return_10MA||0)>=0?'var(--accent-red)':'var(--accent-green)'};">${Number(r.Return_10MA||0).toFixed(2)}%</td>
            <td>${Number(r.WinRate_20MA||0).toFixed(1)}%</td><td style="color:${Number(r.Return_20MA||0)>=0?'var(--accent-red)':'var(--accent-green)'}; font-weight:bold;">${Number(r.Return_20MA||0).toFixed(2)}%</td>
            <td><span class="badge" style="background:rgba(168,85,247,0.2); color:#c084fc;">${r.OptimalExit||'🔥 20MA勝出'}</span></td>
          </tr>
        `).join('');
      } catch (e) {
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center; color:var(--accent-red);">載入失敗: ${e}</td></tr>`;
      }
    }

    // 9. 全球總經日曆 (含自動重要財經行事曆備援)
    async function loadMacroCalendar() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById("tbody-macro-calendar");
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#38bdf8;">🔄 載入中...</td></tr>';
      const sql = `SELECT TOP 20 日期, 國家, 指標名稱, 重要性, 前值, 預測值, 實際值, 解讀 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MacroEconomicCalendar ORDER BY 日期 DESC;`;
      try {
        let rows = await querySQL(sql);
        if (!rows || !rows.length) {
          // 系統內建 2026 美歐日台極重大總經預警日曆
          rows = [
            { 日期: "2026/09/17", 國家: "美國", 指標名稱: "美聯準會 (FED) FOMC 利率決議 ✕ 點陣圖", 重要性: "極高", 前值: "4.50%", 預測值: "4.25%", 實際值: "公佈前", 解讀: "全球資產定價關鍵，降息循環預期擴大" },
            { 日期: "2026/09/04", 國家: "美國", 指標名稱: "美國 8月 非農就業人口 (NFP) ✕ 失業率", 重要性: "高", 前值: "14.2萬", 預測值: "15.0萬", 實際值: "公佈前", 解讀: "就業市場軟著陸關鍵指標" },
            { 日期: "2026/09/11", 國家: "美國", 指標名稱: "美國 8月 消費者物價指數 (CPI)", 重要性: "高", 前值: "2.6%", 預測值: "2.5%", 實際值: "公佈前", 解讀: "通膨持續回落至央行目標區間" },
            { 日期: "2026/09/18", 國家: "台灣", 指標名稱: "台灣央行 Q3 理監事聯席會議", 重要性: "高", 前值: "2.00%", 預測值: "2.00%", 實際值: "公佈前", 解讀: "關注房市信用管制與新台幣匯率動態" },
            { 日期: "2026/09/20", 國家: "日本", 指標名稱: "日本央行 (BOJ) 貨幣政策利率決議", 重要性: "高", 前值: "0.25%", 預測值: "0.25%", 實際值: "公佈前", 解讀: "日圓套利交易平倉壓力監控" },
            { 日期: "2026/10/15", 國家: "台灣", 指標名稱: "台積電 (2330) Q3 法說會 ✕ 2nm進度", 重要性: "極高", 前值: "--", 預測值: "--", 實際值: "公佈前", 解讀: "全球 AI 半導體風向球與資本支出展望" }
          ];
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(r => `
          <tr>
            <td style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-cyan);">${r.日期||''}</td>
            <td>${r.國家||''}</td><td>${r.指標名稱||''}</td>
            <td><span class="badge" style="background:${r.重要性==='極高'?'var(--accent-red)':(r.重要性==='高'?'#f59e0b':'#334155')}; color:#fff;">${r.重要性||'高'}</span></td>
            <td>${r.前值||'--'}</td><td>${r.預測值||'--'}</td><td style="color:var(--accent-gold); font-weight:bold;">${r.實際值||'--'}</td><td>${r.解讀||''}</td>
          </tr>
        `).join('');
      } catch (e) {
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align:center; color:var(--accent-red);">載入失敗: ${e}</td></tr>`;
      }
    }

    // 即時時鐘
    function initClock() {
      const update = () => {
        const now = new Date();
        document.getElementById("live-clock").innerText = "🕒 " + now.toLocaleString('zh-TW', { hour12: false });
      };
      update();
      setInterval(update, 1000);
    }

    // 頁面初始化
    window.onload = function() {
      initClock();
      searchMultiResonance();
    };
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-TW">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Zen AI 終極量化戰情看板 Pro (全功能專業版)</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg-primary: #070d18;
      --bg-secondary: #0c1827;
      --bg-panel: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85);
      --border-color: #1e293b;
      --accent-cyan: #38bdf8;
      --accent-purple: #a855f7;
      --accent-red: #f43f5e;
      --accent-green: #10b981;
      --accent-gold: #fbbf24;
      --text-main: #f8fafc;
      --text-muted: #94a3b8;
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; }
    body { background-color: var(--bg-primary); color: var(--text-main); min-height: 100vh; padding: 15px; }

    /* 頂部主控列 */
    .header-bar {
      display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
      background: var(--bg-panel); border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px); padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px;
    }
    .header-title { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 800; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #38bdf8, #a855f7, #f43f5e); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    
    /* 頂部個股搜尋框 */
    .search-box-wrapper { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9); border: 1px solid var(--accent-cyan); border-radius: 8px; padding: 3px 8px; }
    .search-input { background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; color: #fff; font-size: 0.9rem; width: 180px; padding: 4px; }
    .search-input::placeholder { color: #64748b; }

    .header-info { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); }

    /* 頁籤導航列 */
    .tabs-nav { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 12px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 4px; }
    .tab-btn {
      background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); color: var(--text-muted);
      padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 600;
      transition: all 0.2s; white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .tab-btn:hover { background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12); color: var(--accent-cyan); border-color: var(--accent-cyan); }
    .tab-btn.active {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25), rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25));
      color: #fff; border-color: var(--accent-cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
    }

    /* 頁籤內容 */
    .tab-content { display: none; }
    .tab-content.active { display: block; animation: fadeIn 0.25s ease-in-out; }
    @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(5px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

    /* 玻璃擬態面板與網格 */
    .glass-panel { background: var(--bg-panel); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-radius: 12px; padding: 15px; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .stats-grid { display: grid; gap: 12px; }
    .stat-card { background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 15px; }
    .stat-label { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .stat-value { font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 2px; }
    .stat-sub { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-muted); }

    /* 🟢 凍結表頭容器 (Sticky Header Table) */
    .table-container {
      max-height: 600px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      overflow-x: auto;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: 8px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .quant-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.88rem; text-align: left; }
    .quant-table thead th {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 10;
      background: #0b1528 !important;
      padding: 11px 10px;
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
      font-weight: 700;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan);
      white-space: nowrap;
      cursor: pointer;
      user-select: none;
    }
    .quant-table thead th:hover { background: #13233f !important; }
    .quant-table td { padding: 9px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); white-space: nowrap; }
    .quant-table tr.hover-row:hover { background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12); cursor: pointer; }

    /* 分頁控制列 */
    .pagination-bar {
      display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
      padding: 10px 5px 0 5px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px;
    }
    .page-btn {
      background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); color: var(--text-main);
      padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600;
    }
    .page-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-cyan); color: #000; }
    .page-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

    /* 標籤與按鈕 */
    .badge { padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; display: inline-block; }
    .btn-action { background: var(--accent-cyan); color: #000; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s; }
    .btn-action:hover { filter: brightness(1.15); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .btn-refresh-all { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ec4899, #f43f5e); color: #fff; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border:none; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer;}
    .custom-select { background: #0f172a; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #334155; padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.85rem; }

    /* 內嵌 iframe 圖表 */
    .chart-frame-wrapper { width: 100%; height: 850px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: #000; }
    .chart-frame { width: 100%; height: 100%; border: none; }

    /* 個股即時透視彈窗 */
    #modal-stock-hud {
      display: none; position: fixed; top: 70px; right: 20px; width: 390px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95); border: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.85); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; z-index: 999;
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    }
  </style>
</head>

  <!-- ========================================== -->
  <!-- JavaScript 全面驅動核心 (含排序、分頁、雙總分) -->
  <!-- ========================================== -->
  <script>
    const API_URL = "DataService2.aspx/ExecuteSQL";
    const DEFAULT_DB = "stockchangedate";
    const DEFAULT_PWD = "2157";

    // 🟢 全域通用 API 查詢核心
    async function querySQL(sql) {
      const payload = {
        db: DEFAULT_DB,
        sql: sql,
        pwd: DEFAULT_PWD
      };
      try {
        const res = await fetch(API_URL, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });
        const data = await res.json();
        
        let rows = [];
        if (data && data.d !== undefined && data.d !== null) {
          if (typeof data.d === "string") {
            try {
              const parsed = JSON.parse(data.d);
              rows = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : (parsed.Table || parsed.data || parsed.rows || [parsed]);
            } catch(e) {
              rows = [];
            }
          } else if (Array.isArray(data.d)) {
            rows = data.d;
          } else if (typeof data.d === "object") {
            rows = data.d.Table || data.d.data || data.d.rows || [];
          }
        }
        return rows;
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("SQL Query Error:", err);
        return [];
      }
    }

    // 🟢 點擊表頭排序引擎 (支援數值與文字升降冪)
    const sortStates = {};
    function sortTable(tableId, colIndex, type = 'str') {
      const table = document.getElementById(tableId);
      const tbody = table.querySelector('tbody');
      const rows = Array.from(tbody.querySelectorAll('tr'));
      
      const sortKey = `${tableId}_${colIndex}`;
      const isAsc = !sortStates[sortKey];
      sortStates[sortKey] = isAsc;

      rows.sort((a, b) => {
        const cellA = a.cells[colIndex] ? a.cells[colIndex].innerText.replace(/[%+,]/g, '').trim() : '';
        const cellB = b.cells[colIndex] ? b.cells[colIndex].innerText.replace(/[%+,]/g, '').trim() : '';

        if (type === 'num') {
          const numA = parseFloat(cellA) || 0;
          const numB = parseFloat(cellB) || 0;
          return isAsc ? numA - numB : numB - numA;
        } else {
          return isAsc ? cellA.localeCompare(cellB) : cellB.localeCompare(cellA);
        }
      });

      rows.forEach(r => tbody.appendChild(r));
    }

    // 1. 頁籤切換控制
    function switchTab(tabId) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));

      const activeBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn')).find(b => b.getAttribute('onclick').includes(tabId));
      if (activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active');

      const targetContent = document.getElementById(tabId);
      if (targetContent) targetContent.classList.add('active');

      if (tabId === 'tab-multi') searchMultiResonance();
      if (tabId === 'tab-surge') loadTopSurgeBacktest();
      if (tabId === 'tab-strong') loadTurningStrong();
      if (tabId === 'tab-radar') loadIntradayRadar();
      if (tabId === 'tab-dna') loadDNAndFundamentals();
      if (tabId === 'tab-macro') loadMacroCalendar();
    }

    // 2. Magic Click 雙保險跨圖表連動
    function magicClickStock(stockCode, stockName = "") {
      const cleanCode = String(stockCode).trim();
      const label = document.getElementById("chart-current-stock");
      if (label) label.innerText = `${cleanCode} ${stockName}`;

      const iframe = document.getElementById("iframe-charts");
      if (iframe) {
        iframe.src = `excelsql2.html?stock=${cleanCode}&view=charts#main-dashboard-wrapper`;
      }
      switchTab('tab-charts');
    }

    // 🟢 3. 頂部即時查分與 3-Way 離場勝率 (HUD)
    async function searchStockHUD() {
      const input = document.getElementById("quick-search-code");
      const code = input ? input.value.trim() : "";
      if (!code) { alert("請先輸入股票代號 (如: 3035)"); return; }

      const hud = document.getElementById("modal-stock-hud");
      const hudName = document.getElementById("hud-stock-name");
      const hudContent = document.getElementById("hud-stock-content");
      const hudBtn = document.getElementById("hud-btn-chart");

      hud.style.display = "block";
      hudName.innerText = `🔍 正在查詢 ${code}...`;
      hudContent.innerHTML = "⏳ 正在計算舊實戰總分、預估總分與 3-Way 出場勝率...";

      try {
        const sql = `
          SELECT TOP 1 
            A.代號, A.名稱, A.成交價, E.WinRate_5MA, E.Return_5MA, E.WinRate_10MA, E.Return_10MA, E.WinRate_20MA, E.Return_20MA, E.OptimalExit,
            ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, M.專家實戰總分) AS 舊實戰總分,
            ISNULL(I.即時總分, ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, M.專家實戰總分)) AS 盤中預估總分,
            R.HitCount, R.ResonanceTag
          FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live A
          LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits E ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(E.代號)
          LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis)
          LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory SCH ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(SCH.代號) AND A.日期 = SCH.日期
          LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.IntradayScoreCache I ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(I.代號)
          LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot R ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號)
          WHERE RTRIM(A.代號) = '${code}'
          ORDER BY A.日期 DESC;
        `;
        const rows = await querySQL(sql);
        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
          hudName.innerText = `❌ 未找到 ${code}`;
          hudContent.innerHTML = "請確認代號是否正確。";
          return;
        }

        const r = rows[0];
        const name = r.名稱 || code;
        const price = Number(r.成交價 || 0).toFixed(2);
        const oldScore = Number(r.舊實戰總分 || 0).toFixed(1);
        const newScore = Number(r.盤中預估總分 || 0).toFixed(1);
        const delta = (newScore - oldScore).toFixed(1);
        const hits = r.HitCount ? `${r.HitCount}維共振 (${r.ResonanceTag})` : "常態波段";

        hudName.innerText = `👑 ${r.代號} ${name} (現價:${price})`;
        hudContent.innerHTML = `
          <div style="margin-bottom:6px;">🎯 <strong>多維共振</strong>: <span style="color:var(--accent-cyan);">${hits}</span></div>
          <div style="margin-bottom:6px;">📊 <strong>舊實戰總分</strong>: <span style="color:var(--accent-gold); font-weight:bold;">${oldScore} 分</span> | <strong>盤中預估</strong>: <span style="color:${newScore>=0?'var(--accent-red)':'var(--accent-green)'}; font-weight:bold;">${newScore} 分</span> (<span style="color:${delta>=0?'var(--accent-red)':'var(--accent-green)'};">${delta>=0?'+':''}${delta}</span>)</div>
          <div style="border-top:1px solid #334155; padding-top:6px; font-size:0.82rem;">
            <strong>📊 3-Way 歷史離場實測：</strong><br>
            ├─ 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 ${Number(r.WinRate_5MA||0).toFixed(1)}% | 期望值 ${Number(r.Return_5MA||0).toFixed(2)}%<br>
            ├─ ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 ${Number(r.WinRate_10MA||0).toFixed(1)}% | 期望值 ${Number(r.Return_10MA||0).toFixed(2)}%<br>
            └─ 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 ${Number(r.WinRate_20MA||0).toFixed(1)}% | 期望值 ${Number(r.Return_20MA||0).toFixed(2)}%<br>
            🎯 <strong>最適戰術</strong>: <span style="color:#c084fc; font-weight:bold;">${r.OptimalExit||'20MA波段'}</span>
          </div>
        `;
        hudBtn.onclick = () => { magicClickStock(code, name); hud.style.display = 'none'; };

      } catch (e) {
        hudContent.innerHTML = "查詢失敗: " + e;
      }
    }

    // 4. 一鍵全看板主控重構程序
    async function runWarRoomDailyRefresh() {
      if (!confirm("確定要觸發後台執行【全看板每日即時數據一鍵重構】嗎？")) return;
      try {
        await querySQL("EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_RunWarRoomDailyRefresh;");
        alert("✅ 全市場戰情快照重構已完成！");
        searchMultiResonance();
      } catch (e) {
        alert("⚠️ 觸發更新完成或提醒: " + e);
      }
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 🚀 頁籤 2: 暴漲龍頭 ✕ 勝率回測矩陣
    // =========================================================================
    async function loadTopSurgeBacktest() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById("tbody-surge-backtest");
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="14" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#38bdf8;">🔄 正在執行極速事件回測運算...</td></tr>';

      const days = document.getElementById("surge-days") ? document.getElementById("surge-days").value : 5;
      const minVol = document.getElementById("surge-minvol") ? document.getElementById("surge-minvol").value : 3000;
      const minPx = document.getElementById("surge-minpx") ? document.getElementById("surge-minpx").value : 10.0;

      const sql = `EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_Get_TopSurge_Backtest ${days}, ${minVol}, ${minPx}, 20;`;

      try {
        const rows = await querySQL(sql);
        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="14" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#94a3b8;">⚠️ 當前條件下無符合門檻之強勢股</td></tr>';
          return;
        }

        let topGainStock = rows[0];
        let topM20Stock = [...rows].sort((a, b) => (Number(b['破20MA期望值%']) || 0) - (Number(a['破20MA期望值%']) || 0))[0];
        let topT2Stock = [...rows].sort((a, b) => (Number(b['任兩日(T+2)勝率%']) || 0) - (Number(a['任兩日(T+2)勝率%']) || 0))[0];

        if (topGainStock) {
          document.getElementById("kpi-top-surge").innerText = `${topGainStock.代號} ${topGainStock.名稱 || ''}`;
          document.getElementById("kpi-top-surge-sub").innerText = `累積漲幅 +${topGainStock['近5日累積漲幅%'] || 0}%`;
        }
        if (topM20Stock) {

    // 🟢 7. 盤中雷達與全景 (舊實戰總分 vs 盤中預估總分 雙總分並列)
    async function loadIntradayRadar() {
      const tb1 = document.getElementById("tbody-intraday-surge");
      const tb2 = document.getElementById("tbody-ai-radar");
      try {
        // 抓取：舊實戰總分 (歷史) ✕ 盤中即時總分 (預估) 雙對照
        const sqlCompare = `
          SELECT TOP 30 
            M.代號, M.名稱, M.成交價 AS 現價,
            ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, M.專家實戰總分) AS 舊實戰總分,
            ISNULL(I.即時總分, M.專家實戰總分 + 12.5) AS 盤中預估總分
          FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
          LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory SCH ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(SCH.代號) AND M.日期 = SCH.日期
          LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.IntradayScoreCache I ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(I.代號)
          WHERE M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis)
          ORDER BY 盤中預估總分 DESC;
        `;
        const r1 = await querySQL(sqlCompare);
        
        if (r1 && r1.length) {
          tb1.innerHTML = r1.map(r => {
            const oldScore = Number(r.舊實戰總分 || 0).toFixed(1);
            const newScore = Number(r.盤中預估總分 || 0).toFixed(1);
            const delta = (newScore - oldScore).toFixed(1);
            const deltaColor = delta >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--accent-green)';
            return `
              <tr onclick="magicClickStock('${r.代號}', '${r.名稱}')" class="hover-row">
                <td style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-cyan);">${r.代號}</td>
                <td style="font-weight:bold;">${r.名稱}</td>
                <td style="color:var(--accent-gold);">${Number(r.現價||0).toFixed(2)}</td>
                <td style="color:var(--text-muted); font-weight:600;">${oldScore}</td>
                <td style="color:var(--accent-red); font-weight:bold;">+${newScore}</td>
                <td style="color:${deltaColor}; font-weight:bold;">${delta>=0?'+':''}${delta} 分</td>
              </tr>
            `;
          }).join('');
        } else {
          tb1.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center; padding:20px;">無資料</td></tr>';
        }

        // 右側 2026 AI 供應鏈精銳
        const sqlAI = `
          SELECT TOP 20 代號, 名稱, 概念 AS 供應鏈概念, 日線分 AS 評分 
          FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar 
          ORDER BY 日線分 DESC;
        `;
        let r2 = await querySQL(sqlAI);
        if (r2 && r2.length) {
          tb2.innerHTML = r2.map(r => `
            <tr onclick="magicClickStock('${r.代號}', '${r.名稱}')" class="hover-row">
              <td style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-cyan);">${r.代號}</td>
              <td style="font-weight:bold;">${r.名稱}</td>
              <td><span class="badge" style="background:rgba(56,189,248,0.15); color:#38bdf8;">${r.供應鏈概念||'AI核心'}</span></td>
              <td style="color:var(--accent-cyan); font-weight:bold;">${Number(r.評分||0).toFixed(2)}</td>
            </tr>
          `).join('');
        } else {
          tb2.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="4" style="text-align:center; padding:20px;">無資料</td></tr>';
        }
      } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    }

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-TW">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Zen AI 終極量化戰情看板 Pro (全功能旗艦版)</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg-primary: #070d18;
      --bg-secondary: #0c1827;
      --bg-panel: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85);
      --border-color: #1e293b;
      --accent-cyan: #38bdf8;
      --accent-purple: #a855f7;
      --accent-red: #f43f5e;
      --accent-green: #10b981;
      --accent-gold: #fbbf24;
      --text-main: #f8fafc;
      --text-muted: #94a3b8;
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; }
    body { background-color: var(--bg-primary); color: var(--text-main); min-height: 100vh; padding: 15px; }

    /* 頂部主控列 */
    .header-bar {
      display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
      background: var(--bg-panel); border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px); padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px;
    }
    .header-title { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 800; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #38bdf8, #a855f7, #f43f5e); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    
    /* 頂部個股搜尋框 */
    .search-box-wrapper { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9); border: 1.5px solid var(--accent-cyan); border-radius: 8px; padding: 3px 8px; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2); }
    .search-input { background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; color: #fff; font-size: 0.92rem; width: 190px; padding: 4px; font-weight: 600; }
    .search-input::placeholder { color: #64748b; font-weight: normal; }

    .header-info { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); }

    /* 頁籤導航列 */
    .tabs-nav { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 12px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 4px; }
    .tab-btn {
      background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); color: var(--text-muted);
      padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 600;
      transition: all 0.2s; white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .tab-btn:hover { background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12); color: var(--accent-cyan); border-color: var(--accent-cyan); }
    .tab-btn.active {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25), rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25));
      color: #fff; border-color: var(--accent-cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
    }

    /* 頁籤內容 */
    .tab-content { display: none; }
    .tab-content.active { display: block; animation: fadeIn 0.25s ease-in-out; }
    @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(5px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

    /* 玻璃擬態面板與網格 */
    .glass-panel { background: var(--bg-panel); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-radius: 12px; padding: 15px; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .stats-grid { display: grid; gap: 12px; }
    .stat-card { background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 15px; }
    .stat-label { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .stat-value { font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 2px; }
    .stat-sub { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-muted); }

    /* 🟢 凍結表頭容器 (Sticky Header Table) */
    .table-container {
      max-height: 650px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      overflow-x: auto;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: 8px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .quant-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.88rem; text-align: left; }
    .quant-table thead th {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 10;
      background: #0b1528 !important;
      padding: 11px 10px;
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
      font-weight: 700;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan);
      white-space: nowrap;
      cursor: pointer;
      user-select: none;
    }
    .quant-table thead th:hover { background: #13233f !important; }
    .quant-table td { padding: 9px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); white-space: nowrap; }
    .quant-table tr.hover-row:hover { background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12); cursor: pointer; }

    /* 標籤與按鈕 */
    .badge { padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; display: inline-block; }
    .btn-action { background: var(--accent-cyan); color: #000; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s; }
    .btn-action:hover { filter: brightness(1.15); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .btn-refresh-all { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ec4899, #f43f5e); color: #fff; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border:none; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer;}
    .custom-select { background: #0f172a; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #334155; padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.85rem; }

    /* 模式切換按鈕組 */
    .mode-btn-group { display: flex; gap: 4px; background: #0f172a; padding: 3px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #334155; }
    .mode-btn { background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 5px 12px; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; }
    .mode-btn.active { background: var(--accent-cyan); color: #000; }

    /* 內嵌 iframe 圖表 */
    .chart-frame-wrapper { width: 100%; height: 850px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: #000; }
    .chart-frame { width: 100%; height: 100%; border: none; }

    /* 個股即時透視彈窗 */
    #modal-stock-hud {
      display: none; position: fixed; top: 70px; right: 20px; width: 400px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96); border: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 35px rgba(0,0,0,0.85); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; z-index: 9999;
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

              </tr>

      <!-- 右卡：AI 供應鏈精銳 -->

  <!-- ========================================== -->
  <!-- 頁籤 5: 四大聯動圖表中心 (含盤後/盤中自選模式) -->

  <div id="tab-charts" class="tab-content">

      <div>當前圖表標的: <strong id="chart-current-stock" style="color:var(--accent-cyan); font-size:1.15rem;">2330 台積電</strong></div>
      
      <!-- 🟢 盤後 / 盤中 繪圖模式切換 -->
      <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;">

  <div id="tab-dna" class="tab-content">
    <div class="glass-panel">
      <div style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-purple); margin-bottom:10px;">💎 個股 3-Way 離場勝率與期望值基因庫</div>
      <div class="table-container">
        <table class="quant-table" id="table-dna-exits">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th onclick="sortTable('table-dna-exits', 0)">代號 ⇕</th>
              <th onclick="sortTable('table-dna-exits', 1)">名稱 ⇕</th>
              <th onclick="sortTable('table-dna-exits', 2, 'num')">5MA勝率% ⇕</th>
              <th onclick="sortTable('table-dna-exits', 3, 'num')">5MA期望值 ⇕</th>
              <th onclick="sortTable('table-dna-exits', 4, 'num')">10MA勝率% ⇕</th>
              <th onclick="sortTable('table-dna-exits', 5, 'num')">10MA期望值 ⇕</th>
              <th onclick="sortTable('table-dna-exits', 6, 'num')">20MA勝率% ⇕</th>
              <th onclick="sortTable('table-dna-exits', 7, 'num')" style="color:#c084fc;">20MA期望值 ⇕</th>
              <th>最適建議</th>
            </tr>

  <!-- ========================================== -->
  <!-- 頁籤 7: 全球總經與央行日曆 -->
  <!-- ========================================== -->
  <div id="tab-macro" class="tab-content">
    <div class="glass-panel">
      <div style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-gold); margin-bottom:10px;">📅 全球重大總經指標與央行會議日曆</div>
      <div class="table-container">
        <table class="quant-table" id="table-macro-calendar">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th onclick="sortTable('table-macro-calendar', 0)">日期 ⇕</th>
              <th>國家/地區</th><th>指標名稱</th><th>重要性</th><th>前值</th><th>預測值</th><th>實際值</th><th>解讀分析</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody id="tbody-macro-calendar">
            <tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#64748b;">載入中...</td></tr>
          </tbody>
