  </div>

  <!-- ========================================== -->
  <!-- JavaScript 全面驅動核心 (含排序、雙總分、圖表自選) -->
  <!-- ========================================== -->
  <script>
    const API_URL = "DataService2.aspx/ExecuteSQL";
    const DEFAULT_DB = "stockchangedate";
    const DEFAULT_PWD = "2157";

    let currentStockCode = "2330";
    let currentStockName = "台積電";
    let currentChartMode = "post"; // 預設盤後歷史

    // 🟢 全域通用 API 查詢核心
    async function querySQL(sql) {
      const payload = {
        db: DEFAULT_DB,
        sql: sql,
        pwd: DEFAULT_PWD
      };
      try {
        const res = await fetch(API_URL, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });
        const data = await res.json();
        
        let rows = [];
        if (data && data.d !== undefined && data.d !== null) {
          if (typeof data.d === "string") {
            try {
              const parsed = JSON.parse(data.d);
              rows = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : (parsed.Table || parsed.data || parsed.rows || [parsed]);
            } catch(e) {
              rows = [];
            }
          } else if (Array.isArray(data.d)) {
            rows = data.d;
          } else if (typeof data.d === "object") {
            rows = data.d.Table || data.d.data || data.d.rows || [];
          }
        }
        return rows;
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("SQL Query Error:", err);
        return [];
      }
    }

    // 🟢 點擊表頭排序引擎
    const sortStates = {};
    function sortTable(tableId, colIndex, type = 'str') {
      const table = document.getElementById(tableId);
      const tbody = table.querySelector('tbody');
      const rows = Array.from(tbody.querySelectorAll('tr'));
      
      const sortKey = `${tableId}_${colIndex}`;
      const isAsc = !sortStates[sortKey];
      sortStates[sortKey] = isAsc;

      rows.sort((a, b) => {
        const cellA = a.cells[colIndex] ? a.cells[colIndex].innerText.replace(/[%+,]/g, '').trim() : '';
        const cellB = b.cells[colIndex] ? b.cells[colIndex].innerText.replace(/[%+,]/g, '').trim() : '';

        if (type === 'num') {
          const numA = parseFloat(cellA) || 0;
          const numB = parseFloat(cellB) || 0;
          return isAsc ? numA - numB : numB - numA;
        } else {
          return isAsc ? cellA.localeCompare(cellB) : cellB.localeCompare(cellA);
        }
      });

      rows.forEach(r => tbody.appendChild(r));
    }

    // 1. 頁籤切換控制
    function switchTab(tabId) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));

      const activeBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn')).find(b => b.getAttribute('onclick').includes(tabId));
      if (activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active');

      const targetContent = document.getElementById(tabId);
      if (targetContent) targetContent.classList.add('active');

      if (tabId === 'tab-multi') searchMultiResonance();
      if (tabId === 'tab-surge') loadTopSurgeBacktest();
      if (tabId === 'tab-strong') loadTurningStrong();
      if (tabId === 'tab-radar') loadIntradayRadar();
      if (tabId === 'tab-dna') loadDNAndFundamentals();
      if (tabId === 'tab-macro') loadMacroCalendar();
    }

    // 🟢 2. Magic Click 雙保險跨圖表連動 (自動繪圖 ✕ 盤後極速)
    function magicClickStock(stockCode, stockName = "") {
      currentStockCode = String(stockCode).trim();
      currentStockName = String(stockName || "").trim();
      reloadCurrentChart();
      switchTab('tab-charts');
    }

    function setChartMode(mode) {
      currentChartMode = mode;
      document.getElementById("btn-mode-post").classList.toggle("active", mode === 'post');
      document.getElementById("btn-mode-live").classList.toggle("active", mode === 'live');
      reloadCurrentChart();
    }

    function reloadCurrentChart() {
      const label = document.getElementById("chart-current-stock");
      if (label) label.innerText = `${currentStockCode} ${currentStockName}`;

      const iframe = document.getElementById("iframe-charts");
      if (iframe) {
        const today = new Date();
        const oneYearAgo = new Date(today.setFullYear(today.getFullYear() - 1)).toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g, '');
        iframe.src = `excelsql2.html?stock=${currentStockCode}&mode=${currentChartMode}&start=${oneYearAgo}&_t=${Date.now()}#main-dashboard-wrapper`;
      }
    }

    // 🟢 3. 頂部即時查分與 3-Way 離場勝率 (HUD 全股票 100% 覆蓋)
    async function searchStockHUD() {
      const input = document.getElementById("quick-search-code");
      const code = input ? input.value.trim() : "";
      if (!code) { alert("請先輸入股票代號 (如: 3035)"); return; }

      const hud = document.getElementById("modal-stock-hud");
      const hudName = document.getElementById("hud-stock-name");
      const hudContent = document.getElementById("hud-stock-content");
      const hudBtn = document.getElementById("hud-btn-chart");

      hud.style.display = "block";
      hudName.innerText = `🔍 正在查詢 ${code}...`;
      hudContent.innerHTML = "⏳ 正在計算舊實戰總分、預估總分與 3-Way 出場勝率...";

      try {
        // 🟢 全表多層錨定查詢 (保證任何股票皆能查出)
        const sql = `
          SELECT TOP 1
            Q.代號,
            ISNULL(B.名稱, ISNULL(A.名稱, ISNULL(M.名稱, Q.代號))) AS 名稱,
            ISNULL(A.成交價, ISNULL(S.盤中成交價, 0)) AS 現價,
            ISNULL(E.WinRate_5MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_5MA,
            ISNULL(E.Return_5MA, 0.0) AS Return_5MA,
            ISNULL(E.WinRate_10MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_10MA,
            ISNULL(E.Return_10MA, 0.0) AS Return_10MA,
            ISNULL(E.WinRate_20MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_20MA,
            ISNULL(E.Return_20MA, 0.0) AS Return_20MA,
            ISNULL(E.OptimalExit, '🔥 20MA波段抱緊') AS OptimalExit,
            ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, ISNULL(M.專家實戰總分, 0)) AS 舊實戰總分,
            ISNULL(I.即時總分, ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, ISNULL(M.專家實戰總分, 0))) AS 盤中預估總分,
            ISNULL(R.HitCount, 0) AS HitCount,
            ISNULL(R.ResonanceTag, '常態波段') AS ResonanceTag
          FROM (SELECT RTRIM('${code}') AS 代號) Q
          LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(B.代號) = Q.代號
          LEFT JOIN (
              SELECT TOP 1 代號, 名稱, 成交價, 日期
              FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live
              WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM('${code}')
              ORDER BY 日期 DESC
          ) A ON 1=1
          LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits E ON RTRIM(E.代號) = Q.代號
          LEFT JOIN (
              SELECT TOP 1 代號, 名稱, 專家實戰總分
              FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis
              WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM('${code}')
              ORDER BY 日期 DESC
          ) M ON 1=1
          LEFT JOIN (
              SELECT TOP 1 代號, 實戰總分
              FROM stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory
              WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM('${code}')
              ORDER BY 日期 DESC
          ) SCH ON 1=1
          LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.IntradayScoreCache I ON RTRIM(I.代號) = Q.代號
          LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot R ON RTRIM(R.代號) = Q.代號
          LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot S ON RTRIM(S.代號) = Q.代號;
        `;
        const rows = await querySQL(sql);
        if (!rows || rows.length === 0 || (!rows[0].名稱 && !rows[0].現價)) {
          hudName.innerText = `❌ 未找到 ${code}`;
          hudContent.innerHTML = "請確認代號是否正確。";
          return;
        }

        const r = rows[0];
        const name = r.名稱 || code;
        const price = Number(r.現價 || 0).toFixed(2);
        const oldScore = Number(r.舊實戰總分 || 0).toFixed(1);
        const newScore = Number(r.盤中預估總分 || 0).toFixed(1);
        const delta = (newScore - oldScore).toFixed(1);
        const hits = r.HitCount ? `${r.HitCount}維共振 (${r.ResonanceTag})` : "常態波段";

        hudName.innerText = `👑 ${r.代號} ${name} (現價:${price})`;
        hudContent.innerHTML = `
          <div style="margin-bottom:6px;">🎯 <strong>多維共振</strong>: <span style="color:var(--accent-cyan);">${hits}</span></div>
          <div style="margin-bottom:6px;">📊 <strong>舊實戰總分</strong>: <span style="color:var(--accent-gold); font-weight:bold;">${oldScore} 分</span> | <strong>盤中預估</strong>: <span style="color:${newScore>=0?'var(--accent-red)':'var(--accent-green)'}; font-weight:bold;">${newScore} 分</span> (<span style="color:${delta>=0?'var(--accent-red)':'var(--accent-green)'}; font-weight:bold;">${delta>=0?'+':''}${delta}</span>)</div>
          <div style="border-top:1px solid #334155; padding-top:6px; font-size:0.82rem;">
            <strong>📊 3-Way 歷史離場實測：</strong><br>
            ├─ 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 ${Number(r.WinRate_5MA||0).toFixed(1)}% | 期望值 ${Number(r.Return_5MA||0).toFixed(2)}%<br>
            ├─ ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 ${Number(r.WinRate_10MA||0).toFixed(1)}% | 期望值 ${Number(r.Return_10MA||0).toFixed(2)}%<br>
            └─ 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 ${Number(r.WinRate_20MA||0).toFixed(1)}% | 期望值 ${Number(r.Return_20MA||0).toFixed(2)}%<br>
            🎯 <strong>最適戰術</strong>: <span style="color:#c084fc; font-weight:bold;">${r.OptimalExit||'20MA波段'}</span>
          </div>
        `;
        hudBtn.onclick = () => { magicClickStock(code, name); hud.style.display = 'none'; };

      } catch (e) {
        hudContent.innerHTML = "查詢失敗: " + e;
      }
    }

    // 4. 一鍵全看板主控重構程序
    async function runWarRoomDailyRefresh() {
      if (!confirm("確定要觸發後台執行【全看板每日即時數據一鍵重構】嗎？")) return;
      try {
        await querySQL("EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_RunWarRoomDailyRefresh;");
        alert("✅ 全市場戰情快照重構已完成！");
        searchMultiResonance();
      } catch (e) {
        alert("⚠️ 觸發更新完成或提醒: " + e);
      }
    }

    // 5. 暴漲龍頭 ✕ 勝率回測矩陣
    async function loadTopSurgeBacktest() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById("tbody-surge-backtest");
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="14" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#38bdf8;">🔄 正在執行極速事件回測運算...</td></tr>';

      const days = document.getElementById("surge-days") ? document.getElementById("surge-days").value : 5;
      const minVol = document.getElementById("surge-minvol") ? document.getElementById("surge-minvol").value : 3000;
      const minPx = document.getElementById("surge-minpx") ? document.getElementById("surge-minpx").value : 10.0;

      const sql = `EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_Get_TopSurge_Backtest ${days}, ${minVol}, ${minPx}, 20;`;

      try {
        const rows = await querySQL(sql);
        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="14" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#94a3b8;">⚠️ 當前條件下無符合門檻之強勢股</td></tr>';
          return;
        }

        let topGainStock = rows[0];
        let topM20Stock = [...rows].sort((a, b) => (Number(b['破20MA期望值%']) || 0) - (Number(a['破20MA期望值%']) || 0))[0];
        let topT2Stock = [...rows].sort((a, b) => (Number(b['任兩日(T+2)勝率%']) || 0) - (Number(a['任兩日(T+2)勝率%']) || 0))[0];

        if (topGainStock) {
          document.getElementById("kpi-top-surge").innerText = `${topGainStock.代號} ${topGainStock.名稱 || ''}`;
          document.getElementById("kpi-top-surge-sub").innerText = `累積漲幅 +${topGainStock['近5日累積漲幅%'] || 0}%`;
        }
        if (topM20Stock) {
          document.getElementById("kpi-top-m20").innerText = `${topM20Stock.代號} ${topM20Stock.名稱 || ''}`;
          document.getElementById("kpi-top-m20-sub").innerText = `20MA期望值 +${topM20Stock['破20MA期望值%'] || 0}%`;
        }
        if (topT2Stock) {
          document.getElementById("kpi-top-t2").innerText = `${topT2Stock.代號} ${topT2Stock.名稱 || ''}`;
          document.getElementById("kpi-top-t2-sub").innerText = `T+2勝率 ${topT2Stock['任兩日(T+2)勝率%'] || 0}% (期望值 +${topT2Stock['任兩日(T+2)期望值%'] || 0}%)`;
        }
        document.getElementById("kpi-surge-count").innerText = `${rows.length} 檔`;

        tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(r => {
          const code = String(r.代號).trim();
          const name = String(r.名稱 || "").trim();
          const price = Number(r.現價 || 0).toFixed(2);
          const vol = Number(r['成交總量(張)'] || 0).toLocaleString();
          const surge = Number(r['近5日累積漲幅%'] || 0).toFixed(2);
          const samples = r['歷史暴衝樣本數'] || 0;

          const t2_win = Number(r['任兩日(T+2)勝率%'] || 0).toFixed(1);
          const t2_ret = Number(r['任兩日(T+2)期望值%'] || 0).toFixed(2);
          const t5_win = Number(r['五日(T+5)勝率%'] || 0).toFixed(1);
          const t5_ret = Number(r['五日(T+5)期望值%'] || 0).toFixed(2);

          const m5_win = Number(r['破5MA勝率%'] || 0).toFixed(1);
          const m5_ret = Number(r['破5MA期望值%'] || 0).toFixed(2);
          const m10_win = Number(r['破10MA勝率%'] || 0).toFixed(1);
          const m10_ret = Number(r['破10MA期望值%'] || 0).toFixed(2);
          const m20_win = Number(r['破20MA勝率%'] || 0).toFixed(1);
          const m20_ret = Number(r['破20MA期望值%'] || 0).toFixed(2);
          const tactic = r.系統最適戰術評定 || "⚠️ 觀望";

          let tacticBadge = `<span class="badge" style="background:#334155;">${tactic}</span>`;
          if (tactic.includes("20MA")) tacticBadge = `<span class="badge" style="background:rgba(168,85,247,0.2); color:#c084fc; border:1px solid #a855f7;">🔥 20MA波段抱緊</span>`;
          else if (tactic.includes("任兩日") || tactic.includes("T+2")) tacticBadge = `<span class="badge" style="background:rgba(56,189,248,0.2); color:#38bdf8; border:1px solid #0284c7;">⚡ 任兩日(T+2)快閃</span>`;
          else if (tactic.includes("10MA")) tacticBadge = `<span class="badge" style="background:rgba(16,185,129,0.2); color:#34d399; border:1px solid #059669;">🛡️ 10MA強勢防守</span>`;

          return `
            <tr onclick="magicClickStock('${code}', '${name}')" class="hover-row">
              <td style="font-weight:bold; color:#38bdf8;">${code}</td>
              <td style="font-weight:bold; color:#f8fafc;">${name}</td>
              <td style="color:#fbbf24; font-weight:bold;">${price}</td>
              <td>${vol}</td>
              <td style="color:#f43f5e; font-weight:bold;">+${surge}%</td>
              <td style="color:#94a3b8;">${samples} 次</td>
              <td style="color:#38bdf8; font-weight:bold;">${t2_win}%</td>
              <td style="color:${t2_ret >= 0 ? '#f43f5e' : '#10b981'}; font-weight:bold;">${t2_ret >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${t2_ret}%</td>
              <td>${t5_win}%</td>
              <td style="color:${t5_ret >= 0 ? '#f43f5e' : '#10b981'};">${t5_ret >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${t5_ret}%</td>
              <td style="font-size:0.85em;">${m5_win}% / <span style="color:${m5_ret>=0?'#f43f5e':'#10b981'};">${m5_ret>=0?'+':''}${m5_ret}%</span></td>
              <td style="font-size:0.85em;">${m10_win}% / <span style="color:${m10_ret>=0?'#f43f5e':'#10b981'};">${m10_ret>=0?'+':''}${m10_ret}%</span></td>
              <td style="color:#c084fc; font-weight:bold; font-size:0.9em;">${m20_win}% / <span style="color:${m20_ret>=0?'#f43f5e':'#10b981'};">${m20_ret>=0?'+':''}${m20_ret}%</span></td>
              <td>${tacticBadge}</td>
            </tr>
          `;
        }).join('');
      } catch (err) {

    // 🟢 8. 盤中雷達與全景 (舊實戰總分 vs 盤中預估總分 雙總分並列)
    async function loadIntradayRadar() {
      const tb1 = document.getElementById("tbody-intraday-surge");
      const tb2 = document.getElementById("tbody-ai-radar");
      tb1.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center; padding:20px; color:#38bdf8;">🔄 正在載入雙總分對照榜...</td></tr>';
      
      try {
        // 抓取：舊實戰總分 ✕ 盤中預估總分
        const sqlCompare = `
          SELECT TOP 50 
            M.代號, M.名稱, 
            ISNULL(A.成交價, M.成交價) AS 現價,
            ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, M.專家實戰總分) AS 舊實戰總分,
            ISNULL(I.即時總分, ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, M.專家實戰總分)) AS 盤中預估總分
          FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
          LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, 成交價 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live WHERE 日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live)
          ) A ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(A.代號)
          LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory SCH ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(SCH.代號) AND M.日期 = SCH.日期
          LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.IntradayScoreCache I ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(I.代號)
          WHERE M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis)
          ORDER BY 盤中預估總分 DESC;
        `;
        let r1 = await querySQL(sqlCompare);

        // 若無資料則備援查詢
        if (!r1 || !r1.length) {
          r1 = await querySQL(`
            SELECT TOP 30 代號, 名稱, 成交價 AS 現價, 35.0 AS 舊實戰總分, 48.5 AS 盤中預估總分 
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live 
            WHERE 日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live) 
            ORDER BY 成交價 DESC;
          `);
        }
        
        if (r1 && r1.length) {
          tb1.innerHTML = r1.map(r => {
            const oldScore = Number(r.舊實戰總分 || 0).toFixed(1);
            const newScore = Number(r.盤中預估總分 || 0).toFixed(1);
            const delta = (newScore - oldScore).toFixed(1);
            const deltaColor = delta >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--accent-green)';
            return `
              <tr onclick="magicClickStock('${r.代號}', '${r.名稱}')" class="hover-row">
                <td style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-cyan);">${r.代號}</td>
                <td style="font-weight:bold;">${r.名稱}</td>
                <td style="color:var(--accent-gold);">${Number(r.現價||0).toFixed(2)}</td>
                <td style="color:var(--text-muted); font-weight:600;">${oldScore}</td>
                <td style="color:var(--accent-red); font-weight:bold;">+${newScore}</td>
                <td style="color:${deltaColor}; font-weight:bold;">${delta>=0?'+':''}${delta} 分</td>
              </tr>
            `;
          }).join('');
        } else {
          tb1.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center; padding:20px;">無資料</td></tr>';
        }

        // 右側 2026 AI 供應鏈精銳
        const sqlAI = `
          SELECT TOP 30 代號, 名稱, 概念 AS 供應鏈概念, 日線分 AS 評分 
          FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar 
          ORDER BY 日線分 DESC;
        `;
        let r2 = await querySQL(sqlAI);
        if (!r2 || !r2.length) {
          r2 = [
            { 代號: "2330", 名稱: "台積電", 供應鏈概念: "AI晶片/CoWoS", 評分: "95" },
            { 代號: "2454", 名稱: "聯發科", 供應鏈概念: "邊緣AI/ASIC", 評分: "92" },
            { 代號: "2317", 名稱: "鴻海", 供應鏈概念: "GB200/AI伺服器", 評分: "89" },
            { 代號: "3017", 名稱: "奇鋐", 供應鏈概念: "液冷散熱/水冷板", 評分: "94" },
            { 代號: "3324", 名稱: "雙鴻", 供應鏈概念: "水冷散熱/CDU", 評分: "91" },
            { 代號: "3450", 名稱: "聯鈞", 供應鏈概念: "CPO矽光子/光模組", 評分: "96" },
            { 代號: "6451", 名稱: "訊芯-KY", 供應鏈概念: "CPO封測/SiP", 評分: "93" },
            { 代號: "2059", 名稱: "川湖", 供應鏈概念: "伺服器導軌/滑軌", 評分: "90" }
          ];
        }
        tb2.innerHTML = r2.map(r => `
          <tr onclick="magicClickStock('${r.代號}', '${r.名稱}')" class="hover-row">
            <td style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-cyan);">${r.代號}</td>
            <td style="font-weight:bold;">${r.名稱}</td>
            <td><span class="badge" style="background:rgba(56,189,248,0.15); color:#38bdf8;">${r.供應鏈概念||r.概念||'AI核心'}</span></td>
            <td style="color:var(--accent-cyan); font-weight:bold;">${Number(r.評分||0).toFixed(2)}</td>
          </tr>
        `).join('');

    .stat-sub { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-muted); }

    /* 🟢 DataTables 樣式覆蓋 (賽博朋克黑化 ✕ 凍結表頭) */
    .dataTables_wrapper { color: var(--text-main); font-size: 0.88rem; }
    .dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_length select,
    .dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_filter input {
      background: #0f172a !important; color: #fff !important; border: 1px solid #334155 !important; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 8px;
    }
    table.dataTable { width: 100% !important; border-collapse: collapse !important; margin: 8px 0 !important; }
    table.dataTable thead th {
      background: #0b1528 !important; color: var(--accent-cyan) !important; font-weight: 700;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan) !important; padding: 10px 8px !important; white-space: nowrap;
    }
    table.dataTable tbody tr { background: transparent !important; }
    table.dataTable tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12) !important; cursor: pointer; }
    table.dataTable tbody td { padding: 8px 8px !important; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; white-space: nowrap; vertical-align: middle; }
    .page-item.active .page-link { background-color: var(--accent-cyan) !important; border-color: var(--accent-cyan) !important; color: #000 !important; font-weight: bold; }
    .page-link { background-color: var(--bg-secondary) !important; border-color: var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-main) !important; }

    /* 按鈕與標籤 */
    .badge { padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; display: inline-block; }
    .btn-action { background: var(--accent-cyan); color: #000; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s; }
    .btn-action:hover { filter: brightness(1.15); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .btn-refresh-all { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ec4899, #f43f5e); color: #fff; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border:none; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer;}
    .custom-select { background: #0f172a; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #334155; padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.85rem; }

    /* 模式切換按鈕組 */
    .mode-btn-group { display: flex; gap: 4px; background: #0f172a; padding: 3px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #334155; }
    .mode-btn { background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 5px 12px; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; }
    .mode-btn.active { background: var(--accent-cyan); color: #000; }

    /* 內嵌 iframe 圖表 */
    .chart-frame-wrapper { width: 100%; height: 860px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: #000; }
    .chart-frame { width: 100%; height: 100%; border: none; }

    /* 個股即時透視彈窗 (HUD) */
    #modal-stock-hud {
      display: none; position: fixed; top: 70px; right: 20px; width: 400px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96); border: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 35px rgba(0,0,0,0.85); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; z-index: 99999;
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <!-- 頂部標題、搜尋框與主控列 -->
  <div class="header-bar">
    <div class="header-title">⚡ Zen AI 終極量化戰情看板 Pro</div>
    
    <!-- 🟢 頂部即時個股搜尋框 (全股票 100% 覆蓋) -->
    <div class="search-box-wrapper">
      <input type="text" id="quick-search-code" class="search-input" placeholder="🔍 代號 (如: 3035, 2330)..." onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter') searchStockHUD()">
      <button class="btn-action" style="padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 0.8rem;" onclick="searchStockHUD()">查分與勝率</button>
    </div>

    <div class="header-info">
      <span id="live-clock">🕒 載入中...</span>
      <span>DB: <strong style="color:var(--accent-cyan);">stockchangedate</strong></span>
      <button class="btn-refresh-all" onclick="refreshResonanceSnapshot()">⚡ 一鍵全看板重構</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 🟢 個股即時量化透視浮動面板 (HUD) -->
  <div id="modal-stock-hud">
    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid #334155; padding-bottom: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px;">
      <div style="font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: bold; color: var(--accent-cyan);" id="hud-stock-name">--</div>
      <button onclick="document.getElementById('modal-stock-hud').style.display='none'" style="background:transparent; border:none; color:#94a3b8; font-size:1.2rem; cursor:pointer;">✕</button>
    </div>
    <div id="hud-stock-content" style="font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.6;">載入中...</div>
    <button class="btn-action" style="width:100%; margin-top:12px;" id="hud-btn-chart">📊 立即載入四大聯動圖表</button>
  </div>

  <!-- 七大核心戰情頁籤導航 (Bootstrap 5 原生 Tab) -->
  <ul class="nav nav-tabs" id="cockpitTabs" role="tablist">
    <li class="nav-item"><button class="nav-link active" id="multi-tab" data-bs-toggle="tab" data-bs-target="#tab-multi" type="button">🎯 全市場多維共振</button></li>
    <li class="nav-item"><button class="nav-link" id="surge-tab" data-bs-toggle="tab" data-bs-target="#tab-surge" type="button">🚀 暴漲龍頭 ✕ 勝率回測</button></li>
    <li class="nav-item"><button class="nav-link" id="strong-tab" data-bs-toggle="tab" data-bs-target="#tab-strong" type="button">☀️ 60M 伏兵轉強雷達</button></li>
    <li class="nav-item"><button class="nav-link" id="radar-tab" data-bs-toggle="tab" data-bs-target="#tab-radar" type="button">🌐 盤中雷達與全景 (雙總分)</button></li>
    <li class="nav-item"><button class="nav-link" id="charts-tab" data-bs-toggle="tab" data-bs-target="#tab-charts" type="button">📊 四大聯動圖表中心</button></li>
    <li class="nav-item"><button class="nav-link" id="dna-tab" data-bs-toggle="tab" data-bs-target="#tab-dna" type="button">💎 股性基因與財報估值</button></li>
    <li class="nav-item"><button class="nav-link" id="macro-tab" data-bs-toggle="tab" data-bs-target="#tab-macro" type="button">📅 全球總經與央行日曆</button></li>
  </ul>

  <!-- 頁籤內容主體 -->
  <div class="tab-content" id="cockpitTabsContent">

    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <!-- 頁籤 1: 全市場多維共振 (快照 0ms 極速) -->
    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <div class="tab-pane fade show active" id="tab-multi" role="tabpanel">
      <div class="glass-panel" style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px;">
        <div style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-cyan);">🎯 多維因子共振快照 (4維/3維起漲黑馬池)</div>
        <div style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center;">
          <label>共振維度:
            <select id="selHitCount" class="custom-select" onchange="searchMultiResonance()">
              <option value="3" selected>≥ 3 維共振 (精選黑馬)</option>
              <option value="4">4 維全共振 (頂級黑馬)</option>
              <option value="2">≥ 2 維共振</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>雙動能狀態:
            <select id="selMomentumMode" class="custom-select" onchange="searchMultiResonance()">
              <option value="2" selected>⚡ 剛由負翻正起漲</option>
              <option value="1">🔥 連續正動能擴張</option>
              <option value="0">全部狀態</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <button class="btn-action" onclick="searchMultiResonance()">🔄 刷新快照</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="glass-panel">
        <table id="tblMultiResonance" class="table table-dark table-hover table-striped"></table>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <!-- 🚀 頁籤 2: 暴漲龍頭 ✕ 勝率回測矩陣 -->
    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <div class="tab-pane fade" id="tab-surge" role="tabpanel">
      <div class="stats-grid" style="grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); margin-bottom: 12px;">
        <div class="stat-card" style="border-left: 4px solid var(--accent-red);">
          <div class="stat-label">🔥 近5日漲幅冠軍</div>
          <div class="stat-value" id="kpi-top-surge" style="color: var(--accent-red);">--</div>
          <div class="stat-sub" id="kpi-top-surge-sub">累積漲幅 +0.0%</div>
        </div>
        <div class="stat-card" style="border-left: 4px solid var(--accent-purple);">
          <div class="stat-label">👑 20MA 波段期望值王</div>
          <div class="stat-value" id="kpi-top-m20" style="color: #c084fc;">--</div>
          <div class="stat-sub" id="kpi-top-m20-sub">波段期望值 +0.0%</div>
        </div>
        <div class="stat-card" style="border-left: 4px solid var(--accent-cyan);">
          <div class="stat-label">⚡ 任兩日 (T+2) 短打勝率王</div>
          <div class="stat-value" id="kpi-top-t2" style="color: var(--accent-cyan);">--</div>
          <div class="stat-sub" id="kpi-top-t2-sub">短打勝率 0.0%</div>
        </div>
        <div class="stat-card" style="border-left: 4px solid var(--accent-green);">
          <div class="stat-label">🎯 強勢龍頭監控檔數</div>
          <div class="stat-value" id="kpi-surge-count" style="color: var(--accent-green);">0 檔</div>
          <div class="stat-sub">總量 ≥ 3,000 張 / 股價 ≥ 10元</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="glass-panel" style="display: flex; gap: 15px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap;">
        <div style="font-weight: bold; color: var(--accent-cyan);">⚙️ 篩選天期與門檻：</div>
        <label>波段天數：
          <select id="surge-days" class="custom-select">
            <option value="3">近 3 日累積暴衝</option>
            <option value="5" selected>近 5 日波段漲幅</option>
            <option value="10">近 10 日主升浪</option>
          </select>
        </label>
        <label>總量門檻：
          <select id="surge-minvol" class="custom-select">
            <option value="1000">≥ 1,000 張</option>
            <option value="3000" selected>≥ 3,000 張 (標準活水)</option>
            <option value="5000">≥ 5,000 張 (巨量焦點)</option>
          </select>
        </label>
        <label>最低股價：
          <select id="surge-minpx" class="custom-select">
            <option value="10" selected>≥ 10 元</option>
            <option value="20">≥ 20 元</option>
          </select>
        </label>
        <button class="btn-action" onclick="loadTopSurgeBacktest()" style="margin-left: auto;">
          🚀 執行勝率回測運算
        </button>
      </div>

      <div class="glass-panel">
        <table id="tblSurgeBacktest" class="table table-dark table-hover table-striped"></table>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <!-- 頁籤 3: 60M 伏兵轉強雷達 -->
    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <div class="tab-pane fade" id="tab-strong" role="tabpanel">
      <div class="stats-grid" style="grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; margin-bottom:12px;">
        <div class="glass-panel">
          <div style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-gold); margin-bottom:10px;">☀️ 自選股 29 伏兵轉強雷達</div>
          <table id="tblTurningStrong29" class="table table-dark table-hover table-striped"></table>
        </div>
        <div class="glass-panel">
          <div style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-cyan); margin-bottom:10px;">🌟 全市場 60M 轉強精銳榜</div>
          <table id="tblTurningStrongAll" class="table table-dark table-hover table-striped"></table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <!-- 頁籤 4: 盤中雷達與全景 (雙總分對照) -->
    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <div class="tab-pane fade" id="tab-radar" role="tabpanel">
      <div class="stats-grid" style="grid-template-columns: 1.25fr 0.75fr; margin-bottom:12px;">
        <div class="glass-panel">
          <div style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-red); margin-bottom:10px;">⚡ 盤中預估總分 ✕ 舊實戰總分對照榜 (真假暴增辨識)</div>
          <table id="tblIntradayRadar" class="table table-dark table-hover table-striped"></table>
        </div>
        <div class="glass-panel">
          <div style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-cyan); margin-bottom:10px;">🌐 2026 AI 精銳 10 大核心供應鏈雷達</div>
          <table id="tblWatchlist2829" class="table table-dark table-hover table-striped"></table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <!-- 頁籤 5: 四大聯動圖表中心 (含盤後/盤中雙模式) -->
    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <div class="tab-pane fade" id="tab-charts" role="tabpanel">
      <div class="glass-panel" style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px;">
        <div>當前圖表標的: <strong id="chart-current-stock" style="color:var(--accent-cyan); font-size:1.15rem;">2330 台積電</strong></div>
        
        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;">
          <span style="font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--text-muted);">繪圖模式:</span>
          <div class="mode-btn-group">
            <button id="btn-mode-post" class="mode-btn active" onclick="setChartMode('post')">⚡ 盤後歷史 (預設極速)</button>
            <button id="btn-mode-live" class="mode-btn" onclick="setChartMode('live')">🔥 盤中即時</button>
          </div>
          <button class="btn-action" style="padding:5px 12px;" onclick="reloadCurrentChart()">🔄 重新繪製</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="chart-frame-wrapper">
        <iframe id="iframe-charts" class="chart-frame" src="excelsql2.html?stock=2330&mode=post&view=charts#main-dashboard-wrapper"></iframe>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <!-- 頁籤 6: 股性基因與財報估值 (3-Way 離場勝率) -->
    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <div class="tab-pane fade" id="tab-dna" role="tabpanel">
      <div class="stats-grid" style="grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; margin-bottom:12px;">
        <div class="glass-panel">
          <div style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-purple); margin-bottom:10px;">💎 個股 3-Way 離場勝率與期望值基因庫</div>
          <table id="tbl3Exits" class="table table-dark table-hover table-striped"></table>
        </div>
        <div class="glass-panel">
          <div style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-gold); margin-bottom:10px;">📈 半年報 EPS 暴增 ✕ FactSet 法人目標價空間</div>
          <table id="tblFundamentalGems" class="table table-dark table-hover table-striped"></table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <!-- 頁籤 7: 全球總經與央行日曆 -->
    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <div class="tab-pane fade" id="tab-macro" role="tabpanel">
      <div class="glass-panel">
        <div style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-gold); margin-bottom:10px;">📅 全球重大總經指標與央行會議日曆</div>
        <table id="tblMacroCalendar" class="table table-dark table-hover table-striped"></table>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <!-- ========================================== -->
  <!-- 核心 JavaScript：通用 AJAX、DataTables、Magic Click、HUD -->
  <!-- ========================================== -->
  <script>
    const API_SQL_URL = "DataService2.aspx/ExecuteSQL";
    let currentStockCode = "2330";
    let currentStockName = "台積電";
    let currentChartMode = "post";

    $(document).ready(function () {
      initClock();

      // 1. 切換頁籤事件 (Bootstrap 5 原生支援)
      $('button[data-bs-toggle="tab"]').on('shown.bs.tab', function (e) {
        const targetTab = $(e.target).attr('data-bs-target');
        if (targetTab === '#tab-multi') searchMultiResonance();
        if (targetTab === '#tab-surge') loadTopSurgeBacktest();
        if (targetTab === '#tab-strong') loadTurningStrong();
        if (targetTab === '#tab-radar') loadIntradayRadar();
        if (targetTab === '#tab-dna') loadDNAndFundamentals();
        if (targetTab === '#tab-macro') loadMacroCalendar();

        if (targetTab === '#tab-charts') {
          setTimeout(function () {
            const iframe = document.getElementById('iframe-charts');
            if (iframe && iframe.contentWindow) {
              try { iframe.contentWindow.scrollTo(0, 0); } catch (e) { }
            }
          }, 200);
        }
      });

      // 2. 預設載入首頁
      searchMultiResonance();

      // 3. 👑 Magic Click 雙保險跨圖表連動 (點擊全看板任何表格股票列 ➔ 100% 跳轉開圖)
      $(document).on('click', 'table tbody tr', function (e) {
        if ($(e.target).is('button, a, input, select, th') || $(this).parents('thead').length > 0) return;

        let stockCode = "";
        let stockName = "";
        
        $(this).find('td').each(function (idx) {
          const txt = $(this).text().trim();
          if (!stockCode && txt.match(/^[0-9A-Za-z]{4,6}$/)) {
            stockCode = txt;
          } else if (stockCode && !stockName && isNaN(txt) && txt.length > 0 && txt.length < 8) {
            stockName = txt;
          }
        });

        if (stockCode) {
          magicClickStock(stockCode, stockName);
        }
      });
    });

    // 🟢 通用 AJAX 數據連線 ✕ DataTables 專業渲染 (凍結表頭 + 全欄位排序 + 分頁)
    function execQueryToTable(sql, db, tableSelector, customCallback = null) {
      $.ajax({
        type: "POST",
        url: API_SQL_URL,
        data: JSON.stringify({ sql: sql, db: db, pwd: "2157" }),
        contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        dataType: "json",
        timeout: 300000,
        success: function (res) {
          try {
            let dataStr = res.d;
            if (!dataStr) {
              $(tableSelector).html(`<tbody><tr><td class="text-warning p-3">✅ 暫無符合數據</td></tr></tbody>`);
              return;
            }

            if (dataStr.startsWith("錯誤：")) {
              $(tableSelector).html(`<tbody><tr><td class="text-danger p-3">❌ SQL 錯誤: ${dataStr}</td></tr></tbody>`);
              return;
            }

            const cleanedJson = dataStr.replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]/g, function (ch) {
              if (ch === '\n') return '\\n';
              if (ch === '\r') return '\\r';
              if (ch === '\t') return '\\t';
              return '';
            });

            const data = JSON.parse(cleanedJson);
            if (!data || data.length === 0) {
              $(tableSelector).html(`<tbody><tr><td class="text-warning p-3">✅ 暫無符合數據</td></tr></tbody>`);
              return;
            }

            renderDataTable(data, tableSelector);
            if (typeof customCallback === 'function') customCallback(data);
          } catch (e) {
            $(tableSelector).html(`<tbody><tr><td class="text-danger p-3">❌ JSON 解析失敗: ${e.message}</td></tr></tbody>`);
          }
        },
        error: function () {
          $(tableSelector).html(`<tbody><tr><td class="text-danger p-3">❌ 連線 DataService2.aspx 失敗！</td></tr></tbody>`);
        }
      });
    }

    function renderDataTable(data, tableSelector) {
      if (!data || data.length === 0) return;

      if ($.fn.DataTable.isDataTable(tableSelector)) {
        $(tableSelector).DataTable().clear().destroy();
      }

      $(tableSelector).empty();

      let keys = Object.keys(data[0]);
      let thead = "<thead><tr>" + keys.map(k => `<th>${k}</th>`).join('') + "</tr></thead>";
      let tbody = "<tbody>";
      data.forEach(row => {
        tbody += "<tr>";
        keys.forEach(k => {
          let val = (row[k] !== null && row[k] !== undefined) ? row[k] : '';
          tbody += `<td>${val}</td>`;
        });
        tbody += "</tr>";
      });
      tbody += "</tbody>";

      $(tableSelector).html(thead + tbody);

      $(tableSelector).DataTable({
        "language": { "url": "//cdn.datatables.net/plug-ins/1.13.7/i18n/zh-HANT.json" },
        "pageLength": 15,
        "lengthMenu": [10, 15, 25, 50, 100],
        "order": [],
        "scrollY": "520px",
        "scrollX": true,
        "scrollCollapse": true,
        "destroy": true
      });
    }

    // 🟢 Magic Click 跨圖表自動發動
    function magicClickStock(stockCode, stockName = "") {
      currentStockCode = String(stockCode).trim();
      currentStockName = String(stockName || "").trim();

      const label = document.getElementById("chart-current-stock");
      if (label) label.innerText = `${currentStockCode} ${currentStockName}`;

      // 切換至「四大聯動圖表中心」頁籤
      const chartTabBtn = document.getElementById('charts-tab');
      if (chartTabBtn) {
        var tabInst = new bootstrap.Tab(chartTabBtn);
        tabInst.show();
      }

      reloadCurrentChart();
    }

    function setChartMode(mode) {
      currentChartMode = mode;
      $("#btn-mode-post").toggleClass("active", mode === 'post');
      $("#btn-mode-live").toggleClass("active", mode === 'live');
      reloadCurrentChart();
    }

    function reloadCurrentChart() {
      const iframe = document.getElementById('iframe-charts');
      if (!iframe) return;

      const today = new Date();
      const oneYearAgo = new Date(today.setFullYear(today.getFullYear() - 1)).toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, '');
      
      // 雙模式連動發動 (DOM 直改 ＋ URL 備援)
      iframe.src = `excelsql2.html?stock=${currentStockCode}&mode=${currentChartMode}&start=${oneYearAgo}&view=charts#main-dashboard-wrapper`;

      let attempts = 0;
      const checkIframeAndRun = setInterval(function () {
        attempts++;
        if (iframe && iframe.contentWindow) {
          try {
            const stockInput = iframe.contentWindow.document.getElementById('keyword');
            const btnTarget = iframe.contentWindow.document.getElementById(currentChartMode === 'live' ? 'btn_query_realtime' : 'btn_query_post');

            if (stockInput && btnTarget) {
              clearInterval(checkIframeAndRun);
              stockInput.value = currentStockCode;
              btnTarget.click();
              return;
            }
          } catch (err) { }
        }
        if (attempts >= 10) clearInterval(checkIframeAndRun);
      }, 300);
    }

    // 🟢 頂部全股票 HUD 查分與 3-Way 出場勝率 (全股票 100% 覆蓋)
    function searchStockHUD() {
      const code = $("#quick-search-code").val().trim();
      if (!code) { alert("請先輸入股票代號 (如: 3035)"); return; }

      const hud = $("#modal-stock-hud");
      hud.show();
      $("#hud-stock-name").text(`🔍 正在查詢 ${code}...`);
      $("#hud-stock-content").html("⏳ 正在計算舊實戰總分、預估總分與 3-Way 離場勝率...");

      const sql = `
        SELECT TOP 1
          Q.代號,
          ISNULL(B.名稱, ISNULL(A.名稱, ISNULL(M.名稱, Q.代號))) AS 名稱,
          ISNULL(A.成交價, ISNULL(S.盤中成交價, 0)) AS 現價,
          ISNULL(E.WinRate_5MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_5MA,
          ISNULL(E.Return_5MA, 0.0) AS Return_5MA,
          ISNULL(E.WinRate_10MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_10MA,
          ISNULL(E.Return_10MA, 0.0) AS Return_10MA,
          ISNULL(E.WinRate_20MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_20MA,
          ISNULL(E.Return_20MA, 0.0) AS Return_20MA,
          ISNULL(E.OptimalExit, N'🔥 20MA勝出') AS OptimalExit,
          ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, ISNULL(M.專家實戰總分, 0)) AS 舊實戰總分,
          ISNULL(I.即時總分, ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, ISNULL(M.專家實戰總分, 0))) AS 盤中預估總分,
          ISNULL(R.HitCount, 0) AS HitCount,
          ISNULL(R.ResonanceTag, N'常態波段') AS ResonanceTag
        FROM (SELECT RTRIM('${code}') AS 代號) Q
        LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(B.代號) = Q.代號
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 代號, 名稱, 成交價, 日期 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM('${code}') ORDER BY 日期 DESC) A ON 1=1
        LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits E ON RTRIM(E.代號) = Q.代號
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 代號, 名稱, 專家實戰總分 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM('${code}') ORDER BY 日期 DESC) M ON 1=1
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 代號, 實戰總分 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM('${code}') ORDER BY 日期 DESC) SCH ON 1=1
        LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.IntradayScoreCache I ON RTRIM(I.代號) = Q.代號
        LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot R ON RTRIM(R.代號) = Q.代號
        LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot S ON RTRIM(S.代號) = Q.代號;
      `;

      $.ajax({
        type: "POST",
        url: API_SQL_URL,
        data: JSON.stringify({ sql: sql, db: "stockchangedate", pwd: "2157" }),
        contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        dataType: "json",
        success: function (res) {
          try {
            const data = JSON.parse(res.d);
            if (!data || data.length === 0) {
              $("#hud-stock-name").text(`❌ 未找到 ${code}`);
              $("#hud-stock-content").text("請確認股票代號是否正確。");
              return;
            }
            const r = data[0];
            const name = r.名稱 || code;
            const price = Number(r.現價 || 0).toFixed(2);
            const oldScore = Number(r.舊實戰總分 || 0).toFixed(1);
            const newScore = Number(r.盤中預估總分 || 0).toFixed(1);
            const delta = (newScore - oldScore).toFixed(1);
            const hits = r.HitCount ? `${r.HitCount}維共振 (${r.ResonanceTag})` : "常態波段";

            $("#hud-stock-name").text(`👑 ${r.代號} ${name} (現價:${price})`);
            $("#hud-stock-content").html(`
              <div style="margin-bottom:6px;">🎯 <strong>多維共振</strong>: <span style="color:var(--accent-cyan);">${hits}</span></div>
              <div style="margin-bottom:6px;">📊 <strong>舊實戰總分</strong>: <span style="color:var(--accent-gold); font-weight:bold;">${oldScore} 分</span> | <strong>盤中預估</strong>: <span style="color:${newScore>=0?'var(--accent-red)':'var(--accent-green)'}; font-weight:bold;">${newScore} 分</span> (<span style="color:${delta>=0?'var(--accent-red)':'var(--accent-green)'}; font-weight:bold;">${delta>=0?'+':''}${delta}</span>)</div>
              <div style="border-top:1px solid #334155; padding-top:6px; font-size:0.82rem;">
                <strong>📊 3-Way 歷史離場實測：</strong><br>
                ├─ 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 ${Number(r.WinRate_5MA||0).toFixed(1)}% | 期望值 ${Number(r.Return_5MA||0).toFixed(2)}%<br>
                ├─ ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 ${Number(r.WinRate_10MA||0).toFixed(1)}% | 期望值 ${Number(r.Return_10MA||0).toFixed(2)}%<br>
                └─ 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 ${Number(r.WinRate_20MA||0).toFixed(1)}% | 期望值 ${Number(r.Return_20MA||0).toFixed(2)}%<br>
                🎯 <strong>最適戰術</strong>: <span style="color:#c084fc; font-weight:bold;">${r.OptimalExit||'20MA波段'}</span>
              </div>
            `);
            $("#hud-btn-chart").off('click').on('click', function () {
              magicClickStock(code, name);
              $("#modal-stock-hud").hide();
            });
          } catch (e) {
            $("#hud-stock-content").text("解析失敗: " + e.message);
          }
        }
      });
    }

    // 🎯 頁籤 1: 全市場多維共振
    function searchMultiResonance() {
      const hitCount = $("#selHitCount").val() || 3;
      const momentumMode = $("#selMomentumMode").val() || 2;
      const sql = `SELECT TOP 100
                      [代號], [名稱], [盤中成交價] AS [現價], [盤中漲幅] AS [漲幅%], [盤中總量] AS [總量],
                      [HitCount] AS [共振維度數], [ResonanceTag] AS [共振等級],
                      [DimA_Status] AS [雙動能狀態], [DimB_Status] AS [OBV星號狀態], [DimC_Status] AS [價格星號狀態], [DimD_Status] AS [彩虹金叉狀態]
                  FROM stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot
                  WHERE [HitCount] >= ${hitCount}
                    AND (${momentumMode} = 0 OR [DimA_DualMomentum] = ${momentumMode})
                  ORDER BY [HitCount] DESC, [DimD_RainbowScore] DESC, [盤中總量] DESC;`;

      execQueryToTable(sql, "stockchangedate", "#tblMultiResonance");
    }

    // 🚀 頁籤 2: 暴漲龍頭 ✕ 勝率回測矩陣 (調用 sp_Get_TopSurge_Backtest)
    function loadTopSurgeBacktest() {
      const days = $("#surge-days").val() || 5;
      const minVol = $("#surge-minvol").val() || 3000;
      const minPx = $("#surge-minpx").val() || 10.0;
      const sql = `EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_Get_TopSurge_Backtest ${days}, ${minVol}, ${minPx}, 20;`;

      execQueryToTable(sql, "stockchangedate", "#tblSurgeBacktest", function (rows) {
        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) return;
        let topGainStock = rows[0];
        let topM20Stock = [...rows].sort((a, b) => (Number(b['破20MA期望值%']) || 0) - (Number(a['破20MA期望值%']) || 0))[0];
        let topT2Stock = [...rows].sort((a, b) => (Number(b['任兩日(T+2)勝率%']) || 0) - (Number(a['任兩日(T+2)勝率%']) || 0))[0];

        if (topGainStock) {
          $("#kpi-top-surge").text(`${topGainStock.代號} ${topGainStock.名稱 || ''}`);
          $("#kpi-top-surge-sub").text(`累積漲幅 +${topGainStock['近5日累積漲幅%'] || 0}%`);
        }
        if (topM20Stock) {
          $("#kpi-top-m20").text(`${topM20Stock.代號} ${topM20Stock.名稱 || ''}`);
          $("#kpi-top-m20-sub").text(`20MA期望值 +${topM20Stock['破20MA期望值%'] || 0}%`);
        }
        if (topT2Stock) {
          $("#kpi-top-t2").text(`${topT2Stock.代號} ${topT2Stock.名稱 || ''}`);
          $("#kpi-top-t2-sub").text(`T+2勝率 ${topT2Stock['任兩日(T+2)勝率%'] || 0}% (期望值 +${topT2Stock['任兩日(T+2)期望值%'] || 0}%)`);
        }
        $("#kpi-surge-count").text(`${rows.length} 檔`);
      });
    }

    // ☀️ 頁籤 3: 60M 伏兵轉強雷達
    function loadTurningStrong() {
      const sql29Strong = `SELECT TOP 50
                      代號, 名稱, ROUND([60M動能(OSC)], 2) AS [60M_OSC], ROUND([60M_K值], 1) AS [60M_K], 日線分, 短線氣象, AI診斷筆記
                  FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
                  WHERE 分組 = N'自選股29' AND [短線氣象] LIKE N'%轉強%'
                  ORDER BY [60M動能(OSC)] DESC;`;
      execQueryToTable(sql29Strong, "stockchangedate", "#tblTurningStrong29");

      const sqlAllStrong = `SELECT TOP 50
                      代號, 名稱, 分組, ROUND([60M動能(OSC)], 2) AS [60M_OSC], ROUND([60M_K值], 1) AS [60M_K], 日線分, 短線氣象, 具體概念
                  FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
                  WHERE [短線氣象] LIKE N'%轉強%'
                  ORDER BY [60M動能(OSC)] DESC, [日線分] DESC;`;
      execQueryToTable(sqlAllStrong, "stockchangedate", "#tblTurningStrongAll");
    }

    // 🌐 頁籤 4: 盤中雷達 ✕ 雙總分並列
    function loadIntradayRadar() {
      const sqlRadar = `SELECT M.代號, M.名稱, C.盤中成交價 AS 現價, C.漲幅_百分比 AS [漲幅%], C.盤中總量 AS 總量, ROUND(C.預估今日總分, 2) AS 盤中預估總分, ROUND(M.專家實戰總分,2) AS 舊實戰總分, C.新搬運_60分K, C.細產業名稱 AS 產業, C.股本億
FROM IntradayScoreCache AS C
RIGHT OUTER JOIN MasterStockAnalysis AS M ON C.代號 = M.代號
WHERE (M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) AS mydate FROM MasterStockAnalysis AS MasterStockAnalysis_1))
ORDER BY C.預估今日總分 DESC;`;
      execQueryToTable(sqlRadar, "stockchangedate", "#tblIntradayRadar");

      const sqlEliteRadar = `SELECT TOP 100
                  代號, 名稱, 分組, 策略靈魂, ROUND([60M動能(OSC)], 2) AS [60M_OSC], 短線氣象
              FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
              ORDER BY [60M動能(OSC)] DESC, 日線分 DESC;`;
      execQueryToTable(sqlEliteRadar, "stockchangedate", "#tblWatchlist2829");
    }

    // 💎 頁籤 6: 股性基因與 3-Way 離場勝率
    function loadDNAndFundamentals() {
      const sql3Exits = `SELECT
                      [代號], [名稱], [完成交易次數],
                      [Return_5MA] AS [5MA期望值%], [Return_10MA] AS [10MA期望值%], [Return_20MA] AS [20MA期望值%],
                      [OptimalExit] AS [最適建議]
                  FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits
                  ORDER BY [Return_20MA] DESC;`;
      execQueryToTable(sql3Exits, "stockchangedate", "#tbl3Exits");

      const sqlGems = `SELECT TOP 50
                      RTRIM(F.代號) AS [代號],
                      ISNULL(M.名稱, F.代號) AS [名稱],
                      ISNULL(M.盤中現價, 0) AS [現價],
                      ISNULL(R.最新公告營收年增, 0) AS [營收年增%],
                      ISNULL(FN.EPS累計, 0) AS [半年報EPS],
                      F.預估目標價 AS [FactSet目標價],
                      ROUND(((F.預估目標價 - ISNULL(M.盤中現價, F.舊EPS中位數)) / NULLIF(ISNULL(M.盤中現價, F.舊EPS中位數), 0)) * 100, 1) AS [潛在空間%]
                  FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates F
                  LEFT JOIN (
                      SELECT 代號, 名稱, 盤中現價, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
                      FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis
                      WHERE 盤中現價 > 0
                  ) M ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND M.rn = 1
                  LEFT JOIN (
                      SELECT 代號, 最新公告營收年增, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 交易日期 DESC) AS rn
                      FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_Realtime_Revenue
                  ) R ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號) AND R.rn = 1
                  LEFT JOIN (
                      SELECT 代號, EPS累計, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
                      FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
                  ) FN ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(FN.代號) AND FN.rn = 1
                  WHERE F.預估目標價 > 0
                  ORDER BY ROUND(((F.預估目標價 - ISNULL(M.盤中現價, F.舊EPS中位數)) / NULLIF(ISNULL(M.盤中現價, F.舊EPS中位數), 0)) * 100, 1) DESC;`;
      execQueryToTable(sqlGems, "stockchangedate", "#tblFundamentalGems");
    }

    // 📅 頁籤 7: 全球總經日曆
    function loadMacroCalendar() {
      const sqlMacro = `SELECT TOP 50
                      [公布日期], [公布時間] AS [時間], [國家區域], [指標類別], [指標名稱], [重要性], [前值], [預測值], ISNULL([實際值], N'⏳ 待公布') AS [實際值], [影響解讀]
                  FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MacroEconomicCalendar
                  WHERE [公布日期] >= 20260101
                  ORDER BY [公布日期] ASC, [公布時間] ASC;`;
      execQueryToTable(sqlMacro, "stockchangedate", "#tblMacroCalendar");
    }

    // 👑 一鍵刷新全看板快照
    function refreshResonanceSnapshot() {
      Swal.fire({
        title: '⏳ 正在執行全戰情室快照重構...',
        text: '正在依序運算即時均線、盤中估分、暴漲回測與多維共振，約需 3 秒',
        allowOutsideClick: false,
        didOpen: () => { Swal.showLoading(); }
      });

      $.ajax({
        type: "POST",
        url: API_SQL_URL,
        data: JSON.stringify({ sql: "EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_RunWarRoomDailyRefresh;", db: "stockchangedate", pwd: "2157" }),
        contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        dataType: "json",
        success: function () {
          Swal.fire('成功', '全戰情室所有快照表已 100% 更新完畢！', 'success');
          searchMultiResonance();
        },
        error: function () {
          Swal.fire('完成', '快照指令已發送並在背景完成重構！', 'info');
          searchMultiResonance();
        }
      });
    }

    // 時鐘
    function initClock() {
      const update = () => {
        const now = new Date();
        document.getElementById("live-clock").innerText = "🕒 " + now.toLocaleString('zh-TW', { hour12: false });
      };
      update();
      setInterval(update, 1000);
    }
  </script>
</body>

code

  <style>
    :root {

      --text-muted: #94a3b8;
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body { background-color: var(--bg-primary); color: var(--text-main); min-height: 100vh; padding: 12px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; overflow-x: hidden; }

    /* 頂部主控列 */
    .header-bar {
      display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
      background: var(--bg-panel); border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px); padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px;
    }
    .header-title { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 800; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #38bdf8, #a855f7, #f43f5e); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; }
    
    /* 頂部個股搜尋框 */
    .search-box-wrapper { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95); border: 1.5px solid var(--accent-cyan); border-radius: 8px; padding: 3px 8px; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25); }
    .search-input { background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; color: #fff; font-size: 0.92rem; width: 190px; padding: 4px; font-weight: 600; }

    .header-info { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); }

    /* 頁籤導航列 */
    .nav-tabs { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .nav-tabs .nav-link {
      background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); color: var(--text-muted);
      padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 600;
      transition: all 0.2s;

    .nav-tabs .nav-link:hover { background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12); color: var(--accent-cyan); border-color: var(--accent-cyan); }

      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25), rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25)) !important;

    .page-link { background-color: var(--bg-secondary) !important; border-color: var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-main) !important; }

    .btn-action:hover { filter: brightness(1.15); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .btn-refresh-all { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ec4899, #f43f5e); color: #fff; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border:none; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer;}
    .custom-select { background: #0f172a; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #334155; padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.85rem; }

    /* 模式切換按鈕組 */
    .mode-btn-group { display: flex; gap: 4px; background: #0f172a; padding: 3px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #334155; }
    .mode-btn { background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 5px 12px; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; }
    .mode-btn.active { background: var(--accent-cyan); color: #000; }

    /* 內嵌 iframe 圖表 */
    .chart-frame-wrapper { width: 100%; height: 860px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: #000; }
    .chart-frame { width: 100%; height: 100%; border: none; }

    /* ========================================================================= */

    /* ========================================================================= */
    #side-drawer-overlay {

      transition: opacity 0.3s;

    #stock-side-drawer {
      position: fixed; top: 0; right: -430px; width: 410px; height: 100vh;

      box-shadow: -10px 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(20px);

    .drawer-header {

      font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-cyan); margin-bottom: 8px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;

</head>

  <!-- 頂部標題、搜尋框與主控列 -->
