這三個問題非常關鍵且切中財務量化的核心！以下為您逐一解答並提供 「全自動、跨季免改代碼、雙重對決（去年同期 vs 去年全年）」 的終極升級版 SQL。 --- ### 💡 三大問題核心解答 #### 1. 當季單季 EPS 如何計算？（`目前累計 - 前一期累計`） * 計算邏輯： * 第 1 季（`YYYY01`）：`當季單季EPS = EPS累計`（第一季累計就是單季）。 * 第 2~4 季（`YYYY02, 03, 04`）：`當季單季EPS = 本季EPS累計 - 上一季EPS累計`。 * SQL 實現：利用 `CASE WHEN RIGHT(日期, 2) = '01' THEN EPS累計 ELSE EPS累計 - LAG(EPS累計, 1)` 自動精準扣減，不再受財報單季欄位缺失干擾！ #### 2. 第三季（202603）公布時需要改代碼嗎？ * 答案：完全不需要改任何一行代碼！ * 全自動機制： * 當資料庫匯入 `202603`（Q3）時，系統的 `rn = 1` 會自動抓 Q3、`rn = 2` 會自動抓 Q2（用來算 Q3 單季與季增）、`rn = 5` 會自動抓 2025 Q3（去年同期），全部全自動動態推進！ #### 3. 同時比較「去年同期累計」與「去年全年總 EPS」 * 系統將同時產出兩組重要百分比： * `[累計YoY同期成長%]`：今年前 N 季累計 vs 去年同期前 N 季累計（看成長速度）。 * `[超越去年全年%]`：今年前 N 季累計 vs 去年整年 4 季總獲利（看是否提早賺贏一整年）。 --- ### 📄 純 SELECT 語法（已省略開頭 `SELECT`，直接貼入 `excelsql2.html` 執行）：
sql
F.代號,
F.名稱,
-- 🟢 basicinfo 即時行情、量能、股本與週轉率
ISNULL(B.[成交價], 0) AS 現價,
ISNULL(B.[漲跌], 0) AS 漲跌,
ISNULL(B.[漲幅], 0) AS [漲幅%],
ISNULL(B.[總量], 0) AS [成交總量(張)],
ISNULL(B.[股本億], 0) AS [股本(億)],
ROUND(ISNULL(B.[總量], 0) / NULLIF(B.[股本億] * 100.0, 0), 2) AS [週轉率%],
ISNULL(B.[產業分類], N'一般產業') AS 產業分類,

-- 🟢 財報季別與 EPS (自動計算：當季單季 = 目前累計 - 前期累計)
F.最新財報季別,
F.當季單季EPS,
F.今年累計EPS,

-- 🟢 雙重對決指標 1：vs 去年同期 (看年成長力道)
F.去年同期累計EPS,
ROUND((F.今年累計EPS - F.去年同期累計EPS) / NULLIF(ABS(F.去年同期累計EPS), 0) * 100.0, 1) AS [累計YoY同期成長%],

-- 🟢 雙重對決指標 2：vs 去年全年 (看是否提前賺贏一整年)
F.去年全年總EPS,
ROUND((F.今年累計EPS - F.去年全年總EPS) / NULLIF(ABS(F.去年全年總EPS), 0) * 100.0, 1) AS [超越去年全年%],

-- 🟢 本業毛利率與營業利益率 QoQ 季增表現
F.當季毛利率,
F.上季毛利率,
ROUND(F.當季毛利率 - F.上季毛利率, 2) AS [毛利季增%],
F.當季營益率,
F.上季營益率,
ROUND(F.當季營益率 - F.上季營益率, 2) AS [營益季增%],

-- 🟢 客觀全維財務強勢標籤 (自動適應 Q1~Q4)
CASE 
    WHEN F.今年累計EPS > F.去年全年總EPS AND F.去年全年總EPS > 0 AND (F.當季毛利率 > F.上季毛利率) AND (F.當季營益率 > F.上季營益率) 
        THEN N'👑👑 累計賺贏去年整年 + 本業雙升 (全能王者)'
    WHEN F.今年累計EPS > F.去年全年總EPS AND F.去年全年總EPS > 0 
        THEN N'👑 提前賺贏去年整年 (暴衝)'
    WHEN (F.當季毛利率 > F.上季毛利率) AND (F.當季營益率 > F.上季營益率) 
        THEN N'🔥🔥 本業雙升 (毛利+營益雙暴增)'
    WHEN F.上季單季EPS <= 0 AND F.當季單季EPS > 0 
        THEN N'⚡ 當季轉虧為盈 (轉機黑馬)'
    WHEN F.今年累計EPS > F.去年同期累計EPS 
        THEN N'📈 累計獲利超越去年同期'
    ELSE N'⭐ 獲利常態運行'
END AS 財報強勢標籤

FROM (
    SELECT 
        Cur.代號, Cur.名稱, Cur.日期 AS 最新財報季別,
        Cur.當季單季EPS,
        ISNULL(Cur.EPS累計, 0) AS 今年累計EPS,
        ISNULL(YoY.EPS累計, 0) AS 去年同期累計EPS,
        -- 關聯去年全年報 (去年 Q4 累計 EPS)
        ISNULL(FullYear.EPS累計, ISNULL(YoY.EPS累計, 0)) AS 去年全年總EPS,
        ISNULL(Cur.毛利率, 0) AS 當季毛利率,
        ISNULL(Cur.毛利率上季, ISNULL(Prev.毛利率, 0)) AS 上季毛利率,
        ISNULL(Cur.營業利益率, 0) AS 當季營益率,
        ISNULL(Cur.營業利益率上季, ISNULL(Prev.營業利益率, 0)) AS 上季營益率,
        ISNULL(Prev.當季單季EPS, 0) AS 上季單季EPS
    FROM (
        -- 1. 基礎表：自動計算「當季單季 EPS = 累計 - 前期累計 (Q1則等於累計)」
        SELECT 
            代號, 名稱, 日期, EPS累計, 毛利率, 毛利率上季, 營業利益率, 營業利益率上季,
            CAST(LEFT(日期, 4) AS INT) AS 報告年份,
            RIGHT(日期, 2) AS 報告季度,
            CASE 
                WHEN RIGHT(日期, 2) = '01' THEN ISNULL(EPS累計, 0)
                ELSE ISNULL(EPS累計, 0) - ISNULL(LAG(EPS累計, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期), 0)
            END AS 當季單季EPS,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
    ) Cur
    -- 2. 動態關聯上一季 (rn = 2)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, 毛利率, 營業利益率, 當季單季EPS,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM (
            SELECT 代號, 日期, 毛利率, 營業利益率,
                   CASE 
                       WHEN RIGHT(日期, 2) = '01' THEN ISNULL(EPS累計, 0)
                       ELSE ISNULL(EPS累計, 0) - ISNULL(LAG(EPS累計, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期), 0)
                   END AS 當季單季EPS
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
        ) P
    ) Prev ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(Prev.代號) AND Prev.rn = 2
    -- 3. 動態關聯去年同期 (rn = 5, 即 4 季前)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, EPS累計,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
    ) YoY ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(YoY.代號) AND YoY.rn = 5
    -- 4. 動態精準關聯去年全年 (去年第 4 季 'YYYY-1' + '04')
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, CAST(LEFT(日期, 4) AS INT) AS 年份, EPS累計
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
        WHERE RIGHT(日期, 2) = '04' -- 鎖定第 4 季年報
    ) FullYear ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(FullYear.代號) AND FullYear.年份 = (Cur.報告年份 - 1)
    
    WHERE Cur.rn = 1 -- 永遠鎖定最新公布的這一季 (自動支援 Q1~Q4)
) F
-- 🟢 關聯 basicinfo 取得即時價量、股本與週轉率
LEFT JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B 
    ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
WHERE (
    (F.今年累計EPS > F.去年全年總EPS AND F.去年全年總EPS > 0)    -- 條件 1: 累計賺贏去年整年
    OR (F.當季毛利率 > F.上季毛利率 AND F.當季營益率 > F.上季營益率) -- 條件 2: 本業毛利營益雙升
    OR (F.上季單季EPS <= 0 AND F.當季單季EPS > 0)             -- 條件 3: 單季轉虧為盈
    OR (F.今年累計EPS > F.去年同期累計EPS AND F.去年同期累計EPS > 0) -- 條件 4: 年成長顯著
)
ORDER BY [超越去年全年%] DESC, [毛利季增%] DESC;

    ISNULL(B.[產業分類], N'一般電子') AS 產業分類,
    ISNULL(M.具體概念, ISNULL(R.具體概念, N'AI概念股')) AS 具體概念,
    ISNULL(M.產業價值鏈資訊, N'--') AS 產業價值鏈資訊

FROM (
    SELECT 
        Cur.代號, Cur.名稱, Cur.日期 AS 最新財報季別,
        Cur.當季單季EPS,
        ISNULL(Cur.EPS累計, 0) AS 今年累計EPS,
        ISNULL(YoY.EPS累計, 0) AS 去年同期累計EPS,
        ISNULL(FullYear.EPS累計, ISNULL(YoY.EPS累計, 0)) AS 去年全年總EPS,
        ISNULL(Cur.毛利率, 0) AS 當季毛利率,
        ISNULL(Cur.毛利率上季, ISNULL(Prev.毛利率, 0)) AS 上季毛利率,
        ISNULL(Cur.營業利益率, 0) AS 當季營益率,
        ISNULL(Cur.營業利益率上季, ISNULL(Prev.營業利益率, 0)) AS 上季營益率,
        ISNULL(Prev.當季單季EPS, 0) AS 上季單季EPS,
        -- 評等標籤
        CASE 
            WHEN Cur.EPS累計 > FullYear.EPS累計 AND FullYear.EPS累計 > 0 AND (Cur.毛利率 > ISNULL(Cur.毛利率上季, Prev.毛利率)) AND (Cur.營業利益率 > ISNULL(Cur.營業利益率上季, Prev.營業利益率)) 
                THEN N'👑👑 累計賺贏去年 + 本業雙升 (全能王者)'
            WHEN Cur.EPS累計 > FullYear.EPS累計 AND FullYear.EPS累計 > 0 
                THEN N'👑 提前賺贏去年整年 (暴衝)'
            WHEN (Cur.毛利率 > ISNULL(Cur.毛利率上季, Prev.毛利率)) AND (Cur.營業利益率 > ISNULL(Cur.營業利益率上季, Prev.營業利益率)) 
                THEN N'🔥🔥 本業雙升 (毛利+營益雙暴增)'
            WHEN ISNULL(Prev.當季單季EPS, 0) <= 0 AND Cur.當季單季EPS > 0 
                THEN N'⚡ 當季轉虧為盈 (轉機黑馬)'
            WHEN Cur.EPS累計 > YoY.EPS累計 
                THEN N'📈 累計獲利超越去年同期'
            ELSE N'⭐ 獲利常態運行'
        END AS 財報強勢標籤
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            代號, 名稱, 日期, EPS累計, 毛利率, 毛利率上季, 營業利益率, 營業利益率上季,
            CAST(LEFT(日期, 4) AS INT) AS 報告年份,
            CASE 
                WHEN RIGHT(日期, 2) = '01' THEN ISNULL(EPS累計, 0)
                ELSE ISNULL(EPS累計, 0) - ISNULL(LAG(EPS累計, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期), 0)
            END AS 當季單季EPS,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
    ) Cur
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, 毛利率, 營業利益率, 當季單季EPS,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM (
            SELECT 代號, 日期, 毛利率, 營業利益率,
                   CASE 
                       WHEN RIGHT(日期, 2) = '01' THEN ISNULL(EPS累計, 0)
                       ELSE ISNULL(EPS累計, 0) - ISNULL(LAG(EPS累計, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期), 0)
                   END AS 當季單季EPS
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
        ) P
    ) Prev ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(Prev.代號) AND Prev.rn = 2
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, EPS累計,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
    ) YoY ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(YoY.代號) AND YoY.rn = 5
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, CAST(LEFT(日期, 4) AS INT) AS 年份, EPS累計
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
        WHERE RIGHT(日期, 2) = '04'
    ) FullYear ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(FullYear.代號) AND FullYear.年份 = (Cur.報告年份 - 1)
    WHERE Cur.rn = 1
) F
-- 🟢 1. 關聯 basicinfo 即時價量、股本與週轉率
LEFT JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B 
    ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
-- 🟢 2. 關聯 MasterStockAnalysis (專家實戰總分、具體概念、產業價值鏈資訊)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, 專家實戰總分, 具體概念, 產業價值鏈資訊,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis
) M ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND M.rn = 1
-- 🟢 3. 關聯 View_AI_Elite_Radar (60分K動能、K值、短線氣象)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, 
           MAX([60M動能(OSC)]) AS [60M_OSC], 
           MAX([60M_K值]) AS [60M_K], 
           MAX(短線氣象) AS 短線氣象,
           MAX(具體概念) AS 具體概念
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
    GROUP BY 代號
) R ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號)
-- 🟢 4. 關聯 FactSetEstimates (外資預估目標價)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, 預估目標價,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates
) FST ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(FST.代號) AND FST.rn = 1

WHERE (
    (F.今年累計EPS > F.去年全年總EPS AND F.去年全年總EPS > 0)
    OR (F.當季毛利率 > F.上季毛利率 AND F.當季營益率 > F.上季營益率)
    OR (F.上季單季EPS <= 0 AND F.當季單季EPS > 0)
    OR (F.今年累計EPS > F.去年同期累計EPS AND F.去年同期累計EPS > 0)
)
ORDER BY F.今年累計EPS DESC, [超越去年全年%] DESC;

{

    -- 本業毛利與營益率季增

    ISNULL(M.產業價值鏈資訊, N'--') AS 產業價值鏈資訊

                THEN N'👑👑 累計賺贏去年 + 本業雙升 (全能王者)'
            WHEN Cur.EPS累計 > FullYear.EPS累計 AND FullYear.EPS累計 > 0 
                THEN N'👑 提前賺贏去年整年 (暴衝)'
            WHEN (Cur.毛利率 > ISNULL(Cur.毛利率上季, Prev.毛利率)) AND (Cur.營業利益率 > ISNULL(Cur.營業利益率上季, Prev.營業利益率)) 
                THEN N'🔥🔥 本業雙升 (毛利+營益雙暴增)'
            WHEN ISNULL(Prev.當季單季EPS, 0) <= 0 AND Cur.當季單季EPS > 0 
                THEN N'⚡ 當季轉虧為盈 (轉機黑馬)'
            WHEN Cur.EPS累計 > YoY.EPS累計 
                THEN N'📈 累計獲利超越去年同期'
            ELSE N'⭐ 獲利常態運行'

    FROM (

            CAST(LEFT(日期, 4) AS INT) AS 報告年份,
            CASE 
                WHEN RIGHT(日期, 2) = '01' THEN ISNULL(EPS累計, 0)
                ELSE ISNULL(EPS累計, 0) - ISNULL(LAG(EPS累計, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期), 0)
            END AS 當季單季EPS,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
    ) Cur
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, 毛利率, 營業利益率, 當季單季EPS,

    LEFT JOIN (

    ) FullYear ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(FullYear.代號) AND FullYear.年份 = (Cur.報告年份 - 1)
    WHERE Cur.rn = 1
) F
LEFT JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B 
    ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
LEFT JOIN (

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis
) M ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND M.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, 
           MAX([60M動能(OSC)]) AS [60M_OSC], 
           MAX([60M_K值]) AS [60M_K], 
           MAX(短線氣象) AS 短線氣象,
           MAX(具體概念) AS 具體概念
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
    GROUP BY 代號
) R ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, MAX(預估目標價) AS 預估目標價
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates
    GROUP BY 代號
) FST ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(FST.代號)

WHERE (
    (F.今年累計EPS > F.去年全年總EPS AND F.去年全年總EPS > 0)
    OR (F.當季毛利率 > F.上季毛利率 AND F.當季營益率 > F.上季營益率)
    OR (F.上季單季EPS <= 0 AND F.當季單季EPS > 0)
    OR (F.今年累計EPS > F.去年同期累計EPS AND F.去年同期累計EPS > 0)
)
ORDER BY F.今年累計EPS DESC, [超越去年全年%] DESC;`

    B.[名稱],

    -- 🟢 ③ 營收成長與歷史新高判定
    ROUND(ISNULL(V.[最新公告營收年增], 0), 1) AS [營收年增率%],
    ROUND(ISNULL(V.[營收月增], ISNULL(V.[最新公告營收月增], 0)), 1) AS [營收月增率%],
    ISNULL(V.[當月營收], ISNULL(V.[營業收入], 0)) AS [當月營收(千元)],
    ISNULL(M.[歷史最高營收], ISNULL(V.[當月營收], 0)) AS [歷史最高營收(千元)],
    
    -- 🟢 營收動能綜合評級
    CASE 
        WHEN ISNULL(V.[當月營收], 0) >= ISNULL(M.[歷史最高營收], 0) AND ISNULL(V.[當月營收], 0) > 0 
            THEN N'🌟🌟 單月營收創歷史新高！'
        WHEN ISNULL(V.[最新公告營收年增], 0) >= 50.0 AND ISNULL(V.[營收月增], 0) > 0 
            THEN N'🚀 營收暴衝雙增 (年增>50%)'
        WHEN ISNULL(V.[最新公告營收年增], 0) >= 20.0 AND ISNULL(V.[營收月增], 0) > 0 
            THEN N'📈 營收穩健雙增 (MoM+YoY)'
        WHEN ISNULL(V.[最新公告營收年增], 0) >= 30.0 
            THEN N'🔥 營收年增強勁 (>30%)'
        ELSE N'⭐ 營收正成長'
    END AS 營收強勢評級,

    -- 🟢 ④ 專家總分 ✕ 外資評價
    ROUND(ISNULL(MS.專家實戰總分, 0), 1) AS 專家實戰總分,
    ISNULL(FST.預估目標價, 0) AS [FactSet目標價],
    CASE 
        WHEN ISNULL(FST.預估目標價, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(B.[成交價], 0) > 0 
            THEN ROUND(((FST.預估目標價 - B.[成交價]) / B.[成交價]) * 100.0, 1)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS [外資潛在空間%],

    -- 🟢 ⑤ 產業分類、具體概念與產業鏈資訊
    ISNULL(B.[產業分類], N'一般電子') AS 產業分類,
    ISNULL(MS.具體概念, ISNULL(R.具體概念, N'AI供應鏈')) AS 具體概念,
    ISNULL(MS.產業價值鏈資訊, N'--') AS 產業價值鏈資訊

FROM stockchange.[dbo].[basicinfo] B
LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.[dbo].[View_Realtime_Revenue] V 
    ON RTRIM(B.[代號]) = RTRIM(V.[代號])
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, MAX(營業收入) AS 歷史最高營收
    FROM stockchangedate.[dbo].[View_Realtime_Revenue]
    GROUP BY 代號
) M ON RTRIM(B.[代號]) = RTRIM(M.[代號])
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, 專家實戰總分, 具體概念, 產業價值鏈資訊,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis
) MS ON RTRIM(B.代號) = RTRIM(MS.代號) AND MS.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, 
           MAX([60M動能(OSC)]) AS [60M_OSC], 
           MAX([60M_K值]) AS [60M_K], 
           MAX(短線氣象) AS 短線氣象,
           MAX(具體概念) AS 具體概念
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
    GROUP BY 代號
) R ON RTRIM(B.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, MAX(預估目標價) AS 預估目標價
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates
    GROUP BY 代號
) FST ON RTRIM(B.代號) = RTRIM(FST.代號)

WHERE B.[總量] >= 500
  AND B.[成交價] >= 10.0
  AND ISNULL(V.[最新公告營收年增], 0) > 10.0 -- 篩選營收年增 > 10%
ORDER BY [營收年增率%] DESC, [週轉率%] DESC;`
}
--- ### 3️⃣ 【EPS 獲利 ✕ 營收動能 Merge 終極雙冠王】（雙劍合璧大滿貫）
javascript
{
  cat: "基本面-雙料雙冠王",
  title: "🏆 營收創高雙增 ✕ 半年賺贏去年 ✕ 本業雙升 終極大滿貫",
  sql: `TOP 50
    -- 🟢 ① 即時行情、量能、股本與週轉率
    F.代號,
    F.名稱,
    ISNULL(B.[成交價], 0) AS 現價,
    ISNULL(B.[漲跌], 0) AS 漲跌,
    ISNULL(B.[漲幅], 0) AS [漲幅%],
    ISNULL(B.[總量], 0) AS [成交總量(張)],
    B.[股本億] AS [股本(億)],
    ROUND(ISNULL(B.[總量], 0) / NULLIF(B.[股本億] * 100.0, 0), 2) AS [週轉率%],

    -- 🟢 ② 60分K進場動能與氣象
    ROUND(ISNULL(R.[60M_OSC], 0), 2) AS [60M_OSC],
    ROUND(ISNULL(R.[60M_K], 0), 1)   AS [60M_K值],
    ISNULL(R.[短線氣象], N'☀️ 轉強') AS [60M短線氣象],

    -- 🟢 ③ 營收成長指標
    ROUND(ISNULL(V.[最新公告營收年增], 0), 1) AS [營收年增率%],
    ROUND(ISNULL(V.[營收月增], ISNULL(V.[最新公告營收月增], 0)), 1) AS [營收月增率%],

    -- 🟢 ④ 半年報 EPS 雙對決
    F.當季單季EPS,
    F.今年累計EPS,
    F.去年全年總EPS,
    ROUND((F.今年累計EPS - F.去年全年總EPS) / NULLIF(ABS(F.去年全年總EPS), 0) * 100.0, 1) AS [超越去年全年%],
    ROUND((F.今年累計EPS - F.去年同期累計EPS) / NULLIF(ABS(F.去年同期累計EPS), 0) * 100.0, 1) AS [累計YoY同期成長%],

    -- 🟢 ⑤ 毛利與營益率季增
    F.當季毛利率,
    ROUND(F.當季毛利率 - F.上季毛利率, 2) AS [毛利季增%],
    F.當季營益率,
    ROUND(F.當季營益率 - F.上季營益率, 2) AS [營益季增%],

    -- 🟢 ⑥ 營收 ✕ 獲利 終極大滿貫評級
    CASE 
        WHEN ISNULL(V.[當月營收], 0) >= ISNULL(M_Rev.[歷史最高營收], 0) AND F.今年累計EPS > F.去年全年總EPS AND F.去年全年總EPS > 0 AND (F.當季毛利率 > F.上季毛利率) AND (F.當季營益率 > F.上季營益率)
            THEN N'👑🌟 營收創高 + 半年賺贏去年 + 本業雙升 (終極大滿貫)'
        WHEN F.今年累計EPS > F.去年全年總EPS AND F.去年全年總EPS > 0 AND ISNULL(V.[最新公告營收年增], 0) >= 20.0 AND ISNULL(V.[營收月增], 0) > 0
            THEN N'👑🚀 營收雙增 + 半年賺贏去年 (雙料王者)'
        WHEN (F.當季毛利率 > F.上季毛利率) AND (F.當季營益率 > F.上季營益率) AND ISNULL(V.[最新公告營收年增], 0) >= 20.0
            THEN N'🔥🔥 營收暴衝 + 本業毛利營益雙升'
        WHEN F.今年累計EPS > F.去年全年總EPS AND F.去年全年總EPS > 0 
            THEN N'👑 提前賺贏去年整年'
        ELSE N'⭐ 營收獲利雙強'
    END AS 終極大滿貫評級,

    -- 🟢 ⑦ 專家總分 ✕ 外資目標價空間
    ROUND(ISNULL(MS.專家實戰總分, 0), 1) AS 專家實戰總分,
    ISNULL(FST.預估目標價, 0) AS [FactSet目標價],
    CASE 
        WHEN ISNULL(FST.預估目標價, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(B.[成交價], 0) > 0 
            THEN ROUND(((FST.預估目標價 - B.[成交價]) / B.[成交價]) * 100.0, 1)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS [外資潛在空間%],

    -- 🟢 ⑧ 產業分類、具體概念與產業鏈資訊
    ISNULL(B.[產業分類], N'一般電子') AS 產業分類,
    ISNULL(MS.具體概念, ISNULL(R.具體概念, N'AI供應鏈')) AS 具體概念,
    ISNULL(MS.產業價值鏈資訊, N'--') AS 產業價值鏈資訊

FROM (
    SELECT 
        Cur.代號, Cur.名稱, Cur.日期 AS 最新財報季別,
        Cur.當季單季EPS,
        ISNULL(Cur.EPS累計, 0) AS 今年累計EPS,
        ISNULL(YoY.EPS累計, 0) AS 去年同期累計EPS,
        ISNULL(FullYear.EPS累計, ISNULL(YoY.EPS累計, 0)) AS 去年全年總EPS,
        ISNULL(Cur.毛利率, 0) AS 當季毛利率,
        ISNULL(Cur.毛利率上季, ISNULL(Prev.毛利率, 0)) AS 上季毛利率,
        ISNULL(Cur.營業利益率, 0) AS 當季營益率,
        ISNULL(Cur.營業利益率上季, ISNULL(Prev.營業利益率, 0)) AS 上季營益率
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            代號, 名稱, 日期, EPS累計, 毛利率, 毛利率上季, 營業利益率, 營業利益率上季,
            CAST(LEFT(日期, 4) AS INT) AS 報告年份,
            CASE 
                WHEN RIGHT(日期, 2) = '01' THEN ISNULL(EPS累計, 0)
                ELSE ISNULL(EPS累計, 0) - ISNULL(LAG(EPS累計, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期), 0)
            END AS 當季單季EPS,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
    ) Cur
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, 毛利率, 營業利益率,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
    ) Prev ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(Prev.代號) AND Prev.rn = 2
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, EPS累計,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
    ) YoY ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(YoY.代號) AND YoY.rn = 5
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, CAST(LEFT(日期, 4) AS INT) AS 年份, EPS累計
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
        WHERE RIGHT(日期, 2) = '04'
    ) FullYear ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(FullYear.代號) AND FullYear.年份 = (Cur.報告年份 - 1)
    WHERE Cur.rn = 1
) F
LEFT JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B 
    ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.[dbo].[View_Realtime_Revenue] V 
    ON RTRIM(F.[代號]) = RTRIM(V.[代號])
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, MAX(營業收入) AS 歷史最高營收
    FROM stockchangedate.[dbo].[View_Realtime_Revenue]
    GROUP BY 代號
) M_Rev ON RTRIM(F.[代號]) = RTRIM(M_Rev.[代號])
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, 專家實戰總分, 具體概念, 產業價值鏈資訊,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis
) MS ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(MS.代號) AND MS.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, 
           MAX([60M動能(OSC)]) AS [60M_OSC], 
           MAX([60M_K值]) AS [60M_K], 
           MAX(短線氣象) AS 短線氣象,
           MAX(具體概念) AS 具體概念
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
    GROUP BY 代號
) R ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, MAX(預估目標價) AS 預估目標價
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates
    GROUP BY 代號
) FST ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(FST.代號)

WHERE (
    (F.今年累計EPS > F.去年全年總EPS AND F.去年全年總EPS > 0)
    OR (F.當季毛利率 > F.上季毛利率 AND F.當季營益率 > F.上季營益率)
    OR (ISNULL(V.[最新公告營收年增], 0) >= 20.0)
)
ORDER BY [超越去年全年%] DESC, [營收年增率%] DESC;`
}

    ROUND(ISNULL(MS.專家實戰總分, 0), 1) AS 專家實戰總分,

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis
) MS ON RTRIM(I.代號) = RTRIM(MS.代號) AND MS.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, 
           MAX([60M動能(OSC)]) AS [60M_OSC], 
           MAX([60M_K值]) AS [60M_K], 
           MAX(短線氣象) AS 短線氣象,
           MAX(具體概念) AS 具體概念
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
    GROUP BY 代號
) R ON RTRIM(I.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, MAX(預估目標價) AS 預估目標價
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates
    GROUP BY 代號
) FST ON RTRIM(I.代號) = RTRIM(FST.代號)

WHERE I.rn = 1
  AND ISNULL(B.[成交價], 10.0) >= 10.0
  AND ISNULL(I.年成長, 0) > 10.0 -- 篩選年增率 > 10%
ORDER BY I.年成長 DESC, I.月變動 DESC;`
}
--- ### 3️⃣ 【EPS 獲利 ✕ 營收動能 Merge 終極雙料王】（雙劍合璧大滿貫）
javascript
{
  cat: "基本面-雙料雙冠王",
  title: "🏆 營收創高雙增 ✕ 半年賺贏去年 ✕ 本業雙升 終極大滿貫",
  sql: `TOP 50
    -- 🟢 ① 即時行情、量能、股本與週轉率
    F.代號,
    F.名稱,
    ISNULL(B.[成交價], 0) AS 現價,
    ISNULL(B.[漲跌], 0) AS 漲跌,
    ISNULL(B.[漲幅], 0) AS [漲幅%],
    ISNULL(B.[總量], 0) AS [成交總量(張)],
    B.[股本億] AS [股本(億)],
    ROUND(ISNULL(B.[總量], 0) / NULLIF(B.[股本億] * 100.0, 0), 2) AS [週轉率%],

    -- 🟢 ② 60分K進場動能與氣象
    ROUND(ISNULL(R.[60M_OSC], 0), 2) AS [60M_OSC],
    ROUND(ISNULL(R.[60M_K], 0), 1)   AS [60M_K值],
    ISNULL(R.[短線氣象], N'☀️ 轉強') AS [60M短線氣象],

    -- 🟢 ③ 營收動能指標 (來自 incomesum)
    I.最新營收月份,
    ROUND(ISNULL(I.年成長, 0), 1) AS [營收年增率%],
    ROUND(ISNULL(I.月變動, 0), 1) AS [營收月增率%],
    ISNULL(I.單月營收億, 0) AS [單月營收(億)],

    -- 🟢 ④ 半年報 EPS 雙對決
    F.當季單季EPS,
    F.今年累計EPS,
    F.去年全年總EPS,
    ROUND((F.今年累計EPS - F.去年全年總EPS) / NULLIF(ABS(F.去年全年總EPS), 0) * 100.0, 1) AS [超越去年全年%],
    ROUND((F.今年累計EPS - F.去年同期累計EPS) / NULLIF(ABS(F.去年同期累計EPS), 0) * 100.0, 1) AS [累計YoY同期成長%],

    -- 🟢 ⑤ 毛利與營益率季增
    F.當季毛利率,
    ROUND(F.當季毛利率 - F.上季毛利率, 2) AS [毛利季增%],
    F.當季營益率,
    ROUND(F.當季營益率 - F.上季營益率, 2) AS [營益季增%],

    -- 🟢 ⑥ 營收 ✕ 獲利 終極大滿貫評級
    CASE 
        WHEN ISNULL(I.單月營收億, 0) >= ISNULL(I.歷史最高營收億, 0) AND I.單月營收億 > 0 AND F.今年累計EPS > F.去年全年總EPS AND F.去年全年總EPS > 0 AND (F.當季毛利率 > F.上季毛利率) AND (F.當季營益率 > F.上季營益率)
            THEN N'👑🌟 營收創高 + 半年賺贏去年 + 本業雙升 (終極大滿貫)'
        WHEN F.今年累計EPS > F.去年全年總EPS AND F.去年全年總EPS > 0 AND ISNULL(I.年成長, 0) >= 20.0 AND ISNULL(I.月變動, 0) > 0
            THEN N'👑🚀 營收雙增 + 半年賺贏去年 (雙料王者)'
        WHEN (F.當季毛利率 > F.上季毛利率) AND (F.當季營益率 > F.上季營益率) AND ISNULL(I.年成長, 0) >= 20.0
            THEN N'🔥🔥 營收暴衝 + 本業毛利營益雙升'
        WHEN F.今年累計EPS > F.去年全年總EPS AND F.去年全年總EPS > 0 
            THEN N'👑 提前賺贏去年整年'
        ELSE N'⭐ 營收獲利雙強'
    END AS 終極大滿貫評級,

    -- 🟢 ⑦ 專家總分 ✕ 外資目標價空間
    ROUND(ISNULL(MS.專家實戰總分, 0), 1) AS 專家實戰總分,
    ISNULL(FST.預估目標價, 0) AS [FactSet目標價],
    CASE 
        WHEN ISNULL(FST.預估目標價, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(B.[成交價], 0) > 0 
            THEN ROUND(((FST.預估目標價 - B.[成交價]) / B.[成交價]) * 100.0, 1)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS [外資潛在空間%],

    -- 🟢 ⑧ 產業分類、具體概念與產業鏈資訊 (放最後方)
    ISNULL(B.[產業分類], N'一般電子') AS 產業分類,
    ISNULL(MS.具體概念, ISNULL(R.具體概念, N'AI供應鏈')) AS 具體概念,
    ISNULL(MS.產業價值鏈資訊, N'--') AS 產業價值鏈資訊

FROM (
    SELECT 
        Cur.代號, Cur.名稱, Cur.日期 AS 最新財報季別,
        Cur.當季單季EPS,
        ISNULL(Cur.EPS累計, 0) AS 今年累計EPS,
        ISNULL(YoY.EPS累計, 0) AS 去年同期累計EPS,
        ISNULL(FullYear.EPS累計, ISNULL(YoY.EPS累計, 0)) AS 去年全年總EPS,
        ISNULL(Cur.毛利率, 0) AS 當季毛利率,
        ISNULL(Cur.毛利率上季, ISNULL(Prev.毛利率, 0)) AS 上季毛利率,
        ISNULL(Cur.營業利益率, 0) AS 當季營益率,
        ISNULL(Cur.營業利益率上季, ISNULL(Prev.營業利益率, 0)) AS 上季營益率
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            代號, 名稱, 日期, EPS累計, 毛利率, 毛利率上季, 營業利益率, 營業利益率上季,
            CAST(LEFT(日期, 4) AS INT) AS 報告年份,
            CASE 
                WHEN RIGHT(日期, 2) = '01' THEN ISNULL(EPS累計, 0)
                ELSE ISNULL(EPS累計, 0) - ISNULL(LAG(EPS累計, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期), 0)
            END AS 當季單季EPS,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
    ) Cur
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, 毛利率, 營業利益率,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
    ) Prev ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(Prev.代號) AND Prev.rn = 2
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, EPS累計,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
    ) YoY ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(YoY.代號) AND YoY.rn = 5
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, CAST(LEFT(日期, 4) AS INT) AS 年份, EPS累計
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
        WHERE RIGHT(日期, 2) = '04'
    ) FullYear ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(FullYear.代號) AND FullYear.年份 = (Cur.報告年份 - 1)
    WHERE Cur.rn = 1
) F
-- 🟢 關聯 basicinfo
LEFT JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B 
    ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
-- 🟢 關聯 incomesum 最新月營收
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        代號, 日期 AS 最新營收月份, 年成長, 月變動, 單月營收億,
        MAX(單月營收億) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號) AS 歷史最高營收億,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.incomesum
) I ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(I.代號) AND I.rn = 1
-- 🟢 關聯 MasterStockAnalysis
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, 專家實戰總分, 具體概念, 產業價值鏈資訊,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis
) MS ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(MS.代號) AND MS.rn = 1
-- 🟢 關聯 View_AI_Elite_Radar
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, 
           MAX([60M動能(OSC)]) AS [60M_OSC], 
           MAX([60M_K值]) AS [60M_K], 
           MAX(短線氣象) AS 短線氣象,
           MAX(具體概念) AS 具體概念
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
    GROUP BY 代號
) R ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號)
-- 🟢 關聯 FactSetEstimates
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, MAX(預估目標價) AS 預估目標價
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates
    GROUP BY 代號
) FST ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(FST.代號)

WHERE (
    (F.今年累計EPS > F.去年全年總EPS AND F.去年全年總EPS > 0)
    OR (F.當季毛利率 > F.上季毛利率 AND F.當季營益率 > F.上季營益率)
    OR (ISNULL(I.年成長, 0) >= 15.0)
)
ORDER BY [超越去年全年%] DESC, [營收年增率%] DESC;`
}

🤖 GEMINI
這張截圖抓到了一個 SQL Server 非常經典且致命的架構 Bug：「檢視表欄位錯位 (View Metadata Drift)」 以及 「營收月份配對邏輯錯誤」！ --- ### 🔍 兩大 Bug 深度解析 #### 🔴 Bug 1：欄位嚴重錯位（概念文字跑到「營收年增率」，數字全部平移） * 現象： * `營收年增率` 裡面竟然出現了 `晶圓代工全球龍頭 | CoWoS...`（這是 `具體概念` 的文字）。 * `累計營收年成長` 出現了 `半導體(中游--> IC/晶圓製造)`（這是 `產業價值鏈資訊` 的文字）。 * 後面的 `單月營收億`、`毛利率`、`營業利益率` 全部被塞入了一模一樣的數字（`87.47`、`87.49`...）。 * 根本原因： * 在建立 View 時寫了 `SELECT M.*, I.年成長 ...`。 * 後來 `MasterStockAnalysis` 資料表新增了欄位（例如新增了 `具體概念`、`產業價值鏈資訊`），但 View 的底層中繼資料沒有更新，導致 SQL Server 的欄位指針整體向右錯位偏移！ --- #### 🔴 Bug 2：營收月份配對失敗（8月交易日去抓8月營收 ➔ 永遠抓不到） * 錯誤語法： `ON M.代號 = I.代號 AND LEFT(CAST(M.日期 AS VARCHAR), 6) = CAST(I.日期 AS VARCHAR)` * 根本原因： * 交易日 `M.日期` 是 `20260827`（8月），但 8 月營收要到 9月10日 才會公布！ * 目前最新已公布的營收是 7 月（`202607`）。 * 當條件寫 `202608 = 202607` 時，會永遠對不上（變成 NULL）！ * 正確做法：營收應該與財報一樣，透過子查詢抓取「最新已公布的那一期 (`rn = 1`)」！ --- ### 🛠️ 終極修復方案 --- #### 步驟 1：在 SSMS 執行刷新（若要保留原 View） 在 SQL Server 執行以下指令，可立即修復欄位錯位：
sql
EXEC sp_refreshview 'stockchangedate.dbo.View_Master_Fundamental';
--- #### 步驟 2：重構 `View_Master_Fundamental`（徹底根除錯位與營收月份 Bug） 請在 SSMS 執行以下重構語法（明列欄位名稱，嚴禁 `M.*`，並修正營收取最新一期）：
sql
USE [stockchangedate];
GO

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [dbo].[View_Master_Fundamental]
AS
SELECT 
    M.自動編號, M.名稱, M.代號, M.產業分類, M.股本億, M.日期,
    M.盤中現價, M.盤中漲幅, M.盤中總量, M.價五日乖離, M.量倍數,
    M.OBV分, M.價均分, M.技術分, M.籌碼分, M.量能分,
    M.專家實戰總分, M.實戰標籤,
    M.集中度1日, M.集中度5日, M.集中度10日, M.集中度20日, M.集中度60日,
    M.obv淨額, M.obv5日均線, M.obv34日均線, M.obv累積金叉次數,
    M.具體概念, M.產業價值鏈資訊,

    -- 🟢 營收維度 (取 incomesum 最新已公布之營收，解決月份對不上的問題)
    ISNULL(I.年成長, 0)         AS 營收年增率,
    ISNULL(I.累計營收年成長, 0) AS 累計營收年成長,
    ISNULL(I.月變動, 0)         AS 營收月增率,
    ISNULL(I.單月營收億, 0)     AS 單月營收億,
    ISNULL(I.累計營收億, 0)     AS 累計營收億,
    I.日期                     AS 最新營收月份,

    -- 🟢 獲利維度 (取 financesum 最新一期季報)
    ISNULL(F.毛利率, 0)         AS 毛利率,
    ISNULL(F.營業利益率, 0)     AS 營業利益率,
    ISNULL(F.EPS, 0)           AS 單季EPS,
    ISNULL(F.EPS累計, 0)       AS 累計EPS,
    ISNULL(F.ROE, 0)           AS ROE,
    ISNULL(F.負債比率, 0)       AS 負債比率,
    F.日期                     AS 最新財報季別

FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M

-- 🟢 關聯 incomesum 最新一期月營收 (rn = 1)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        代號, 年成長, 累計營收年成長, 月變動, 單月營收億, 累計營收億, 日期,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.incomesum
) I ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(I.代號) AND I.rn = 1

-- 🟢 關聯 financesum 最新一期財報 (rn = 1)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        代號, 毛利率, 營業利益率, EPS, EPS累計, ROE, 負債比率, 日期,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
) F ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(F.代號) AND F.rn = 1;
GO
--- ### 🚀 步驟 3：在 `excelsql2.html` 中執行的【營收動能與創高雙增王】查詢 修復 View 之後，直接查詢此 View，數據將 100% 精準對齊（營收年增率、單月營收億、毛利率各自歸位，不再有文字錯位）： #### 📄 純 SELECT 語法（已省略開頭 `SELECT`）：
sql
TOP 50
    V.代號,
    V.名稱,
    V.盤中現價 AS 現價,
    V.盤中漲幅 AS [漲幅%],
    V.盤中總量 AS [總量(張)],
    V.股本億 AS [股本(億)],
    -- 週轉率 %
    ROUND(V.盤中總量 / NULLIF(V.股本億 * 100.0, 0), 2) AS [週轉率%],
    V.最新營收月份,
    V.營收年增率 AS [營收年增%],
    V.營收月增率 AS [營收月增%],
    V.單月營收億 AS [單月營收(億)],
    V.累計營收年成長 AS [累計營收年增%],
    V.專家實戰總分,
    -- 🟢 營收強勢評級
    CASE 
        WHEN V.營收年增率 >= 50.0 AND V.營收月增率 > 0 THEN N'🚀 營收暴衝雙增 (年增>50%)'
        WHEN V.營收年增率 >= 20.0 AND V.營收月增率 > 0 THEN N'📈 營收穩健雙增 (MoM+YoY)'
        WHEN V.營收年增率 >= 30.0 THEN N'🔥 營收年增強勁 (>30%)'
        ELSE N'⭐ 營收正成長'
    END AS 營收強勢評級,
    V.毛利率,
    V.營業利益率,
    V.單季EPS,
    V.產業分類,
    V.具體概念,
    V.產業價值鏈資訊
FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_Master_Fundamental V
WHERE V.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis)
  AND V.盤中現價 >= 10.0
  AND V.盤中總量 >= 1000
  AND V.營收年增率 >= 15.0 -- 篩選年增率 > 15%
ORDER BY V.營收年增率 DESC, V.營收月增率 DESC;

javascript
// =========================================================================
// 1️⃣ 【EPS 獲利與本業質變王】
// =========================================================================
{
  cat: "基本面-EPS獲利質變",
  title: "👑 半年報賺贏去年 ✕ 三率雙升 ✕ 60M進場與外資空間",
  sql: `TOP 50
    -- 🟢 ① 即時行情、籌碼與換手動能
    F.代號,
    F.名稱,
    ISNULL(B.[成交價], 0) AS 現價,
    ISNULL(B.[漲跌], 0) AS 漲跌,
    ISNULL(B.[漲幅], 0) AS [漲幅%],
    ISNULL(B.[總量], 0) AS [成交總量(張)],
    B.[股本億] AS [股本(億)],
    ROUND(ISNULL(B.[總量], 0) / NULLIF(B.[股本億] * 100.0, 0), 2) AS [週轉率%],
    
    -- 🟢 ② 60分K短線動能與進場氣象
    ROUND(ISNULL(R.[60M_OSC], 0), 2) AS [60M_OSC],
    ROUND(ISNULL(R.[60M_K], 0), 1)   AS [60M_K值],
    ISNULL(R.[短線氣象], N'☀️ 轉強') AS [60M短線氣象],

    -- 🟢 ③ 半年報獲利與成長實績 (自動計算單季與雙對決)
    F.最新財報季別,
    F.當季單季EPS,
    F.今年累計EPS,
    -- 雙對決 1：vs 去年同期
    F.去年同期累計EPS,
    ROUND((F.今年累計EPS - F.去年同期累計EPS) / NULLIF(ABS(F.去年同期累計EPS), 0) * 100.0, 1) AS [累計YoY同期成長%],
    -- 雙對決 2：vs 去年全年 (提早賺贏一整年)
    F.去年全年總EPS,
    ROUND((F.今年累計EPS - F.去年全年總EPS) / NULLIF(ABS(F.去年全年總EPS), 0) * 100.0, 1) AS [超越去年全年%],
    -- 本業毛利與營益率季增
    F.當季毛利率,
    ROUND(F.當季毛利率 - F.上季毛利率, 2) AS [毛利季增%],
    F.當季營益率,
    ROUND(F.當季營益率 - F.上季營益率, 2) AS [營益季增%],
    F.財報強勢標籤,

    -- 🟢 ④ 專家評分 ✕ 外資 FactSet 評價空間
    ROUND(ISNULL(M.專家實戰總分, 0), 1) AS 專家實戰總分,
    ISNULL(FST.預估目標價, 0) AS [FactSet目標價],
    CASE 
        WHEN ISNULL(FST.預估目標價, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(B.[成交價], 0) > 0 
            THEN ROUND(((FST.預估目標價 - B.[成交價]) / B.[成交價]) * 100.0, 1)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS [外資潛在空間%],

    -- 🟢 ⑤ 產業分類、核心概念與長文字價值鏈 (放最右側)
    ISNULL(B.[產業分類], N'一般電子') AS 產業分類,
    ISNULL(M.具體概念, ISNULL(R.具體概念, N'AI概念股')) AS 具體概念,
    ISNULL(M.產業價值鏈資訊, N'--') AS 產業價值鏈資訊

FROM (
    SELECT 
        Cur.代號, Cur.名稱, Cur.日期 AS 最新財報季別,
        Cur.當季單季EPS,
        ISNULL(Cur.EPS累計, 0) AS 今年累計EPS,
        ISNULL(YoY.EPS累計, 0) AS 去年同期累計EPS,
        ISNULL(FullYear.EPS累計, ISNULL(YoY.EPS累計, 0)) AS 去年全年總EPS,
        ISNULL(Cur.毛利率, 0) AS 當季毛利率,
        ISNULL(Cur.毛利率上季, ISNULL(Prev.毛利率, 0)) AS 上季毛利率,
        ISNULL(Cur.營業利益率, 0) AS 當季營益率,
        ISNULL(Cur.營業利益率上季, ISNULL(Prev.營業利益率, 0)) AS 上季營益率,
        ISNULL(Prev.當季單季EPS, 0) AS 上季單季EPS,
        -- 評等標籤
        CASE 
            WHEN Cur.EPS累計 > FullYear.EPS累計 AND FullYear.EPS累計 > 0 AND (Cur.毛利率 > ISNULL(Cur.毛利率上季, Prev.毛利率)) AND (Cur.營業利益率 > ISNULL(Cur.營業利益率上季, Prev.營業利益率)) 
                THEN N'👑👑 累計賺贏去年 + 本業雙升 (全能王者)'
            WHEN Cur.EPS累計 > FullYear.EPS累計 AND FullYear.EPS累計 > 0 
                THEN N'👑 提前賺贏去年整年 (暴衝)'
            WHEN (Cur.毛利率 > ISNULL(Cur.毛利率上季, Prev.毛利率)) AND (Cur.營業利益率 > ISNULL(Cur.營業利益率上季, Prev.營業利益率)) 
                THEN N'🔥🔥 本業雙升 (毛利+營益雙暴增)'
            WHEN ISNULL(Prev.當季單季EPS, 0) <= 0 AND Cur.當季單季EPS > 0 
                THEN N'⚡ 當季轉虧為盈 (轉機黑馬)'
            WHEN Cur.EPS累計 > YoY.EPS累計 
                THEN N'📈 累計獲利超越去年同期'
            ELSE N'⭐ 獲利常態運行'
        END AS 財報強勢標籤
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            代號, 名稱, 日期, EPS累計, 毛利率, 毛利率上季, 營業利益率, 營業利益率上季,
            CAST(LEFT(日期, 4) AS INT) AS 報告年份,
            CASE 
                WHEN RIGHT(日期, 2) = '01' THEN ISNULL(EPS累計, 0)
                ELSE ISNULL(EPS累計, 0) - ISNULL(LAG(EPS累計, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期), 0)
            END AS 當季單季EPS,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
    ) Cur
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, 毛利率, 營業利益率, 當季單季EPS,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM (
            SELECT 代號, 日期, 毛利率, 營業利益率,
                   CASE 
                       WHEN RIGHT(日期, 2) = '01' THEN ISNULL(EPS累計, 0)
                       ELSE ISNULL(EPS累計, 0) - ISNULL(LAG(EPS累計, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期), 0)
                   END AS 當季單季EPS
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
        ) P
    ) Prev ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(Prev.代號) AND Prev.rn = 2
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, EPS累計,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
    ) YoY ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(YoY.代號) AND YoY.rn = 5
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, CAST(LEFT(日期, 4) AS INT) AS 年份, EPS累計
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
        WHERE RIGHT(日期, 2) = '04'
    ) FullYear ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(FullYear.代號) AND FullYear.年份 = (Cur.報告年份 - 1)
    WHERE Cur.rn = 1
) F
LEFT JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B 
    ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, 專家實戰總分, 具體概念, 產業價值鏈資訊,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis
) M ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND M.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, 
           MAX([60M動能(OSC)]) AS [60M_OSC], 
           MAX([60M_K值]) AS [60M_K], 
           MAX(短線氣象) AS 短線氣象,
           MAX(具體概念) AS 具體概念
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
    GROUP BY 代號
) R ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, MAX(預估目標價) AS 預估目標價
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates
    GROUP BY 代號
) FST ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(FST.代號)

WHERE (
    (F.今年累計EPS > F.去年全年總EPS AND F.去年全年總EPS > 0)
    OR (F.當季毛利率 > F.上季毛利率 AND F.當季營益率 > F.上季營益率)
    OR (F.上季單季EPS <= 0 AND F.當季單季EPS > 0)
    OR (F.今年累計EPS > F.去年同期累計EPS AND F.去年同期累計EPS > 0)
)
ORDER BY F.今年累計EPS DESC, [超越去年全年%] DESC;`
},

// =========================================================================
// 2️⃣ 【營收動能與創高雙增王】(已對齊 incomesum 真實欄位)
// =========================================================================
{
  cat: "基本面-營收動能",
  title: "🚀 單月營收創高 ✕ 月變動年成長雙增 ✕ 60M動能與週轉率",
  sql: `TOP 50
    -- 🟢 ① 即時行情、量能、股本與週轉率
    B.[代號],
    B.[名稱],
    ISNULL(B.[成交價], 0) AS 現價,
    ISNULL(B.[漲跌], 0) AS 漲跌,
    ISNULL(B.[漲幅], 0) AS [漲幅%],
    ISNULL(B.[總量], 0) AS [成交總量(張)],
    B.[股本億] AS [股本(億)],
    ROUND(ISNULL(B.[總量], 0) / NULLIF(B.[股本億] * 100.0, 0), 2) AS [週轉率%],

    -- 🟢 ② 60分K短線動能與氣象
    ROUND(ISNULL(R.[60M_OSC], 0), 2) AS [60M_OSC],
    ROUND(ISNULL(R.[60M_K], 0), 1)   AS [60M_K值],
    ISNULL(R.[短線氣象], N'☀️ 轉強') AS [60M短線氣象],

    -- 🟢 ③ 營收真實指標 (來自 incomesum)
    I.最新營收月份,
    ROUND(ISNULL(I.年成長, 0), 1) AS [營收年增率%],
    ROUND(ISNULL(I.月變動, 0), 1) AS [營收月增率%],
    ROUND(ISNULL(I.累計營收年成長, 0), 1) AS [累計營收年增%],
    ROUND(ISNULL(I.近12月營收成長, 0), 1) AS [近12月年增%],
    ISNULL(I.單月營收億, 0) AS [單月營收(億)],
    ISNULL(I.累計營收億, 0) AS [累計營收(億)],
    
    -- 🟢 營收動能綜合評級
    CASE 
        WHEN I.單月營收億 >= I.歷史最高營收億 AND I.單月營收億 > 0 
            THEN N'🌟🌟 單月營收創歷史新高！'
        WHEN I.年成長 >= 50.0 AND I.月變動 > 0 
            THEN N'🚀 營收暴衝雙增 (年增>50%)'
        WHEN I.年成長 >= 20.0 AND I.月變動 > 0 
            THEN N'📈 營收穩健雙增 (MoM+YoY)'
        WHEN I.年成長 >= 30.0 
            THEN N'🔥 營收年增強勁 (>30%)'
        ELSE N'⭐ 營收正成長'
    END AS 營收強勢評級,

    -- 🟢 ④ 專家總分 ✕ 外資評價
    ROUND(ISNULL(MS.專家實戰總分, 0), 1) AS 專家實戰總分,
    ISNULL(FST.預估目標價, 0) AS [FactSet目標價],
    CASE 
        WHEN ISNULL(FST.預估目標價, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(B.[成交價], 0) > 0 
            THEN ROUND(((FST.預估目標價 - B.[成交價]) / B.[成交價]) * 100.0, 1)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS [外資潛在空間%],

    -- 🟢 ⑤ 產業分類、具體概念與產業鏈資訊
    ISNULL(B.[產業分類], N'一般電子') AS 產業分類,
    ISNULL(MS.具體概念, ISNULL(R.具體概念, N'AI供應鏈')) AS 具體概念,
    ISNULL(MS.產業價值鏈資訊, N'--') AS 產業價值鏈資訊

FROM (
    SELECT 
        代號, 名稱, 日期 AS 最新營收月份,
        年成長, 月變動, 累計營收年成長, 近12月營收成長,
        單月營收億, 累計營收億,
        MAX(單月營收億) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號) AS 歷史最高營收億,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.incomesum
) I
LEFT JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B 
    ON RTRIM(I.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, 專家實戰總分, 具體概念, 產業價值鏈資訊,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis
) MS ON RTRIM(I.代號) = RTRIM(MS.代號) AND MS.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, 
           MAX([60M動能(OSC)]) AS [60M_OSC], 
           MAX([60M_K值]) AS [60M_K], 
           MAX(短線氣象) AS 短線氣象,
           MAX(具體概念) AS 具體概念
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
    GROUP BY 代號
) R ON RTRIM(I.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, MAX(預估目標價) AS 預估目標價
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates
    GROUP BY 代號
) FST ON RTRIM(I.代號) = RTRIM(FST.代號)

WHERE I.rn = 1
  AND ISNULL(B.[成交價], 10.0) >= 10.0
  AND ISNULL(I.年成長, 0) > 10.0 -- 篩選年增率 > 10%
ORDER BY I.年成長 DESC, I.月變動 DESC;`
},

// =========================================================================
// 3️⃣ 【EPS 獲利 ✕ 營收動能 Merge 終極雙料王】
// =========================================================================
{
  cat: "基本面-雙料雙冠王",
  title: "🏆 營收創高雙增 ✕ 半年賺贏去年 ✕ 本業雙升 終極大滿貫",
  sql: `TOP 50
    -- 🟢 ① 即時行情、量能、股本與週轉率
    F.代號,
    F.名稱,
    ISNULL(B.[成交價], 0) AS 現價,
    ISNULL(B.[漲跌], 0) AS 漲跌,
    ISNULL(B.[漲幅], 0) AS [漲幅%],
    ISNULL(B.[總量], 0) AS [成交總量(張)],
    B.[股本億] AS [股本(億)],
    ROUND(ISNULL(B.[總量], 0) / NULLIF(B.[股本億] * 100.0, 0), 2) AS [週轉率%],

    -- 🟢 ② 60分K進場動能與氣象
    ROUND(ISNULL(R.[60M_OSC], 0), 2) AS [60M_OSC],
    ROUND(ISNULL(R.[60M_K], 0), 1)   AS [60M_K值],
    ISNULL(R.[短線氣象], N'☀️ 轉強') AS [60M短線氣象],

    -- 🟢 ③ 營收動能指標 (來自 incomesum)
    I.最新營收月份,
    ROUND(ISNULL(I.年成長, 0), 1) AS [營收年增率%],
    ROUND(ISNULL(I.月變動, 0), 1) AS [營收月增率%],
    ISNULL(I.單月營收億, 0) AS [單月營收(億)],

    -- 🟢 ④ 半年報 EPS 雙對決
    F.當季單季EPS,
    F.今年累計EPS,
    F.去年全年總EPS,
    ROUND((F.今年累計EPS - F.去年全年總EPS) / NULLIF(ABS(F.去年全年總EPS), 0) * 100.0, 1) AS [超越去年全年%],
    ROUND((F.今年累計EPS - F.去年同期累計EPS) / NULLIF(ABS(F.去年同期累計EPS), 0) * 100.0, 1) AS [累計YoY同期成長%],

    -- 🟢 ⑤ 毛利與營益率季增
    F.當季毛利率,
    ROUND(F.當季毛利率 - F.上季毛利率, 2) AS [毛利季增%],
    F.當季營益率,
    ROUND(F.當季營益率 - F.上季營益率, 2) AS [營益季增%],

    -- 🟢 ⑥ 營收 ✕ 獲利 終極大滿貫評級
    CASE 
        WHEN ISNULL(I.單月營收億, 0) >= ISNULL(I.歷史最高營收億, 0) AND I.單月營收億 > 0 AND F.今年累計EPS > F.去年全年總EPS AND F.去年全年總EPS > 0 AND (F.當季毛利率 > F.上季毛利率) AND (F.當季營益率 > F.上季營益率)
            THEN N'👑🌟 營收創高 + 半年賺贏去年 + 本業雙升 (終極大滿貫)'
        WHEN F.今年累計EPS > F.去年全年總EPS AND F.去年全年總EPS > 0 AND ISNULL(I.年成長, 0) >= 20.0 AND ISNULL(I.月變動, 0) > 0
            THEN N'👑🚀 營收雙增 + 半年賺贏去年 (雙料王者)'
        WHEN (F.當季毛利率 > F.上季毛利率) AND (F.當季營益率 > F.上季營益率) AND ISNULL(I.年成長, 0) >= 20.0
            THEN N'🔥🔥 營收暴衝 + 本業毛利營益雙升'
        WHEN F.今年累計EPS > F.去年全年總EPS AND F.去年全年總EPS > 0 
            THEN N'👑 提前賺贏去年整年'
        ELSE N'⭐ 營收獲利雙強'
    END AS 終極大滿貫評級,

    -- 🟢 ⑦ 專家總分 ✕ 外資目標價空間
    ROUND(ISNULL(MS.專家實戰總分, 0), 1) AS 專家實戰總分,
    ISNULL(FST.預估目標價, 0) AS [FactSet目標價],
    CASE 
        WHEN ISNULL(FST.預估目標價, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(B.[成交價], 0) > 0 
            THEN ROUND(((FST.預估目標價 - B.[成交價]) / B.[成交價]) * 100.0, 1)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS [外資潛在空間%],

    -- 🟢 ⑧ 產業分類、具體概念與產業鏈資訊
    ISNULL(B.[產業分類], N'一般電子') AS 產業分類,
    ISNULL(MS.具體概念, ISNULL(R.具體概念, N'AI供應鏈')) AS 具體概念,
    ISNULL(MS.產業價值鏈資訊, N'--') AS 產業價值鏈資訊

FROM (
    SELECT 
        Cur.代號, Cur.名稱, Cur.日期 AS 最新財報季別,
        Cur.當季單季EPS,
        ISNULL(Cur.EPS累計, 0) AS 今年累計EPS,
        ISNULL(YoY.EPS累計, 0) AS 去年同期累計EPS,
        ISNULL(FullYear.EPS累計, ISNULL(YoY.EPS累計, 0)) AS 去年全年總EPS,
        ISNULL(Cur.毛利率, 0) AS 當季毛利率,
        ISNULL(Cur.毛利率上季, ISNULL(Prev.毛利率, 0)) AS 上季毛利率,
        ISNULL(Cur.營業利益率, 0) AS 當季營益率,
        ISNULL(Cur.營業利益率上季, ISNULL(Prev.營業利益率, 0)) AS 上季營益率
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            代號, 名稱, 日期, EPS累計, 毛利率, 毛利率上季, 營業利益率, 營業利益率上季,
            CAST(LEFT(日期, 4) AS INT) AS 報告年份,
            CASE 
                WHEN RIGHT(日期, 2) = '01' THEN ISNULL(EPS累計, 0)
                ELSE ISNULL(EPS累計, 0) - ISNULL(LAG(EPS累計, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期), 0)
            END AS 當季單季EPS,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
    ) Cur
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, 毛利率, 營業利益率,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
    ) Prev ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(Prev.代號) AND Prev.rn = 2
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, EPS累計,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
    ) YoY ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(YoY.代號) AND YoY.rn = 5
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, CAST(LEFT(日期, 4) AS INT) AS 年份, EPS累計
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
        WHERE RIGHT(日期, 2) = '04'
    ) FullYear ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(FullYear.代號) AND FullYear.年份 = (Cur.報告年份 - 1)
    WHERE Cur.rn = 1
) F
LEFT JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B 
    ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        代號, 日期 AS 最新營收月份, 年成長, 月變動, 單月營收億,
        MAX(單月營收億) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號) AS 歷史最高營收億,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.incomesum
) I ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(I.代號) AND I.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, 專家實戰總分, 具體概念, 產業價值鏈資訊,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis
) MS ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(MS.代號) AND MS.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, 
           MAX([60M動能(OSC)]) AS [60M_OSC], 
           MAX([60M_K值]) AS [60M_K], 
           MAX(短線氣象) AS 短線氣象,
           MAX(具體概念) AS 具體概念
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
    GROUP BY 代號
) R ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 代號, MAX(預估目標價) AS 預估目標價
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates
    GROUP BY 代號
) FST ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(FST.代號)

WHERE (
    (F.今年累計EPS > F.去年全年總EPS AND F.去年全年總EPS > 0)
    OR (F.當季毛利率 > F.上季毛利率 AND F.當季營益率 > F.上季營益率)
    OR (ISNULL(I.年成長, 0) >= 15.0)
)
ORDER BY [超越去年全年%] DESC, [營收年增率%] DESC;`
}
--- ### 💡 更新確認： 這三套範本皆已修正： 1. `incomesum` 的 `年成長`、`月變動`、`單月營收億` 真實欄位。 2. `FactSetEstimates` 的 `MAX(預估目標價) ... GROUP BY`（免依賴日期欄位）。 3. `financesum` 的 當季單季 EPS 自動扣減與跨季動態自動適應。 您可直接整批存入 `myword1.html?id=96`！

🧠 Gemini 的思考路徑：
Investigating String Limits I'm currently looking into a "BC31498" error related to excessive string length within an ASP.NET environment, specifically in the `excelimport2.aspx` file. It appears to involve VB.NET code, potentially with HTML being compiled into a LiteralControl. I'm trying to determine why this is happening. Analyzing Compilation Failures I've zeroed in on the core of the problem: excessively long string constants during ASP.NET compilation, specifically VB.NET's role. It appears `excelimport2.aspx`'s extensive static HTML/SQL templates are being compiled into literal strings, exceeding the compiler's limit of roughly 65,000 characters. Now I'm evaluating standard solutions to clean up the problem. Evaluating Externalization Strategies I'm now deep-diving into potential solutions. The cleanest approach seems to be externalizing the SQL templates entirely, perhaps into `.js` or `.json` files. This avoids the VB.NET compiler's limitations altogether, as the external files are served directly by IIS. Though, a quick fix by breaking up the compilation blocks with server tags is also a possibility. Considering Static HTML Conversion I'm now considering the simple route. If `excelimport2.aspx` doesn't use server-side controls, converting it to pure `.html` means IIS delivers it directly as static content. This completely bypasses the VB.NET compiler and any string length limitations, just like the `excelsql2.html` files we looked at before.

這個錯誤是 ASP.NET 在編譯 `.aspx` 檔案時非常經典的編譯器限制問題： --- ### 🔍 錯誤原因解析 * 錯誤代碼：`BC31498: Length of String constant exceeds current memory limit. Try splitting the string into multiple constants.` * 原因： * 當 `.aspx` 檔案中包含大量靜態 HTML 或龐大的 JavaScript 陣列（例如 50+ 組超長的 SQL 範本）時，ASP.NET 編譯器（VB.NET）會試圖把這大段 HTML 當作一個「超長單一字串常數（`LiteralControl`）」進行編譯。 * VB.NET 編譯器對單一字串常數有 64 KB 的長度硬上限，一旦範本內容超過上限，編譯器就會記憶體溢位崩潰報錯！ --- ### 🛠️ 最佳解決方案（推薦 3 種解法） --- ### ⭐ 方案一（最專業、一勞永逸）：將 SQL 範本抽離為獨立的 `sql_templates.js` 將龐大的 SQL 範本陣列獨立存成一個 `.js` 檔案，讓瀏覽器直接載入。這樣完全不經過 ASP.NET 編譯器，放 1,000 組範本都不會報錯！ #### 步驟 1：在同目錄新增 `sql_templates.js` 將您所有的 SQL 範本陣列剪下，存成獨立的 `sql_templates.js`：
javascript
// sql_templates.js
const sqlTemplates = [
  { cat: "基本面-EPS獲利質變", title: "👑 半年報賺贏去年 ✕ 三率雙升 ✕ 60M進場與外資空間", sql: `...` },
  { cat: "基本面-營收動能", title: "🚀 單月營收創高 ✕ 月變動年成長雙增 ✕ 60M動能與週轉率", sql: `...` },
  { cat: "基本面-雙料雙冠王", title: "🏆 營收創高雙增 ✕ 半年賺贏去年 ✕ 本業雙升 終極大滿貫", sql: `...` },
  // ... 其他 50+ 組範本 ...
];
#### 步驟 2：在 `excelimport2.aspx` 的 `<head>` 中引入它 在 `.aspx` 檔案中只需加入這一行：
html
<script src="sql_templates.js"></script>
原本的 `.aspx` 體積瞬間縮小 90%，ASP.NET 秒速編譯成功！ --- ### ⚡ 方案二（最快）：如果沒有後端伺服器控制項，直接改副檔名為 `.html` 如果這個頁面都是透過 JavaScript / AJAX (`DataService2.aspx`) 去跟資料庫溝通，頁面內沒有使用 `<asp:... runat="server">` 的伺服器控制項： * 直接將 `excelimport2.aspx` 重新命名為 `excelimport2.html`！ * 優點：`.html` 是純靜態檔案，IIS 會直接傳送給瀏覽器，100% 繞過 ASP.NET / VB.NET 編譯器，再長都不會報錯，且載入速度提升 2~3 倍！ --- ### 🛠️ 方案三（不改檔案結構）：在 `.aspx` 中插入伺服器標籤打斷字串合併 若必須維持在 `.aspx` 且不想抽離檔案，可在長 HTML / 範本中間插入 `<%-- 分隔標籤 --%>` 或 `<% Response.Write("") %>`，強制打斷編譯器的單一字串合併：
html
<script>
  const part1 = [
    // 前 20 組範本
  ];
</script>

<%-- 🟢 插入這行伺服器標籤，強制 ASP.NET 切割 LiteralControl --%>
<% Response.Write("") %>

<script>
  const part2 = [
    // 後續範本
  ];
  const allTemplates = part1.concat(part2);
</script>
--- ### 💡 建議選擇： * 首選「方案一」或「方案二」：把範本存成 `sql_templates.js` 或直接使用 `.html`，以後無論再增加多少組 SQL 範本都絕對不會再遇到 `BC31498` 限制！

為您量身打造一個專屬的 【Zen AI 歌單打包與智能編輯系統 Pro (`playlist_editor.html`)】！ 它結合了 `myword1.html`（文字打包系統）的直覺介面 與 `message6s.html` / `message6_1.html` 的影音曲庫資料庫，徹底解決「手動查 ID 困難、改歌單麻煩」的痛點。 --- ### 🌟 專屬歌單編輯系統 5 大核心功能 1. 📑 歌單槽位快速切換與打包：下拉選單直接選擇 1~N 號歌單槽位（如：`10. 張清芳`），自動載入歌單名稱與已排入的全部歌曲。 2. 🔍 右側內建曲庫極速檢索：直接輸入歌手名（如：`菲兒`）、歌名（如：`擁抱你離去`）或 ID，即時列出所有歌曲與編號。 3. ➕ 一鍵加入歌單（免記編號）：在搜尋結果點擊 「+ 加入歌單」，編號自動排入當前歌單並即時預覽！ 4. ↕️ 視覺化上下排序與單曲刪除：歌單內的歌曲支援 「🔼 上移」、「🔽 下移」、「🗑️ 移除」，調整順序零難度。 5. 📝 批次 ID 文字打包模式：支援直接貼入 `2140,2139,2138` 批次字串，點擊「解析並載入」即可一次同步。 --- ### 📄 完整獨立網頁原始碼：`playlist_editor.html` 請將以下程式碼存為 `playlist_editor.html`，放在與 `message5.aspx` 相同的網站目錄下（例如 `C:\...\androidapp\`）：
html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-TW">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Zen AI 歌單打包與智能編輯系統 Pro</title>

  <!-- 引入 Bootstrap 5、Icons、jQuery 與 SweetAlert2 -->
  <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.2/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.1/font/bootstrap-icons.css">
  <script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.7.1.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.2/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sweetalert2@11"></script>

  <style>
    :root {
      --bg-primary: #070d18;
      --bg-secondary: #0c1827;
      --bg-panel: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
      --border-color: #1e293b;
      --accent-cyan: #38bdf8;
      --accent-purple: #a855f7;
      --accent-red: #f43f5e;
      --accent-green: #10b981;
      --accent-gold: #fbbf24;
      --text-main: #f8fafc;
      --text-muted: #94a3b8;
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body { background-color: var(--bg-primary); color: var(--text-main); min-height: 100vh; padding: 15px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; }

    /* 頂部導航 */
    .header-bar {
      display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
      background: var(--bg-panel); border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px); padding: 14px 22px; border-radius: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 15px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px;
    }
    .header-title { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 800; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #38bdf8, #a855f7, #f43f5e); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
    
    /* 玻璃面板 */
    .glass-panel { background: var(--bg-panel); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); height: 100%; }
    .panel-title { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-cyan); margin-bottom: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; }

    /* 輸入控制元件 */
    .custom-input { background: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #334155; color: #fff; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.9rem; width: 100%; outline: none; transition: 0.2s; }
    .custom-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent-cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25); }
    .custom-select { background: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #334155; color: #fff; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.9rem; outline: none; }

    /* 按鈕樣式 */
    .btn-action { background: var(--accent-cyan); color: #000; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
    .btn-action:hover { filter: brightness(1.15); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .btn-save { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #10b981, #059669); color: #fff; }
    .btn-secondary-custom { background: #1e293b; color: #cbd5e1; border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }
    .btn-secondary-custom:hover { background: #334155; color: #fff; }

    /* 表格樣式 */
    .table-container { max-height: 520px; overflow-y: auto; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; }
    .quant-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.88rem; text-align: left; }
    .quant-table th { position: sticky; top: 0; background: #0b1528 !important; color: var(--accent-cyan); padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan); z-index: 5; white-space: nowrap; }
    .quant-table td { padding: 9px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); vertical-align: middle; }
    .quant-table tr:hover { background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08); }

    /* 標籤 */
    .badge-tag { padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; }
    .badge-id { background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2); color: var(--accent-cyan); border: 1px solid #0284c7; }
    .badge-count { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2); color: var(--accent-gold); border: 1px solid #d97706; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <!-- 頂部標題與快速導航 -->
  <div class="header-bar">
    <div class="header-title">
      <i class="bi bi-music-note-list text-warning"></i>
      <span>Zen AI 歌單打包與智能編輯系統 Pro</span>
    </div>
    <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-3">
      <a href="message6s.html" target="_blank" class="btn-secondary-custom text-decoration-none">
        <i class="bi bi-play-circle text-danger me-1"></i>影音播放器
      </a>
      <a href="message6_1.html" target="_blank" class="btn-secondary-custom text-decoration-none">
        <i class="bi bi-youtube text-danger me-1"></i>YouTube 播放器
      </a>
      <a href="warroom_cockpit.html" target="_blank" class="btn-secondary-custom text-decoration-none">
        <i class="bi bi-grid-1x2-fill text-info me-1"></i>戰情看板
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="container-fluid">
    <div class="row g-3">
      
      <!-- ========================================== -->
      <!-- 👈 左半部：歌單槽位編輯工作區 (Playlist Workspace) -->
      <!-- ========================================== -->
      <div class="col-lg-6">
        <div class="glass-panel">
          <div class="panel-title">
            <span><i class="bi bi-collection-play-fill me-2"></i>歌單設定與排播曲目</span>
            <span class="badge badge-count" id="badge-playlist-count">共 0 首</span>
          </div>

          <!-- 槽位選擇器 -->
          <div class="row g-2 mb-3 align-items-center">
            <div class="col-sm-7">
              <label class="small text-muted mb-1">選擇歌單存檔槽位 (Playlist Slot)：</label>
              <select id="select-slot" class="custom-select w-100" onchange="onSlotChange()">
                <option value="">⏳ 正在載入槽位清單...</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div class="col-sm-5">
              <label class="small text-muted mb-1">歌單名稱 (自訂標題)：</label>
              <input type="text" id="input-slot-name" class="custom-input" placeholder="例如: 10. 張清芳經典">
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- 批次 ID 字串 (像打包系統一樣直觀) -->
          <div class="mb-3">
            <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-1">
              <label class="small text-muted">歌單 ID 打包清單 (以逗號分隔)：</label>
              <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-info" style="font-size: 0.75rem;" onclick="syncPlaylistFromText()">
                <i class="bi bi-arrow-repeat me-1"></i>解析文字並重整列表
              </button>
            </div>
            <textarea id="textarea-ids" class="custom-input" style="height: 65px; font-family: monospace;" placeholder="點擊右側歌曲自動追加，或手動貼入如: 2140,2139,2138..."></textarea>
          </div>

          <!-- 歌單內的歌曲明細 (支援上下調整與刪除) -->
          <div class="table-container mb-3" style="max-height: 380px;">
            <table class="quant-table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th style="width: 55px;">序號</th>
                  <th style="width: 70px;">ID</th>
                  <th>歌手 / 類型</th>
                  <th>歌名 / 內容</th>
                  <th style="width: 140px; text-align: center;">操作 (排序/移除)</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody id="tbody-playlist-items">
                <tr><td colspan="5" class="text-center text-muted p-4">👈 請先從上方選擇歌單槽位</td></tr>
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          <!-- 儲存與清空按鈕 -->
          <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
            <button class="btn btn-outline-danger btn-sm" onclick="clearCurrentPlaylist()">
              <i class="bi bi-trash3 me-1"></i>清空目前歌單
            </button>
            <button class="btn-action btn-save" onclick="saveCurrentPlaylist()">
              <i class="bi bi-cloud-arrow-up-fill me-1"></i>💾 儲存並更新歌單槽位
            </button>
          </div>

        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ========================================== -->
      <!-- 👉 右半部：全資料庫曲庫檢索與快速點歌 (Song Library Search) -->
      <!-- ========================================== -->
      <div class="col-lg-6">
        <div class="glass-panel">
          <div class="panel-title">
            <span><i class="bi bi-search me-2"></i>曲庫總覽與快速檢索 (查詢編號)</span>
            <span class="small text-muted" id="search-total-text">總計 0 首</span>
          </div>

          <!-- 搜尋列 -->
          <div class="row g-2 mb-3">
            <div class="col-8">
              <div class="input-group">
                <input type="text" id="search-keyword" class="custom-input" placeholder="🔍 輸入歌名、歌手名或識別碼..." onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter') doSearch(1)">
                <button class="btn-action" style="border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;" onclick="doSearch(1)">
                  <i class="bi bi-search"></i> 搜尋
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="col-4">
              <button class="btn-secondary-custom w-100 h-100" onclick="loadAllSongs()">
                <i class="bi bi-grid-fill me-1"></i>顯示最新曲庫
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- 曲庫搜尋結果表格 -->
          <div class="table-container mb-3" style="max-height: 480px;">
            <table class="quant-table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th style="width: 70px;">ID</th>
                  <th style="width: 110px;">歌手/類型</th>
                  <th>歌名 / 內容</th>
                  <th style="width: 95px; text-align: center;">加入歌單</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody id="tbody-library-items">
                <tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center text-muted p-4">⏳ 正在載入曲庫清單...</td></tr>
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          <!-- 分頁控制列 -->
          <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center small text-muted">
            <span id="page-info">第 1 頁</span>
            <div class="d-flex gap-1">
              <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" id="btn-prev-page" onclick="changePage(-1)"><i class="bi bi-chevron-left"></i> 上一頁</button>
              <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" id="btn-next-page" onclick="changePage(1)">下一頁 <i class="bi bi-chevron-right"></i></button>
            </div>
          </div>

        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ========================================== -->
  <!-- 核心 JavaScript 交互邏輯 -->
  <!-- ========================================== -->
  <script>
    const API_URL = "message5.aspx";

    let currentSlotId = null;
    let currentPlaylistSongs = []; // 當前歌單中的歌曲物件陣列 [{識別碼, 姓名, 內容}, ...]
    let currentPage = 1;
    const pageSize = 15;
    let totalLibraryCount = 0;

    $(document).ready(function () {
      loadSlotNames();
      doSearch(1);
    });

    // =========================================================================
    // 1. 載入歌單槽位清單 (GetSlotNames)
    // =========================================================================
    function loadSlotNames(selectedId = null) {
      $.ajax({
        type: "POST",
        url: API_URL + "/GetSlotNames",
        data: "{}",
        contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        dataType: "json",
        success: function (res) {
          const list = res.d || [];
          const select = $("#select-slot");
          select.empty();

          if (list.length === 0) {
            select.append('<option value="">⚠️ 無可用槽位</option>');
            return;
          }

          list.forEach(slot => {
            const displayName = slot.name ? `${slot.id}. ${slot.name}` : `${slot.id}. (空白槽位)`;
            select.append(`<option value="${slot.id}">${displayName}</option>`);
          });

          if (selectedId) {
            select.val(selectedId);
          }
          onSlotChange();
        },
        error: function () {
          $("#select-slot").html('<option value="">❌ 連線後端失敗</option>');
        }
      });
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 2. 切換歌單槽位 ➔ 載入歌單明細 (LoadPlaylistItems)
    // =========================================================================
    function onSlotChange() {
      const slotId = $("#select-slot").val();
      if (!slotId) return;
      currentSlotId = parseInt(slotId);

      const slotText = $("#select-slot option:selected").text();
      const rawName = slotText.includes('.') ? slotText.substring(slotText.indexOf('.') + 1).trim() : slotText;
      $("#input-slot-name").val(rawName === '(空白槽位)' ? '' : rawName);

      $("#tbody-playlist-items").html('<tr><td colspan="5" class="text-center text-info p-4">⏳ 正在載入該槽位歌曲...</td></tr>');

      $.ajax({
        type: "POST",
        url: API_URL + "/LoadPlaylistItems",
        data: JSON.stringify({ slotId: currentSlotId }),
        contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        dataType: "json",
        success: function (res) {
          const data = res.d ? res.d.data : [];
          currentPlaylistSongs = data || [];
          renderPlaylistTable();
          updateIdTextarea();
        },
        error: function () {
          $("#tbody-playlist-items").html('<tr><td colspan="5" class="text-center text-danger p-4">❌ 載入失敗</td></tr>');
        }
      });
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 3. 渲染左側歌單表格
    // =========================================================================
    function renderPlaylistTable() {
      const tbody = $("#tbody-playlist-items");
      tbody.empty();

      $("#badge-playlist-count").text(`共 ${currentPlaylistSongs.length} 首`);

      if (currentPlaylistSongs.length === 0) {
        tbody.html('<tr><td colspan="5" class="text-center text-muted p-4">📭 目前歌單為空，請從右側曲庫點擊「+ 加入」</td></tr>');
        return;
      }

      currentPlaylistSongs.forEach((song, idx) => {
        const id = song.識別碼 || song.id;
        const name = song.姓名 || song.name || '--';
        const title = song.內容 || song.word || '--';

        tbody.append(`
          <tr>
            <td class="text-muted fw-bold">${idx + 1}</td>
            <td><span class="badge badge-tag badge-id">${id}</span></td>
            <td class="text-info text-truncate" style="max-width:120px;" title="${name}">${name}</td>
            <td class="text-light text-truncate" style="max-width:180px;" title="${title}">${title}</td>
            <td class="text-center">
              <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary px-1 py-0" onclick="moveSong(${idx}, -1)" title="上移" ${idx === 0 ? 'disabled' : ''}><i class="bi bi-arrow-up"></i></button>
              <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary px-1 py-0" onclick="moveSong(${idx}, 1)" title="下移" ${idx === currentPlaylistSongs.length - 1 ? 'disabled' : ''}><i class="bi bi-arrow-down"></i></button>
              <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger px-1 py-0 ms-1" onclick="removeSong(${idx})" title="移除"><i class="bi bi-x-lg"></i></button>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `);
      });
    }

    function updateIdTextarea() {
      const ids = currentPlaylistSongs.map(s => s.識別碼 || s.id).join(',');
      $("#textarea-ids").val(ids);
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 4. 操作歌單：加入、移除、上下移動、文字解析
    // =========================================================================
    function addSongToPlaylist(song) {
      currentPlaylistSongs.push(song);
      renderPlaylistTable();
      updateIdTextarea();

      // 輕微提示效果
      const Toast = Swal.mixin({ toast: true, position: 'top-end', showConfirmButton: false, timer: 1200 });
      Toast.fire({ icon: 'success', title: `已加入: ${song.內容 || song.word}` });
    }

    function removeSong(index) {
      currentPlaylistSongs.splice(index, 1);
      renderPlaylistTable();
      updateIdTextarea();
    }

    function moveSong(index, direction) {
      const targetIndex = index + direction;
      if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= currentPlaylistSongs.length) return;

      const temp = currentPlaylistSongs[index];
      currentPlaylistSongs[index] = currentPlaylistSongs[targetIndex];
      currentPlaylistSongs[targetIndex] = temp;

      renderPlaylistTable();
      updateIdTextarea();
    }

    function clearCurrentPlaylist() {
      if (currentPlaylistSongs.length === 0) return;
      currentPlaylistSongs = [];
      renderPlaylistTable();
      updateIdTextarea();
    }

    // 手動貼上 ID 字串解析 (例如 2140,2139)
    function syncPlaylistFromText() {
      const rawText = $("#textarea-ids").val().trim();
      if (!rawText) {
        currentPlaylistSongs = [];
        renderPlaylistTable();
        return;
      }

      // 提取所有數字 ID
      const ids = rawText.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(s => s.match(/^\d+$/));
      if (ids.length === 0) {
        Swal.fire('提示', '未偵測到有效的數字 ID，請以逗號分隔 (如: 2140,2139)', 'warning');
        return;
      }

      Swal.fire({ title: '⏳ 正在解析歌曲資訊...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });

      // 呼叫 GetData 批次取回歌曲資訊
      $.ajax({
        type: "POST",
        url: API_URL + "/GetData",
        data: JSON.stringify({ searchKey: "", sortBy: "識別碼", sortDir: "DESC", pageIndex: 1, pageSize: 999999 }),
        contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        dataType: "json",
        success: function (res) {
          Swal.close();
          const allRows = res.d ? res.d.data : [];
          const rowMap = {};
          allRows.forEach(r => { rowMap[r.識別碼] = r; });

          currentPlaylistSongs = [];
          ids.forEach(id => {
            if (rowMap[id]) {
              currentPlaylistSongs.push(rowMap[id]);
            } else {
              currentPlaylistSongs.push({ 識別碼: id, 姓名: '自訂項目', 內容: `歌曲編號 #${id}` });
            }
          });

          renderPlaylistTable();
          updateIdTextarea();
          Swal.fire('完成', `成功解析並載入 ${currentPlaylistSongs.length} 首歌曲！`, 'success');
        },
        error: function () {
          Swal.fire('錯誤', '查詢資料庫失敗', 'error');
        }
      });
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 5. 儲存歌單槽位 (SavePlaylist)
    // =========================================================================
    function saveCurrentPlaylist() {
      if (!currentSlotId) {
        Swal.fire('提示', '請先選擇要儲存的歌單槽位', 'warning');
        return;
      }

      const slotName = $("#input-slot-name").val().trim();
      if (!slotName) {
        Swal.fire('提示', '請輸入歌單名稱 (例如: 10. 張清芳經典)', 'warning');
        return;
      }

      const idListStr = currentPlaylistSongs.map(s => s.識別碼 || s.id).join(',');

      Swal.fire({
        title: '確定要儲存歌單嗎？',
        html: `槽位：<strong>#${currentSlotId}</strong><br>名稱：<strong>${slotName}</strong><br>包含曲數：<strong>${currentPlaylistSongs.length} 首</strong>`,
        icon: 'question',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: '💾 確定儲存',
        cancelButtonText: '取消'
      }).then((result) => {
        if (result.isConfirmed) {
          $.ajax({
            type: "POST",
            url: API_URL + "/SavePlaylist",
            data: JSON.stringify({ slotId: currentSlotId, slotName: slotName, ids: idListStr }),
            contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
            dataType: "json",
            success: function (res) {
              if (res.d && res.d.success) {
                Swal.fire('儲存成功！', `歌單【${slotName}】已成功同步至資料庫！`, 'success');
                loadSlotNames(currentSlotId);
              } else {
                Swal.fire('儲存失敗', res.d ? res.d.msg : '未知錯誤', 'error');
              }
            },
            error: function (xhr) {
              Swal.fire('連線錯誤', '無法連接後端 SavePlaylist 服務', 'error');
            }
          });
        }
      });
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 6. 右側曲庫檢索 (GetData)
    // =========================================================================
    function doSearch(page = 1) {
      currentPage = page;
      const keyword = $("#search-keyword").val().trim();

      $("#tbody-library-items").html('<tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center text-info p-4">⏳ 正在檢索曲庫...</td></tr>');

      $.ajax({
        type: "POST",
        url: API_URL + "/GetData",
        data: JSON.stringify({
          searchKey: keyword,
          sortBy: "識別碼",
          sortDir: "DESC",
          pageIndex: currentPage,
          pageSize: pageSize
        }),
        contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        dataType: "json",
        success: function (res) {
          if (res.d && res.d.error) {
            $("#tbody-library-items").html(`<tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center text-danger p-4">❌ ${res.d.error}</td></tr>`);
            return;
          }

          const rows = res.d ? res.d.data : [];
          totalLibraryCount = res.d ? res.d.totalCount : 0;

          renderLibraryTable(rows);
        },
        error: function () {
          $("#tbody-library-items").html('<tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center text-danger p-4">❌ 檢索失敗</td></tr>');
        }
      });
    }

    function loadAllSongs() {
      $("#search-keyword").val('');
      doSearch(1);
    }

    function renderLibraryTable(rows) {
      const tbody = $("#tbody-library-items");
      tbody.empty();

      $("#search-total-text").text(`檢索結果: ${totalLibraryCount} 首`);
      const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalLibraryCount / pageSize) || 1;
      $("#page-info").text(`第 ${currentPage} / ${totalPages} 頁 (共 ${totalLibraryCount} 筆)`);
      $("#btn-prev-page").prop('disabled', currentPage <= 1);
      $("#btn-next-page").prop('disabled', currentPage >= totalPages);

      if (rows.length === 0) {
        tbody.html('<tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center text-muted p-4">🔍 找不到符合條件的歌曲</td></tr>');
        return;
      }

      rows.forEach(r => {
        // 安全轉成 JSON 字串傳遞
        const songJson = JSON.stringify(r).replace(/"/g, '&quot;');

        tbody.append(`
          <tr>
            <td><span class="badge badge-tag badge-id">${r.識別碼}</span></td>
            <td class="text-info text-truncate" style="max-width:110px;" title="${r.姓名}">${r.姓名}</td>
            <td class="text-light text-truncate" style="max-width:190px;" title="${r.內容}">${r.內容}</td>
            <td class="text-center">
              <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-info py-0 px-2" onclick='addSongToPlaylist(${songJson})'>
                <i class="bi bi-plus-lg"></i> 加入
              </button>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `);
      });
    }

    function changePage(delta) {
      const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalLibraryCount / pageSize) || 1;
      const target = currentPage + delta;
      if (target >= 1 && target <= totalPages) {
        doSearch(target);
      }
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>

// 3. 渲染左側歌單表格 (放大歌名歌手 ✕ 縮小超連結)

function renderPlaylistTable() {
  const tbody = $("#tbody-playlist-items");
  tbody.empty();

  $("#badge-playlist-count").text(`共 ${currentPlaylistSongs.length} 首`);

  if (currentPlaylistSongs.length === 0) {
    tbody.html('<tr><td colspan="5" class="text-center text-muted p-4">📭 目前歌單為空，請從右側曲庫點擊「+ 加入」</td></tr>');

  }

  currentPlaylistSongs.forEach((song, idx) => {
    const id = song.識別碼 || song.id;
    const name = song.姓名 || song.name || '--';
    const link = song.內容 || song.word || song.mail1 || song.mail || '--';

    tbody.append(`
      <tr>
        <td class="text-muted fw-bold">${idx + 1}</td>

        <td class="text-secondary text-truncate small" style="max-width: 90px; font-size: 0.75rem;" title="${link}">${link}</td>
        <td class="text-center">
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary px-1 py-0" onclick="moveSong(${idx}, -1)" title="上移" ${idx === 0 ? 'disabled' : ''}><i class="bi bi-arrow-up"></i></button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary px-1 py-0" onclick="moveSong(${idx}, 1)" title="下移" ${idx === currentPlaylistSongs.length - 1 ? 'disabled' : ''}><i class="bi bi-arrow-down"></i></button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger px-1 py-0 ms-1" onclick="removeSong(${idx})" title="移除"><i class="bi bi-x-lg"></i></button>
        </td>
      </tr>
    `);
  });
}

GroqCloud — 推論速度極快（極致速度體驗） * 支援模型：Llama 3.1 / 3.3（8B/70B）、Gemma 2、Mixtral、Whisper（語音辨識）等開源模型。 * 特點： * 採用自研 LPU 晶片，生成速度極快（每秒可達數百 Token）。 * 免費額度充足，完全相容 OpenAI API SDK。 * 取得方式：註冊 [Groq Console](https://console.groq.com/) 即可直接建立 API Key。 --- ### 3. OpenRouter — 一站式聚合平台（有多款標註 `:free` 的頂級模型） * 支援模型：DeepSeek R1 / V3、Llama 3.3 70B、Qwen 2.5 72B、Gemini Flash 等多款標記為 `:free` 的模型。 * 特點： * 同一個 API 格式可以隨意切換數十種不同的免費/付費模型。 * 只要在模型名稱後加上 `:free`（例如 `meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct:free`）即可完全免費調用。 * 取得方式：註冊 [OpenRouter.ai](https://openrouter.ai/)。 --- ### 4. GitHub Models — 免費體驗 GPT-4o、Llama 3、Mistral * 支援模型：OpenAI GPT-4o / GPT-4o-mini、Llama 3.3、Phi-4、Mistral Large 等。 * 特點： * 微軟與 GitHub 提供給開發者測試的免費 Playground 與 API。 * 直接使用個人的 GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT) 即可調用。 * 取得方式：前往 [GitHub Marketplace - Models](https://github.com/marketplace/models)。 --- ### 5. Cloudflare Workers AI — 邊緣計算，每日免費額度 * 支援模型：Llama 3.1、Qwen 2.5、Mistral、Embedding 向量模型等。 * 特點： * 免費帳號每天提供 10,000 個神經元（Neurons）額度，適合輕量級應用或自動化腳本。 * 取得方式：登入 [Cloudflare Dashboard](https://dash.cloudflare.com/) 啟用 Workers AI。 --- ### 6. Hugging Face Serverless Inference API * 支援模型：Hugging Face 上的數萬種開源模型（文字生成、翻譯、分類、語音等）。 * 特點： * 免費版有 Rate Limit（頻率限制），適合個人小型實驗或特定開源小模型。 * 取得方式：註冊 [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/) 建立 Access Token。 --- ### 💻 範例：使用 Python SDK 調用免費 API（以 Groq / OpenRouter 為例） 因為它們都支援 OpenAI 相容介面，程式碼非常簡潔：

vb
Imports System.IO
Imports System.Net
Imports System.Text
Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Serialization

Public Class stockai1
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    ' =========================================================================
    ' 🛠️【1. OpenRouter API 設定區】
    ' =========================================================================
    Private Const OPENROUTER_API_KEY As String = "sk-or-v1-請在此填入您的OpenRouter金鑰"
    Private Const OPENROUTER_URL As String = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions"

    Protected Sub Page_Load(ByVal sender As Object, ByVal e As System.EventArgs) Handles Me.Load
        Response.AddHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        Response.AddHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "POST, GET, OPTIONS")
        Response.AddHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
        If Request.HttpMethod = "OPTIONS" Then Response.End()
    End Sub

    ' =========================================================================
    ' 🛠️【2. 三級自動輪詢 WebMethod 服務】
    ' =========================================================================
    <WebMethod()>
    <ScriptMethod(ResponseFormat:=ResponseFormat.Json)>
    Public Shared Function GenerateAIReport(ByVal stockCode As String, ByVal stockName As String, ByVal promptText As String, ByVal selectedModelMode As String) As Object
        Dim js As New JavaScriptSerializer()
        Dim startTime As DateTime = DateTime.Now

        ' 🎯 三大頂級免費大模型梯隊
        Dim modelIds As String() = {
            "deepseek/deepseek-r1:free",
            "qwen/qwen-2.5-72b-instruct:free",
            "meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct:free"
        }

        Dim modelNames As String() = {
            "🧠 DeepSeek-R1 (671B 滿血推理)",
            "💎 Qwen-2.5 (72B 繁中量化之王)",
            "⚡ Llama-3.3 (70B 開源旗艦)"
        }

        ' 若使用者手動指定模型，則排在第 1 順位
        Dim targetList As New List(Of Integer)()
        If selectedModelMode = "deepseek" Then
            targetList.Add(0) : targetList.Add(1) : targetList.Add(2)
        ElseIf selectedModelMode = "qwen" Then
            targetList.Add(1) : targetList.Add(0) : targetList.Add(2)
        ElseIf selectedModelMode = "llama" Then
            targetList.Add(2) : targetList.Add(0) : targetList.Add(1)
        Else
            targetList.Add(0) : targetList.Add(1) : targetList.Add(2) ' 預設自動輪詢
        End If

        Dim lastErrorMsg As String = ""

        ' 依序輪詢 3 個模型
        For Each idx In targetList
            Dim curModelId As String = modelIds(idx)
            Dim curModelName As String = modelNames(idx)

            Try
                Dim reply As String = CallSingleOpenRouterModel(curModelId, promptText)

                If Not String.IsNullOrEmpty(reply) Then
                    Dim durationMs As Double = (DateTime.Now - startTime).TotalMilliseconds
                    Return New With {
                        .success = True,
                        .modelId = curModelId,
                        .modelName = curModelName,
                        .reply = reply,
                        .duration = String.Format("{0:0.0}s", durationMs / 1000.0)
                    }
                End If
            Catch ex As Exception
                lastErrorMsg = "[" & curModelName & "] 呼叫失敗: " & ex.Message
                ' 繼續下一個模型重試
            End Try
        Next

        ' 3 個模型全部失敗
        Return New With {
            .success = False,
            .error = "❌ 三大頂級免費模型當前皆繁忙（429 頻率限制或服務中載），請稍候 5~10 秒後重試。\n最後錯誤: " & lastErrorMsg
        }
    End Function

    ' =========================================================================
    ' 🛠️【3. 單一模型 HTTP POST 呼叫函式】
    ' =========================================================================
    Private Shared Function CallSingleOpenRouterModel(ByVal modelId As String, ByVal promptText As String) As String
        ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol = SecurityProtocolType.Tls12 Or CType(3072, SecurityProtocolType)

        Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(OPENROUTER_URL), HttpWebRequest)
        request.Method = "POST"
        request.ContentType = "application/json; charset=utf-8"
        request.Headers.Add("Authorization", "Bearer " & OPENROUTER_API_KEY)
        request.Headers.Add("HTTP-Referer", "https://zen2965.duckdns.org")
        request.Headers.Add("X-Title", "Zen AI StockMaster Pro")
        request.Timeout = 45000 ' 45 秒超時

        Dim requestBody As New With {
            .model = modelId,
            .messages = New Object() {
                New With {.role = "system", .content = "你是一位頂級台股資深量化操盤總監。分析內容請一針見血，條理分明，全部使用繁體中文回覆。"},
                New With {.role = "user", .content = promptText}
            },
            .temperature = 0.6
        }

        Dim js As New JavaScriptSerializer()
        Dim jsonStr As String = js.Serialize(requestBody)
        Dim byteArray As Byte() = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(jsonStr)
        request.ContentLength = byteArray.Length

        Using dataStream As Stream = request.GetRequestStream()
            dataStream.Write(byteArray, 0, byteArray.Length)
        End Using

        Using response As WebResponse = request.GetResponse()
            Using streamReader As New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream(), Encoding.UTF8)
                Dim responseJson As String = streamReader.ReadToEnd()
                Dim parsed As Dictionary(Of String, Object) = js.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(responseJson)

                If parsed.ContainsKey("choices") Then
                    Dim choices As Object() = CType(parsed("choices"), Object())
                    If choices.Length > 0 Then
                        Dim firstChoice As Dictionary(Of String, Object) = CType(choices(0), Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                        If firstChoice.ContainsKey("message") Then
                            Dim messageObj As Dictionary(Of String, Object) = CType(firstChoice("message"), Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                            Return messageObj("content").ToString()
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
            End Using
        End Using

        Return ""
    End Function
End Class

    /* AI 解盤文字呈現區 */
    .report-content {
      background: #091220; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 18px 20px; font-size: 0.94rem; line-height: 1.75; color: #e2e8f0; white-space: pre-wrap;

    /* 內嵌四大圖表 */

<body>

  <!-- 頂部導航 -->
  <div class="header-bar">

      <i class="bi bi-cpu-fill text-info"></i>

    </div>
    <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-3">
      <a href="warroom_cockpit.html" target="_blank" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-info text-decoration-none">
        <i class="bi bi-grid-1x2-fill me-1"></i>量化戰情室
      </a>
      <a href="excelsql2.html" target="_blank" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-warning text-decoration-none">
        <i class="bi bi-table me-1"></i>Excel SQL

  <div class="container-fluid">

      <!-- 👈 左側：個股選擇與模型控制 -->
      <div class="col-lg-4">
        <div class="glass-panel">
          <h5 class="fw-bold text-info mb-3"><i class="bi bi-sliders me-2"></i>操盤分析設定</h5>
          
          <!-- 股票代號輸入 -->
          <div class="mb-3">
            <label class="small text-muted mb-1">輸入股票代號：</label>
            <div class="input-group">
              <input type="text" id="input-stock-code" class="custom-input" placeholder="例如: 2330, 2489, 3035" value="2330">
              <button class="btn-action" onclick="analyzeStock()">
                <i class="bi bi-lightning-charge-fill"></i> 生成解盤
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- 模型切換器 -->
          <div class="mb-3">
            <label class="small text-muted mb-1">AI 思考模型策略：</label>
            <select id="select-model-mode" class="custom-select w-100">
              <option value="auto" selected>⚡ 智慧三級輪詢 (DeepSeek ➔ Qwen ➔ Llama)</option>
              <option value="deepseek">🧠 優先: DeepSeek-R1:free (671B 滿血推理)</option>
              <option value="qwen">💎 優先: Qwen-2.5-72B:free (72B 繁中量化)</option>
              <option value="llama">⚡ 優先: Llama-3.3-70B:free (70B 開源旗艦)</option>

          <!-- 3-Way 離場勝率即時卡片 -->
          <div class="p-3 mb-3" style="background:#091220; border:1px solid #1e293b; border-radius:8px;">
            <div class="small fw-bold text-warning mb-2"><i class="bi bi-shield-check me-1"></i>該股 3-Way 離場基因勝率</div>
            <div id="box-3exits" class="small text-muted" style="line-height:1.6;">

            </div>
