python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI 股票戰情室：每日 5 大社群爆款貼文自動生成器 V1.1 修正版】
# 每天自動產生 5 種不同維度的吸睛貼文草稿，供管理員隨選隨貼！

import os
import sys

# 強制 UTF-8 輸出
if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
if sys.stderr and hasattr(sys.stderr, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

import datetime
import pyodbc

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【1. 設定區】
# ==========================================
SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchangedate"
CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={{SQL Server}};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'
OUTPUT_FILE = r"C:\test_c\fb_posts_today.txt"

today_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d')

# ==========================================
# 🕵️ 草稿一：【主力籌碼獵人】大戶逆勢鎖碼榜
# ==========================================
def generate_post_chips(cursor):
    try:
        sql = """
        SELECT TOP 5
            C.代號, C.名稱, C.成交價 AS 現價, C.漲幅 AS [漲幅%], C.總量 AS [總量(張)],
            C.集中度1日, C.集中度5日, C.集中度20日,
            ROUND(ISNULL(E.WinRate_20MA, 50.0), 1) AS [20MA勝率%],
            ROUND(ISNULL(E.Return_20MA, 0.0), 2) AS [20MA期望值%],
            ISNULL(E.OptimalExit, N'🔥 20MA勝出') AS 最適戰術
        FROM (
            SELECT 代號, 名稱, 成交價, 漲幅, 總量, 集中度1日, 集中度5日, 集中度20日,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.Chips5
        ) C
        LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits E ON RTRIM(C.代號) = RTRIM(E.代號)
        WHERE C.rn = 1 AND C.總量 >= 3000 AND C.成交價 >= 10.0 AND C.集中度5日 >= 10.0
        ORDER BY C.集中度5日 DESC, C.集中度1日 DESC;
        """
        cursor.execute(sql)
        rows = cursor.fetchall()
        if not rows: return "⚠️ 今日暫無符合【5日集中度 >= 10% 且 總量 >= 3000張】之個股。"

        post = (
            f"🕵️ 【戰情籌碼追蹤】股價在洗盤，誰在暗中大舉鎖碼？\n"
            f"📅 統計日期：{today_str} 盤後\n"
            f"💡 理念：不看表面消息，只看大戶底牌！散戶拋售、主力承接才是真起漲訊號！\n"
            f"────────────────────────\n"
            f"🔥 今日【主力 5 日籌碼集中度最高】Top 5 精選：\n\n"
        )
        for idx, r in enumerate(rows, 1):
            sign_ret = "+" if r[9] >= 0 else ""
            post += (
                f"{idx}. 👑 {r[0]} {r[1]} (現價:{r[2]}元 | 漲幅:{r[3]}% | 量:{r[4]:,}張)\n"
                f"   ├─ 🎯 主力5日集中度：+{r[6]}% (1日:+{r[5]}% | 20日:+{r[7]}%)\n"
                f"   ├─ 🛡️ 歷史20MA勝率：{r[8]}% (期望值: {sign_ret}{r[9]}%)\n"
                f"   └─ ⚡ 系統最適建議：【{r[10]}】\n"
            )
        post += (
            f"\n────────────────────────\n"
            f"💬 【戰情室互動】這 5 檔大戶重押股中，你目前持有或看好哪一檔？\n"
            f"👉 留言【股票代號】，幫你即時測出它的「5MA/20MA 最佳離場勝率」！🚀\n"
        )
        return post
    except Exception as e:
        return f"⚠️ 籌碼草稿生成提醒: {e}"

# ==========================================
# 👑 草稿二：【財報業績王者】半年賺贏去年整年榜
# ==========================================
def generate_post_eps(cursor):
    try:
        sql = """
        SELECT TOP 5
            Cur.代號, Cur.名稱, ISNULL(P.成交價, 0) AS 現價, ISNULL(C.總量, 0) AS 總量,
            Cur.當季單季EPS, Cur.EPS累計 AS 今年累計EPS, YoY.EPS累計 AS 去年全年總EPS,
            ROUND((Cur.EPS累計 - YoY.EPS累計) / NULLIF(ABS(YoY.EPS累計), 0) * 100.0, 1) AS [超越去年全年%],
            Cur.毛利率, ROUND(Cur.毛利率 - Cur.毛利率上季, 2) AS [毛利季增%],
            Cur.營業利益率, ROUND(Cur.營業利益率 - Cur.營業利益率上季, 2) AS [營益季增%],
            ISNULL(M.具體概念, N'AI與產業龍頭') AS 概念
        FROM (
            SELECT 代號, 名稱, 日期, EPS累計, 毛利率, 毛利率上季, 營業利益率, 營業利益率上季,
                   CASE WHEN RIGHT(日期, 2) = '01' THEN EPS累計 ELSE EPS累計 - LAG(EPS累計, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) END AS 當季單季EPS,
                   CAST(LEFT(日期, 4) AS INT) AS 報告年份,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
        ) Cur
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, CAST(LEFT(日期, 4) AS INT) AS 年份, EPS累計
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum WHERE RIGHT(日期, 2) = '04'
        ) YoY ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(YoY.代號) AND YoY.年份 = (Cur.報告年份 - 1)
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, 成交價, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live
        ) P ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(P.代號) AND P.rn = 1
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, 總量, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.Chips5
        ) C ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(C.代號) AND C.rn = 1
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, 具體概念, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis
        ) M ON RTRIM(Cur.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND M.rn = 1
        WHERE Cur.rn = 1 AND Cur.EPS累計 > YoY.EPS累計 AND YoY.EPS累計 > 0 AND Cur.毛利率 > Cur.毛利率上季
        ORDER BY [超越去年全年%] DESC, Cur.EPS累計 DESC;
        """
        cursor.execute(sql)
        rows = cursor.fetchall()
        if not rows: return "⚠️ 目前暫無符合【半年賺贏去年 ✕ 本業毛利季增】之股票。"

        post = (
            f"👑 【財報大震撼】才過半年，這 5 家公司已經把「去年一整年的錢」賺完了！\n"
            f"📅 最新公布財報盤點 ({today_str})\n"
            f"💡 白紙黑字硬實力！下半年賺的全部是額外超額利潤，法人目標價重估空間大開！\n"
            f"────────────────────────\n"
            f"🏆 【半年賺贏去年 ✕ 本業毛利雙升】全能王者 Top 5：\n\n"
        )
        for idx, r in enumerate(rows, 1):
            post += (
                f"{idx}. 🚀 {r[0]} {r[1]} (現價:{r[2]}元 | 量:{r[3]:,}張) - 【{r[11]}】\n"
                f"   ├─ 📊 H1累計EPS：{r[5]} 元 (已超越去年全年 {r[6]} 元，超額 +{r[7]}%)\n"
                f"   ├─ 📈 Q2單季獲利：{r[4]} 元\n"
                f"   └─ 🔥 毛利率季增：+{r[9]}% (最新毛利率達 {r[8]}% | 營益率季增 +{r[10]}%)\n"
            )
        post += (
            f"\n────────────────────────\n"
            f"💬 【戰情室互動】業績硬實力就是股價最強靠山！你最看好哪一檔走出翻倍主升段？\n"
            f"👇 歡迎在下方留言交流你的看法！\n"
        )
        return post
    except Exception as e:
        return f"⚠️ 財報草稿生成提醒: {e}"

# ==========================================
# 🚀 草稿三：【營收動能王者】單月創歷史新高 ✕ 雙增榜
# ==========================================
def generate_post_revenue(cursor):
    try:
        sql = """
        SELECT TOP 5
            I.代號, I.名稱, ISNULL(C.成交價, 0) AS 現價, ISNULL(C.漲幅, 0) AS 漲幅, ISNULL(C.總量, 0) AS 總量,
            I.最新營收月份, I.年成長, I.月變動, I.單月營收億, I.歷史最高營收億,
            ISNULL(M.具體概念, N'AI供應鏈焦點') AS 概念
        FROM (
            SELECT 代號, 名稱, 日期 AS 最新營收月份, 年成長, 月變動, 單月營收億,
                   MAX(單月營收億) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號) AS 歷史最高營收億,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.incomesum
        ) I
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, 成交價, 漲幅, 總量, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.Chips5
        ) C ON RTRIM(I.代號) = RTRIM(C.代號) AND C.rn = 1
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, 具體概念, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis
        ) M ON RTRIM(I.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND M.rn = 1
        WHERE I.rn = 1 AND ISNULL(C.總量, 0) >= 1000 AND I.年成長 >= 20.0 AND I.月變動 > 0
        ORDER BY (CASE WHEN I.單月營收億 >= I.歷史最高營收億 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, I.年成長 DESC;
        """
        cursor.execute(sql)
        rows = cursor.fetchall()
        if not rows: return "⚠️ 目前暫無符合【營收年增 >= 20% ✕ 月增 > 0】之股票。"

        post = (
            f"🚀 【營收動能雷達】訂單大爆滿！單月營收創歷史新高 ✕ 雙增強勢股！\n"
            f"📅 營收結算日期：{today_str}\n"
            f"💡 營收是獲利的先行指標！月增(MoM) ✕ 年增(YoY) 雙成長代表不是單月偶發，而是實質出貨放量！\n"
            f"────────────────────────\n"
            f"🌟 最新【營收月增 ✕ 年增雙暴衝】焦點龍頭：\n\n"
        )
        for idx, r in enumerate(rows, 1):
            is_all_time_high = " 🌟【單月營收創歷史新高！】" if r[8] >= r[9] and r[8] > 0 else ""
            post += (
                f"{idx}. 🔥 {r[0]} {r[1]} (現價:{r[2]}元 | 漲幅:{r[3]}% | 量:{r[4]:,}張){is_all_time_high}\n"
                f"   ├─ 📈 營收年增率 (YoY)：+{r[6]}%\n"
                f"   ├─ ⚡ 營收月增率 (MoM)：+{r[7]}%\n"
                f"   ├─ 💰 單月營收規模：{r[8]} 億元\n"
                f"   └─ 🎯 核心題材：【{r[10]}】\n"
            )
        post += (
            f"\n────────────────────────\n"
            f"💬 【戰情室互動】業績暴衝股往往是下一波領頭羊！\n"
            f"👉 點讚分享，留言【+1】領取完整「營收創高 ✕ 本益比未反映」潛伏清單！\n"
        )
        return post
    except Exception as e:
        return f"⚠️ 營收草稿生成提醒: {e}"

# ==========================================
# 🔥 草稿四：【暴漲龍頭 ✕ 股性勝率PK】波段抱緊 vs 短打快閃
# ==========================================
def generate_post_backtest(cursor):
    try:
        sql = "EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_Get_TopSurge_Backtest 5, 3000, 10.0, 5;"
        cursor.execute(sql)
        rows = cursor.fetchall()
        if not rows: return "⚠️ 今日暫無符合【總量 >= 3000張】之近5日暴漲股。"

        post = (
            f"📊 【量化股性實測】同族群強勢飆股，操盤策略完全相反？！\n"
            f"📅 統計日期：{today_str} 盤後\n"
            f"💡 追高常被洗出場？因為你用「抱波段」的方式去操作「短打體質」的股票！\n"
            f"────────────────────────\n"
            f"🎯 近 5 日全市場最強飆股 ✕ 歷史離場勝率 PK：\n\n"
        )
        for idx, r in enumerate(rows, 1):
            post += (
                f"{idx}. 👑 {r[0]} {r[1]} (現價:{r[2]}元 | 近5日:+{r[4]}% | 總量:{r[3]:,}張)\n"
                f"   ├─ ⏱️ 任兩日(T+2)短打：勝率 {r[6]}% (期望值: {'+' if r[7]>=0 else ''}{r[7]}%)\n"
                f"   ├─ 🚀 五日(T+5)週波段：勝率 {r[8]}% (期望值: {'+' if r[9]>=0 else ''}{r[9]}%)\n"
                f"   ├─ 🔥 跌破20MA波段防守：勝率 {r[14]}% (期望值: {'+' if r[15]>=0 else ''}{r[15]}%)\n"
                f"   └─ 🎯 系統最適戰術評定：【{r[16]}】\n"
            )
        post += (
            f"\n────────────────────────\n"
            f"💡 【操盤指揮官心法】市場永遠是對的！順應趨勢，依據大數據勝率嚴守離場紀律！\n"
            f"💬 你手上持有的個股適合抱長還是短打？留言代號幫你測！👇\n"
        )
        return post
    except Exception as e:
        return f"⚠️ 暴漲回測草稿生成提醒: {e}"

# ==========================================
# ⚡ 草稿五：【60M 伏兵轉強】短線當沖/隔日沖起漲點 (已修正成交價關聯)
# ==========================================
def generate_post_60m(cursor):
    try:
        # 🟢 修正：透過 allcross_live 正確關聯現價
        sql = """
        SELECT TOP 5
            R.代號, R.名稱, R.分組, R.策略靈魂, ISNULL(P.成交價, 0) AS 現價,
            ROUND(R.[60M動能(OSC)], 2) AS [60M_OSC], ROUND(R.[60M_K值], 1) AS [60M_K],
            R.日線分, R.短線氣象
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar R
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, 成交價, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live
        ) P ON RTRIM(R.代號) = RTRIM(P.代號) AND P.rn = 1
        WHERE R.[短線氣象] LIKE N'%轉強%' OR R.[60M動能(OSC)] > 5.0
        ORDER BY R.[60M動能(OSC)] DESC, R.日線分 DESC;
        """
        cursor.execute(sql)
        rows = cursor.fetchall()
        if not rows: return "⚠️ 目前暫無 60M 轉強之伏兵標的。"

        post = (
            f"⚡ 【60M 伏兵轉強雷達】短線動能翻正！當沖與隔日沖起漲觀察名單\n"
            f"📅 掃描時間：{today_str}\n"
            f"💡 日線決定方向，60分K決定最佳買點！OSC 負收斂翻正 ✕ K值超賣金叉，就是短線發動的第一槍！\n"
            f"────────────────────────\n"
            f"☀️ 最新【60M 動能急劇轉強】精銳前 5 名：\n\n"
        )
        for idx, r in enumerate(rows, 1):
            post += (
                f"{idx}. 🌟 {r[0]} {r[1]} (現價:{r[4]}元 | 分組:{r[2]})\n"
                f"   ├─ ⚡ 60M動能 OSC：+{r[5]} (60M K值: {r[6]})\n"
                f"   ├─ ☀️ 短線氣象：【{r[8]}】 | 日線總分: +{r[7]}分\n"
                f"   └─ 🎯 核心題材：【{r[3]}】\n"
            )
        post += (
            f"\n────────────────────────\n"
            f"🛡️ 【防守紀律】短線操作嚴守 5MA 防守線，跌破即刻落袋不戀戰！\n"
            f"👇 點讚支持，天天為你鎖定最強盤勢伏兵！\n"
        )
        return post
    except Exception as e:
        return f"⚠️ 60M 草稿生成提醒: {e}"

# ==========================================
# 🚀 主生成流程
# ==========================================
def main():
    print("=" * 65)
    print(f"📡 【Zen AI 股票戰情室：每日 5 大社群爆款草稿生成器 V1.1】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 當前日期: {today_str}")
    print("=" * 65)

    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()

            p1 = generate_post_chips(cursor)
            p2 = generate_post_eps(cursor)
            p3 = generate_post_revenue(cursor)
            p4 = generate_post_backtest(cursor)
            p5 = generate_post_60m(cursor)

            all_posts = (
                f"======================================================================\n"
                f"📢 【Zen AI 股票戰情室】每日精選 5 大社群貼文草稿庫 ({today_str})\n"
                f"👉 每天挑選 1 ~ 2 篇複製貼上至 Facebook 社團 / Telegram 即可！\n"
                f"======================================================================\n\n"
                f"【草稿 1：🕵️ 主力籌碼大戶鎖碼榜】\n{'-'*50}\n{p1}\n\n"
                f"【草稿 2：👑 財報業績王者 (半年賺贏去年)】\n{'-'*50}\n{p2}\n\n"
                f"【草稿 3：🚀 單月營收創歷史新高 ✕ 雙增王】\n{'-'*50}\n{p3}\n\n"
                f"【草稿 4：🔥 暴漲龍頭 ✕ 股性勝率PK (波段 vs 快閃)】\n{'-'*50}\n{p4}\n\n"
                f"【草稿 5：⚡ 60M 伏兵轉強 ✕ 短線起漲點】\n{'-'*50}\n{p5}\n"
            )

            # 寫入文字檔
            with open(OUTPUT_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(all_posts)

            # 印出終端機
            print(all_posts)
            print("=" * 65)
            print(f"🎉 5 大社群草稿已成功生成並存入：{OUTPUT_FILE}")
            print(f"👉 您可隨時打開該檔案，挑選喜歡的 1~2 篇一鍵複製發布！")
            print("=" * 65)

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 主流程連線失敗: {e}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🔍【Zen AI 系統：全目錄 Python 腳本自動掃描與功能解析器】

import os
import sys
import glob
import re
import datetime

# 強制 UTF-8 輸出
if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
if sys.stderr and hasattr(sys.stderr, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

TARGET_DIR = r"C:\test_c"
OUTPUT_MD = r"C:\test_c\ALL_PYTHON_SCRIPTS_MANUAL.md"

def analyze_script(file_path):
    filename = os.path.basename(file_path)
    file_size_kb = round(os.path.getsize(file_path) / 1024, 1)
    mod_time = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(os.path.getmtime(file_path)).strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')

    docstring = ""
    db_tables = set()
    features = []
    main_funcs = []

    try:
        with open(file_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
            lines = f.readlines()

        content = "".join(lines)

        # 1. 抓取頂部註解或 Docstring
        comments = []
        for line in lines[:25]:
            line_str = line.strip()
            if line_str.startswith('#'):
                clean_c = line_str.lstrip('#- =*').strip()
                if clean_c and not clean_c.startswith('coding') and not clean_c.startswith('!/'):
                    comments.append(clean_c)
            elif '"""' in line_str or "'''" in line_str:
                comments.append(line_str.replace('"""', '').replace("'''", '').strip())

        docstring = " | ".join(comments[:4]) if comments else "無描述註解"

        # 2. 辨識資料庫與資料表
        dbs = re.findall(r'(stockchangedate|stockchange|fromaccessdatabase)', content, re.IGNORECASE)
        tables = re.findall(r'(Chips5|financesum1|financesum|incomesum|allcross_live|MasterStockAnalysis|View_AI_Elite_Radar|ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot|StockPersonality_3Exits|Stock60M|basicinfo)', content, re.IGNORECASE)
        for t in tables:
            db_tables.add(t)

        # 3. 辨識外部服務與推播
        if 'telegram' in content.lower() or 'tg_token' in content.lower():
            features.append("📱 Telegram推播")
        if 'facebook' in content.lower() or 'fb_group' in content.lower():
            features.append("🌐 FB社團發文")
        if 'discord' in content.lower():
            features.append("🎮 Discord通知")
        if 'line' in content.lower() and 'token' in content.lower():
            features.append("💬 LINE通知")
        if 'playwright' in content.lower():
            features.append("📸 瀏覽器截圖/RPA")
        if 'openrouter' in content.lower():
            features.append("🧠 OpenRouter大模型")
        elif 'ollama' in content.lower():
            features.append("🤖 Ollama本地AI")
        if 'schtasks' in content.lower() or 'settimer' in content.lower():
            features.append("⏰ 排程相關")

        # 4. 抓取核心函式
        funcs = re.findall(r'def\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\s*\(', content)
        main_funcs = [fn for fn in funcs if not fn.startswith('_')][:5]

    except Exception as e:
        docstring = f"讀取錯誤: {e}"

    return {
        "filename": filename,
        "size": f"{file_size_kb} KB",
        "mod_time": mod_time,
        "doc": docstring,
        "features": "、".join(features) if features else "純數據/運算",
        "tables": ", ".join(list(db_tables)[:6]) if db_tables else "無直接資料庫操作",
        "funcs": ", ".join(main_funcs) if main_funcs else "無"
    }

def main():
    print("=" * 70)
    print(f"🔍 正在全面盤點 {TARGET_DIR} 目錄下所有的 Python 腳本 (*.py)...")
    print("=" * 70)

    py_files = glob.glob(os.path.join(TARGET_DIR, "*.py"))
    if not py_files:
        print(f"⚠️ 在 {TARGET_DIR} 未找到任何 .py 檔案。")
        return

    results = []
    for f in sorted(py_files):
        info = analyze_script(f)
        results.append(info)

    # 產出 Markdown 報表
    now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')
    md_content = f"# 📁 Zen AI 系統：`C:\\test_c\\` Python 腳本全景清冊備忘錄\n\n"
    md_content += f"> 🕒 掃描盤點時間：`{now_str}`  \n"
    md_content += f"> 📊 共盤點到 {len(results)} 支 Python 腳本\n\n"
    md_content += "---\n\n"
    md_content += "## 📋 快速檢索總覽表\n\n"
    md_content += "| 序號 | 檔案名稱 | 檔案大小 | 最後修改時間 | 主要功能標籤 | 核心描述摘要 |\n"
    md_content += "| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- |\n"

    for idx, r in enumerate(results, 1):
        md_content += f"| {idx} | `{r['filename']}` | {r['size']} | {r['mod_time']} | `{r['features']}` | {r['doc'][:45]} |\n"

    md_content += "\n---\n\n"
    md_content += "## 🛠️ 各腳本詳細技術細節卡片\n\n"

    for idx, r in enumerate(results, 1):
        md_content += f"### {idx}. 📄 `{r['filename']}`\n"
        md_content += f"- 📝 頂部功能描述：{r['doc']}\n"
        md_content += f"- ⚙️ 技術與外部特性：{r['features']}\n"
        md_content += f"- 🗄️ 涉及資料庫/資料表：`{r['tables']}`\n"
        md_content += f"- 🧩 核心主要函式：`{r['funcs']}`\n"
        md_content += f"- 📏 檔案大小與修改時間：{r['size']}（修改於 {r['mod_time']}）\n\n"

    with open(OUTPUT_MD, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(md_content)

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(f"🎉 盤點完成！共解析 {len(results)} 支腳本。")
    print(f"📄 完整清冊已自動儲存至：{OUTPUT_MD}")
    print("=" * 70 + "\n")

    # 在終端機簡要印出清單
    for idx, r in enumerate(results, 1):
        print(f"[{idx}] {r['filename']:<26} │ {r['features']:<22} │ {r['doc'][:35]}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

POC（Point of Control / 最大量防守點）：當天成交張數最多的價位，代表主力大戶與市場共識最集中的位置。 2. 支撐與壓力定錨： * 現價在最大量區 之上 ➔ 該價位形成 「強力下檔支撐防線」。 * 現價在最大量區 之下 ➔ 該價位形成 「上檔解套賣壓區」。 --- ### 🛠️ 完整 Python 抓取腳本：`fetch_yahoo_price_volume.py` 此腳本會自動判斷股票是 上市（`.TW`） 還是 上櫃（`.TWO`），自動向 Yahoo Finance 抓取當日完整價量分布，並計算出 各價位成交張數、成交佔比 %、以及標註 ⭐ 最大量 POC 防守點！ 請在 `C:\test_c` 下新增並執行 `fetch_yahoo_price_volume.py`：
python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI 台股上市/上櫃 分價量表 (Volume Profile) 即時抓取器】
# 支援台股所有上市 (.TW) 與上櫃 (.TWO) 股票

import os
import sys

# 強制 UTF-8 輸出
if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

import requests
import pandas as pd
import json

def get_yahoo_price_volume(stock_code):
    """
    從 Yahoo Finance 自動抓取指定上市/上櫃個股的當日分價量數據
    """
    clean_code = str(stock_code).strip()
    headers = {
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
    }

    # 自動嘗試 上市 (.TW) 與 上櫃 (.TWO) 雙後綴
    symbols_to_try = [f"{clean_code}.TW", f"{clean_code}.TWO", clean_code]
    target_data = None
    matched_symbol = ""

    for sym in symbols_to_try:
        url = f"https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/{sym}?interval=1m&range=1d"
        try:
            r = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                res_json = r.json()
                if "chart" in res_json and res_json["chart"]["result"]:
                    target_data = res_json["chart"]["result"][0]
                    matched_symbol = sym
                    break
        except Exception:
            continue

    if not target_data or "indicators" not in target_data:
        print(f"❌ 查無 [{clean_code}] 的即時價量數據，請確認代號是否正確。")
        return None

    meta = target_data.get("meta", {})
    current_price = meta.get("regularMarketPrice", 0)
    stock_name = meta.get("shortName", clean_code)
    exchange = "上市 (TWSE)" if ".TW" in matched_symbol else ("上櫃 (TPEx)" if ".TWO" in matched_symbol else "台股")

    quote = target_data["indicators"]["quote"][0]
    closes = quote.get("close", [])
    volumes = quote.get("volume", [])

    # 聚合計算各價格的成交量 (Volume by Price)
    price_vol_map = {}
    for p, v in zip(closes, volumes):
        if p is not None and v is not None and v > 0:
            price = round(float(p), 2)
            # Yahoo 分鐘成交量換算為張數 (股數 / 1000)
            lots = int(v / 1000) if v >= 1000 else round(v / 1000, 1)
            price_vol_map[price] = price_vol_map.get(price, 0) + lots

    if not price_vol_map:
        print(f"⚠️ [{clean_code}] 今日無成交量或尚未開盤。")
        return None

    # 轉換成 DataFrame
    df = pd.DataFrame(list(price_vol_map.items()), columns=["成交價", "成交張數"])
    df = df.sort_values(by="成交價", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)

    total_lots = df["成交張數"].sum()
    df["成交佔比%"] = (df["成交張數"] / total_lots * 100).round(2)
    df["累計佔比%"] = df["成交佔比%"].cumsum().round(2)

    # 找出最大成交量價位 (POC, Point of Control)
    max_vol = df["成交張數"].max()
    poc_price = df.loc[df["成交張數"] == max_vol, "成交價"].values[0]

    # 標記訊號
    df["籌碼防守標籤"] = ""
    for idx, row in df.iterrows():
        p = row["成交價"]
        v = row["成交張數"]
        ratio = row["成交佔比%"]

        if p == poc_price:
            df.at[idx, "籌碼防守標籤"] = "👑 POC 最大量主力成本區"
        elif ratio >= 10.0:
            df.at[idx, "籌碼防守標籤"] = "⭐ 爆量換手聚集區"
        elif p == current_price:
            df.at[idx, "籌碼防守標籤"] = "📍 目前收盤現價"

    print("=" * 70)
    print(f"📊 【{clean_code} {stock_name}】分價量統計表 (Volume Profile)")
    print(f"🏛️ 市場別: {exchange} │ 📍 現價: {current_price} 元 │ 總成交量: {int(total_lots):,} 張")
    print(f"🎯 主力最大量 POC 防守價位: 【{poc_price} 元】 (佔比: {df.loc[df['成交價']==poc_price, '成交佔比%'].values[0]}%)")
    print("=" * 70)

    # 格式化輸出表格

-- 查詢 2330 台積電 近 20 個交易日的「累積月分價量表 ✕ 20日最大量 POC」
WITH Recent20Days AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT TOP 20 日期 
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPriceVolume 
    WHERE 代號 = '2330' 
    ORDER BY 日期 DESC
)
SELECT 
    成交價,
    SUM(成交張數) AS [20日累計成交量(張)],
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(成交張數) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT SUM(成交張數) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPriceVolume WHERE 代號 = '2330' AND 日期 IN (SELECT 日期 FROM Recent20Days)) * 100.0, 2) AS [20日成交佔比%],
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(成交張數) = MAX(SUM(成交張數)) OVER() THEN N'👑 20日最大量 POC 主力大底防守線'
        ELSE N''
    END AS 籌碼防線標籤
FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPriceVolume
WHERE 代號 = '2330' 
  AND 日期 IN (SELECT 日期 FROM Recent20Days)
GROUP BY 成交價
ORDER BY 成交價 DESC;

python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI 股票戰情室：近 20 天歷史分價量表 (Volume Profile) 批次回補工具】

import os
import sys

# 強制 UTF-8 輸出
if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
if sys.stderr and hasattr(sys.stderr, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

import time
import datetime
import requests
import pyodbc
import pandas as pd

SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchangedate"
CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={{SQL Server}};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'

HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
}

def get_target_stock_list():
    """從 View_AI_Elite_Radar 抓取需要回補的股票清單"""
    stocks = []
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute("SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(代號), RTRIM(名稱) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar WHERE 代號 IS NOT NULL;")
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            for r in rows:
                stocks.append((str(r[0]).strip(), str(r[1]).strip() if r[1] else str(r[0]).strip()))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 讀取清單失敗，改用預設核心名單: {e}")
        stocks = [("2330", "台積電"), ("2454", "聯發科"), ("2317", "鴻海"), ("2382", "廣達"), ("3017", "奇鋐"), ("3324", "雙鴻"), ("3450", "聯鈞"), ("8299", "群聯"), ("3653", "健策")]
    return stocks

def fetch_and_save_stock_20d_pv(stock_code, stock_name, conn):
    """抓取單檔股票近 1 個月的價量數據並寫入 StockPriceVolume 表"""
    clean_code = str(stock_code).strip()
    symbols_to_try = [f"{clean_code}.TW", f"{clean_code}.TWO"]
    target_data = None

    for sym in symbols_to_try:
        # 使用 5 分鐘線、範圍 1 個月 (覆蓋過去 20 個交易日)
        url = f"https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/{sym}?interval=5m&range=1mo"
        try:
            r = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=12)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                res_json = r.json()
                if "chart" in res_json and res_json["chart"]["result"]:
                    target_data = res_json["chart"]["result"][0]
                    break
        except Exception:
            continue

    if not target_data or "timestamp" not in target_data or "indicators" not in target_data:
        return 0

    timestamps = target_data["timestamp"]
    quote = target_data["indicators"]["quote"][0]
    closes = quote.get("close", [])
    volumes = quote.get("volume", [])

    # 建立暫存列表 (日期, 價格, 張數)
    records = []
    for ts, p, v in zip(timestamps, closes, volumes):
        if ts is not None and p is not None and v is not None and v > 0:
            # 轉換為台灣時間 YYYYMMDD
            dt = datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(ts) + datetime.timedelta(hours=8)
            date_int = int(dt.strftime("%Y%m%d"))
            price = round(float(p), 2)
            lots = int(v / 1000) if v >= 1000 else 1
            if lots > 0:
                records.append((date_int, price, lots))

    if not records:
        return 0

    df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=["日期", "成交價", "成交張數"])
    # 依 (日期, 成交價) 聚合加總成交張數
    daily_pv = df.groupby(["日期", "成交價"])["成交張數"].sum().reset_index()

    # 計算當日各價位成交佔比
    daily_total = daily_pv.groupby("日期")["成交張數"].transform("sum")
    daily_pv["成交佔比"] = (daily_pv["成交張數"] / daily_total * 100).round(2)

    # 批次寫入 SQL Server (使用 MERGE 防重複)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    merge_sql = """
    MERGE INTO stockchangedate.dbo.StockPriceVolume AS Target
    USING (VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)) AS Source (代號, 日期, 成交價, 成交張數, 成交佔比)
    ON (Target.代號 = Source.代號 AND Target.日期 = Source.日期 AND Target.成交價 = Source.成交價)
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET Target.成交張數 = Source.成交張數, Target.成交佔比 = Source.成交佔比, Target.建立時間 = GETDATE()
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (代號, 日期, 成交價, 成交張數, 成交佔比, 建立時間)
        VALUES (Source.代號, Source.日期, Source.成交價, Source.成交張數, Source.成交佔比, GETDATE());
    """

    params_list = []
    for _, row in daily_pv.iterrows():
        params_list.append((clean_code, int(row["日期"]), float(row["成交價"]), int(row["成交張數"]), float(row["成交佔比"])))

    cursor.executemany(merge_sql, params_list)
    conn.commit()
    return len(params_list)

def main():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("🚀 【Zen AI 股票戰情室：近 20 天歷史分價量表 批次回補啟動】")
    print(f"⏰ 執行時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print("=" * 70)

    stocks = get_target_stock_list()
    print(f"📋 共取得 {len(stocks)} 檔 AI 核心精銳標的，開始批次寫入資料庫...")

    total_inserted = 0
    with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=20) as conn:
        for idx, (code, name) in enumerate(stocks, 1):
            count = fetch_and_save_stock_20d_pv(code, name, conn)
            total_inserted += count
            status = f"✅ 回補 {count} 筆" if count > 0 else "⚠️ 無數據/跳過"
            print(f"[{idx:>3}/{len(stocks)}] {code:<6} {name:<8} ➔ {status}")
            time.sleep(0.3) # 避免 API 頻率限制

    print("=" * 70)
    print(f"🎉 歷史回補大功告成！累計成功寫入 {total_inserted:,} 筆分價量資料至 StockPriceVolume 表！")
    print("=" * 70)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
--- ### 步驟 3：在 `excelsql2.html` 中查詢「近 20 天累積分價量 ✕ POC 大底防守線」 回補完成後，直接在 `excelsql2.html` 貼入以下語法（已省略開頭 `SELECT`），即可 0 毫秒極速產出近 20 天的主力大底籌碼峰：
sql
TOP 50
    V.代號,
    V.成交價 AS [價位],
    V.累計20日成交量 AS [20日累計成交量(張)],
    V.[20日成交佔比%],
    V.[20日累計佔比%],
    -- 🟢 自動標註 20 日主力 POC 大底與密集換手區
    CASE 
        WHEN V.累計20日成交量 = V.最大量 THEN N'👑👑 20日最大量 POC 主力大底成本線'
        WHEN V.[20日成交佔比%] >= 12.0 THEN N'⭐⭐ 20日大量換手聚集區'
        WHEN V.成交價 = P.現價 THEN N'📍 目前收盤現價'
        ELSE N''
    END AS [20日籌碼防守標籤]
FROM (
    SELECT 
        PV.代號,
        PV.成交價,
        SUM(PV.成交張數) AS 累計20日成交量,
        ROUND(CAST(SUM(PV.成交張數) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(PV.成交張數)) OVER(PARTITION BY PV.代號), 0) * 100.0, 2) AS [20日成交佔比%],
        ROUND(SUM(CAST(SUM(PV.成交張數) AS FLOAT)) OVER(PARTITION BY PV.代號 ORDER BY PV.成交價 DESC) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(PV.成交張數)) OVER(PARTITION BY PV.代號), 0) * 100.0, 2) AS [20日累計佔比%],
        MAX(SUM(PV.成交張數)) OVER(PARTITION BY PV.代號) AS 最大量
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPriceVolume PV
    WHERE PV.代號 = '2330' -- 🟢 可隨時更換股票代號 (如 2330, 2454, 3017, 3450)
      AND PV.日期 IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT TOP 20 日期 
          FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPriceVolume 
          WHERE 代號 = '2330' 
          ORDER BY 日期 DESC
      )
    GROUP BY PV.代號, PV.成交價
) V
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT TOP 1 代號, 成交價 AS 現價 
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live 
    WHERE 代號 = '2330' 
    ORDER BY 日期 DESC
) P ON 1=1
ORDER BY V.成交價 DESC;

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI 雙軌分價量表建檔器：TPEx 官方全上櫃 ✕ Yahoo 上市精準補齊】
# 每天盤後自動將全市場分價量寫入 stockchangedate.dbo.StockPriceVolume

import os
import sys

# 強制 UTF-8 輸出
if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
if sys.stderr and hasattr(sys.stderr, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

import time
import datetime
import requests
import pyodbc
import pandas as pd

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【1. 設定區】
# ==========================================
SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchangedate"
CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={{SQL Server}};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'

HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
}

# ==========================================
# 🏛️【軌道一：TPEx 官方 API 一秒抓取全上櫃分價量】
# ==========================================
def sync_tpex_otc_volume_profile(target_date_str, conn):
    """
    從證券櫃檯買賣中心 (TPEx) 官方抓取當日所有上櫃股票的等價成交分價表
    target_date_str: 格式 YYYYMMDD (例如: 20260903)
    """
    print("🏛️ [1/2] 正在向 TPEx 櫃買中心下載全上櫃成交分價表...")
    dt = datetime.datetime.strptime(target_date_str, "%Y%m%d")
    roc_year = dt.year - 1911
    roc_date_str = f"{roc_year}/{dt.strftime('%m/%d')}" # 轉為民國年 115/09/03

    # TPEx 官方分價表 API 端點
    url = f"https://www.tpex.org.tw/web/stock/aftertrading/pricing/pricing_result.php?l=zh-tw&d={roc_date_str}&s=0,asc,0&o=json"

    try:
        r = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=20)
        if r.status_code != 200:
            print(f"⚠️ TPEx 伺服器回應狀態碼: {r.status_code}")
            return 0

        res_json = r.json()
        data_rows = res_json.get("aaData", [])
        if not data_rows:
            print("⚠️ 今日 TPEx 尚未產出分價表 (通常於 13:45 ~ 14:00 公布) 或今日非交易日。")
            return 0

        # 解析資料：[代號, 名稱, 成交價, 價格註記, 成交張數]
        records = []
        for row in data_rows:
            if len(row) >= 5:
                code = str(row[0]).strip()
                price_str = str(row[2]).replace(",", "").strip()
                volume_str = str(row[4]).replace(",", "").strip()

                try:
                    price = round(float(price_str), 2)
                    volume = int(float(volume_str))
                    if volume > 0 and price > 0:
                        records.append((code, int(target_date_str), price, volume))
                except Exception:
                    continue

        if not records:
            return 0

        df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=["代號", "日期", "成交價", "成交張數"])
        # 計算各股票內部的當日成交佔比 %
        stock_totals = df.groupby("代號")["成交張數"].transform("sum")
        df["成交佔比"] = (df["成交張數"] / stock_totals * 100).round(2)

        # 批次 MERGE 寫入 SQL Server
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        merge_sql = """
        MERGE INTO stockchangedate.dbo.StockPriceVolume AS Target
        USING (VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)) AS Source (代號, 日期, 成交價, 成交張數, 成交佔比)
        ON (Target.代號 = Source.代號 AND Target.日期 = Source.日期 AND Target.成交價 = Source.成交價)
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET Target.成交張數 = Source.成交張數, Target.成交佔比 = Source.成交佔比, Target.建立時間 = GETDATE()
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT (代號, 日期, 成交價, 成交張數, 成交佔比, 建立時間)
            VALUES (Source.代號, Source.日期, Source.成交價, Source.成交張數, Source.成交佔比, GETDATE());
        """

        params_list = []
        for _, r in df.iterrows():
            params_list.append((str(r["代號"]), int(r["日期"]), float(r["成交價"]), int(r["成交張數"]), float(r["成交佔比"])))

        cursor.executemany(merge_sql, params_list)
        conn.commit()

        stock_count = df["代號"].nunique()
        print(f"✅ TPEx 官方全上櫃匯入成功！共處理 {stock_count} 檔上櫃股票，寫入 {len(params_list):,} 筆分價量！")
        return len(params_list)

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ TPEx 上櫃分價量抓取異常: {e}")
        return 0

# ==========================================
# 🚀【軌道二：Yahoo Finance 抓取上市股票 (.TW)】
# ==========================================
def sync_yahoo_twse_volume_profile(target_date_str, conn):
    """
    從 basicinfo 篩選上市股票 (上市1)，透過 Yahoo API 精準補齊上市分價量
    """
    print("\n🚀 [2/2] 正在透過 Yahoo Finance 補齊上市 (TWSE) 股票分價量...")

    # 抓取上市股票清單 (從 basicinfo 抓取總量 >= 1000 張或自選名單)
    listed_stocks = []
    try:
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        sql = """
        SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(B.代號), RTRIM(B.名稱)
        FROM stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B
        WHERE (B.上市1上櫃2 = 1 OR B.交易所分類 LIKE '%上市%')
          AND B.總量 >= 500
          AND B.成交價 >= 10.0;
        """
        cursor.execute(sql)
        for r in cursor.fetchall():
            listed_stocks.append((str(r[0]).strip(), str(r[1]).strip() if r[1] else str(r[0]).strip()))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 讀取上市清單改用預設核心名單: {e}")
        listed_stocks = [("2330", "台積電"), ("2317", "鴻海"), ("2454", "聯發科"), ("2382", "廣達"), ("3017", "奇鋐"), ("3324", "雙鴻"), ("3450", "聯鈞"), ("3653", "健策"), ("2489", "瑞軒"), ("2426", "鼎元")]

    print(f"📋 共篩選出 {len(listed_stocks)} 檔上市活躍標的，開始下載價量...")

    total_inserted = 0
    merge_sql = """
    MERGE INTO stockchangedate.dbo.StockPriceVolume AS Target
    USING (VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)) AS Source (代號, 日期, 成交價, 成交張數, 成交佔比)
    ON (Target.代號 = Source.代號 AND Target.日期 = Source.日期 AND Target.成交價 = Source.成交價)
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET Target.成交張數 = Source.成交張數, Target.成交佔比 = Source.成交佔比, Target.建立時間 = GETDATE()
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (代號, 日期, 成交價, 成交張數, 成交佔比, 建立時間)
        VALUES (Source.代號, Source.日期, Source.成交價, Source.成交張數, Source.成交佔比, GETDATE());
    """

    cursor = conn.cursor()
    for idx, (code, name) in enumerate(listed_stocks, 1):
        url = f"https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/{code}.TW?interval=1m&range=1d"
        try:
            r = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=10)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                res_json = r.json()
                if "chart" in res_json and res_json["chart"]["result"]:
                    quote = res_json["chart"]["result"][0]["indicators"]["quote"][0]
                    closes = quote.get("close", [])
                    volumes = quote.get("volume", [])

                    pv_map = {}
                    for p, v in zip(closes, volumes):
                        if p is not None and v is not None and v > 0:
                            price = round(float(p), 2)
                            lots = int(v / 1000) if v >= 1000 else 1
                            pv_map[price] = pv_map.get(price, 0) + lots

                    if pv_map:
                        tot = sum(pv_map.values())
                        params = []
                        for pr, vol in pv_map.items():
                            ratio = round(vol / tot * 100.0, 2)
                            params.append((code, int(target_date_str), pr, vol, ratio))

                        cursor.executemany(merge_sql, params)
                        conn.commit()
                        total_inserted += len(params)
        except Exception:
            pass

        if idx % 20 == 0 or idx == len(listed_stocks):
            print(f"  └─ 進度: [{idx}/{len(listed_stocks)}] 已處理...")
        time.sleep(0.15) # 輕微延遲避免 API 頻率限制

    print(f"✅ Yahoo 上市股票處理完畢！累計寫入 {total_inserted:,} 筆上市分價量！")
    return total_inserted

# ==========================================
# 🚀 主控制流程
# ==========================================
def main():
    target_date = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d")
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        target_date = str(sys.argv[1]).strip()

    print("=" * 70)
    print("🏆 【Zen AI 台股雙軌分價量表每日自動建檔任務】啟動！")
    print(f"📅 建檔目標日期：{target_date}")
    print("=" * 70)

    with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=20) as conn:
        # 1. 抓取 TPEx 官方全上櫃
        otc_count = sync_tpex_otc_volume_profile(target_date, conn)

        # 2. 抓取 Yahoo 上市
        twse_count = sync_yahoo_twse_volume_profile(target_date, conn)

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(f"🎉 今日雙軌分價量建檔全部完成！")
    print(f"📊 總計寫入：上櫃 {otc_count:,} 筆 ＋ 上市 {twse_count:,} 筆 ＝ {otc_count + twse_count:,} 筆")
    print("=" * 70)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI 雙軌分價量表建檔器 V2.0：TPEx 官方全上櫃 (OpenAPI+CSV) ✕ Yahoo 上市精準補齊】

import os
import sys

# 強制 UTF-8 輸出
if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
if sys.stderr and hasattr(sys.stderr, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

import time
import datetime
import requests
import pyodbc
import pandas as pd
import io

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【1. 設定區】
# ==========================================
SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchangedate"
CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={{SQL Server}};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'

HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
    "Referer": "https://www.tpex.org.tw/zh-tw/mainboard/trading/info/pricing.html",
    "Accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,application/json,*/*;q=0.8"
}

# ==========================================
# 🏛️【軌道一：TPEx 官方全上櫃分價量 (三層自動容錯)】
# ==========================================
def sync_tpex_otc_volume_profile(target_date_str, conn):
    print(f"🏛️ [1/2] 正在向 TPEx 櫃買中心下載全上櫃成交分價表 ({target_date_str})...")
    dt = datetime.datetime.strptime(target_date_str, "%Y%m%d")
    roc_year = dt.year - 1911
    roc_date_str = f"{roc_year}/{dt.strftime('%m/%d')}" # 民國年 115/08/03

    records = []

    # 1. 第一層嘗試：TPEx 官方 OpenAPI (若查詢當日)
    try:
        openapi_url = "https://www.tpex.org.tw/openapi/v1/tpex_mainboard_volume_profile"
        r = requests.get(openapi_url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=8)
        if r.status_code == 200 and r.text.strip().startswith("["):
            rows = r.json()
            for row in rows:
                code = str(row.get("SecuritiesCompanyCode", "")).strip()
                price = float(row.get("Close", 0))
                volume = int(row.get("TradingShares", 0) / 1000)
                if volume > 0 and price > 0:
                    records.append((code, int(target_date_str), price, volume))
            if records:
                print("  └─ 成功透過 TPEx OpenAPI 取得即時分價量！")
    except Exception:
        pass

    # 2. 第二層嘗試：TPEx Web JSON 端點 (歷史日期)
    if not records:
        try:
            json_url = f"https://www.tpex.org.tw/web/stock/aftertrading/pricing/pricing_result.php?l=zh-tw&d={roc_date_str}&s=0,asc,0&o=json"
            r = requests.get(json_url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=12)
            if r.status_code == 200 and r.text.strip().startswith("{"):
                res_json = r.json()
                data_rows = res_json.get("aaData", [])
                for row in data_rows:
                    if len(row) >= 5:
                        code = str(row[0]).strip()
                        price = float(str(row[2]).replace(",", "").strip())
                        volume = int(float(str(row[4]).replace(",", "").strip()))
                        if volume > 0 and price > 0:
                            records.append((code, int(target_date_str), price, volume))
                if records:
                    print("  └─ 成功透過 TPEx Web JSON 取得歷史分價量！")
        except Exception:
            pass

    # 3. 第三層嘗試：TPEx Web CSV 串流 (最穩定、絕不報錯)
    if not records:
        try:
            csv_url = f"https://www.tpex.org.tw/web/stock/aftertrading/pricing/pricing_result.php?l=zh-tw&d={roc_date_str}&s=0,asc,0&o=csv"
            r = requests.get(csv_url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=15)
            if r.status_code == 200 and len(r.text) > 100 and "股票代號" in r.text:
                csv_data = io.StringIO(r.text)
                # 跳過說明標頭讀取 CSV
                for line in csv_data:
                    parts = [p.strip().replace('"', '') for p in line.split(',')]
                    if len(parts) >= 5 and parts[0].isdigit():
                        code = parts[0]
                        price_str = parts[2].replace(",", "")
                        vol_str = parts[4].replace(",", "")
                        try:
                            price = round(float(price_str), 2)
                            volume = int(float(vol_str))
                            if volume > 0 and price > 0:
                                records.append((code, int(target_date_str), price, volume))
                        except Exception:
                            continue
                if records:
                    print("  └─ 成功透過 TPEx 官方 CSV 串流解析分價量！")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ CSV 解析提示: {e}")

    if not records:
        print(f"⚠️ [{target_date_str}] TPEx 櫃買中心查無分價數據 (非交易日或伺服器尚未結算)。")
        return 0

    df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=["代號", "日期", "成交價", "成交張數"])
    stock_totals = df.groupby("代號")["成交張數"].transform("sum")
    df["成交佔比"] = (df["成交張數"] / stock_totals * 100).round(2)

    cursor = conn.cursor()
    merge_sql = """
    MERGE INTO stockchangedate.dbo.StockPriceVolume AS Target
    USING (VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)) AS Source (代號, 日期, 成交價, 成交張數, 成交佔比)
    ON (Target.代號 = Source.代號 AND Target.日期 = Source.日期 AND Target.成交價 = Source.成交價)
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET Target.成交張數 = Source.成交張數, Target.成交佔比 = Source.成交佔比, Target.建立時間 = GETDATE()
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (代號, 日期, 成交價, 成交張數, 成交佔比, 建立時間)
        VALUES (Source.代號, Source.日期, Source.成交價, Source.成交張數, Source.成交佔比, GETDATE());
    """

    params_list = []
    for _, r in df.iterrows():
        params_list.append((str(r["代號"]), int(r["日期"]), float(r["成交價"]), int(r["成交張數"]), float(r["成交佔比"])))

    cursor.executemany(merge_sql, params_list)
    conn.commit()

    stock_count = df["代號"].nunique()
    print(f"✅ TPEx 上櫃分價量寫入完畢！處理 {stock_count} 檔上櫃股票，累計寫入 {len(params_list):,} 筆！")
    return len(params_list)

# ==========================================
def sync_yahoo_twse_volume_profile(target_date_str, conn):
    print("\n🚀 [2/2] 正在透過 Yahoo Finance 補齊上市 (TWSE) 股票分價量...")

    listed_stocks = []
    try:
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        sql = """
        SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(B.代號), RTRIM(B.名稱)
        FROM stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B
        WHERE (B.上市1上櫃2 = 1 OR B.交易所分類 LIKE '%上市%')
          AND B.總量 >= 500
          AND B.成交價 >= 10.0;
        """
        cursor.execute(sql)
        for r in cursor.fetchall():
            listed_stocks.append((str(r[0]).strip(), str(r[1]).strip() if r[1] else str(r[0]).strip()))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 讀取上市清單改用預設核心名單: {e}")
        listed_stocks = [("2330", "台積電"), ("2317", "鴻海"), ("2454", "聯發科"), ("2382", "廣達"), ("3017", "奇鋐"), ("3324", "雙鴻"), ("3450", "聯鈞"), ("3653", "健策"), ("2489", "瑞軒"), ("2426", "鼎元")]

    print(f"📋 共篩選出 {len(listed_stocks)} 檔上市活躍標的，開始下載價量...")

    total_inserted = 0
    merge_sql = """
    MERGE INTO stockchangedate.dbo.StockPriceVolume AS Target
    USING (VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)) AS Source (代號, 日期, 成交價, 成交張數, 成交佔比)
    ON (Target.代號 = Source.代號 AND Target.日期 = Source.日期 AND Target.成交價 = Source.成交價)
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET Target.成交張數 = Source.成交張數, Target.成交佔比 = Source.成交佔比, Target.建立時間 = GETDATE()
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (代號, 日期, 成交價, 成交張數, 成交佔比, 建立時間)
        VALUES (Source.代號, Source.日期, Source.成交價, Source.成交張數, Source.成交佔比, GETDATE());
    """

    cursor = conn.cursor()
    for idx, (code, name) in enumerate(listed_stocks, 1):
        url = f"https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/{code}.TW?interval=1m&range=1d"
        try:
            r = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=8)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                res_json = r.json()
                if "chart" in res_json and res_json["chart"]["result"]:
                    quote = res_json["chart"]["result"][0]["indicators"]["quote"][0]
                    closes = quote.get("close", [])
                    volumes = quote.get("volume", [])

                    pv_map = {}
                    for p, v in zip(closes, volumes):
                        if p is not None and v is not None and v > 0:
                            price = round(float(p), 2)
                            lots = int(v / 1000) if v >= 1000 else 1
                            pv_map[price] = pv_map.get(price, 0) + lots

                    if pv_map:
                        tot = sum(pv_map.values())
                        params = []
                        for pr, vol in pv_map.items():
                            ratio = round(vol / tot * 100.0, 2)
                            params.append((code, int(target_date_str), pr, vol, ratio))

                        cursor.executemany(merge_sql, params)
                        conn.commit()
                        total_inserted += len(params)
        except Exception:
            pass

        if idx % 20 == 0 or idx == len(listed_stocks):
            print(f"  └─ 進度: [{idx}/{len(listed_stocks)}] 已處理...")
        time.sleep(0.12)

    print(f"✅ Yahoo 上市股票處理完畢！累計寫入 {total_inserted:,} 筆上市分價量！")
    return total_inserted

# ==========================================

def main():
    target_date = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d")
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        target_date = str(sys.argv[1]).strip()

    print("=" * 70)

    print("=" * 70)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# 🏆【Zen AI 雙軌分價量表建檔器 V2.1：TPEx 官方全上櫃 (tpex_prvol) ✕ Yahoo 上市精準補齊】

HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",

def sync_tpex_otc_volume_profile(target_date_str, conn):
    print(f"🏛️ [1/2] 正在向 TPEx 櫃買中心下載全上櫃成交分價表 ({target_date_str})...")
    dt = datetime.datetime.strptime(target_date_str, "%Y%m%d")
    roc_year = dt.year - 1911
    roc_date_str = f"{roc_year}/{dt.strftime('%m/%d')}"

    records = []

    # 1. 🟢 第一層：TPEx 官方最新 OpenAPI (tpex_prvol)
    try:
        openapi_url = "https://www.tpex.org.tw/openapi/v1/tpex_prvol"
        r = requests.get(openapi_url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=10)
        if r.status_code == 200:
            text = r.text.strip()
            if text.startswith("["):
                rows = r.json()
                for row in rows:
                    code = str(row.get("SecuritiesCompanyCode", row.get("Code", ""))).strip()
                    price_val = row.get("Close", row.get("Price", 0))
                    vol_val = row.get("TradingShares", row.get("Volume", 0))
                    try:
                        price = round(float(price_val), 2)
                        volume = int(float(vol_val) / 1000) if float(vol_val) >= 1000 else int(float(vol_val))
                        if volume > 0 and price > 0 and code:
                            records.append((code, int(target_date_str), price, volume))
                    except Exception:
                        continue
                if records:
                    print("  └─ 成功透過 TPEx OpenAPI 取得全上櫃分價量！")
    except Exception:
        pass

    # 2. 🟢 第二層：TPEx 歷史 Web API (安全檢查 JSON 標頭)
    if not records:
        try:
            web_url = f"https://www.tpex.org.tw/web/stock/aftertrading/pricing/pricing_result.php?l=zh-tw&d={roc_date_str}&s=0,asc,0&o=json"
            r = requests.get(web_url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=12)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                text = r.text.strip()
                # 只有當內容確實為 JSON 物件時才解析，避免 Expecting value 崩潰
                if text.startswith("{") and text.endswith("}"):
                    res_json = r.json()
                    data_rows = res_json.get("aaData", [])
                    for row in data_rows:
                        if len(row) >= 5:
                            code = str(row[0]).strip()
                            price_str = str(row[2]).replace(",", "").strip()
                            vol_str = str(row[4]).replace(",", "").strip()
                            try:
                                price = round(float(price_str), 2)
                                volume = int(float(vol_str))
                                if volume > 0 and price > 0:
                                    records.append((code, int(target_date_str), price, volume))
                            except Exception:
                                continue
                    if records:
                        print("  └─ 成功透過 TPEx 歷史 Web API 取得分價量！")
        except Exception:
            pass

    # 3. 🟢 第三層：TPEx CSV 串流解析
    if not records:
        try:
            csv_url = f"https://www.tpex.org.tw/web/stock/aftertrading/pricing/pricing_result.php?l=zh-tw&d={roc_date_str}&s=0,asc,0&o=csv"
            r = requests.get(csv_url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=12)
            if r.status_code == 200 and len(r.text) > 100:
                csv_data = io.StringIO(r.text)
                for line in csv_data:
                    parts = [p.strip().replace('"', '') for p in line.split(',')]
                    if len(parts) >= 5 and parts[0].isdigit():
                        code = parts[0]
                        try:
                            price = round(float(parts[2].replace(",", "")), 2)
                            volume = int(float(parts[4].replace(",", "")))
                            if volume > 0 and price > 0:
                                records.append((code, int(target_date_str), price, volume))
                        except Exception:
                            continue
                if records:
                    print("  └─ 成功透過 TPEx 官方 CSV 解析分價量！")
        except Exception:
            pass

    if not records:
        print(f"⚠️ [{target_date_str}] TPEx 查無上櫃數據 (非交易日或伺服器尚未發布)，安全跳過。")
        return 0

    df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=["代號", "日期", "成交價", "成交張數"])
    stock_totals = df.groupby("代號")["成交張數"].transform("sum")
    df["成交佔比"] = (df["成交張數"] / stock_totals * 100).round(2)

    cursor = conn.cursor()
    merge_sql = """
    MERGE INTO stockchangedate.dbo.StockPriceVolume AS Target
    USING (VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)) AS Source (代號, 日期, 成交價, 成交張數, 成交佔比)
    ON (Target.代號 = Source.代號 AND Target.日期 = Source.日期 AND Target.成交價 = Source.成交價)
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET Target.成交張數 = Source.成交張數, Target.成交佔比 = Source.成交佔比, Target.建立時間 = GETDATE()
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (代號, 日期, 成交價, 成交張數, 成交佔比, 建立時間)
        VALUES (Source.代號, Source.日期, Source.成交價, Source.成交張數, Source.成交佔比, GETDATE());
    """

    params_list = []
    for _, r in df.iterrows():
        params_list.append((str(r["代號"]), int(r["日期"]), float(r["成交價"]), int(r["成交張數"]), float(r["成交佔比"])))

    cursor.executemany(merge_sql, params_list)
    conn.commit()

    stock_count = df["代號"].nunique()
    print(f"✅ TPEx 上櫃分價量寫入完畢！共處理 {stock_count} 檔上櫃股票，累計寫入 {len(params_list):,} 筆！")
    return len(params_list)

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI 雙軌分價量表建檔器 V2.2：TPEx 官方新版 API ✕ Yahoo 上市精準補齊】

import os
import sys

# 強制 UTF-8 輸出
if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
if sys.stderr and hasattr(sys.stderr, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

import time
import datetime
import requests
import pyodbc
import pandas as pd
import io

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【1. 設定區】
# ==========================================
SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchangedate"
CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={{SQL Server}};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'

HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
    "Referer": "https://www.tpex.org.tw/zh-tw/mainboard/trading/info/volume-profile.html",
    "Accept": "application/json, text/javascript, */*; q=0.01"
}

# ==========================================
# 🏛️【軌道一：TPEx 官方全上櫃分價量 (新版端點 ✕ 四層防護)】
# ==========================================
def sync_tpex_otc_volume_profile(target_date_str, conn):
    print(f"🏛️ [1/2] 正在向 TPEx 櫃買中心下載全上櫃成交分價表 ({target_date_str})...")
    dt = datetime.datetime.strptime(target_date_str, "%Y%m%d")
    date_formatted = dt.strftime("%Y/%m/%d") # 2026/08/03
    roc_year = dt.year - 1911
    roc_date_str = f"{roc_year}/{dt.strftime('%m/%d')}" # 115/08/03

    records = []

    # 4 個官方新舊端點自動備援
    endpoints = [
        f"https://www.tpex.org.tw/www/zh-tw/afterTrading/volumeProfile?date={date_formatted}&response=json",
        f"https://www.tpex.org.tw/www/zh-tw/afterTrading/volumeProfile?date={roc_date_str}&response=json",
        "https://www.tpex.org.tw/openapi/v1/tpex_prvol",
        f"https://www.tpex.org.tw/web/stock/aftertrading/pricing/pricing_result.php?l=zh-tw&d={roc_date_str}&s=0,asc,0&o=json"
    ]

    for url in endpoints:
        try:
            r = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=12)
            if r.status_code == 200 and r.text.strip():
                text = r.text.strip()
                if text.startswith("{") or text.startswith("["):
                    res_json = r.json()
                    data_rows = []

                    # 1. OpenAPI 陣列格式
                    if isinstance(res_json, list):
                        for row in res_json:
                            code = str(row.get("SecuritiesCompanyCode", row.get("Code", ""))).strip()
                            price_val = row.get("Close", row.get("Price", 0))
                            vol_val = row.get("TradingShares", row.get("Volume", 0))
                            try:
                                price = round(float(price_val), 2)
                                volume = int(float(vol_val) / 1000) if float(vol_val) >= 1000 else int(float(vol_val))
                                if volume > 0 and price > 0 and code:
                                    records.append((code, int(target_date_str), price, volume))
                            except Exception:
                                continue

                    # 2. 新版 Web JSON 格式 (tables[0].data 或 data 或 aaData)
                    elif isinstance(res_json, dict):
                        if "tables" in res_json and len(res_json["tables"]) > 0:
                            data_rows = res_json["tables"][0].get("data", [])
                        elif "aaData" in res_json:
                            data_rows = res_json.get("aaData", [])
                        elif "data" in res_json:
                            data_rows = res_json.get("data", [])

                        for row in data_rows:
                            if len(row) >= 5:
                                code = str(row[0]).strip()
                                price_str = str(row[2]).replace(",", "").strip()
                                vol_str = str(row[4]).replace(",", "").strip()
                                try:
                                    price = round(float(price_str), 2)
                                    volume = int(float(vol_str))
                                    if volume > 0 and price > 0 and code:
                                        records.append((code, int(target_date_str), price, volume))
                                except Exception:
                                    continue

                    if records:
                        print(f"  └─ 成功透過 TPEx 官方端點取得分價量！(共 {len(records):,} 筆明細)")
                        break
        except Exception:
            continue

    if not records:
        print(f"⚠️ [{target_date_str}] TPEx 查無該日分價數據 (非交易日或伺服器尚未發布)，自動跳過。")
        return 0

    df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=["代號", "日期", "成交價", "成交張數"])
    stock_totals = df.groupby("代號")["成交張數"].transform("sum")
    df["成交佔比"] = (df["成交張數"] / stock_totals * 100).round(2)

    cursor = conn.cursor()
    merge_sql = """
    MERGE INTO stockchangedate.dbo.StockPriceVolume AS Target
    USING (VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)) AS Source (代號, 日期, 成交價, 成交張數, 成交佔比)
    ON (Target.代號 = Source.代號 AND Target.日期 = Source.日期 AND Target.成交價 = Source.成交價)
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET Target.成交張數 = Source.成交張數, Target.成交佔比 = Source.成交佔比, Target.建立時間 = GETDATE()
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (代號, 日期, 成交價, 成交張數, 成交佔比, 建立時間)
        VALUES (Source.代號, Source.日期, Source.成交價, Source.成交張數, Source.成交佔比, GETDATE());
    """

    params_list = []
    for _, r in df.iterrows():
        params_list.append((str(r["代號"]), int(r["日期"]), float(r["成交價"]), int(r["成交張數"]), float(r["成交佔比"])))

    cursor.executemany(merge_sql, params_list)
    conn.commit()

    stock_count = df["代號"].nunique()
    print(f"✅ TPEx 上櫃分價量寫入完畢！共處理 {stock_count} 檔上櫃股票，累計寫入 {len(params_list):,} 筆！")
    return len(params_list)

# ==========================================
# 🚀【軌道二：Yahoo Finance 抓取上市股票 (.TW)】
# ==========================================
def sync_yahoo_twse_volume_profile(target_date_str, conn):
    print("\n🚀 [2/2] 正在透過 Yahoo Finance 補齊上市 (TWSE) 股票分價量...")

    listed_stocks = []
    try:
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        sql = """
        SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(B.代號), RTRIM(B.名稱)
        FROM stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B
        WHERE (B.上市1上櫃2 = 1 OR B.交易所分類 LIKE '%上市%')
          AND B.總量 >= 500
          AND B.成交價 >= 10.0;
        """
        cursor.execute(sql)
        for r in cursor.fetchall():
            listed_stocks.append((str(r[0]).strip(), str(r[1]).strip() if r[1] else str(r[0]).strip()))
    except Exception as e:
        listed_stocks = [("2330", "台積電"), ("2317", "鴻海"), ("2454", "聯發科"), ("2382", "廣達"), ("3017", "奇鋐"), ("3324", "雙鴻"), ("3450", "聯鈞"), ("3653", "健策"), ("2489", "瑞軒"), ("2426", "鼎元")]

    print(f"📋 共篩選出 {len(listed_stocks)} 檔上市活躍標的，開始下載價量...")

    total_inserted = 0
    merge_sql = """
    MERGE INTO stockchangedate.dbo.StockPriceVolume AS Target
    USING (VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)) AS Source (代號, 日期, 成交價, 成交張數, 成交佔比)
    ON (Target.代號 = Source.代號 AND Target.日期 = Source.日期 AND Target.成交價 = Source.成交價)
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET Target.成交張數 = Source.成交張數, Target.成交佔比 = Source.成交佔比, Target.建立時間 = GETDATE()
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (代號, 日期, 成交價, 成交張數, 成交佔比, 建立時間)
        VALUES (Source.代號, Source.日期, Source.成交價, Source.成交張數, Source.成交佔比, GETDATE());
    """

    cursor = conn.cursor()
    for idx, (code, name) in enumerate(listed_stocks, 1):
        url = f"https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/{code}.TW?interval=1m&range=1d"
        try:
            r = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=8)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                res_json = r.json()
                if "chart" in res_json and res_json["chart"]["result"]:
                    quote = res_json["chart"]["result"][0]["indicators"]["quote"][0]
                    closes = quote.get("close", [])
                    volumes = quote.get("volume", [])

                    pv_map = {}
                    for p, v in zip(closes, volumes):
                        if p is not None and v is not None and v > 0:
                            price = round(float(p), 2)
                            lots = int(v / 1000) if v >= 1000 else 1
                            pv_map[price] = pv_map.get(price, 0) + lots

                    if pv_map:
                        tot = sum(pv_map.values())
                        params = []
                        for pr, vol in pv_map.items():
                            ratio = round(vol / tot * 100.0, 2)
                            params.append((code, int(target_date_str), pr, vol, ratio))

                        cursor.executemany(merge_sql, params)
                        conn.commit()
                        total_inserted += len(params)
        except Exception:
            pass

        if idx % 30 == 0 or idx == len(listed_stocks):
            print(f"  └─ 進度: [{idx}/{len(listed_stocks)}] 上市股票處理中...")
        time.sleep(0.1)

    print(f"✅ Yahoo 上市股票處理完畢！累計寫入 {total_inserted:,} 筆上市分價量！")
    return total_inserted

# ==========================================
# 🚀 主控制流程
# ==========================================
def main():
    target_date = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d")
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        target_date = str(sys.argv[1]).strip()

    print("=" * 70)
    print("🏆 【Zen AI 台股雙軌分價量表每日自動建檔任務 V2.2】啟動！")
    print(f"📅 建檔目標日期：{target_date}")
    print("=" * 70)

    with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=20) as conn:
        otc_count = sync_tpex_otc_volume_profile(target_date, conn)
        twse_count = sync_yahoo_twse_volume_profile(target_date, conn)

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(f"🎉 雙軌分價量建檔全部完成！")
    print(f"📊 總計寫入：上櫃 {otc_count:,} 筆 ＋ 上市 {twse_count:,} 筆 ＝ {otc_count + twse_count:,} 筆")
    print("=" * 70)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI 雙軌分價量表建檔器 V3.0：TPEx 官方當日快照 ✕ Yahoo 歷史自動回補】

import os
import sys

# 強制 UTF-8 輸出
if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
if sys.stderr and hasattr(sys.stderr, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

import time
import datetime
import requests
import pyodbc
import pandas as pd

# ==========================================
# 🛠️【1. 設定區】
# ==========================================
SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchangedate"
CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={{SQL Server}};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'

HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
    "Accept": "application/json, text/plain, */*"
}

# ==========================================
# 🏛️【軌道一：TPEx 官方 OpenAPI (tpex_prvol 當日全上櫃快照)】
# ==========================================
def sync_tpex_today_snapshot(target_date_str, conn):
    print(f"🏛️ [1/2] 正在向 TPEx 官方下載今日全上櫃成交分價表快照...")
    records = []
    
    # 官方 OpenAPI (專門提供最新當日全市場快照)
    openapi_url = "https://www.tpex.org.tw/openapi/v1/tpex_prvol"
    
    try:
        r = requests.get(openapi_url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=12)
        if r.status_code == 200 and r.text.strip().startswith("["):
            rows = r.json()
            for row in rows:
                code = str(row.get("SecuritiesCompanyCode", row.get("Code", ""))).strip()
                price_val = row.get("Close", row.get("Price", 0))
                vol_val = row.get("TradingShares", row.get("Volume", 0))
                try:
                    price = round(float(price_val), 2)
                    volume = int(float(vol_val) / 1000) if float(vol_val) >= 1000 else int(float(vol_val))
                    if volume > 0 and price > 0 and code:
                        records.append((code, int(target_date_str), price, volume))
                except Exception:
                    continue
            
            if records:
                print(f"  └─ 成功透過 TPEx 官方 OpenAPI 取得全上櫃分價量！(共 {len(records):,} 筆明細)")
        else:
            print(f"⚠️ TPEx 伺服器狀態碼: {r.status_code}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ TPEx 官方端點連線提醒: {e}")

    if not records:
        print("⚠️ TPEx 官方當日端點未取得資料，上櫃標的將自動交由 Yahoo 進行精準補齊。")
        return 0

    df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=["代號", "日期", "成交價", "成交張數"])
    stock_totals = df.groupby("代號")["成交張數"].transform("sum")
    df["成交佔比"] = (df["成交張數"] / stock_totals * 100).round(2)

    cursor = conn.cursor()
    merge_sql = """
    MERGE INTO stockchangedate.dbo.StockPriceVolume AS Target
    USING (VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)) AS Source (代號, 日期, 成交價, 成交張數, 成交佔比)
    ON (Target.代號 = Source.代號 AND Target.日期 = Source.日期 AND Target.成交價 = Source.成交價)
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET Target.成交張數 = Source.成交張數, Target.成交佔比 = Source.成交佔比, Target.建立時間 = GETDATE()
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (代號, 日期, 成交價, 成交張數, 成交佔比, 建立時間)
        VALUES (Source.代號, Source.日期, Source.成交價, Source.成交張數, Source.成交佔比, GETDATE());
    """

    params_list = []
    for _, r in df.iterrows():
        params_list.append((str(r["代號"]), int(r["日期"]), float(r["成交價"]), int(r["成交張數"]), float(r["成交佔比"])))

    cursor.executemany(merge_sql, params_list)
    conn.commit()

    stock_count = df["代號"].nunique()
    print(f"✅ TPEx 上櫃分價量寫入完畢！共處理 {stock_count} 檔上櫃股票，累計寫入 {len(params_list):,} 筆！")
    return len(params_list)

# ==========================================
# 🚀【軌道二：Yahoo Finance 抓取 (支援上市 .TW 與上櫃 .TWO 歷史回補)】
# ==========================================
def sync_yahoo_volume_profile(target_date_str, conn, otc_completed=False):
    dt_target = datetime.datetime.strptime(target_date_str, "%Y%m%d")
    is_today = (target_date_str == datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d"))

    market_desc = "上市 (TWSE)" if otc_completed else "上市 (.TW) 與 上櫃 (.TWO) 歷史"
    print(f"\n🚀 [2/2] 正在透過 Yahoo Finance 處理 {market_desc} 分價量...")

    # 抓取目標股票清單
    target_stocks = []
    try:
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        if otc_completed:
            # 若上櫃已由 TPEx 官方完成，只抓上市
            sql = """
            SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(B.代號), RTRIM(B.名稱), 1 AS 上市
            FROM stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B
            WHERE (B.上市1上櫃2 = 1 OR B.交易所分類 LIKE '%上市%')
              AND B.總量 >= 500 AND B.成交價 >= 10.0;
            """
        else:
            # 歷史日期回補：抓取上市櫃全部活躍標的
            sql = """
            SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(B.代號), RTRIM(B.名稱), B.上市1上櫃2
            FROM stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B
            WHERE B.總量 >= 500 AND B.成交價 >= 10.0;
            """
        cursor.execute(sql)
        for r in cursor.fetchall():
            target_stocks.append((str(r[0]).strip(), str(r[1]).strip() if r[1] else str(r[0]).strip(), int(r[2]) if r[2] else 1))
    except Exception as e:
        target_stocks = [("2330", "台積電", 1), ("2317", "鴻海", 1), ("2454", "聯發科", 1), ("3017", "奇鋐", 1), ("8299", "群聯", 2), ("3450", "聯鈞", 1)]

    print(f"📋 共篩選出 {len(target_stocks)} 檔標的，開始下載分價量...")

    total_inserted = 0
    merge_sql = """
    MERGE INTO stockchangedate.dbo.StockPriceVolume AS Target
    USING (VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)) AS Source (代號, 日期, 成交價, 成交張數, 成交佔比)
    ON (Target.代號 = Source.代號 AND Target.日期 = Source.日期 AND Target.成交價 = Source.成交價)
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET Target.成交張數 = Source.成交張數, Target.成交佔比 = Source.成交佔比, Target.建立時間 = GETDATE()
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (代號, 日期, 成交價, 成交張數, 成交佔比, 建立時間)
        VALUES (Source.代號, Source.日期, Source.成交價, Source.成交張數, Source.成交佔比, GETDATE());
    """

    cursor = conn.cursor()
    for idx, (code, name, mkt_type) in enumerate(target_stocks, 1):
        suffix = ".TWO" if mkt_type == 2 else ".TW"
        sym = f"{code}{suffix}"
        
        # 當日用 1m，歷史回補用 5m 範圍 1mo
        range_param = "1d" if is_today else "1mo"
        interval_param = "1m" if is_today else "5m"
        url = f"https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/{sym}?interval={interval_param}&range={range_param}"

        try:
            r = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=8)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                res_json = r.json()
                if "chart" in res_json and res_json["chart"]["result"]:
                    res_data = res_json["chart"]["result"][0]
                    timestamps = res_data.get("timestamp", [])
                    quote = res_data["indicators"]["quote"][0]
                    closes = quote.get("close", [])
                    volumes = quote.get("volume", [])

                    pv_map = {}
                    for ts, p, v in zip(timestamps, closes, volumes):
                        if ts and p is not None and v is not None and v > 0:
                            # 轉換台灣時間
                            dt = datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(ts) + datetime.timedelta(hours=8)
                            row_date_str = dt.strftime("%Y%m%d")
                            
                            # 若查詢指定日期，只保留該日期的資料
                            if row_date_str == target_date_str:
                                price = round(float(p), 2)
                                lots = int(v / 1000) if v >= 1000 else 1
                                pv_map[price] = pv_map.get(price, 0) + lots

                    if pv_map:
                        tot = sum(pv_map.values())
                        params = []
                        for pr, vol in pv_map.items():
                            ratio = round(vol / tot * 100.0, 2)
                            params.append((code, int(target_date_str), pr, vol, ratio))

                        cursor.executemany(merge_sql, params)
                        conn.commit()
                        total_inserted += len(params)
        except Exception:
            pass

        if idx % 30 == 0 or idx == len(target_stocks):
            print(f"  └─ 進度: [{idx}/{len(target_stocks)}] 已處理...")
        time.sleep(0.1)

    print(f"✅ Yahoo 價量處理完畢！累計寫入 {total_inserted:,} 筆分價量！")
    return total_inserted

# ==========================================
# 🚀 主控制流程
# ==========================================
def main():
    target_date = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d")
    is_custom_history_date = False
    
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        target_date = str(sys.argv[1]).strip()
        if target_date != datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d"):
            is_custom_history_date = True

    print("=" * 70)

    print("=" * 70)

    with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=20) as conn:
        otc_count = 0
        if not is_custom_history_date:
            # 1. 當日模式：調用 TPEx 官方最新 OpenAPI (tpex_prvol)
            otc_count = sync_tpex_today_snapshot(target_date, conn)
        
        # 2. 透過 Yahoo 補齊上市 (或全市場歷史回補)
        twse_count = sync_yahoo_volume_profile(target_date, conn, otc_completed=(otc_count > 0))

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(f"🎉 分價量建檔全部完成！")
    print(f"📊 總計寫入：上櫃 {otc_count:,} 筆 ＋ 上市/歷史 {twse_count:,} 筆 ＝ {otc_count + twse_count:,} 筆")
    print("=" * 70)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
