    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [功能 1.1]：專家選股語音轉 SQL (使用 StockScore 表) (已升級 OpenRouter)
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function TranslateToSQL1(ByVal userSpeech As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim matchedSql As String = LookupKBMatch(userSpeech)
            If Not String.IsNullOrEmpty(matchedSql) Then
                Return New With {.success = True, .sql = matchedSql}
            End If

            Dim realCols As String = "A.[名稱],A.[代號],A.[產業分類],A.[股本億],A.[盤中現價],A.[盤中漲幅],A.[盤中總量],A.[價五日乖離],A.[量倍數],A.[OBV分],A.[價均分],A.[技術分],A.[籌碼分],A.[量能分],A.[專家實戰總分],A.[實戰標籤],A.[日期]"

            Dim prompt As String = "你是一個 T-SQL 專家。請針對 [StockScore] 表撰寫 SQL。" & vbCrLf &
                "【輸出規範】：只輸出 SQL 語句，禁止解釋。" & vbCrLf &
                "【數值門檻規範】： " & vbCrLf &
                "- [籌碼分]：若提到『籌碼好』或篩選時，請使用 >= 5 (嚴禁使用 60)。" & vbCrLf &
                "- [專家實戰總分]：提到『高分』時建議使用 > 25。" & vbCrLf &
                "- [OBV分]、[價均分]、[技術分]：若需篩選，預設使用 >= 5。" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf &
                "【模式導向 (Select Case)】：" & vbCrLf &
                "Case 1: 若提到『連三升』" & vbCrLf &
                "   -> 使用 WITH Ranked 模板" & vbCrLf &
                "Case 2: 查詢『單一股票』" & vbCrLf &
                "   -> SELECT ... WHERE A.代號 = N'代號' ORDER BY A.日期 DESC" & vbCrLf &
                "Case 3: 一般篩選" & vbCrLf &
                "   -> SELECT TOP 100 " & realCols & " FROM StockScore A WHERE A.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM StockScore) AND A.[籌碼分] >= 5" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf &
                GetStockCodeHint(userSpeech) & vbCrLf &
                GetAIEngineeringKBSamples() & vbCrLf &
                "【使用者指令】：" & userSpeech

            Dim aiSql As String = CallOpenRouterWithFallback(prompt, "你是一位專精 SQL Server T-SQL 的量化架構師，只輸出乾淨的 SQL 語句，禁止任何說明文字。")
            Dim cleanedSql As String = CleanSqlResult(aiSql)

            If userSpeech.Contains("連") AndAlso Not cleanedSql.ToUpper().Contains("WITH") Then
                cleanedSql = "WITH Ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) as rn FROM StockScore) " &
                     "SELECT DISTINCT TOP 100 " & realCols & " FROM Ranked A " &
                     "INNER JOIN Ranked B ON A.代號 = B.代號 AND B.rn = 2 " &
                     "INNER JOIN Ranked C ON A.代號 = C.代號 AND C.rn = 3 " &
                     "WHERE A.rn = 1 AND A.專家實戰總分 > B.專家實戰總分 AND B.專家實戰總分 > C.專家實戰總分"
            End If

            Return New With {.success = True, .sql = cleanedSql}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "專家引擎失敗: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

                {"A2", "實戰標籤解析：解釋目前標籤對操作的意義。"},

                {"B1", "大戶鎖碼分析：判斷籌碼（1-60日）是否趨於集中。"},
                {"B2", "法人動向追蹤：判斷法人共識程度。"},
                {"B3", "籌碼分深挖：判斷是主力吸籌還是獲利了結。"},
                {"B4", "資券使用率預警：判斷散戶與專業投資者的對抗強度。"},
                {"C1", "K-D 多週期分析：對比日、週、月趨勢階段。"},
                {"C2", "MACD 動能分析：分析價格動能是否衰減。"},
                {"C3", "乖離率風險評估：建議回調價格區間。"},
                {"C4", "量能突破判定：判斷量能是否支撐目前漲幅。"},
                {"D1", "進場時機建議：應採『分批買進』還是『等待回調』？"},
                {"D2", "止損止盈建議：建議合理的止損位與目標價。"},
                {"D3", "波段持有分析：該股是否適合波段操作。"},
                {"D4", "隱藏風險挖掘：尋找數據中的轉弱訊號。"},
                {"E1", "量價背離偵測：檢查是否存在量價或籌碼背離。"},
                {"E2", "潛伏低位偵測：搜尋是否符合低位金叉潛伏特徵。"},
                {"E3", "過熱警報分析：判斷是否為典型的主力出貨訊號。"},
                {"E4", "極速反轉預測：判斷是否處於空轉多的臨界點。"}
            }

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' 👑【圖表數據獲取函數】：內建盤中自動隨動運算與快取刷新防線
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetStockTrendData(ByVal stockId As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim list As New List(Of Object)
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Using cmdLive As New SqlCommand("EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_CalcIntradayStockLive @StockCode = @id", conn)
                    cmdLive.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", stockId.Trim())
                    conn.Open()
                    cmdLive.ExecuteNonQuery()
                    conn.Close()
                End Using

                Using cmdRefresh As New SqlCommand("EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_RefreshIntradayScoreCache_Single @StockCode = @id", conn)
                    cmdRefresh.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", stockId.Trim())
                    conn.Open()
                    cmdRefresh.ExecuteNonQuery()
                    conn.Close()
                End Using

                Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 10 名稱, 代號, 日期, 盤中現價, 專家實戰總分 " &
                                   "FROM MasterStockAnalysis WHERE 代號 = @id ORDER BY 日期 DESC"
                Using cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", stockId.Trim())
                    conn.Open()
                    Using dr As SqlDataReader = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                        While dr.Read()
                            list.Add(New With {
                                .date = dr("日期").ToString(),
                                .price = Convert.ToDouble(dr("盤中現價")),
                                .goldCount = Convert.ToDouble(dr("專家實戰總分"))
                            })
                        End While
                    End Using
                End Using
            End Using
            list.Reverse()
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = list}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [功能 4]：全市場產業熱力診斷 (已升級 OpenRouter)
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetIndustryAnalysis(ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim rows As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql = "SELECT TOP 10 [產業分類], ROUND(AVG(CAST([一日漲幅] AS FLOAT)), 2) as [平均漲幅], AVG([均價黃金交叉次數]) as [平均金叉] " &
                          "FROM [View_AI_Stock_Pro] WHERE [日期] = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM winnewdate) " &
                          "GROUP BY [產業分類] ORDER BY [平均漲幅] DESC"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                conn.Open()
                Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("industry", dr("產業分類").ToString())
                        row.Add("avg_change", dr("平均漲幅"))
                        row.Add("avg_gold", dr("平均金叉"))
                        rows.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using

            Dim systemPrompt As String = "你是一位資深總經與板塊策略師。請根據產業平均漲幅數據，精準點評今日資金流向與熱點族群，使用繁體中文。"
            Dim prompt = "今日產業數據：" & New JavaScriptSerializer().Serialize(rows)
            Dim analysis = CallOpenRouterWithFallback(prompt, systemPrompt)
            Return New With {.success = True, .analysis = analysis, .rawData = rows}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [功能 5]：歷史勝率回測 (已升級 OpenRouter)
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetWinRateAnalysis(ByVal stockId As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim historyData As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 240 b.[日期], b.[成交價], w.[均價黃金交叉次數] " &
                                   "FROM [basicinfo] AS b " &
                                   "INNER JOIN [winnewdate] AS w ON b.[代號] = w.[股票代號] AND b.[日期] = w.[日期] " &
                                   "WHERE b.[代號] = @id " &
                                   "ORDER BY b.[日期] ASC"

                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", stockId)
                conn.Open()
                Using dr As SqlDataReader = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("d", dr("日期").ToString())
                        row.Add("p", Val(dr("成交價").ToString()))
                        row.Add("g", Val(dr("均價黃金交叉次數").ToString()))
                        historyData.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using

            If historyData.Count = 0 Then Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "無歷史資料"}

            Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
            Dim systemPrompt As String = "你是一位量化回測分析師。請分析一年期歷史數據，嚴禁 LaTeX 與 Markdown 標題，請直接使用純中文描述。"
            Dim prompt As String = "【數據說明】：d=日期, p=價格, g=金叉次數。" & vbCrLf &
                "【任務】：1.找出所有 g >= 7 的日期。 2.計算出現訊號後 5 天內的漲跌。 3.若無 g>=7 則分析 g>=4。 4.總結勝率並給出 80 字內操作建議。" & vbCrLf &
                "數據：" & jss.Serialize(historyData)

            Dim aiReport = CallOpenRouterWithFallback(prompt, systemPrompt)
            Return New With {.success = True, .analysis = aiReport}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' =========================================================================
    ' 🚀【全新核心引擎】：OpenRouter 70B~120B 三級自動輪詢容錯核心 (取代本地 7B)
    ' =========================================================================
    Private Shared Function CallOpenRouterWithFallback(ByVal promptText As String, Optional ByVal systemPrompt As String = "你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監。分析內容請一針見血，條理分明，全部使用繁體中文回覆。") As String
        ' 🎯 當前三大活躍頂級免費大模型
        Dim modelIds As String() = {
            "openrouter/free",
            "inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash:free",
            "nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free"
        }

        Dim lastErrorMsg As String = ""

        ' 依序嘗試 3 個大模型
        For Each modelId In modelIds
            Try
                Dim reply As String = CallSingleOpenRouterAPI(modelId, promptText, systemPrompt)
                If Not String.IsNullOrEmpty(reply) Then
                    Return reply.Trim()
                End If
            Catch ex As Exception
                lastErrorMsg = "[" & modelId & "]: " & ex.Message
            End Try
        Next

        Throw New Exception("OpenRouter 三大模型皆繁忙，請稍候重試 (" & lastErrorMsg & ")")
    End Function

    Private Shared Function CallSingleOpenRouterAPI(ByVal modelId As String, ByVal promptText As String, ByVal systemPrompt As String) As String
        ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol = SecurityProtocolType.Tls12 Or CType(3072, SecurityProtocolType)

        Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(OPENROUTER_URL), HttpWebRequest)
        request.Method = "POST"
        request.ContentType = "application/json; charset=utf-8"
        request.Headers.Add("Authorization", "Bearer " & OPENROUTER_API_KEY.Trim())
        request.Headers.Add("HTTP-Referer", "https://zen2965.duckdns.org")
        request.Headers.Add("X-Title", "Zen AI StockMaster2 Pro")
        request.Timeout = 40000

        Dim requestBody As New With {
            .model = modelId,
            .messages = New Object() {
                New With {.role = "system", .content = systemPrompt},
                New With {.role = "user", .content = promptText}
            },
            .temperature = 0.5
        }

        Dim js As New JavaScriptSerializer()
        Dim jsonStr As String = js.Serialize(requestBody)
        Dim byteArray As Byte() = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(jsonStr)
        request.ContentLength = byteArray.Length

        Using dataStream As Stream = request.GetRequestStream()
            dataStream.Write(byteArray, 0, byteArray.Length)
        End Using

        Using response As WebResponse = request.GetResponse()
            Using streamReader As New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream(), Encoding.UTF8)
                Dim responseJson As String = streamReader.ReadToEnd()
                Dim parsed As Dictionary(Of String, Object) = js.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(responseJson)

                If parsed IsNot Nothing AndAlso parsed.ContainsKey("choices") Then
                    Dim choicesList As ArrayList = TryCast(parsed("choices"), ArrayList)
                    If choicesList IsNot Nothing AndAlso choicesList.Count > 0 Then
                        Dim firstChoice As Dictionary(Of String, Object) = TryCast(choicesList(0), Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                        If firstChoice IsNot Nothing AndAlso firstChoice.ContainsKey("message") Then
                            Dim messageObj As Dictionary(Of String, Object) = TryCast(firstChoice("message"), Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                            If messageObj IsNot Nothing AndAlso messageObj.ContainsKey("content") Then
                                Return messageObj("content").ToString()
                            End If
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
            End Using
        End Using

        Return ""
    End Function

    ' =========================================================
    ' 👑【核心與盾牌二】：常見欄位與繁簡體自動清洗對齊器
    ' =========================================================
    Private Shared Function CleanSqlResult(ByVal sql As String) As String
        Dim res = sql.Replace("
sql", "").Replace("

        End If

    End Function

    ' =========================================================
    ' 👑【核心新增】：知識庫雙向模糊直通匹配器
    ' =========================================================
    Private Shared Function LookupKBMatch(ByVal userSpeech As String) As String
        Dim matchedSql As String = ""
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 1 CorrectSQL " &
                                   "FROM stockchangedate.dbo.AIEngineeringKB " &
                                   "WHERE UserPrompt LIKE N'%' + @speech + N'%' " &
                                   "ORDER BY QueryCount DESC, ID DESC"
                Using cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@speech", userSpeech.Trim())
                    conn.Open()
                    Dim result = cmd.ExecuteScalar()
                    If result IsNot Nothing Then
                        matchedSql = result.ToString().Trim()
                        IncrementQueryCount(userSpeech.Trim())
                    End If
                End Using
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception
        End Try
        Return matchedSql
    End Function

    Private Shared Sub IncrementQueryCount(ByVal userSpeech As String)
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "UPDATE stockchangedate.dbo.AIEngineeringKB " &
                                   "SET QueryCount = QueryCount + 1, LastUsedDate = GETDATE() " &
                                   "WHERE UserPrompt LIKE N'%' + @speech + N'%'"
                Using cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@speech", userSpeech.Trim())
                    conn.Open()
                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
                End Using
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception
        End Try
    End Sub

    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function DeletePlan(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                conn.Open()
                Dim sql = "DELETE FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid; DELETE FROM TravelPlans WHERE PlanID = @pid;"
                Using cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
                End Using
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

End Class

    ' =========================================================
    ' 👑【盾牌一】：盤中個股名稱自動對位器 (防止代號幻覺)
    ' =========================================================
    Private Shared Function GetStockCodeHint(ByVal userSpeech As String) As String
        Dim hint As String = ""
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(GetConnString())
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(代號) AS 代號, RTRIM(名稱) AS 名稱 " &
                                   "FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis " &
                                   "WHERE @speech LIKE '%' + RTRIM(名稱) + '%'"
                Using cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@speech", userSpeech)
                    conn.Open()
                    Using dr As SqlDataReader = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                        Dim matches As New List(Of String)()
                        While dr.Read()
                            matches.Add(String.Format("股票名稱『{0}』對應的 [代號] 必須為 '{1}'", dr("名稱").ToString().Trim(), dr("代號").ToString().Trim()))
                        End While
                        If matches.Count > 0 Then
                            hint &= vbCrLf & "【⚠️ 系統盤中個股對齊提示 - 必須嚴格遵守】： " & vbCrLf
                            For Each m In matches
                                hint &= "- " & m & vbCrLf
                            Next
                            hint &= "請在撰寫 SQL 時，若涉及上述股票，WHERE 條件【必須】精確對齊為 代號 = '代號'，嚴禁使用任何幻覺或簡體代號！" & vbCrLf
                        End If
                    End Using
                End Using
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception
        End Try
        Return hint
    End Function

                Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 5 UserPrompt, CorrectSQL FROM stockchangedate.dbo.AIEngineeringKB ORDER BY QueryCount DESC"
                Using cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                    conn.Open()
                    Using dr As SqlDataReader = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                        If dr.HasRows Then
                            samples &= vbCrLf & "【最新實戰成功範本（請參考其結構與繁體字體）】：" & vbCrLf
                            While dr.Read()
                                samples &= "需求：" & dr("UserPrompt").ToString() & vbCrLf
                                samples &= "正確的 SQL 範例：\n
sql\n" & dr("CorrectSQL").ToString() & "\n
" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
                            End While
                        End If
                    End Using
                End Using
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception
        End Try
        Return samples
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [功能 1]：大寬表 MasterStockAnalysis 語音轉 SQL (OpenRouter 旗艦版)
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function TranslateToSQL(ByVal userSpeech As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim matchedSql As String = LookupKBMatch(userSpeech)
            If Not String.IsNullOrEmpty(matchedSql) Then
                Return New With {.success = True, .sql = matchedSql, .isBypass = True}
            End If

            Dim prompt As String = "你是一個 T-SQL 專家。目標表：MasterStockAnalysis。" & vbCrLf &
                "【⚠️ 繁簡體與字體極重要規則】： " & vbCrLf &
                "1. 欄位名稱必須 100% 使用繁體中文，嚴禁使用簡體字！" & vbCrLf &
                "   - 必須使用 '專家實戰總分'，嚴禁寫成 '专家實戰總分'！" & vbCrLf &
                "   - 必須使用 '實戰標籤'，嚴禁寫成 '实戰標籤'！" & vbCrLf &
                "   - 必須使用 '股本億'，嚴禁寫成 '股本亿'！" & vbCrLf &
                "【核心規範】： " & vbCrLf &
                "1. 嚴禁使用 DATEADD 或日期函數，[日期] 欄位是 INT 數字 (如 20260906)。" & vbCrLf &
                "2. 處理『連續幾天』的需求時，必須使用 LAG() 視窗函數，禁止使用自我連接(JOIN)。" & vbCrLf &
                "3. 取得前幾名僅限用 SELECT TOP X，嚴禁重複出現 DISTINCT。" & vbCrLf &
                "4. 集中度欄位請用 [集中度1日]、[集中度5日]。" & vbCrLf &
                "5. 僅輸出 SQL 代碼，不准有任何解釋文字。" & vbCrLf &
                GetStockCodeHint(userSpeech) & vbCrLf &
                GetAIEngineeringKBSamples() & vbCrLf &
                "【追加規範】：（規範：1.禁止縮寫欄位。2.必須使用完整名稱：均價黃金交叉次數, obv累積金叉次數。3.嚴禁使用中括號。4.嚴禁在欄位後加別名如 [產業分類]分類。）" & vbCrLf &
                "需求：" & userSpeech

            Dim aiSql As String = CallOpenRouterWithFallback(prompt, "你是一位專精 SQL Server T-SQL 的量化架構師，只輸出乾淨的 SQL 語句，禁止任何說明文字。")
            Dim cleanedSql As String = CleanSqlResult(aiSql)
            Return New With {.success = True, .sql = cleanedSql}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "轉譯出錯: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------

    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function TranslateToSQL1(ByVal userSpeech As String) As Object
        Try

                Return New With {.success = True, .sql = matchedSql}
            End If

            Dim realCols As String = "A.[名稱],A.[代號],A.[產業分類],A.[股本億],A.[盤中現價],A.[盤中漲幅],A.[盤中總量],A.[價五日乖離],A.[量倍數],A.[OBV分],A.[價均分],A.[技術分],A.[籌碼分],A.[量能分],A.[專家實戰總分],A.[實戰標籤],A.[日期]"

            Dim prompt As String = "你是一個 T-SQL 專家。請針對 [StockScore] 表撰寫 SQL。" & vbCrLf &
                "【輸出規範】：只輸出 SQL 語句，禁止解釋。" & vbCrLf &
                "【數值門檻規範】： " & vbCrLf &

                "- [專家實戰總分]：提到『高分』時建議使用 > 25。" & vbCrLf &
                "- [OBV分]、[價均分]、[技術分]：若需篩選，預設使用 >= 5。" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf &
                "【模式導向 (Select Case)】：" & vbCrLf &
                "Case 1: 若提到『連三升』" & vbCrLf &
                "   -> 使用 WITH Ranked 模板" & vbCrLf &
                "Case 2: 查詢『單一股票』" & vbCrLf &
                "   -> SELECT ... WHERE A.代號 = N'代號' ORDER BY A.日期 DESC" & vbCrLf &
                "Case 3: 一般篩選" & vbCrLf &
                "   -> SELECT TOP 100 " & realCols & " FROM StockScore A WHERE A.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM StockScore) AND A.[籌碼分] >= 5" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf &
                GetStockCodeHint(userSpeech) & vbCrLf &
                GetAIEngineeringKBSamples() & vbCrLf &
                "【使用者指令】：" & userSpeech

            Dim aiSql As String = CallOpenRouterWithFallback(prompt, "你是一位專精 SQL Server T-SQL 的量化架構師，只輸出乾淨的 SQL 語句，禁止任何說明文字。")
            Dim cleanedSql As String = CleanSqlResult(aiSql)

            If userSpeech.Contains("連") AndAlso Not cleanedSql.ToUpper().Contains("WITH") Then
                cleanedSql = "WITH Ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) as rn FROM StockScore) " &
                     "SELECT DISTINCT TOP 100 " & realCols & " FROM Ranked A " &
                     "INNER JOIN Ranked B ON A.代號 = B.代號 AND B.rn = 2 " &
                     "INNER JOIN Ranked C ON A.代號 = C.代號 AND C.rn = 3 " &
                     "WHERE A.rn = 1 AND A.專家實戰總分 > B.專家實戰總分 AND B.專家實戰總分 > C.專家實戰總分"
            End If

            Return New With {.success = True, .sql = cleanedSql}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "專家引擎失敗: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [功能 2]：專家深度診斷 (20 種任務策略)
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function AnalyzeExpertTask(ByVal stockDataJson As String, ByVal taskId As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim systemPrompt As String = "你是一位頂尖量化交易員與籌碼專家。請根據數據回答，規範如下：" & vbCrLf &
                "1. 嚴禁使用 LaTeX (如 \ge, \approx, $) 或 Markdown 標題(###)。" & vbCrLf &
                "2. 專家總分 = OBV分+價均分+技術分+籌碼分+量能分。" & vbCrLf &
                "3. 判定標籤：追高(乖離8-18%)、量價齊揚(站均量>=7且漲幅>3%)、大戶鎖碼(庫存增幅>2%)。" & vbCrLf &
                "4. 簡潔條列式，100字內，全部使用繁體中文。"

            Dim taskLib As New Dictionary(Of String, String) From {
                {"A1", "全方位健康檢查：給出 1-10 投資信心分。"},
                {"A2", "實戰標籤解析：解釋目前標籤對操作的意義。"},
                {"A3", "總分拆解分析：指出該股最強與最弱的環節。"},
                {"A4", "短線爆發潛力：分析是否具備短線快速拉升條件。"},
                {"B1", "大戶鎖碼分析：判斷籌碼（1-60日）是否趨於集中。"},
                {"B2", "法人動向追蹤：判斷法人共識程度。"},
                {"B3", "籌碼分深挖：判斷是主力吸籌還是獲利了結。"},
                {"B4", "資券使用率預警：判斷散戶與專業投資者的對抗強度。"},
                {"C1", "K-D 多週期分析：對比日、週、月趨勢階段。"},
                {"C2", "MACD 動能分析：分析價格動能是否衰減。"},
                {"C3", "乖離率風險評估：建議回調價格區間。"},
                {"C4", "量能突破判定：判斷量能是否支撐目前漲幅。"},
                {"D1", "進場時機建議：應採『分批買進』還是『等待回調』？"},
                {"D2", "止損止盈建議：建議合理的止損位與目標價。"},
                {"D3", "波段持有分析：該股是否適合波段操作。"},
                {"D4", "隱藏風險挖掘：尋找數據中的轉弱訊號。"},
                {"E1", "量價背離偵測：檢查是否存在量價或籌碼背離。"},
                {"E2", "潛伏低位偵測：搜尋是否符合低位金叉潛伏特徵。"},
                {"E3", "過熱警報分析：判斷是否為典型的主力出貨訊號。"},
                {"E4", "極速反轉預測：判斷是否處於空轉多的臨界點。"}
            }

            Dim taskDesc = If(taskLib.ContainsKey(taskId), taskLib(taskId), "綜合診斷")
            Dim finalPrompt = "【診斷任務】：" & taskDesc & vbCrLf & "【個股即時數據】：" & stockDataJson

            Dim result = CallOpenRouterWithFallback(finalPrompt, systemPrompt)
            Return New With {.success = True, .analysis = result, .taskName = taskId}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' 👑【圖表數據獲取函數】：內建盤中自動隨動運算與快取刷新防線
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetStockTrendData(ByVal stockId As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim list As New List(Of Object)
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(GetConnString())
                Using cmdLive As New SqlCommand("EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_CalcIntradayStockLive @StockCode = @id", conn)
                    cmdLive.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", stockId.Trim())
                    conn.Open()
                    cmdLive.ExecuteNonQuery()
                    conn.Close()
                End Using

                Using cmdRefresh As New SqlCommand("EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_RefreshIntradayScoreCache_Single @StockCode = @id", conn)
                    cmdRefresh.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", stockId.Trim())
                    conn.Open()
                    cmdRefresh.ExecuteNonQuery()
                    conn.Close()
                End Using

                Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 10 名稱, 代號, 日期, 盤中現價, 專家實戰總分 " &
                                   "FROM MasterStockAnalysis WHERE 代號 = @id ORDER BY 日期 DESC"
                Using cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", stockId.Trim())
                    conn.Open()
                    Using dr As SqlDataReader = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                        While dr.Read()
                            list.Add(New With {
                                .date = dr("日期").ToString(),
                                .price = Convert.ToDouble(dr("盤中現價")),
                                .goldCount = Convert.ToDouble(dr("專家實戰總分"))
                            })
                        End While
                    End Using
                End Using
            End Using
            list.Reverse()
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = list}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [功能 4]：全市場產業熱力診斷
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetIndustryAnalysis(ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim rows As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(GetConnString())
                Dim sql = "SELECT TOP 10 [產業分類], ROUND(AVG(CAST([一日漲幅] AS FLOAT)), 2) as [平均漲幅], AVG([均價黃金交叉次數]) as [平均金叉] " &
                          "FROM [View_AI_Stock_Pro] WHERE [日期] = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM winnewdate) " &
                          "GROUP BY [產業分類] ORDER BY [平均漲幅] DESC"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                conn.Open()
                Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("industry", dr("產業分類").ToString())
                        row.Add("avg_change", dr("平均漲幅"))
                        row.Add("avg_gold", dr("平均金叉"))
                        rows.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using

            Dim systemPrompt As String = "你是一位資深總經與板塊策略師。請根據產業平均漲幅數據，精準點評今日資金流向與熱點族群，使用繁體中文。"
            Dim prompt = "今日產業數據：" & New JavaScriptSerializer().Serialize(rows)
            Dim analysis = CallOpenRouterWithFallback(prompt, systemPrompt)
            Return New With {.success = True, .analysis = analysis, .rawData = rows}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [功能 5]：歷史勝率回測
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetWinRateAnalysis(ByVal stockId As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim historyData As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(GetConnString())
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 240 b.[日期], b.[成交價], w.[均價黃金交叉次數] " &
                                   "FROM [basicinfo] AS b " &
                                   "INNER JOIN [winnewdate] AS w ON b.[代號] = w.[股票代號] AND b.[日期] = w.[日期] " &
                                   "WHERE b.[代號] = @id " &
                                   "ORDER BY b.[日期] ASC"

                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", stockId)
                conn.Open()
                Using dr As SqlDataReader = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("d", dr("日期").ToString())
                        row.Add("p", Val(dr("成交價").ToString()))
                        row.Add("g", Val(dr("均價黃金交叉次數").ToString()))
                        historyData.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using

            If historyData.Count = 0 Then Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "無歷史資料"}

            Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
            Dim systemPrompt As String = "你是一位量化回測分析師。請分析一年期歷史數據，嚴禁 LaTeX 與 Markdown 標題，請直接使用純中文描述。"
            Dim prompt As String = "【數據說明】：d=日期, p=價格, g=金叉次數。" & vbCrLf &
                "【任務】：1.找出所有 g >= 7 的日期。 2.計算出現訊號後 5 天內的漲跌。 3.若無 g>=7 則分析 g>=4。 4.總結勝率並給出 80 字內操作建議。" & vbCrLf &
                "數據：" & jss.Serialize(historyData)

            Dim aiReport = CallOpenRouterWithFallback(prompt, systemPrompt)
            Return New With {.success = True, .analysis = aiReport}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' =========================================================================
    ' 🚀【全新核心引擎】：OpenRouter 5 重全自動防護呼叫函式 (含 Cloudflare 穿透)
    ' =========================================================================
    Private Shared Function CallOpenRouterWithFallback(ByVal promptText As String, Optional ByVal systemPrompt As String = "你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監。分析內容請一針見血，條理分明，全部使用繁體中文回覆。") As String
        ' 🎯 5 大活躍免費大模型梯隊 (多重容錯)
        Dim modelIds As String() = {
            "openrouter/free",
            "google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:free",
            "meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct:free",
            "qwen/qwen-2.5-coder-32b-instruct:free",
            "inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash:free"
        }

        Dim lastErrorMsg As String = ""

        For Each modelId In modelIds
            Try
                Dim reply As String = CallSingleOpenRouterAPI(modelId, promptText, systemPrompt)
                If Not String.IsNullOrEmpty(reply) Then
                    Return reply.Trim()
                End If
            Catch ex As Exception
                lastErrorMsg = "[" & modelId & "]: " & ex.Message
            End Try
        Next

        Throw New Exception("OpenRouter 模型目前皆繁忙，請稍候 5~10 秒重試 (" & lastErrorMsg & ")")
    End Function

    Private Shared Function CallSingleOpenRouterAPI(ByVal modelId As String, ByVal promptText As String, ByVal systemPrompt As String) As String
        ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol = SecurityProtocolType.Tls12 Or CType(3072, SecurityProtocolType)

        Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(OPENROUTER_URL), HttpWebRequest)
        request.Method = "POST"
        request.ContentType = "application/json; charset=utf-8"
        ' 🟢 關鍵修復 1：加上真實瀏覽器 User-Agent，徹底穿透 Cloudflare WAF 防火牆
        request.UserAgent = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
        request.Headers.Add("Authorization", "Bearer " & OPENROUTER_API_KEY.Trim())
        request.Headers.Add("HTTP-Referer", "https://zen2965.duckdns.org")
        request.Headers.Add("X-Title", "Zen AI StockMaster2 Pro")
        request.Timeout = 35000

        Dim requestBody As New With {
            .model = modelId,
            .messages = New Object() {
                New With {.role = "system", .content = systemPrompt},
                New With {.role = "user", .content = promptText}
            },
            .temperature = 0.5
        }

        Dim js As New JavaScriptSerializer()
        Dim jsonStr As String = js.Serialize(requestBody)
        Dim byteArray As Byte() = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(jsonStr)
        request.ContentLength = byteArray.Length

        Using dataStream As Stream = request.GetRequestStream()
            dataStream.Write(byteArray, 0, byteArray.Length)
        End Using

        Using response As WebResponse = request.GetResponse()
            Using streamReader As New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream(), Encoding.UTF8)
                Dim responseJson As String = streamReader.ReadToEnd()
                Dim parsed As Dictionary(Of String, Object) = js.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(responseJson)

                If parsed IsNot Nothing AndAlso parsed.ContainsKey("choices") Then
                    Dim choicesList As ArrayList = TryCast(parsed("choices"), ArrayList)
                    If choicesList IsNot Nothing AndAlso choicesList.Count > 0 Then
                        Dim firstChoice As Dictionary(Of String, Object) = TryCast(choicesList(0), Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                        If firstChoice IsNot Nothing AndAlso firstChoice.ContainsKey("message") Then
                            Dim messageObj As Dictionary(Of String, Object) = TryCast(firstChoice("message"), Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                            If messageObj IsNot Nothing AndAlso messageObj.ContainsKey("content") Then
                                Return messageObj("content").ToString()
                            End If
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
            End Using
        End Using

        Return ""
    End Function

    ' =========================================================
    ' 👑【核心與盾牌二】：常見欄位與繁簡體自動清洗對齊器
    ' =========================================================
    Private Shared Function CleanSqlResult(ByVal sql As String) As String
        Dim res = sql.Replace("
sql", "").Replace("
", "").Replace(";", "").Trim()

        Dim tempSql As String = res.ToUpper()
        Dim testSql As String = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(tempSql, "/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", "").Trim()

        If Not String.IsNullOrEmpty(testSql) AndAlso
           Not testSql.StartsWith("SELECT") AndAlso
           Not testSql.StartsWith("WITH") AndAlso
           Not testSql.StartsWith("EXEC") Then
            res = "SELECT " & res
        End If

        res = res.Replace("Experts 寞性實戰總分", "實戰總分")
        res = res.Replace("Expert 寞性實戰總分", "實戰總分")
        res = res.Replace("Experts 寞性實戰總分黃金交叉次數", "實戰總分黃金交叉次數")
        res = res.Replace("Experts 寞性", "實戰")
        res = res.Replace("Expert 寞性", "實戰")
        res = res.Replace("寞性實戰", "實戰")
        res = res.Replace("寞性", "實戰")
        res = res.Replace("Experts 實戰總分", "實戰總分")
        res = res.Replace("Expert 實戰總分", "實戰總分")
        res = res.Replace("Experts 實戰", "實戰")
        res = res.Replace("Expert 實戰", "實戰")
        res = res.Replace("專家實戰總分_ma", "實戰總分_ma")
        res = res.Replace("專家 實戰總分_ma", "實戰總分_ma")
        res = res.Replace("專家實戰總分黃金交叉次數", "實戰總分黃金交叉次數")

        res = res.Replace("专家", "專家").Replace("专", "專")
        res = res.Replace("实战", "實戰").Replace("实", "實")
        res = res.Replace("标签", "標籤").Replace("标", "標").Replace("签", "籤")
        res = res.Replace("亿", "億")
        res = res.Replace("名称", "名稱").Replace("称", "稱")
        res = res.Replace("均价", "均價").Replace("价", "價")
        res = res.Replace("黄交", "黃金交叉").Replace("黄", "黃")
        res = res.Replace("總分", "總分")
        res = res.Replace("累計", "累計")

        res = res.Replace("交易量", "盤中總量")
        res = res.Replace("最新價格", "盤中現價")
        res = res.Replace("最新價", "盤中現價")
        res = res.Replace("收盤價", "盤中現價")
        res = res.Replace("資料 日期", "日期")
        res = res.Replace("資料日期", "日期")
        res = res.Replace("交易日期", "日期")
        res = res.Replace("交易[日期]", "日期")
        res = res.Replace("OBV金叉總數", "obv累積金叉次數")
        res = res.Replace("OBV累積金叉次數", "obv累積金叉次數")
        res = res.Replace("OBV_累積金叉", "obv累積金叉次數")
        res = res.Replace("股票代号", "代號").Replace("股票代號", "代號").Replace("股票名稱", "名稱")

        res = res.Replace("代號 LIKE N'%聯發科%'", "名稱 LIKE N'%聯發科%'")
        res = res.Replace("代號 LIKE '%聯發科%'", "名稱 LIKE N'%聯發科%'")

        res = res.Replace("DISTINCT TOP 100 DISTINCT", "DISTINCT TOP 100")
        res = res.Replace("DISTINCT DISTINCT", "DISTINCT")

        res = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(res, "\][\u4e00-\u9fa5]+", "]")

        If res.Contains("DATEADD") Then
            res = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(res, "AND\s+\[?日期\]?\s*>=?\s*DATEADD\(.*?\)", "")
            res = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(res, "WHERE\s+\[?日期\]?\s*>=?\s*DATEADD\(.*?\)", "WHERE 1=1")
        End If

        Return res.Trim()
    End Function

    ' =========================================================
    ' 👑【核心新增】：知識庫雙向模糊直通匹配器
    ' =========================================================
    Private Shared Function LookupKBMatch(ByVal userSpeech As String) As String
        Dim matchedSql As String = ""
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(GetConnString())
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 1 CorrectSQL " &
                                   "FROM stockchangedate.dbo.AIEngineeringKB " &
                                   "WHERE UserPrompt LIKE N'%' + @speech + N'%' " &
                                   "ORDER BY QueryCount DESC, ID DESC"
                Using cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@speech", userSpeech.Trim())
                    conn.Open()
                    Dim result = cmd.ExecuteScalar()
                    If result IsNot Nothing Then
                        matchedSql = result.ToString().Trim()
                        IncrementQueryCount(userSpeech.Trim())
                    End If
                End Using
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception
        End Try
        Return matchedSql
    End Function

    Private Shared Sub IncrementQueryCount(ByVal userSpeech As String)
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(GetConnString())
                Dim sql As String = "UPDATE stockchangedate.dbo.AIEngineeringKB " &
                                   "SET QueryCount = QueryCount + 1, LastUsedDate = GETDATE() " &
                                   "WHERE UserPrompt LIKE N'%' + @speech + N'%'"
                Using cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@speech", userSpeech.Trim())
                    conn.Open()
                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
                End Using
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception
        End Try
    End Sub

    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function DeletePlan(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(GetConnString())
                conn.Open()
                Dim sql = "DELETE FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid; DELETE FROM TravelPlans WHERE PlanID = @pid;"
                Using cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
                End Using
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

Comparing AI Outputs Now I'm diving deeper into the nuances between the AI outputs. I see clear distinctions in how the OpenRouter model (Image 1) and the Ollama 7B model (Image 2) approach scoring and identifying strengths/weaknesses, even though they analyzed the same stock and task. The scoring systems are completely different: 10 points versus 26 points. The strongest and weakest aspects are also distinct, and the OpenRouter one uses a subjective label, while Ollama provides the specific sub-scores for each section. This requires further analysis to understand the impact of these backend variations. Investigating Score Derivation I'm now zeroing in on the scoring discrepancies. The critical question is the origin of the 1, 2, 3, 4, 0 values. My focus is on tracing these values back to their source, specifically examining `stockDataJson` and the SQL query results. It seems the SQL in `stockmaster2.html` didn't include the sub-scores. This makes me curious about what data actually *was* passed to the AI in that case. I'm cross-referencing `stockmaster.html` to find out how the row data differs between the two HTML files when the "AI診斷" button is pressed. Uncovering Data Origins I'm now tracing the root of these discrepancies to the data itself. The crucial point is the absence of score columns (`OBV分`, etc.) in the JSON row data. This absence is the reason for the hallucinated scores across both models. The older Ollama 7B simply fabricated scores, while OpenRouter, despite a clearer prompt, also had to make up the missing values. However, OpenRouter still accurately interpreted the table data it *did* have, and derived its conclusions correctly. I'm focusing on why those score columns were missing in the older SQL query. Pinpointing Missing Data I'm now zeroing in on the outputs from the Ollama 7B model (Image 2), which is filled with boilerplate text like "Inventory growth shows the mentality of major holders" and "Attention should be paid to the risk of adjustment." I can see how both models diverged due to the missing sub-scores. The root cause comes down to the table displayed on screen, "20日 POC 主力大底成本線," which lacks the `[OBV分]`, `[價均分]`, `[技術分]`, `[籌碼分]`, `[量能分]`, and `[專家實戰總分]` columns in its query. The models were forced to invent the missing sub-scores due to the prompt referencing those nonexistent fields. The real question now is how to fix this in `stockai2.aspx.vb` and `stockmaster2.html`. Implementing Data Fix I've realized the path forward: Within `stockai2.aspx.vb`, before the AI call, I will *always* query the database for the actual sub-scores, based on the stock code, and merge them into the JSON. This ensures the AI receives genuine data, regardless of the screen's current SQL. This should eliminate all score hallucinations, as the models will have genuine score columns to base their decisions on.

vb
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    ' [功能 2]：專家深度診斷 (自動從資料庫補齊 5 大分數真實數據)
    ' ---------------------------------------------------------
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function AnalyzeExpertTask(ByVal stockDataJson As String, ByVal taskId As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim js As New JavaScriptSerializer()
            Dim parsedRow As Dictionary(Of String, Object) = Nothing
            Try
                parsedRow = js.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(stockDataJson)
            Catch
            End Try

            Dim stockCode As String = ""
            If parsedRow IsNot Nothing AndAlso parsedRow.ContainsKey("代號") Then
                stockCode = parsedRow("代號").ToString().Trim()
            End If

            ' 🟢 若有代號，自動向資料庫查詢真實的 5 大分項與實戰總分
            Dim realScoreInfo As String = ""
            If Not String.IsNullOrEmpty(stockCode) Then
                Try
                    Using conn As New SqlConnection(GetConnString())
                        Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 1 盤中現價, OBV分, 價均分, 技術分, 籌碼分, 量能分, 專家實戰總分, 實戰標籤 " &
                                           "FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis WHERE RTRIM(代號) = @id ORDER BY 日期 DESC"
                        Using cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", stockCode)
                            conn.Open()
                            Using dr As SqlDataReader = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                                If dr.Read() Then
                                    realScoreInfo = String.Format("【資料庫真實總分指標】：專家實戰總分 {0} 分 (OBV分: {1}, 價均分: {2}, 技術分: {3}, 籌碼分: {4}, 量能分: {5})，實戰標籤: 【{6}】",
                                        dr("專家實戰總分"), dr("OBV分"), dr("價均分"), dr("技術分"), dr("籌碼分"), dr("量能分"), dr("實戰標籤"))
                                End If
                            End Using
                        End Using
                    End Using
                Catch
                End Try
            End If

            Dim systemPrompt As String = "你是一位頂尖台股量化操盤總監與籌碼專家。請嚴格根據提供的真實數據回答，規範如下：" & vbCrLf &
                "1. 嚴禁胡亂編造數據，必須 100% 依據提供的分數與數值進行分析。" & vbCrLf &
                "2. 嚴禁使用 LaTeX 符號 ($、\ge) 或 Markdown 標題 (###)。" & vbCrLf &
                "3. 簡潔條列式，100 字內，全部使用繁體中文，一針見血。"

            Dim taskLib As New Dictionary(Of String, String) From {
                {"A1", "全方位健康檢查：給出 1-10 投資信心分。"},
                {"A2", "實戰標籤解析：解釋目前標籤對操作的意義。"},
                {"A3", "總分拆解分析：指出該股最強與最弱的環節。"},
                {"A4", "短線爆發潛力：分析是否具備短線快速拉升條件。"},
                {"B1", "大戶鎖碼分析：判斷籌碼（1-60日）是否趨於集中。"},
                {"B2", "法人動向追蹤：判斷法人共識程度。"},
                {"B3", "籌碼分深挖：判斷是主力吸籌還是獲利了結。"},
                {"B4", "資券使用率預警：判斷散戶與專業投資者的對抗強度。"},
                {"C1", "K-D 多週期分析：對比日、週、月趨勢階段。"},
                {"C2", "MACD 動能分析：分析價格動能是否衰減。"},
                {"C3", "乖離率風險評估：建議回調價格區間。"},
                {"C4", "量能突破判定：判斷量能是否支撐目前漲幅。"},
                {"D1", "進場時機建議：應採『分批買進』還是『等待回調』？"},
                {"D2", "止損止盈建議：建議合理的止損位與目標價。"},
                {"D3", "波段持有分析：該股是否適合波段操作。"},
                {"D4", "隱藏風險挖掘：尋找數據中的轉弱訊號。"},
                {"E1", "量價背離偵測：檢查是否存在量價或籌碼背離。"},
                {"E2", "潛伏低位偵測：搜尋是否符合低位金叉潛伏特徵。"},
                {"E3", "過熱警報分析：判斷是否為典型的主力出貨訊號。"},
                {"E4", "極速反轉預測：判斷是否處於空轉多的臨界點。"}
            }

            Dim taskDesc = If(taskLib.ContainsKey(taskId), taskLib(taskId), "綜合診斷")
            Dim finalPrompt = "【診斷任務】：" & taskDesc & vbCrLf &
                If(Not String.IsNullOrEmpty(realScoreInfo), realScoreInfo & vbCrLf, "") &
                "【前端畫面即時數據】：" & stockDataJson

            Dim result = CallOpenRouterWithFallback(finalPrompt, systemPrompt)
            Return New With {.success = True, .analysis = result, .taskName = taskId}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

import os

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

if sys.stderr and hasattr(sys.stderr, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

engine = create_engine(engine_url, pool_size=10, max_overflow=20)
TARGET_TABLE = "dbo.notioninfo"

# 🟢 OpenRouter API 配置
OPENROUTER_API_KEY = "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"
OPENROUTER_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions"

HEADERS = {
    "Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENROUTER_API_KEY.strip()}",

    "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",

}

MODEL_TIERS = [
    ("openrouter/free", "🌐 OpenRouter 官方動態分流"),
    ("inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash:free", "📈 Ling-3.0-Flash (104B 金融專用)"),
    ("nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free", "⚡ NVIDIA Nemotron (120B 旗艦大腦)")
]

# 線程安全鎖與進度計數器
print_lock = threading.Lock()
processed_count = 0

# ==========================================
# 🗄️【2. 資料庫查詢：找出需擴充標籤的股票】
# ==========================================
def get_stocks_to_upgrade():
    """找出標籤數少於 6 個且非 Expert 專家手動維護的股票"""
    sql = """
    SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(M.名稱) as 名稱 
    FROM dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    LEFT JOIN dbo.notioninfo N ON RTRIM(M.名稱) = RTRIM(N.mail1)
    WHERE (
          N.word1 IS NULL
          OR (
              N.word1 NOT LIKE '%Expert%'
              AND (LEN(ISNULL(N.name1, '')) - LEN(REPLACE(ISNULL(N.name1, ''), '|', '')) < 5)
          )
      )
      AND (N.word1 NOT LIKE '%Expert%' OR N.word1 IS NULL)
    """
    try:
        return pd.read_sql(sql, engine)
    except Exception as e:
        with print_lock:
            print(f"❌ 讀取資料庫失敗: {e}")
        return pd.DataFrame()

# ==========================================
# 🧠【3. 呼叫 OpenRouter 70B~120B 三級輪詢大模型】
# ==========================================
def ask_openrouter_fallback(names_str):
    prompt = f"""你現在是台股產業百科全書與嚴謹的量化專家。請針對名單中的台股公司，給出真實且精確的產業題材標籤。

⚠️ 嚴格防幻覺規範：
1. 實事求是：高科技/AI/半導體公司給予 6~10 個精準標籤；傳統產業（如食品、紡織、鋼鐵、建材、塑化、紙業）給予 3~5 個真實產業核心標籤！
2. 嚴禁亂塞流行詞：若該公司非 CPO 矽光子、CoWoS、NVIDIA、TPU、800G 交換器、液冷散熱供應鏈，絕對禁止出現相關標籤！

輸出格式規範：
每檔股票一行，格式必須嚴格為：『股票名稱:標籤1 | 標籤2 | 標籤3 | 標籤4』
嚴禁任何開場白、結尾或多餘解釋。

待分析名單：{names_str}"""

    for model_id, model_name in MODEL_TIERS:
        payload = {
            "model": model_id,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": "你是一位專精台股產業價值鏈與量化標籤的資深研究員，只輸出規範格式，嚴禁多餘文字。"},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt}
            ],
            "temperature": 0.4
        }

        try:
            r = requests.post(OPENROUTER_URL, headers=HEADERS, json=payload, timeout=40)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                res_json = r.json()
                if "choices" in res_json and len(res_json["choices"]) > 0:
                    content = res_json["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
                    if content and ":" in content:
                        return content.strip(), model_name
            elif r.status_code == 429:
                time.sleep(1.5) # 遇到頻率限制短暫退避
        except Exception:
            pass

    return "", "全部模型忙碌"

# ==========================================
# 💾【4. 資料庫寫入 (線程安全先刪後插)】
# ==========================================
def clean_and_insert(name, concepts, model_name):
    current_date = time.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    try:
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            conn.execute(
                text("DELETE FROM dbo.notioninfo WHERE mail1 = :name AND (word1 NOT LIKE '%Expert%' OR word1 IS NULL)"),
                {"name": name}
            )
            insert_sql = text(f"""
                INSERT INTO {TARGET_TABLE} (name1, mail1, word1, 時間戳記)
                VALUES (:concepts, :name, :word, :ts)
            """)
            conn.execute(insert_sql, {
                "concepts": concepts,
                "name": name,
                "word": f"{name}(OpenRouter大模型100B+)",
                "ts": current_date
            })
        with print_lock:
            print(f"   ├─ 👑 [{model_name}] {name}: {concepts}")
    except Exception as e:
        with print_lock:
            print(f"   └─ ❌ 寫入 {name} 失敗: {e}")

# ==========================================
# ⚡【5. 批次處理任務】
# ==========================================
def process_batch(batch_names, total_count):
    global processed_count
    names_str = ", ".join(batch_names)
    
    raw_output, model_name = ask_openrouter_fallback(names_str)
    success_count = 0

    if raw_output:
        for line in raw_output.strip().split('\n'):
            line = line.strip()
            # 處理 DeepSeek 思考標籤或 Markdown 符號
            if line.startswith("•") or line.startswith("-"):
                line = line[1:].strip()
            if ":" in line or "：" in line:
                sep = ":" if ":" in line else "："
                parts = line.split(sep, 1)
                if len(parts) == 2:
                    s_name = parts[0].strip().replace("*", "").replace("【", "").replace("】", "")
                    s_concepts = parts[1].strip().replace("*", "")
                    if 1 < len(s_name) < 12 and len(s_concepts) > 3:
                        clean_and_insert(s_name, s_concepts, model_name)
                        success_count += 1

    with print_lock:
        processed_count += len(batch_names)
        print(f"⚡ [進度 {processed_count}/{total_count}] 批次完成 (成功解析 {success_count} 檔): {names_str}")

# ==========================================
# 🚀【6. 主執行流程 (多線程並行)】
# ==========================================
if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("=" * 70)
    print("🚀 【Zen AI 產業基因標籤庫：OpenRouter 70B~120B 大模型擴充引擎 V6.0】")
    print(f"⏰ 當前時間: {time.strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print("🎯 模型梯隊: OpenRouter Free ➔ Ling-3.0 (104B 金融專用) ➔ Nemotron (120B)")

    print("\n🔍 正在掃描資料庫中標籤不足 6 個之股票...")
    df_list = get_stocks_to_upgrade()
    total = len(df_list)

    if total == 0:
        print("🎉 恭喜！資料庫中所有股票皆已具備完整 6~15 個高質量產業標籤！")
        sys.exit(0)

    print(f"📊 待補全/升級股票總數: {total} 檔")

    # 批次大小設為 4 檔股票 (平衡 Token 長度與回應速度)
    batch_size = 4
    batches = [df_list['名稱'].iloc[i:i+batch_size].tolist() for i in range(0, total, batch_size)]

    # 啟用 3 個工作線程 (避免免費 API 頻率超限)
    max_threads = 3
    print(f"⚡ 啟用 {max_threads} 個多線程連線池，開始全速生產高質量標籤...\n")

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_threads) as executor:
        futures = [executor.submit(process_batch, batch, total) for batch in batches]
        for future in as_completed(futures):
            try:
                future.result()
            except Exception as e:
                with print_lock:
                    print(f"❌ 線程執行異常: {e}")

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("🎉 🎉 全市場產業基因 100B+ 大模型標籤升級大功告成！")

# 🧠【2. OpenRouter 5 重全自動防護呼叫函式 (含 Cloudflare 穿透)】
# =========================================================================
def call_openrouter_5tier_fallback(prompt_text, system_prompt="你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監。分析內容請一針見血，條理分明，全部使用繁體中文回覆。"):
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENROUTER_API_KEY.strip()}",
        "HTTP-Referer": "https://zen2965.duckdns.org",
        "X-Title": "Zen AI Telegram Bot Pro",
        "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
    }

    last_err = ""
    for model_id, model_name in MODEL_TIERS:
        payload = {
            "model": model_id,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt_text}
            ],
            "temperature": 0.5
        }
        try:
            r = requests.post(OPENROUTER_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=35)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                res_json = r.json()
                if "choices" in res_json and len(res_json["choices"]) > 0:
                    content = res_json["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
                    if content and content.strip():
                        clean_content = content.strip()
                        # 🟢 自動清洗 DeepSeek 等推理模型的 <think> 標籤
                        if "<think>" in clean_content and "</think>" in clean_content:
                            parts = clean_content.split("</think>")
                            clean_content = parts[1].strip()
                        return clean_content, model_name
            elif r.status_code in [429, 503, 500, 404]:
                last_err = f"{model_name} (HTTP {r.status_code})"
                time.sleep(0.8)
        except Exception as e:
            last_err = f"{model_name} ({e})"
            time.sleep(0.5)

    return f"⚠️ 抱歉，目前 5 大頂級 AI 雲端模型節點皆繁忙，請稍候 5~10 秒再試一次。\n(最後狀態: {last_err})", "服務繁忙"

# =========================================================================
# 🗄️【3. 資料庫個股數據穿透查詢】
# =========================================================================
def query_stock_full_data(stock_code_or_name):
    clean_kw = str(stock_code_or_name).strip()
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 1
      A.代號, A.名稱, A.成交價, A.price_ma5, A.price_ma20, A.price_ma60, A.三大法人_ma5, A.三大法人_ma20,
      ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, M.專家實戰總分) AS 實戰總分,
      ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分_ma20, M.專家實戰總分) AS 實戰總分_ma20,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_5MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_5MA, ISNULL(E.Return_5MA, 0.0) AS Return_5MA,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_10MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_10MA, ISNULL(E.Return_10MA, 0.0) AS Return_10MA,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_20MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_20MA, ISNULL(E.Return_20MA, 0.0) AS Return_20MA,
      ISNULL(E.OptimalExit, N'🔥 20MA勝出') AS OptimalExit,
      ISNULL(C5.集中度1日, 0.0) AS 集中度1日, ISNULL(C5.集中度5日, 0.0) AS 集中度5日, ISNULL(C5.集中度20日, 0.0) AS 集中度20日,
      ISNULL(R.HitCount, 0) AS HitCount, ISNULL(R.ResonanceTag, N'常態波段') AS ResonanceTag,
      ISNULL(RAD.[60M動能(OSC)], 0.0) AS OSC_60M, ISNULL(RAD.短線氣象, N'☀️ 轉強') AS 短線氣象,
      ISNULL(FST.預估目標價, 0) AS FactSet目標價
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live A
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory SCH ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(SCH.代號) AND A.日期 = SCH.日期
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits E ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(E.代號)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 代號, 集中度1日, 集中度5日, 集中度20日 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.Chips5 WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM(?) OR RTRIM(名稱) = RTRIM(?) ORDER BY 日期 DESC) C5 ON 1=1
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot R ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar RAD ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(RAD.代號)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT 代號, MAX(預估目標價) AS 預估目標價 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates GROUP BY 代號) FST ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(FST.代號)
    WHERE RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(?) OR RTRIM(A.名稱) = RTRIM(?)
    ORDER BY A.日期 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (clean_kw, clean_kw, clean_kw, clean_kw))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row:
                return {
                    "code": str(row[0]).strip(), "name": str(row[1]).strip(),
                    "price": float(row[2]) if row[2] else 0.0,
                    "m5": float(row[3]) if row[3] else 0.0,
                    "m20": float(row[4]) if row[4] else 0.0,
                    "m60": float(row[5]) if row[5] else 0.0,
                    "f5": float(row[6]) if row[6] else 0.0,
                    "f20": float(row[7]) if row[7] else 0.0,
                    "score": float(row[8]) if row[8] else 0.0,
                    "score20": float(row[9]) if row[9] else 0.0,
                    "w5": float(row[10]) if row[10] else 50.0, "ret5": float(row[11]) if row[11] else 0.0,
                    "w10": float(row[12]) if row[12] else 50.0, "ret10": float(row[13]) if row[13] else 0.0,
                    "w20": float(row[14]) if row[14] else 50.0, "ret20": float(row[15]) if row[15] else 0.0,
                    "optimal": str(row[16]).strip() if row[16] else "🔥 20MA勝出",
                    "c1": float(row[17]) if row[17] else 0.0, "c5": float(row[18]) if row[18] else 0.0, "c20": float(row[19]) if row[19] else 0.0,
                    "hit_count": int(row[20]) if row[20] else 0, "tag": str(row[21]).strip() if row[21] else "常態波段",
                    "osc_60m": float(row[22]) if row[22] else 0.0, "weather": str(row[23]).strip() if row[23] else "☀️ 轉強",
                    "target_price": float(row[24]) if row[24] else 0.0
                }
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 查詢股票異常: {e}")
    return None

@bot.message_handler(commands=['start', 'help'])

        "💡 使用說明：\n"

        "2. 機器人將穿透資料庫，並由 OpenRouter 70B~120B 頂級大模型（五重自動防護） 為您產出深度量化操盤戰報！\n\n"
        "📊 包含：3-Way 離場勝率 PK、Chips5 主力集中度、60M 動能氣象、五維金叉與開盤目標價指引！"
    )

@bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: True)
def handle_all_messages(message):
    user_text = message.text.strip()
    chat_id = message.chat.id
    user_name = message.from_user.first_name or "使用者"

    # 檢查是否為股票代號或個股名稱 (4~6 碼數字或 2~6 字中文)
    is_stock_query = re.match(r'^[0-9A-Za-z]{4,6}$', user_text) or (len(user_text) <= 6 and not any(ch in user_text for ch in ['?', '？', '！', '!', ' ', '\n']))

    if is_stock_query:
        # 發送「正在思考」等待提示
        wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"⏳ 正在穿透資料庫撈取【{user_text}】最新量化數據，並由 OpenRouter 頂級大腦進行五維推演中...")

        stock = query_stock_full_data(user_text)
        if not stock:
            bot.edit_message_text(f"❌ 找不到股票【{user_text}】，請確認代號或名稱是否正確（例: 2330 或 台積電）。", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            return

        # 組裝數值字串
        f5_str = f"買超 {stock['f5']:.1f} 張" if stock['f5'] >= 0 else f"賣超 {abs(stock['f5']):.1f} 張"
        f20_str = f"買超 {stock['f20']:.1f} 張" if stock['f20'] >= 0 else f"賣超 {abs(stock['f20']):.1f} 張"
        score_str = f"+{stock['score']:.2f} 分" if stock['score'] >= 0 else f"{stock['score']:.2f} 分"
        chip_str = f"Chips5主力集中度(1日 {stock['c1']}%、5日 {stock['c5']}%、20日 {stock['c20']}%)"
        target_str = f"外資FactSet目標價 {stock['target_price']}元" if stock['target_price'] > 0 else "暫無外資目標價"

        # 3-Way 勝率文字卡
        r5_sign = "+" if stock['ret5'] >= 0 else ""
        r10_sign = "+" if stock['ret10'] >= 0 else ""
        r20_sign = "+" if stock['ret20'] >= 0 else ""
        pk_block = (
            f"📊 該股歷史離場戰術實測 PK（站 5MA 買進）：\n"
            f"├─ 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w5']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r5_sign}{stock['ret5']:.2f}%\n"
            f"├─ ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w10']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r10_sign}{stock['ret10']:.2f}%\n"
            f"└─ 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w20']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r20_sign}{stock['ret20']:.2f}%\n"
            f"🎯 最適建議：【{stock['optimal']}】"
        )

        prompt = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監。使用者正在看你發送的「一鍵四大圖表同步聯動共振圖」。
請解說【{stock['code']} {stock['name']}】最新盤後量化數據：
- 現價：{stock['price']}元 | 5MA：{stock['m5']}元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']}元 | 60MA：{stock['m60']}元
- 三大法人5MA {f5_str}、20MA {f20_str} | 實戰總分 {score_str} (20日均分 {stock['score20']:.2f}分)
- {chip_str} | {target_str}
- 60M OSC {stock['osc_60m']} (短線氣象：{stock['weather']}) | 當前為【{stock['hit_count']}維共振 ({stock['tag']})】
- {pk_block}

請嚴格分成以下五大段，每段 60~90 字，精準一針見血：
📌 【圖一：價格與均線防守】
📌 【圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振】
📌 【圖二：OBV星號與籌碼鎖碼解讀】
📌 【圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振】
📌 【指揮官實戰總結指引】（給出下營業日開盤目標價、防守價與本金凱利部位％配置建議）
請全部使用繁體中文回覆。"""

        # 調用 OpenRouter 5 重輪詢
        ai_reply, model_name = call_openrouter_5tier_fallback(prompt)

        header_msg = (
            f"👑 【{stock['code']} {stock['name']}】量化操盤戰術報告\n"
            f"⚡ 響應大腦：`{model_name}`\n"
            f"📍 現價：`{stock['price']} 元` │ 實戰總分：`{score_str}`\n"
            f"────────────────────────\n"
            f"{pk_block}\n"
            f"────────────────────────\n\n"
        )

        final_msg = header_msg + ai_reply
        bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
        
        # 若訊息過長分段發送
        if len(final_msg) > 4000:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, final_msg[:4000])
            bot.send_message(chat_id, final_msg[4000:])
        else:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, final_msg)

    else:
        # 一般自由對話
        ai_reply, model_name = call_openrouter_5tier_fallback(
            prompt_text=user_text,
            system_prompt="你是一位專精台股量化交易與籌碼分析的 AI 操盤總監，請親切、專業、條理分明地使用繁體中文回答使用者的問題。"
        )
        bot.reply_to(message, f"🤖 [{model_name}]\n\n{ai_reply}")

# ==========================================
# 🚀【5. 機器人長輪詢主程式】
# ==========================================
def main():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Telegram 雙向對話操盤機器人 V2.0 (OpenRouter 版)】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 啟動時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print("🎯 核心模型: OpenRouter 5 重自動防護輪詢 (70B~120B)")
    print("📡 正在監聽 Telegram 雙向訊息中... (按 Ctrl+C 可停止)")
    print("=" * 70)

    while True:
        try:
            bot.infinity_polling(timeout=20, long_polling_timeout=15)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ 網路波動重試中: {e}")
            time.sleep(3)

def call_openrouter_5tier_fallback(prompt_text, system_prompt="你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監。分析內容請一針見血，條理分明，全部使用繁體中文回覆。"):
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENROUTER_API_KEY.strip()}",
        "HTTP-Referer": "https://zen2965.duckdns.org",
        "X-Title": "Zen AI Telegram Bot R-Edition",
        "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
    }

    last_err = ""
    for model_id, model_name in MODEL_TIERS:
        payload = {
            "model": model_id,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt_text}
            ],
            "temperature": 0.5
        }
        try:
            r = requests.post(OPENROUTER_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=35)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                res_json = r.json()
                if "choices" in res_json and len(res_json["choices"]) > 0:
                    content = res_json["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
                    if content and content.strip():
                        clean_content = content.strip()
                        if "<think>" in clean_content and "</think>" in clean_content:
                            parts = clean_content.split("</think>")
                            clean_content = parts[1].strip()
                        return clean_content, model_name
            elif r.status_code in [429, 503, 500, 404]:
                last_err = f"{model_name} (HTTP {r.status_code})"
                time.sleep(0.8)
        except Exception as e:
            last_err = f"{model_name} ({e})"
            time.sleep(0.5)

    return f"⚠️ 抱歉，目前 5 大頂級 AI 雲端模型節點皆繁忙，請稍候 5~10 秒再試一次。\n(最後狀態: {last_err})", "服務繁忙"

def query_stock_full_data(stock_code_or_name):
    clean_kw = str(stock_code_or_name).strip()
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 1
      A.代號, A.名稱, A.成交價, A.price_ma5, A.price_ma20, A.price_ma60, A.三大法人_ma5, A.三大法人_ma20,
      ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, M.專家實戰總分) AS 實戰總分,
      ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分_ma20, M.專家實戰總分) AS 實戰總分_ma20,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_5MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_5MA, ISNULL(E.Return_5MA, 0.0) AS Return_5MA,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_10MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_10MA, ISNULL(E.Return_10MA, 0.0) AS Return_10MA,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_20MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_20MA, ISNULL(E.Return_20MA, 0.0) AS Return_20MA,
      ISNULL(E.OptimalExit, N'🔥 20MA勝出') AS OptimalExit,
      ISNULL(C5.集中度1日, 0.0) AS 集中度1日, ISNULL(C5.集中度5日, 0.0) AS 集中度5日, ISNULL(C5.集中度20日, 0.0) AS 集中度20日,
      ISNULL(R.HitCount, 0) AS HitCount, ISNULL(R.ResonanceTag, N'常態波段') AS ResonanceTag,
      ISNULL(RAD.[60M動能(OSC)], 0.0) AS OSC_60M, ISNULL(RAD.短線氣象, N'☀️ 轉強') AS 短線氣象,
      ISNULL(FST.預估目標價, 0) AS FactSet目標價
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live A
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory SCH ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(SCH.代號) AND A.日期 = SCH.日期
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits E ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(E.代號)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 代號, 集中度1日, 集中度5日, 集中度20日 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.Chips5 WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM(?) OR RTRIM(名稱) = RTRIM(?) ORDER BY 日期 DESC) C5 ON 1=1
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot R ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar RAD ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(RAD.代號)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT 代號, MAX(預估目標價) AS 預估目標價 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates GROUP BY 代號) FST ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(FST.代號)
    WHERE RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(?) OR RTRIM(A.名稱) = RTRIM(?)
    ORDER BY A.日期 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (clean_kw, clean_kw, clean_kw, clean_kw))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row:
                return {
                    "code": str(row[0]).strip(), "name": str(row[1]).strip(),
                    "price": float(row[2]) if row[2] else 0.0,
                    "m5": float(row[3]) if row[3] else 0.0,
                    "m20": float(row[4]) if row[4] else 0.0,
                    "m60": float(row[5]) if row[5] else 0.0,
                    "f5": float(row[6]) if row[6] else 0.0,
                    "f20": float(row[7]) if row[7] else 0.0,
                    "score": float(row[8]) if row[8] else 0.0,
                    "score20": float(row[9]) if row[9] else 0.0,
                    "w5": float(row[10]) if row[10] else 50.0, "ret5": float(row[11]) if row[11] else 0.0,
                    "w10": float(row[12]) if row[12] else 50.0, "ret10": float(row[13]) if row[13] else 0.0,
                    "w20": float(row[14]) if row[14] else 50.0, "ret20": float(row[15]) if row[15] else 0.0,
                    "optimal": str(row[16]).strip() if row[16] else "🔥 20MA勝出",
                    "c1": float(row[17]) if row[17] else 0.0, "c5": float(row[18]) if row[18] else 0.0, "c20": float(row[19]) if row[19] else 0.0,
                    "hit_count": int(row[20]) if row[20] else 0, "tag": str(row[21]).strip() if row[21] else "常態波段",
                    "osc_60m": float(row[22]) if row[22] else 0.0, "weather": str(row[23]).strip() if row[23] else "☀️ 轉強",
                    "target_price": float(row[24]) if row[24] else 0.0
                }
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 查詢股票異常: {e}")
    return None

# 📸【4. Playwright 自動截取四大圖表】
# =========================================================================
async def capture_stock_chart(stock_code):
    clean_code = str(stock_code).strip()
    today = datetime.datetime.now()
    one_year_ago = (today - datetime.timedelta(days=365)).strftime('%Y%m%d')
    timestamp_now = int(time.time() * 1000)

    url = f"https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/excelsql2.html?stock={clean_code}&start={one_year_ago}&_v={timestamp_now}"
    photo_filename = f"chart_{clean_code}_{timestamp_now}.png"
    output_path = os.path.join(STATIC_DIR, photo_filename)

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = await browser.new_context(
            viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 1300},
            ignore_https_errors=True,
            extra_http_headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache"}
        )
        page = await context.new_page()
        try:
            await page.goto(url, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=45000)
            await asyncio.sleep(2.0)

            # 點擊「盤後聯動」按鈕
            btn_post = page.locator("#btn_query_post")
            if await btn_post.count() > 0 and await btn_post.is_visible():
                await btn_post.click()
            else:
                await page.evaluate("""
                    const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, input[type="button"], a'))
                        .find(el => el.textContent.includes('歷史') || el.textContent.includes('聯動'));
                    if (btn) btn.click();
                """)

            await asyncio.sleep(4.5)

            # 畫面淨化 (擷取四大圖表)
            await page.evaluate("""
                const p = document.getElementById('html-chart-price');
                const c = document.getElementById('html-chart-cross');
                const o = document.getElementById('html-chart-obv');
                const s = document.getElementById('html-chart-score');
                if (p && o && s) {
                    const container = document.createElement('div');
                    container.id = 'clean-charts-container';
                    container.style.backgroundColor = '#0c1827';
                    container.style.padding = '10px';
                    container.style.width = '100%';
                    container.appendChild(p);
                    if (c) container.appendChild(c);
                    container.appendChild(o);
                    container.appendChild(s);
                    document.body.insertBefore(container, document.body.firstChild);
                    document.querySelectorAll('body > *').forEach(el => {
                        if (el.id !== 'clean-charts-container') el.style.display = 'none';
                    });
                }
            """)
            await asyncio.sleep(1.5)
            await page.screenshot(path=output_path, full_page=True)
            return output_path
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ 截圖失敗 [{clean_code}]: {e}")
            return None
        finally:
            await browser.close()

# 🔍【5. 60M 低檔金叉選股查詢】
# =========================================================================
def query_kd_cross_stocks():
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 10 代號, 名稱, 分組, 策略靈魂, ROUND([60M動能(OSC)], 2) AS [60M_OSC], ROUND([60M_K值], 1) AS [60M_K], 日線分, 短線氣象
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
    WHERE [短線氣象] LIKE N'%轉強%' OR [60M動能(OSC)] > 5.0
    ORDER BY [60M動能(OSC)] DESC, 日線分 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            return rows
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 查詢金叉失敗: {e}")
        return []

        "4. `找金叉R` 或 `選股R` ➔ 執行 60M 低檔伏兵轉強選股清單。\n\n"
