@bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: True)
def handle_r_commands(message):
    raw_text = message.text.strip()
    chat_id = message.chat.id

    # 🟢 核心過濾：只響應結尾為 'R' 或 'r' 的指令 (確保雙機器人同時運行不衝突！)
    if not (raw_text.endswith("R") or raw_text.endswith("r")):
        return

    # 去除結尾的 'R' 取得乾淨指令
    cmd_text = raw_text[:-1].strip()

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 🎯 指令 4：【找金叉R】或【選股R】
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    if cmd_text in ["找金叉", "選股", "金叉", "60M金叉"]:
        wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, "⏳ 正在掃描全市場 60M 低檔轉強伏兵清單...")
        rows = query_kd_cross_stocks()
        if not rows:
            bot.edit_message_text("⚠️ 目前無符合 60M 轉強之金叉標的。", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            return

        today_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d')
        msg = f"⚡ 【Zen AI 60M 低檔轉強精選榜 (OpenRouter 版)】\n📅 日期：{today_str}\n────────────────────────\n"
        for idx, r in enumerate(rows, 1):
            msg += f"{idx}. 🌟 {r[0]} {r[1]} ({r[2]})\n   ├─ 60M OSC: `+{r[4]}` | 60M K值: `{r[5]}`\n   ├─ 短線氣象: 【{r[7]}】 | 日線總分: `+{r[6]}分`\n   └─ 核心題材: 【{r[3]}】\n"
        msg += "\n👉 輸入 `股號 說明R` (例: `2454 說明R`) 即可生成該股三合一深度戰報！"

        bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
        bot.send_message(chat_id, msg, parse_mode='Markdown')
        return

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 解析個股指令：判斷是「純解盤」、「要圖片」還是「三合一說明」
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    is_mode_desc = bool(re.search(r'(說明|詳細|圖文)', cmd_text)) # Mode 3: 圖片 + 深度解讀
    is_mode_photo = bool(re.search(r'(圖片|截圖|圖表|圖)', cmd_text)) and not is_mode_desc # Mode 2: 圖片 + 傳統解盤

    # 提取股票代號或名稱 (移除「圖片」、「說明」等關鍵字)
    target_stock = re.sub(r'(圖片|截圖|圖表|圖|說明|詳細|圖文)', '', cmd_text).strip()

    if not target_stock:
        bot.reply_to(message, "💡 指令格式：`2408R` (深度解盤)、`2408 圖片R` (圖表)、`2408 說明R` (三合一)", parse_mode='Markdown')
        return

    wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"⏳ 正在穿透資料庫檢索【{target_stock}】並由 OpenRouter 大腦推演中...")

    stock = query_stock_full_data(target_stock)
    if not stock:
        bot.edit_message_text(f"❌ 找不到股票【{target_stock}】，請確認代號或名稱是否正確（例: `2408R`）。", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id, parse_mode='Markdown')
        return

    # 組裝數值字串
    f5_str = f"買超 {stock['f5']:.1f} 張" if stock['f5'] >= 0 else f"賣超 {abs(stock['f5']):.1f} 張"
    f20_str = f"買超 {stock['f20']:.1f} 張" if stock['f20'] >= 0 else f"賣超 {abs(stock['f20']):.1f} 張"
    score_str = f"+{stock['score']:.2f} 分" if stock['score'] >= 0 else f"{stock['score']:.2f} 分"
    chip_str = f"Chips5主力集中度(1日 {stock['c1']}%、5日 {stock['c5']}%、20日 {stock['c20']}%)"
    target_str = f"外資FactSet目標價 {stock['target_price']}元" if stock['target_price'] > 0 else "暫無外資目標價"

    r5_sign = "+" if stock['ret5'] >= 0 else ""
    r10_sign = "+" if stock['ret10'] >= 0 else ""
    r20_sign = "+" if stock['ret20'] >= 0 else ""
    pk_block = (
        f"📊 該股歷史 3-Way 離場戰術實測 PK：\n"
        f"├─ 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w5']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r5_sign}{stock['ret5']:.2f}%\n"
        f"├─ ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w10']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r10_sign}{stock['ret10']:.2f}%\n"
        f"└─ 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w20']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r20_sign}{stock['ret20']:.2f}%\n"
        f"🎯 系統最適建議：【{stock['optimal']}】"
    )

    prompt = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監。使用者正在看你發送的「一鍵四大圖表同步聯動共振圖」。
請解說【{stock['code']} {stock['name']}】最新盤後量化數據：
- 現價：{stock['price']}元 | 5MA：{stock['m5']}元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']}元 | 60MA：{stock['m60']}元
- 三大法人5MA {f5_str}、20MA {f20_str} | 實戰總分 {score_str} (20日均分 {stock['score20']:.2f}分)
- {chip_str} | {target_str}
- 60M OSC {stock['osc_60m']} (短線氣象：{stock['weather']}) | 當前為【{stock['hit_count']}維共振 ({stock['tag']})】
- {pk_block}

請嚴格分成以下五大段，每段 60~90 字，精準一針見血：
📌 【圖一：價格與均線防守】
📌 【圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振】
📌 【圖二：OBV星號與籌碼鎖碼解讀】
📌 【圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振】
📌 【指揮官實戰總結指引】（給出下營業日開盤目標價、防守價與本金凱利部位％配置建議）
請全部使用繁體中文回覆。"""

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 🎯 指令 2：【2408 圖片R】➔ 純截圖 ＋ 傳統摘要
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    if is_mode_photo:
        bot.edit_message_text(f"📷 正在截取【{stock['code']} {stock['name']}】四大圖表...", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
        photo_path = asyncio.run(capture_stock_chart(stock['code']))
        bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)

        caption = (
            f"📊 【{stock['code']} {stock['name']}】四大圖表聯動戰報\n"
            f"📍 現價：`{stock['price']} 元` │ 實戰總分：`{score_str}`\n"
            f"🎯 多維共振：`{stock['hit_count']}維 ({stock['tag']})`\n"
            f"────────────────────────\n"
            f"{pk_block}"
        )
        if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
            with open(photo_path, 'rb') as f:
                bot.send_photo(chat_id, f, caption=caption, parse_mode='Markdown')
        else:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, caption, parse_mode='Markdown')
        return

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 🎯 指令 3：【2408 說明R】➔ 三合一 (四大圖表 ＋ 70B大模型深度圖文解讀)
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    if is_mode_desc:
        bot.edit_message_text(f"📷 正在截取圖表並由 OpenRouter 大腦進行深度推演中...", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
        photo_path = asyncio.run(capture_stock_chart(stock['code']))
        ai_reply, model_name = call_openrouter_5tier_fallback(prompt)
        bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)

        caption_head = (
            f"👑 【{stock['code']} {stock['name']}】三合一深度圖文操盤報告\n"
            f"⚡ 響應大腦：`{model_name}`\n"
            f"📍 現價：`{stock['price']} 元` │ 實戰總分：`{score_str}`\n"
            f"────────────────────────\n"
            f"{pk_block}\n"
            f"────────────────────────\n\n"
        )
        full_report = caption_head + ai_reply

        if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
            with open(photo_path, 'rb') as f:
                if len(full_report) <= 1024:
                    bot.send_photo(chat_id, f, caption=full_report, parse_mode='Markdown')
                else:
                    bot.send_photo(chat_id, f, caption=caption_head, parse_mode='Markdown')
                    bot.send_message(chat_id, ai_reply)
        else:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, full_report)
        return

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 🎯 指令 1：【2408R】➔ OpenRouter 深度純文字五段式解盤
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    ai_reply, model_name = call_openrouter_5tier_fallback(prompt)
    header_msg = (
        f"👑 【{stock['code']} {stock['name']}】量化操盤戰術報告 (OpenRouter 版)\n"
        f"⚡ 響應大腦：`{model_name}`\n"
        f"📍 現價：`{stock['price']} 元` │ 實戰總分：`{score_str}`\n"
        f"────────────────────────\n"
        f"{pk_block}\n"
        f"────────────────────────\n\n"
    )
    final_msg = header_msg + ai_reply
    bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)

    if len(final_msg) > 4000:
        bot.send_message(chat_id, final_msg[:4000])
        bot.send_message(chat_id, final_msg[4000:])
    else:
        bot.send_message(chat_id, final_msg)

# =========================================================================
# 🚀【7. 機器人啟動入口】
# =========================================================================
def main():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Telegram 操盤機器人 V2.0 (OpenRouter *R 專屬版)】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 啟動時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print("🎯 專屬指令: 2408R / 2408 圖片R / 2408 說明R / 找金叉R")
    print("📡 正在監聽 Telegram 訊息... (可與舊版 zen_ai_bot.py 同時執行)")
    print("=" * 70)

    while True:
        try:
            bot.infinity_polling(timeout=20, long_polling_timeout=15)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ 網路波動重試中: {e}")
            time.sleep(3)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

🧠 Gemini 的思考路徑：
Investigating Bot Conflict I'm currently looking into the conflict error related to Telegram's `getUpdates` requests. It seems like the bot is being terminated because of another active instance. I'm focusing on the root cause and how to avoid simultaneous bot execution to keep the bot operational. Clarifying Token Conflicts I've pinpointed the root cause: concurrent bot instances using the same token trigger Telegram's conflict error. The mistake was assuming distinct scripts with the same token would work, but `getUpdates` strictly enforces a single consumer per token. The clean, recommended fix is to merge the scripts into a single bot, routing commands based on the "R" suffix. Alternatively, a separate bot token provides an alternative approach. I'll explain the conflict situation in detail now. Implementing Unified Script I've crafted a unified script, `zen_ai_bot1.py`, to resolve the conflict. It routes requests based on an "R" suffix in the user's command. This allows the bot to choose between local Ollama (default) and OpenRouter (suffix "R") based models. All four command types are now supported for both configurations. I'm focusing on the logic to ensure proper model routing.

Conflict: terminated by other getUpdates request; make sure that only one bot instance is running` * 原因： * Telegram 伺服器規定：同一個 Bot Token（機器人金鑰），同一時間「只能允許一個 Python 程式」連線收訊息 (Polling)。 * 當您同時啟動 `zen_ai_bot.py` 與 `zen_ai_bot1.py` 時，兩支程式使用同一個 Token 互相爭搶連線，會互相把對方踢下線，導致兩邊同時狂噴 409 衝突錯誤！ --- ### 🏆 最佳解決方案：【二合一雙大腦大一統腳本】 我們把 「本地 Ollama 7B」 與 「雲端 OpenRouter 70B~120B」 兩套運算引擎直接整合進 單一的一支 `zen_ai_bot1.py`！ 只需在背景執行這唯一的一支腳本： * 📱 輸入 `2408` / `2408 圖片` / `找金叉` ➔ 自動由 「本地 Ollama 7B」 運算（舊版模式）。 * 📱 輸入 `2408R` / `2408 圖片R` / `找金叉R` ➔ 自動由 「OpenRouter 70B~120B」 運算（新版大腦）。 👉 只需開一個 CMD 視窗，兩種模式無縫共存，徹底根除 409 報錯！ --- ### 📄 請將 `C:\test_c\zen_ai_bot1.py` 完整替換為以下【二合一雙核心正式版】：

        return f"❌ 本地 Ollama 連線失敗: {e}", "Ollama 異常"
    return "❌ 本地 AI 無回應", "Ollama 異常"

# B. 雲端 OpenRouter 5 重防護輪詢 (70B~120B)
def call_openrouter_5tier_fallback(prompt_text, system_prompt="你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監。分析內容請一針見血，條理分明，全部使用繁體中文回覆。"):
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENROUTER_API_KEY.strip()}",
        "HTTP-Referer": "https://zen2965.duckdns.org",
        "X-Title": "Zen AI Telegram Bot Dual-Core",
        "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
    }

    last_err = ""
    for model_id, model_name in MODEL_TIERS:
        payload = {
            "model": model_id,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt_text}
            ],
            "temperature": 0.5
        }
        try:
            r = requests.post(OPENROUTER_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=35)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                res_json = r.json()
                if "choices" in res_json and len(res_json["choices"]) > 0:
                    content = res_json["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
                    if content and content.strip():
                        clean_content = content.strip()
                        if "<think>" in clean_content and "</think>" in clean_content:
                            parts = clean_content.split("</think>")
                            clean_content = parts[1].strip()
                        return clean_content, model_name
            elif r.status_code in [429, 503, 500, 404]:
                last_err = f"{model_name} (HTTP {r.status_code})"
                time.sleep(0.8)
        except Exception as e:
            last_err = f"{model_name} ({e})"
            time.sleep(0.5)

    return f"⚠️ 抱歉，目前 5 大頂級 AI 雲端模型節點皆繁忙，請稍候重試。\n(最後狀態: {last_err})", "服務繁忙"

# =========================================================================
# 🗄️【3. 資料庫個股數據穿透查詢】
# =========================================================================
def query_stock_full_data(stock_code_or_name):
    clean_kw = str(stock_code_or_name).strip()
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 1
      A.代號, A.名稱, A.成交價, A.price_ma5, A.price_ma20, A.price_ma60, A.三大法人_ma5, A.三大法人_ma20,
      ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, M.專家實戰總分) AS 實戰總分,
      ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分_ma20, M.專家實戰總分) AS 實戰總分_ma20,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_5MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_5MA, ISNULL(E.Return_5MA, 0.0) AS Return_5MA,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_10MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_10MA, ISNULL(E.Return_10MA, 0.0) AS Return_10MA,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_20MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_20MA, ISNULL(E.Return_20MA, 0.0) AS Return_20MA,
      ISNULL(E.OptimalExit, N'🔥 20MA勝出') AS OptimalExit,
      ISNULL(C5.集中度1日, 0.0) AS 集中度1日, ISNULL(C5.集中度5日, 0.0) AS 集中度5日, ISNULL(C5.集中度20日, 0.0) AS 集中度20日,
      ISNULL(R.HitCount, 0) AS HitCount, ISNULL(R.ResonanceTag, N'常態波段') AS ResonanceTag,
      ISNULL(RAD.[60M動能(OSC)], 0.0) AS OSC_60M, ISNULL(RAD.短線氣象, N'☀️ 轉強') AS 短線氣象,
      ISNULL(FST.預估目標價, 0) AS FactSet目標價
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live A
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory SCH ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(SCH.代號) AND A.日期 = SCH.日期
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits E ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(E.代號)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 代號, 集中度1日, 集中度5日, 集中度20日 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.Chips5 WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM(?) OR RTRIM(名稱) = RTRIM(?) ORDER BY 日期 DESC) C5 ON 1=1
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot R ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar RAD ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(RAD.代號)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT 代號, MAX(預估目標價) AS 預估目標價 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates GROUP BY 代號) FST ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(FST.代號)
    WHERE RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(?) OR RTRIM(A.名稱) = RTRIM(?)
    ORDER BY A.日期 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (clean_kw, clean_kw, clean_kw, clean_kw))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row:
                return {
                    "code": str(row[0]).strip(), "name": str(row[1]).strip(),
                    "price": float(row[2]) if row[2] else 0.0,
                    "m5": float(row[3]) if row[3] else 0.0,
                    "m20": float(row[4]) if row[4] else 0.0,
                    "m60": float(row[5]) if row[5] else 0.0,
                    "f5": float(row[6]) if row[6] else 0.0,
                    "f20": float(row[7]) if row[7] else 0.0,
                    "score": float(row[8]) if row[8] else 0.0,
                    "score20": float(row[9]) if row[9] else 0.0,
                    "w5": float(row[10]) if row[10] else 50.0, "ret5": float(row[11]) if row[11] else 0.0,
                    "w10": float(row[12]) if row[12] else 50.0, "ret10": float(row[13]) if row[13] else 0.0,
                    "w20": float(row[14]) if row[14] else 50.0, "ret20": float(row[15]) if row[15] else 0.0,
                    "optimal": str(row[16]).strip() if row[16] else "🔥 20MA勝出",
                    "c1": float(row[17]) if row[17] else 0.0, "c5": float(row[18]) if row[18] else 0.0, "c20": float(row[19]) if row[19] else 0.0,
                    "hit_count": int(row[20]) if row[20] else 0, "tag": str(row[21]).strip() if row[21] else "常態波段",
                    "osc_60m": float(row[22]) if row[22] else 0.0, "weather": str(row[23]).strip() if row[23] else "☀️ 轉強",
                    "target_price": float(row[24]) if row[24] else 0.0
                }
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 查詢股票異常: {e}")
    return None

# =========================================================================
# 📸【4. Playwright 自動截取四大圖表】
# =========================================================================
async def capture_stock_chart(stock_code):
    clean_code = str(stock_code).strip()
    today = datetime.datetime.now()
    one_year_ago = (today - datetime.timedelta(days=365)).strftime('%Y%m%d')
    timestamp_now = int(time.time() * 1000)

    url = f"https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/excelsql2.html?stock={clean_code}&start={one_year_ago}&_v={timestamp_now}"
    photo_filename = f"chart_{clean_code}_{timestamp_now}.png"
    output_path = os.path.join(STATIC_DIR, photo_filename)

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = await browser.new_context(
            viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 1300},
            ignore_https_errors=True,
            extra_http_headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache"}
        )
        page = await context.new_page()
        try:
            await page.goto(url, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=45000)
            await asyncio.sleep(2.0)

            btn_post = page.locator("#btn_query_post")
            if await btn_post.count() > 0 and await btn_post.is_visible():
                await btn_post.click()
            else:
                await page.evaluate("""
                    const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, input[type="button"], a'))
                        .find(el => el.textContent.includes('歷史') || el.textContent.includes('聯動'));
                    if (btn) btn.click();
                """)

            await asyncio.sleep(4.5)

            # 畫面淨化
            await page.evaluate("""
                const p = document.getElementById('html-chart-price');
                const c = document.getElementById('html-chart-cross');
                const o = document.getElementById('html-chart-obv');
                const s = document.getElementById('html-chart-score');
                if (p && o && s) {
                    const container = document.createElement('div');
                    container.id = 'clean-charts-container';
                    container.style.backgroundColor = '#0c1827';
                    container.style.padding = '10px';
                    container.style.width = '100%';
                    container.appendChild(p);
                    if (c) container.appendChild(c);
                    container.appendChild(o);
                    container.appendChild(s);
                    document.body.insertBefore(container, document.body.firstChild);
                    document.querySelectorAll('body > *').forEach(el => {
                        if (el.id !== 'clean-charts-container') el.style.display = 'none';
                    });
                }
            """)
            await asyncio.sleep(1.5)
            await page.screenshot(path=output_path, full_page=True)
            return output_path
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ 截圖失敗 [{clean_code}]: {e}")
            return None
        finally:
            await browser.close()

# =========================================================================
# 🔍【5. 60M 低檔金叉選股查詢】
# =========================================================================
def query_kd_cross_stocks():
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 10 代號, 名稱, 分組, 策略靈魂, ROUND([60M動能(OSC)], 2) AS [60M_OSC], ROUND([60M_K值], 1) AS [60M_K], 日線分, 短線氣象
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
    WHERE [短線氣象] LIKE N'%轉強%' OR [60M動能(OSC)] > 5.0
    ORDER BY [60M動能(OSC)] DESC, 日線分 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            return rows
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 查詢金叉失敗: {e}")
        return []

        "🤖 【Zen AI 雙向量化操盤助手 Pro (雙核心旗艦版)】\n\n"
        "💡 二合一指令使用說明：\n"
        "────────────────────────\n"

        "• `2408R` ➔ OpenRouter 深度解盤 ＋ 3-Way 離場勝率 ＋ Chips5 集中度\n"
        "• `2408 圖片R` ➔ 附帶雙 Y 軸四大圖表截圖\n"
        "• `2408 說明R` ➔ 四大圖表 ＋ 70B 深度解讀 (三合一旗艦)\n"

        "• `2408 說明` ➔ 本地三合一圖文解讀\n"
        "• `找金叉` ➔ 本地金叉選股清單\n"
        "────────────────────────"
    )
    bot.reply_to(message, welcome_text, parse_mode='Markdown')

@bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: True)
def handle_all_messages(message):
    raw_text = message.text.strip()
    chat_id = message.chat.id

    # 🟢 1. 判斷是否使用 OpenRouter (指令結尾帶 R 或 r)
    is_use_openrouter = raw_text.endswith("R") or raw_text.endswith("r")
    clean_cmd = raw_text[:-1].strip() if is_use_openrouter else raw_text

    engine_tag = "⚡ OpenRouter 120B" if is_use_openrouter else "🤖 本地 Ollama 7B"

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 🎯 指令 A：【找金叉】或【選股】(含 R 與 無 R)
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    if clean_cmd in ["找金叉", "選股", "金叉", "60M金叉"]:
        wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"⏳ 正在掃描全市場 60M 轉強伏兵清單 ({engine_tag})...")
        rows = query_kd_cross_stocks()
        if not rows:
            bot.edit_message_text("⚠️ 目前無符合 60M 轉強之金叉標的。", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            return

        today_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d')
        msg = f"⚡ 【Zen AI 60M 低檔轉強精選榜 ({engine_tag})】\n📅 日期：{today_str}\n────────────────────────\n"
        for idx, r in enumerate(rows, 1):
            msg += f"{idx}. 🌟 {r[0]} {r[1]} ({r[2]})\n   ├─ 60M OSC: `+{r[4]}` | 60M K值: `{r[5]}`\n   ├─ 短線氣象: 【{r[7]}】 | 日線總分: `+{r[6]}分`\n   └─ 核心題材: 【{r[3]}】\n"
        
        hint_cmd = "2454 說明R" if is_use_openrouter else "2454 說明"
        msg += f"\n👉 輸入 `股號 說明` (例: `{hint_cmd}`) 即可產出該股三合一深度戰報！"

        bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
        bot.send_message(chat_id, msg, parse_mode='Markdown')
        return

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 解析個股指令：判斷是「純解盤」、「要圖片」還是「三合一說明」
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    is_mode_desc = bool(re.search(r'(說明|詳細|圖文)', clean_cmd)) # Mode 3: 圖片 + 深度解讀
    is_mode_photo = bool(re.search(r'(圖片|截圖|圖表|圖)', clean_cmd)) and not is_mode_desc # Mode 2: 圖片 + 傳統解盤

    target_stock = re.sub(r'(圖片|截圖|圖表|圖|說明|詳細|圖文)', '', clean_cmd).strip()

    if not target_stock:
        bot.reply_to(message, "💡 指令範例：`2408` (本地)、`2408R` (OpenRouter)、`2408 說明R` (三合一)", parse_mode='Markdown')
        return

    wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"⏳ 正在穿透資料庫檢索【{target_stock}】並由 {engine_tag} 推演中...")

    stock = query_stock_full_data(target_stock)
    if not stock:
        bot.edit_message_text(f"❌ 找不到股票【{target_stock}】，請確認代號或名稱是否正確（例: `2408` 或 `2408R`）。", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id, parse_mode='Markdown')
        return

    # 組裝量化數值
    f5_str = f"買超 {stock['f5']:.1f} 張" if stock['f5'] >= 0 else f"賣超 {abs(stock['f5']):.1f} 張"
    f20_str = f"買超 {stock['f20']:.1f} 張" if stock['f20'] >= 0 else f"賣超 {abs(stock['f20']):.1f} 張"
    score_str = f"+{stock['score']:.2f} 分" if stock['score'] >= 0 else f"{stock['score']:.2f} 分"
    chip_str = f"Chips5主力集中度(1日 {stock['c1']}%、5日 {stock['c5']}%、20日 {stock['c20']}%)"
    target_str = f"外資FactSet目標價 {stock['target_price']}元" if stock['target_price'] > 0 else "暫無外資目標價"

    r5_sign = "+" if stock['ret5'] >= 0 else ""
    r10_sign = "+" if stock['ret10'] >= 0 else ""
    r20_sign = "+" if stock['ret20'] >= 0 else ""
    pk_block = (
        f"📊 該股歷史 3-Way 離場戰術實測 PK：\n"
        f"├─ 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w5']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r5_sign}{stock['ret5']:.2f}%\n"
        f"├─ ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w10']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r10_sign}{stock['ret10']:.2f}%\n"
        f"└─ 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w20']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r20_sign}{stock['ret20']:.2f}%\n"
        f"🎯 系統最適建議：【{stock['optimal']}】"
    )

    prompt = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監。使用者正在看你發送的「一鍵四大圖表同步聯動共振圖」。
請解說【${stock['code']} ${stock['name']}】最新盤後量化數據：
- 現價：${stock['price']}元 | 5MA：${stock['m5']}元 | 20MA：${stock['m20']}元 | 60MA：${stock['m60']}元
- 三大法人5MA ${f5_str}、20MA ${f20_str} | 實戰總分 ${score_str} (20日均分 ${stock['score20']:.2f}分)
- ${chip_str} | ${target_str}
- 60M OSC ${stock['osc_60m']} (短線氣象：${stock['weather']}) | 當前為【${stock['hit_count']}維共振 (${stock['tag']})】
- ${pk_block}

請嚴格分成以下五大段，每段 60~90 字，精準一針見血：
📌 【圖一：價格與均線防守】
📌 【圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振】
📌 【圖二：OBV星號與籌碼鎖碼解讀】
📌 【圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振】
📌 【指揮官實戰總結指引】（給出下營業日開盤目標價、防守價與本金凱利部位％配置建議）
請全部使用繁體中文回覆。"""

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 🎯 模式 B：【純截圖 ＋ 傳統摘要】
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    if is_mode_photo:
        bot.edit_message_text(f"📷 正在截取【{stock['code']} {stock['name']}】四大圖表...", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
        photo_path = asyncio.run(capture_stock_chart(stock['code']))
        bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)

        caption = (
            f"📊 【{stock['code']} {stock['name']}】四大圖表聯動戰報\n"
            f"📍 現價：`{stock['price']} 元` │ 實戰總分：`{score_str}`\n"
            f"🎯 多維共振：`{stock['hit_count']}維 ({stock['tag']})`\n"
            f"────────────────────────\n"
            f"{pk_block}"
        )
        if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
            with open(photo_path, 'rb') as f:
                bot.send_photo(chat_id, f, caption=caption, parse_mode='Markdown')
        else:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, caption, parse_mode='Markdown')
        return

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 🎯 模式 C：【三合一 (圖表 ＋ AI 深度圖文解讀)】
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    if is_mode_desc:
        bot.edit_message_text(f"📷 正在截取圖表並由 {engine_tag} 進行深度推演中...", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
        photo_path = asyncio.run(capture_stock_chart(stock['code']))
        
        # 依模式調用 AI
        if is_use_openrouter:
            ai_reply, model_name = call_openrouter_5tier_fallback(prompt)
        else:
            ai_reply, model_name = call_ollama_local(prompt)

        bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)

        caption_head = (
            f"👑 【{stock['code']} {stock['name']}】三合一深度圖文操盤報告\n"
            f"⚡ 運算大腦：`{model_name}`\n"
            f"📍 現價：`{stock['price']} 元` │ 實戰總分：`{score_str}`\n"
            f"────────────────────────\n"
            f"{pk_block}\n"
            f"────────────────────────\n\n"
        )
        full_report = caption_head + ai_reply

        if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
            with open(photo_path, 'rb') as f:
                if len(full_report) <= 1024:
                    bot.send_photo(chat_id, f, caption=full_report, parse_mode='Markdown')
                else:
                    bot.send_photo(chat_id, f, caption=caption_head, parse_mode='Markdown')
                    bot.send_message(chat_id, ai_reply)
        else:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, full_report)
        return

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 🎯 模式 A：【純文字深度解盤】
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    if is_use_openrouter:
        ai_reply, model_name = call_openrouter_5tier_fallback(prompt)
    else:
        ai_reply, model_name = call_ollama_local(prompt)

    header_msg = (
        f"👑 【{stock['code']} {stock['name']}】量化操盤戰術報告\n"
        f"⚡ 運算大腦：`{model_name}`\n"
        f"📍 現價：`{stock['price']} 元` │ 實戰總分：`{score_str}`\n"
        f"────────────────────────\n"
        f"{pk_block}\n"
        f"────────────────────────\n\n"
    )
    final_msg = header_msg + ai_reply
    bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)

    if len(final_msg) > 4000:
        bot.send_message(chat_id, final_msg[:4000])
        bot.send_message(chat_id, final_msg[4000:])
    else:
        bot.send_message(chat_id, final_msg)

# =========================================================================
# 🚀【7. 機器人啟動入口】
# =========================================================================

def clean_stock_code(code_val):
    if not code_val: return ""

    if c_str.endswith(".0"):

def query_stock_full_data(stock_code_or_name):
    clean_kw = clean_stock_code(stock_code_or_name)
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 1
      A.代號, A.名稱, A.成交價, A.price_ma5, A.price_ma20, A.price_ma60, A.三大法人_ma5, A.三大法人_ma20,
      ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, M.專家實戰總分) AS 實戰總分,
      ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分_ma20, M.專家實戰總分) AS 實戰總分_ma20,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_5MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_5MA, ISNULL(E.Return_5MA, 0.0) AS Return_5MA,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_10MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_10MA, ISNULL(E.Return_10MA, 0.0) AS Return_10MA,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_20MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_20MA, ISNULL(E.Return_20MA, 0.0) AS Return_20MA,
      ISNULL(E.OptimalExit, N'🔥 20MA勝出') AS OptimalExit,
      ISNULL(C5.集中度1日, 0.0) AS 集中度1日, ISNULL(C5.集中度5日, 0.0) AS 集中度5日, ISNULL(C5.集中度20日, 0.0) AS 集中度20日,
      ISNULL(R.HitCount, 0) AS HitCount, ISNULL(R.ResonanceTag, N'常態波段') AS ResonanceTag,
      ISNULL(RAD.[60M動能(OSC)], 0.0) AS OSC_60M, ISNULL(RAD.短線氣象, N'☀️ 轉強') AS 短線氣象,
      ISNULL(FST.預估目標價, 0) AS FactSet目標價
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live A
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory SCH ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(SCH.代號) AND A.日期 = SCH.日期
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits E ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(E.代號)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 代號, 集中度1日, 集中度5日, 集中度20日 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.Chips5 WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM(?) OR RTRIM(名稱) = RTRIM(?) ORDER BY 日期 DESC) C5 ON 1=1
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot R ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar RAD ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(RAD.代號)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT 代號, MAX(預估目標價) AS 預估目標價 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates GROUP BY 代號) FST ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(FST.代號)
    WHERE RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(?) OR RTRIM(A.名稱) = RTRIM(?)
    ORDER BY A.日期 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (clean_kw, clean_kw, clean_kw, clean_kw))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row:
                return {
                    "code": clean_stock_code(row[0]), "name": str(row[1]).strip(),
                    "price": float(row[2]) if row[2] else 0.0,
                    "m5": float(row[3]) if row[3] else 0.0,
                    "m20": float(row[4]) if row[4] else 0.0,
                    "m60": float(row[5]) if row[5] else 0.0,
                    "f5": float(row[6]) if row[6] else 0.0,
                    "f20": float(row[7]) if row[7] else 0.0,
                    "score": float(row[8]) if row[8] else 0.0,
                    "score20": float(row[9]) if row[9] else 0.0,
                    "w5": float(row[10]) if row[10] else 50.0, "ret5": float(row[11]) if row[11] else 0.0,
                    "w10": float(row[12]) if row[12] else 50.0, "ret10": float(row[13]) if row[13] else 0.0,
                    "w20": float(row[14]) if row[14] else 50.0, "ret20": float(row[15]) if row[15] else 0.0,
                    "optimal": str(row[16]).strip() if row[16] else "🔥 20MA勝出",
                    "c1": float(row[17]) if row[17] else 0.0, "c5": float(row[18]) if row[18] else 0.0, "c20": float(row[19]) if row[19] else 0.0,
                    "hit_count": int(row[20]) if row[20] else 0, "tag": str(row[21]).strip() if row[21] else "常態波段",
                    "osc_60m": float(row[22]) if row[22] else 0.0, "weather": str(row[23]).strip() if row[23] else "☀️ 轉強",
                    "target_price": float(row[24]) if row[24] else 0.0
                }
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 查詢股票異常: {e}")
    return None

# 📸【4. Playwright 自動截取四大圖表 (修復純淨代號)】
# ==========================================
async def capture_stock_chart(stock_code):
    clean_code = clean_stock_code(stock_code)
    today = datetime.datetime.now()
    one_year_ago = (today - datetime.timedelta(days=365)).strftime('%Y%m%d')
    timestamp_now = int(time.time() * 1000)

    url = f"https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/excelsql2.html?stock={clean_code}&start={one_year_ago}&_v={timestamp_now}"
    photo_filename = f"chart_{clean_code}_{timestamp_now}.png"
    output_path = os.path.join(STATIC_DIR, photo_filename)

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = await browser.new_context(
            viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 1300},
            ignore_https_errors=True,
            extra_http_headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache"}
        )
        page = await context.new_page()
        try:
            await page.goto(url, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=45000)
            await asyncio.sleep(2.0)

            btn_post = page.locator("#btn_query_post")
            if await btn_post.count() > 0 and await btn_post.is_visible():
                await btn_post.click()
            else:
                await page.evaluate("""
                    const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, input[type="button"], a'))
                        .find(el => el.textContent.includes('歷史') || el.textContent.includes('聯動'));
                    if (btn) btn.click();
                """)

            await asyncio.sleep(4.5)

            # 畫面淨化
            await page.evaluate("""
                const p = document.getElementById('html-chart-price');
                const c = document.getElementById('html-chart-cross');
                const o = document.getElementById('html-chart-obv');
                const s = document.getElementById('html-chart-score');
                if (p && o && s) {
                    const container = document.createElement('div');
                    container.id = 'clean-charts-container';
                    container.style.backgroundColor = '#0c1827';
                    container.style.padding = '10px';
                    container.style.width = '100%';
                    container.appendChild(p);
                    if (c) container.appendChild(c);
                    container.appendChild(o);
                    container.appendChild(s);
                    document.body.insertBefore(container, document.body.firstChild);
                    document.querySelectorAll('body > *').forEach(el => {
                        if (el.id !== 'clean-charts-container') el.style.display = 'none';
                    });
                }
            """)
            await asyncio.sleep(1.5)
            await page.screenshot(path=output_path, full_page=True)
            return output_path
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ 截圖失敗 [{clean_code}]: {e}")
            return None
        finally:
            await browser.close()

# 🔍【5. 60M 低檔金叉選股查詢】

def query_kd_cross_stocks():
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 10 代號, 名稱, 分組, 策略靈魂, ROUND([60M動能(OSC)], 2) AS [60M_OSC], ROUND([60M_K值], 1) AS [60M_K], 日線分, 短線氣象
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
    WHERE [短線氣象] LIKE N'%轉強%' OR [60M動能(OSC)] > 5.0
    ORDER BY [60M動能(OSC)] DESC, 日線分 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            return rows
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 查詢金叉失敗: {e}")
        return []

@bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: True)
def handle_all_messages(message):
    raw_text = message.text.strip()
    chat_id = message.chat.id

    is_use_openrouter = raw_text.endswith("R") or raw_text.endswith("r")
    clean_cmd = raw_text[:-1].strip() if is_use_openrouter else raw_text

    engine_tag = "⚡ OpenRouter 120B" if is_use_openrouter else "🤖 本地 Ollama 7B"

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 🎯 指令 A：【找金叉】或【選股】
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    if clean_cmd in ["找金叉", "選股", "金叉", "60M金叉"]:
        wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"⏳ 正在掃描全市場 60M 轉強伏兵清單 ({engine_tag})...")

def query_stock_full_data(stock_code_or_name):
    clean_kw = clean_stock_code(stock_code_or_name)
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 1
      A.代號, A.名稱, A.成交價, A.price_ma5, A.price_ma20, A.price_ma60, A.三大法人_ma5, A.三大法人_ma20,
      ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, M.專家實戰總分) AS 實戰總分,
      ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分_ma20, M.專家實戰總分) AS 實戰總分_ma20,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_5MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_5MA, ISNULL(E.Return_5MA, 0.0) AS Return_5MA,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_10MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_10MA, ISNULL(E.Return_10MA, 0.0) AS Return_10MA,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_20MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_20MA, ISNULL(E.Return_20MA, 0.0) AS Return_20MA,
      ISNULL(E.OptimalExit, N'🔥 20MA勝出') AS OptimalExit,
      ISNULL(C5.集中度1日, 0.0) AS 集中度1日, ISNULL(C5.集中度5日, 0.0) AS 集中度5日, ISNULL(C5.集中度20日, 0.0) AS 集中度20日,
      ISNULL(R.HitCount, 0) AS HitCount, ISNULL(R.ResonanceTag, N'常態波段') AS ResonanceTag,
      ISNULL(RAD.[60M動能(OSC)], 0.0) AS OSC_60M, ISNULL(RAD.短線氣象, N'☀️ 轉強') AS 短線氣象,
      ISNULL(FST.預估目標價, 0) AS FactSet目標價
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live A
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory SCH ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(SCH.代號) AND A.日期 = SCH.日期
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits E ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(E.代號)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 代號, 集中度1日, 集中度5日, 集中度20日 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.Chips5 WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM(?) OR RTRIM(名稱) = RTRIM(?) ORDER BY 日期 DESC) C5 ON 1=1
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot R ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar RAD ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(RAD.代號)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT 代號, MAX(預估目標價) AS 預估目標價 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates GROUP BY 代號) FST ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(FST.代號)
    WHERE RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(?) OR RTRIM(A.名稱) = RTRIM(?)
    ORDER BY A.日期 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (clean_kw, clean_kw, clean_kw, clean_kw))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row:
                return {
                    "code": clean_stock_code(row[0]), "name": str(row[1]).strip(),
                    "price": float(row[2]) if row[2] else 0.0,
                    "m5": float(row[3]) if row[3] else 0.0,
                    "m20": float(row[4]) if row[4] else 0.0,
                    "m60": float(row[5]) if row[5] else 0.0,
                    "f5": float(row[6]) if row[6] else 0.0,
                    "f20": float(row[7]) if row[7] else 0.0,
                    "score": float(row[8]) if row[8] else 0.0,
                    "score20": float(row[9]) if row[9] else 0.0,
                    "w5": float(row[10]) if row[10] else 50.0, "ret5": float(row[11]) if row[11] else 0.0,
                    "w10": float(row[12]) if row[12] else 50.0, "ret10": float(row[13]) if row[13] else 0.0,
                    "w20": float(row[14]) if row[14] else 50.0, "ret20": float(row[15]) if row[15] else 0.0,
                    "optimal": str(row[16]).strip() if row[16] else "🔥 20MA勝出",
                    "c1": float(row[17]) if row[17] else 0.0, "c5": float(row[18]) if row[18] else 0.0, "c20": float(row[19]) if row[19] else 0.0,
                    "hit_count": int(row[20]) if row[20] else 0, "tag": str(row[21]).strip() if row[21] else "常態波段",
                    "osc_60m": float(row[22]) if row[22] else 0.0, "weather": str(row[23]).strip() if row[23] else "☀️ 轉強",
                    "target_price": float(row[24]) if row[24] else 0.0
                }
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 查詢股票異常: {e}")
    return None

# ==========================================
# 📸【4. Playwright 自動截取四大圖表】
# ==========================================
async def capture_stock_chart(stock_code):
    clean_code = clean_stock_code(stock_code)
    today = datetime.datetime.now()
    one_year_ago = (today - datetime.timedelta(days=365)).strftime('%Y%m%d')
    timestamp_now = int(time.time() * 1000)

    url = f"https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/excelsql2.html?stock={clean_code}&start={one_year_ago}&_v={timestamp_now}"
    photo_filename = f"chart_{clean_code}_{timestamp_now}.png"
    output_path = os.path.join(STATIC_DIR, photo_filename)

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = await browser.new_context(
            viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 1300},
            ignore_https_errors=True,
            extra_http_headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache"}
        )
        page = await context.new_page()
        try:
            await page.goto(url, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=45000)
            await asyncio.sleep(2.0)

            btn_post = page.locator("#btn_query_post")
            if await btn_post.count() > 0 and await btn_post.is_visible():
                await btn_post.click()
            else:
                await page.evaluate("""
                    const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, input[type="button"], a'))
                        .find(el => el.textContent.includes('歷史') || el.textContent.includes('聯動'));
                    if (btn) btn.click();
                """)

            await asyncio.sleep(4.5)

            # 畫面淨化
            await page.evaluate("""
                const p = document.getElementById('html-chart-price');
                const c = document.getElementById('html-chart-cross');
                const o = document.getElementById('html-chart-obv');
                const s = document.getElementById('html-chart-score');
                if (p && o && s) {
                    const container = document.createElement('div');
                    container.id = 'clean-charts-container';
                    container.style.backgroundColor = '#0c1827';
                    container.style.padding = '10px';
                    container.style.width = '100%';
                    container.appendChild(p);
                    if (c) container.appendChild(c);
                    container.appendChild(o);
                    container.appendChild(s);
                    document.body.insertBefore(container, document.body.firstChild);
                    document.querySelectorAll('body > *').forEach(el => {
                        if (el.id !== 'clean-charts-container') el.style.display = 'none';
                    });
                }
            """)
            await asyncio.sleep(1.5)
            await page.screenshot(path=output_path, full_page=True)
            return output_path
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ 截圖失敗 [{clean_code}]: {e}")
            return None
        finally:
            await browser.close()

# 🔍【5. 60M 低檔金叉選股查詢】
# ==========================================
def query_kd_cross_stocks():
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 10 代號, 名稱, 分組, 策略靈魂, ROUND([60M動能(OSC)], 2) AS [60M_OSC], ROUND([60M_K值], 1) AS [60M_K], 日線分, 短線氣象
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
    WHERE [短線氣象] LIKE N'%轉強%' OR [60M動能(OSC)] > 5.0
    ORDER BY [60M動能(OSC)] DESC, 日線分 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            return rows
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 查詢金叉失敗: {e}")
        return []

@bot.message_handler(commands=['start', 'help'])
def send_welcome(message):
    welcome_text = (
        "🤖 【Zen AI 雙向量化操盤助手 Pro (雙核心旗艦版)】\n\n"
        "💡 二合一指令使用說明：\n"
        "────────────────────────\n"
        "🟢 【OpenRouter 70B~120B 大模型 (指令帶 R)】：\n"
        "• `2408R` ➔ OpenRouter 深度解盤 ＋ 3-Way 離場勝率 ＋ Chips5 集中度\n"
        "• `2408 圖片R` ➔ 附帶雙 Y 軸四大圖表截圖\n"
        "• `2408 說明R` ➔ 四大圖表 ＋ 70B 深度解讀 (三合一旗艦)\n"
        "• `找金叉R` 或 `選股R` ➔ 60M 低檔轉強選股榜 (OpenRouter)\n\n"
        "🔵 【本地 Ollama 7B 模型 (一般無 R 指令)】：\n"
        "• `2408` ➔ 本地 Ollama 快速解盤\n"
        "• `2408 圖片` ➔ 本地圖表發送\n"
        "• `2408 說明` ➔ 本地三合一圖文解讀\n"
        "• `找金叉` ➔ 本地金叉選股清單\n"
        "────────────────────────"
    )
    bot.reply_to(message, welcome_text, parse_mode='Markdown')

@bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: True)
def handle_all_messages(message):
    raw_text = message.text.strip()
    chat_id = message.chat.id

    # 判斷是否使用 OpenRouter (帶 R)
    is_use_openrouter = raw_text.endswith("R") or raw_text.endswith("r")
    clean_cmd = raw_text[:-1].strip() if is_use_openrouter else raw_text

    engine_tag = "⚡ OpenRouter 120B" if is_use_openrouter else "🤖 本地 Ollama 7B"

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 🎯 指令 A：【找金叉】或【選股】
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    if clean_cmd in ["找金叉", "選股", "金叉", "60M金叉"]:
        wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"⏳ 正在掃描全市場 60M 轉強伏兵清單 ({engine_tag})...")
        rows = query_kd_cross_stocks()
        if not rows:
            bot.edit_message_text("⚠️ 目前無符合 60M 轉強之金叉標的。", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            return

        today_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d')
        msg = f"⚡ 【Zen AI 60M 低檔轉強精選榜 ({engine_tag})】\n📅 日期：{today_str}\n────────────────────────\n"
        for idx, r in enumerate(rows, 1):
            msg += f"{idx}. 🌟 {r[0]} {r[1]} ({r[2]})\n   ├─ 60M OSC: `+{r[4]}` | 60M K值: `{r[5]}`\n   ├─ 短線氣象: 【{r[7]}】 | 日線總分: `+{r[6]}分`\n   └─ 核心題材: 【{r[3]}】\n"
        
        hint_cmd = "2454 說明R" if is_use_openrouter else "2454 說明"
        msg += f"\n👉 輸入 `股號 說明` (例: `{hint_cmd}`) 即可產出該股三合一深度戰報！"

        bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
        bot.send_message(chat_id, msg)
        return

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 解析個股指令
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    is_mode_desc = bool(re.search(r'(說明|詳細|圖文)', clean_cmd))
    is_mode_photo = bool(re.search(r'(圖片|截圖|圖表|圖)', clean_cmd)) and not is_mode_desc

    target_stock = re.sub(r'(圖片|截圖|圖表|圖|說明|詳細|圖文)', '', clean_cmd).strip()
    target_stock = clean_stock_code(target_stock)

    if not target_stock:
        bot.reply_to(message, "💡 指令範例：`2408` (本地)、`2408R` (OpenRouter)、`2408 說明R` (三合一)")
        return

    wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"⏳ 正在穿透資料庫檢索【{target_stock}】並由 {engine_tag} 推演中...")

    stock = query_stock_full_data(target_stock)
    if not stock:
        bot.edit_message_text(f"❌ 找不到股票【{target_stock}】，請確認代號或名稱是否正確（例: `2408` 或 `2408R`）。", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
        return

    f5_str = f"買超 {stock['f5']:.1f} 張" if stock['f5'] >= 0 else f"賣超 {abs(stock['f5']):.1f} 張"
    f20_str = f"買超 {stock['f20']:.1f} 張" if stock['f20'] >= 0 else f"賣超 {abs(stock['f20']):.1f} 張"
    score_str = f"+{stock['score']:.2f} 分" if stock['score'] >= 0 else f"{stock['score']:.2f} 分"
    chip_str = f"Chips5主力集中度(1日 {stock['c1']}%、5日 {stock['c5']}%、20日 {stock['c20']}%)"
    target_str = f"外資FactSet目標價 {stock['target_price']}元" if stock['target_price'] > 0 else "暫無外資目標價"

    r5_sign = "+" if stock['ret5'] >= 0 else ""
    r10_sign = "+" if stock['ret10'] >= 0 else ""
    r20_sign = "+" if stock['ret20'] >= 0 else ""
    pk_block = (
        f"📊 該股歷史 3-Way 離場戰術實測 PK：\n"
        f"├─ 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w5']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r5_sign}{stock['ret5']:.2f}%\n"
        f"├─ ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w10']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r10_sign}{stock['ret10']:.2f}%\n"
        f"└─ 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w20']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r20_sign}{stock['ret20']:.2f}%\n"
        f"🎯 系統最適建議：【{stock['optimal']}】"
    )

    prompt = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監。使用者正在看你發送的「一鍵四大圖表同步聯動共振圖」。
請解說【{stock['code']} {stock['name']}】最新盤後量化數據：
- 現價：{stock['price']}元 | 5MA：{stock['m5']}元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']}元 | 60MA：{stock['m60']}元
- 三大法人5MA {f5_str}、20MA {f20_str} | 實戰總分 {score_str} (20日均分 {stock['score20']:.2f}分)
- {chip_str} | {target_str}
- 60M OSC {stock['osc_60m']} (短線氣象：{stock['weather']}) | 當前為【{stock['hit_count']}維共振 ({stock['tag']})】
- {pk_block}

請嚴格分成以下五大段，每段 60~90 字，精準一針見血：
📌 【圖一：價格與均線防守】
📌 【圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振】
📌 【圖二：OBV星號與籌碼鎖碼解讀】
📌 【圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振】
📌 【指揮官實戰總結指引】（給出下營業日開盤目標價、防守價與本金凱利部位％配置建議）
請全部使用繁體中文回覆。"""

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 🎯 模式 B：【純截圖 ＋ 傳統摘要】
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    if is_mode_photo:
        bot.edit_message_text(f"📷 正在截取【{stock['code']} {stock['name']}】四大圖表...", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
        photo_path = asyncio.run(capture_stock_chart(stock['code']))
        bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)

        caption = (
            f"📊 【{stock['code']} {stock['name']}】四大圖表聯動戰報\n"
            f"📍 現價：{stock['price']} 元 │ 實戰總分：{score_str}\n"
            f"🎯 多維共振：{stock['hit_count']}維 ({stock['tag']})\n"
            f"────────────────────────\n"
            f"{pk_block}"
        )
        if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
            with open(photo_path, 'rb') as f:
                bot.send_photo(chat_id, f, caption=caption)
        else:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, caption)
        return

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 🎯 模式 C：【三合一 (四大圖表 ＋ 完整五段式解盤獨立訊息)】
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    if is_mode_desc:
        bot.edit_message_text(f"📷 正在截取圖表並由 {engine_tag} 進行深度推演中...", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
        photo_path = asyncio.run(capture_stock_chart(stock['code']))
        
        if is_use_openrouter:
            ai_reply, model_name = call_openrouter_5tier_fallback(prompt)
        else:
            ai_reply, model_name = call_ollama_local(prompt)

        bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)

        # 🟢 第一則訊息：發送四大圖表 ＋ 3-Way 勝率卡 (精簡不爆字數)
        caption_head = (
            f"👑 【{stock['code']} {stock['name']}】四大圖表聯動戰報\n"
            f"⚡ 運算大腦：{model_name}\n"
            f"📍 現價：{stock['price']} 元 │ 實戰總分：{score_str}\n"
            f"────────────────────────\n"
            f"{pk_block}"
        )

        if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
            with open(photo_path, 'rb') as f:
                bot.send_photo(chat_id, f, caption=caption_head)
        else:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, caption_head)

        time.sleep(1) # 短暫間隔確保順序

        # 🟢 第二則訊息：獨立完整發送 100% 五段式 AI 操盤總監報告 (完全不截斷！)
        full_ai_msg = f"📊 【{stock['code']} {stock['name']}】五大維度深度量化解盤：\n\n{ai_reply}"
        
        if len(full_ai_msg) > 3800:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, full_ai_msg[:3800])
            bot.send_message(chat_id, full_ai_msg[3800:])
        else:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, full_ai_msg)
        return

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 🎯 模式 A：【純文字深度解盤】
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    if is_use_openrouter:
        ai_reply, model_name = call_openrouter_5tier_fallback(prompt)
    else:
        ai_reply, model_name = call_ollama_local(prompt)

    header_msg = (
        f"👑 【{stock['code']} {stock['name']}】量化操盤戰術報告\n"
        f"⚡ 運算大腦：{model_name}\n"
        f"📍 現價：{stock['price']} 元 │ 實戰總分：{score_str}\n"
        f"────────────────────────\n"
        f"{pk_block}\n"
        f"────────────────────────\n\n"
    )
    final_msg = header_msg + ai_reply
    bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)

    if len(final_msg) > 3800:
        bot.send_message(chat_id, final_msg[:3800])
        bot.send_message(chat_id, final_msg[3800:])
    else:
        bot.send_message(chat_id, final_msg)

# 🚀【7. 機器人啟動入口】

def main():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Telegram 雙向量化操盤機器人 V2.2 (雙核心旗艦版)】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 啟動時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print("🟢 OpenRouter 120B 指令: 2454R / 2454 圖片R / 2454 說明R / 找金叉R")
    print("🔵 本地 Ollama 7B 指令: 2454 / 2454 圖片 / 2454 說明 / 找金叉")
    print("=" * 70)

    while True:
        try:
            bot.infinity_polling(timeout=20, long_polling_timeout=15)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ 連線重試中: {e}")
            time.sleep(3)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def call_openrouter_5tier_fallback(prompt_text, system_prompt="你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監。分析內容請一針見血，條理分明，全部使用繁體中文回覆。"):

def query_stock_full_data(stock_code_or_name):
    clean_kw = clean_stock_code(stock_code_or_name)
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 1
      A.代號, A.名稱, A.成交價, A.price_ma5, A.price_ma20, A.price_ma60, A.三大法人_ma5, A.三大法人_ma20,
      ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, M.專家實戰總分) AS 實戰總分,
      ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分_ma20, M.專家實戰總分) AS 實戰總分_ma20,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_5MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_5MA, ISNULL(E.Return_5MA, 0.0) AS Return_5MA,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_10MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_10MA, ISNULL(E.Return_10MA, 0.0) AS Return_10MA,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_20MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_20MA, ISNULL(E.Return_20MA, 0.0) AS Return_20MA,
      ISNULL(E.OptimalExit, N'🔥 20MA勝出') AS OptimalExit,
      ISNULL(C5.集中度1日, 0.0) AS 集中度1日, ISNULL(C5.集中度5日, 0.0) AS 集中度5日, ISNULL(C5.集中度20日, 0.0) AS 集中度20日,
      ISNULL(R.HitCount, 0) AS HitCount, ISNULL(R.ResonanceTag, N'常態波段') AS ResonanceTag,
      ISNULL(RAD.[60M動能(OSC)], 0.0) AS OSC_60M, ISNULL(RAD.[60M_K值], 50.0) AS K_60M, ISNULL(RAD.短線氣象, N'☀️ 轉強') AS 短線氣象,
      ISNULL(FST.預估目標價, 0) AS FactSet目標價,
      CAST(A.日期 AS VARCHAR) AS 資料日期
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live A
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory SCH ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(SCH.代號) AND A.日期 = SCH.日期
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits E ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(E.代號)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 代號, 集中度1日, 集中度5日, 集中度20日 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.Chips5 WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM(?) OR RTRIM(名稱) = RTRIM(?) ORDER BY 日期 DESC) C5 ON 1=1
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot R ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar RAD ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(RAD.代號)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT 代號, MAX(預估目標價) AS 預估目標價 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates GROUP BY 代號) FST ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(FST.代號)
    WHERE RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(?) OR RTRIM(A.名稱) = RTRIM(?)
    ORDER BY A.日期 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (clean_kw, clean_kw, clean_kw, clean_kw))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row:
                raw_date = str(row[25]).split('.')[0].strip() if len(row) > 25 and row[25] else "最新"
                return {
                    "code": clean_stock_code(row[0]), "name": str(row[1]).strip(),
                    "price": float(row[2]) if row[2] else 0.0,
                    "m5": float(row[3]) if row[3] else 0.0,
                    "m20": float(row[4]) if row[4] else 0.0,
                    "m60": float(row[5]) if row[5] else 0.0,
                    "f5": float(row[6]) if row[6] else 0.0,
                    "f20": float(row[7]) if row[7] else 0.0,
                    "score": float(row[8]) if row[8] else 0.0,
                    "score20": float(row[9]) if row[9] else 0.0,
                    "w5": float(row[10]) if row[10] else 50.0, "ret5": float(row[11]) if row[11] else 0.0,
                    "w10": float(row[12]) if row[12] else 50.0, "ret10": float(row[13]) if row[13] else 0.0,
                    "w20": float(row[14]) if row[14] else 50.0, "ret20": float(row[15]) if row[15] else 0.0,
                    "optimal": str(row[16]).strip() if row[16] else "🔥 20MA勝出",
                    "c1": float(row[17]) if row[17] else 0.0, "c5": float(row[18]) if row[18] else 0.0, "c20": float(row[19]) if row[19] else 0.0,
                    "hit_count": int(row[20]) if row[20] else 0, "tag": str(row[21]).strip() if row[21] else "常態波段",
                    "osc_60m": float(row[22]) if row[22] else 0.0, "k_60m": float(row[23]) if row[23] else 50.0,
                    "weather": str(row[24]).strip() if row[24] else "☀️ 轉強",
                    "target_price": float(row[25]) if len(row) > 25 and row[25] else 0.0,
                    "date": raw_date
                }
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 查詢股票異常: {e}")
    return None

# 📸【4. Playwright 自動截取四大圖表】

async def capture_stock_chart(stock_code):
    clean_code = clean_stock_code(stock_code)
    today = datetime.datetime.now()
    one_year_ago = (today - datetime.timedelta(days=365)).strftime('%Y%m%d')
    timestamp_now = int(time.time() * 1000)

    url = f"https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/excelsql2.html?stock={clean_code}&start={one_year_ago}&_v={timestamp_now}"
    photo_filename = f"chart_{clean_code}_{timestamp_now}.png"
    output_path = os.path.join(STATIC_DIR, photo_filename)

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = await browser.new_context(
            viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 1300},
            ignore_https_errors=True,
            extra_http_headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache"}
        )
        page = await context.new_page()
        try:
            await page.goto(url, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=45000)
            await asyncio.sleep(2.0)

            btn_post = page.locator("#btn_query_post")
            if await btn_post.count() > 0 and await btn_post.is_visible():
                await btn_post.click()
            else:
                await page.evaluate("""
                    const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, input[type="button"], a'))
                        .find(el => el.textContent.includes('歷史') || el.textContent.includes('聯動'));
                    if (btn) btn.click();
                """)

            await asyncio.sleep(4.5)

            # 畫面淨化
            await page.evaluate("""
                const p = document.getElementById('html-chart-price');
                const c = document.getElementById('html-chart-cross');
                const o = document.getElementById('html-chart-obv');
                const s = document.getElementById('html-chart-score');
                if (p && o && s) {
                    const container = document.createElement('div');
                    container.id = 'clean-charts-container';
                    container.style.backgroundColor = '#0c1827';
                    container.style.padding = '10px';
                    container.style.width = '100%';
                    container.appendChild(p);
                    if (c) container.appendChild(c);
                    container.appendChild(o);
                    container.appendChild(s);
                    document.body.insertBefore(container, document.body.firstChild);
                    document.querySelectorAll('body > *').forEach(el => {
                        if (el.id !== 'clean-charts-container') el.style.display = 'none';
                    });
                }
            """)
            await asyncio.sleep(1.5)
            await page.screenshot(path=output_path, full_page=True)
            return output_path
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ 截圖失敗 [{clean_code}]: {e}")
            return None
        finally:
            await browser.close()

# 🔍【5. 60M 低檔金叉選股查詢】
# =========================================================================
def query_kd_cross_stocks():
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 10 代號, 名稱, 分組, 策略靈魂, ROUND([60M動能(OSC)], 2) AS [60M_OSC], ROUND([60M_K值], 1) AS [60M_K], 日線分, 短線氣象
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
    WHERE [短線氣象] LIKE N'%轉強%' OR [60M動能(OSC)] > 5.0
    ORDER BY [60M動能(OSC)] DESC, 日線分 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            return rows
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 查詢金叉失敗: {e}")
        return []

@bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: True)
def handle_all_messages(message):
    raw_text = message.text.strip()
    chat_id = message.chat.id

    is_use_openrouter = raw_text.endswith("R") or raw_text.endswith("r")
    clean_cmd = raw_text[:-1].strip() if is_use_openrouter else raw_text

    engine_tag = "⚡ OpenRouter 120B" if is_use_openrouter else "🤖 本地 Ollama 7B"

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 🎯 指令 A：【找金叉】或【選股】
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    if clean_cmd in ["找金叉", "選股", "金叉", "60M金叉"]:
        wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"⏳ 正在掃描全市場 60M 轉強伏兵清單 ({engine_tag})...")
        rows = query_kd_cross_stocks()
        if not rows:
            bot.edit_message_text("⚠️ 目前無符合 60M 轉強之金叉標的。", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            return

        today_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d')
        msg = f"⚡ 【Zen AI 60M 低檔轉強精選榜 ({engine_tag})】\n📅 日期：{today_str}\n────────────────────────\n"
        for idx, r in enumerate(rows, 1):
            msg += f"{idx}. 🌟 {r[0]} {r[1]} ({r[2]})\n   ├─ 60M OSC: `+{r[4]}` | 60M K值: `{r[5]}`\n   ├─ 短線氣象: 【{r[7]}】 | 日線總分: `+{r[6]}分`\n   └─ 核心題材: 【{r[3]}】\n"
        
        hint_cmd = "2454 說明R" if is_use_openrouter else "2454 說明"
        msg += f"\n👉 輸入 `股號 說明` (例: `{hint_cmd}`) 即可產出該股三合一深度戰報！"

        bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
        bot.send_message(chat_id, msg)
        return

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 解析個股指令
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    is_mode_desc = bool(re.search(r'(說明|詳細|圖文)', clean_cmd))
    is_mode_photo = bool(re.search(r'(圖片|截圖|圖表|圖)', clean_cmd)) and not is_mode_desc

    target_stock = re.sub(r'(圖片|截圖|圖表|圖|說明|詳細|圖文)', '', clean_cmd).strip()
    target_stock = clean_stock_code(target_stock)

    if not target_stock:
        bot.reply_to(message, "💡 指令範例：`2408` (本地)、`2408R` (OpenRouter)、`2408 說明R` (三合一)")
        return

    wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"⏳ 正在穿透資料庫檢索【{target_stock}】並由 {engine_tag} 推演中...")

def send_to_line(message_text, image_path=None):
    if not LINE_TOKEN or "請在此" in LINE_TOKEN:
        return
    url = "https://notify-api.line.me/api/notify"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {LINE_TOKEN}"}
    payload = {"message": message_text}
    files = None
    try:
        if image_path and os.path.exists(image_path):
            files = {"imageFile": open(image_path, "rb")}
            requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=payload, files=files, timeout=15)
        else:
            requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=payload, timeout=15)
        print("✅ LINE 管道圖文推送完成！")

                    if content and content.strip():
                        clean_content = content.strip()
                        if "<think>" in clean_content and "</think>" in clean_content:
                            parts = clean_content.split("</think>")
                            clean_content = parts[1].strip()
                        print(f"  └─ 成功由大腦【{model_name}】產出深度解盤！")
                        return clean_content, model_name
            elif r.status_code in [429, 503, 500, 404]:
                last_err = f"{model_name} (HTTP {r.status_code})"
                time.sleep(0.8)
        except Exception as e:
            last_err = f"{model_name} ({e})"
            time.sleep(0.5)

    return f"⚠️ 抱歉，目前 5 大頂級 AI 雲端模型節點皆繁忙，請稍候重試。\n(最後狀態: {last_err})", "服務繁忙"

# =========================================================================
# 🗄️【4. 資料庫個股數據穿透查詢 (含前後 SP 隨動計算)】
# =========================================================================
def run_pre_calc(stock_code):
    """步驟前：盤中隨動計算"""
    clean_code = clean_stock_code(stock_code)
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=8) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute("EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_CalcIntradayStockLive @StockCode = ?", (clean_code,))
            conn.commit()
            print(f"⚡ [Python 預先計算] 股號 {clean_code} 盤中隨動計算已在資料庫端完成。")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 盤中隨動計算提醒: {e}")

def run_post_refresh(stock_code):
    """步驟後：單股快取更新"""
    clean_code = clean_stock_code(stock_code)
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=8) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute("EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_RefreshIntradayScoreCache_Single @StockCode = ?", (clean_code,))
            conn.commit()
            print(f"🔄 [Python 背景更新] 正在刷新單股估分快取: {clean_code}")
            print(f"✅ [Python 背景更新] 股號 {clean_code} 的單股快取更新已順利完成。")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 估分快取更新提醒: {e}")

def query_stock_full_data(stock_code_or_name):
    clean_kw = clean_stock_code(stock_code_or_name)
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 1
      A.代號, A.名稱, A.成交價, A.price_ma5, A.price_ma20, A.price_ma60, A.三大法人_ma5, A.三大法人_ma20,
      ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, M.專家實戰總分) AS 實戰總分,
      ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分_ma20, M.專家實戰總分) AS 實戰總分_ma20,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_5MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_5MA, ISNULL(E.Return_5MA, 0.0) AS Return_5MA,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_10MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_10MA, ISNULL(E.Return_10MA, 0.0) AS Return_10MA,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_20MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_20MA, ISNULL(E.Return_20MA, 0.0) AS Return_20MA,
      ISNULL(E.OptimalExit, N'🔥 20MA勝出') AS OptimalExit,
      ISNULL(C5.集中度1日, 0.0) AS 集中度1日, ISNULL(C5.集中度5日, 0.0) AS 集中度5日, ISNULL(C5.集中度20日, 0.0) AS 集中度20日,
      ISNULL(R.HitCount, 0) AS HitCount, ISNULL(R.ResonanceTag, N'常態波段') AS ResonanceTag,
      ISNULL(RAD.[60M動能(OSC)], 0.0) AS OSC_60M, ISNULL(RAD.[60M_K值], 50.0) AS K_60M, ISNULL(RAD.短線氣象, N'☀️ 轉強') AS 短線氣象,
      ISNULL(FST.預估目標價, 0) AS FactSet目標價,
      CAST(A.日期 AS VARCHAR) AS 資料日期
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live A
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory SCH ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(SCH.代號) AND A.日期 = SCH.日期
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits E ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(E.代號)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 代號, 集中度1日, 集中度5日, 集中度20日 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.Chips5 WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM(?) OR RTRIM(名稱) = RTRIM(?) ORDER BY 日期 DESC) C5 ON 1=1
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot R ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar RAD ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(RAD.代號)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT 代號, MAX(預估目標價) AS 預估目標價 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates GROUP BY 代號) FST ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(FST.代號)
    WHERE RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(?) OR RTRIM(A.名稱) = RTRIM(?)
    ORDER BY A.日期 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (clean_kw, clean_kw, clean_kw, clean_kw))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row:
                raw_date = str(row[25]).split('.')[0].strip() if len(row) > 25 and row[25] else "最新"
                return {
                    "code": clean_stock_code(row[0]), "name": str(row[1]).strip(),
                    "price": float(row[2]) if row[2] else 0.0,
                    "m5": float(row[3]) if row[3] else 0.0,
                    "m20": float(row[4]) if row[4] else 0.0,
                    "m60": float(row[5]) if row[5] else 0.0,
                    "f5": float(row[6]) if row[6] else 0.0,
                    "f20": float(row[7]) if row[7] else 0.0,
                    "score": float(row[8]) if row[8] else 0.0,
                    "score20": float(row[9]) if row[9] else 0.0,
                    "w5": float(row[10]) if row[10] else 50.0, "ret5": float(row[11]) if row[11] else 0.0,
                    "w10": float(row[12]) if row[12] else 50.0, "ret10": float(row[13]) if row[13] else 0.0,
                    "w20": float(row[14]) if row[14] else 50.0, "ret20": float(row[15]) if row[15] else 0.0,
                    "optimal": str(row[16]).strip() if row[16] else "🔥 20MA勝出",
                    "c1": float(row[17]) if row[17] else 0.0, "c5": float(row[18]) if row[18] else 0.0, "c20": float(row[19]) if row[19] else 0.0,
                    "hit_count": int(row[20]) if row[20] else 0, "tag": str(row[21]).strip() if row[21] else "常態波段",
                    "osc_60m": float(row[22]) if row[22] else 0.0, "k_60m": float(row[23]) if row[23] else 50.0,
                    "weather": str(row[24]).strip() if row[24] else "☀️ 轉強",
                    "target_price": float(row[25]) if len(row) > 25 and row[25] else 0.0,
                    "date": raw_date
                }
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 查詢股票異常: {e}")
    return None

# =========================================================================
# 📸【5. Playwright 智慧時段截圖 (支援 btn_query_live ✕ btn_query_post)】
# =========================================================================
async def capture_stock_chart(stock_code):
    clean_code = clean_stock_code(stock_code)
    today = datetime.datetime.now()
    one_year_ago = (today - datetime.timedelta(days=365)).strftime('%Y%m%d')
    timestamp_now = int(time.time() * 1000)

    url = f"https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/excelsql2.html?stock={clean_code}&start={one_year_ago}&_v={timestamp_now}"
    photo_filename = f"chart_{clean_code}_{timestamp_now}.png"
    output_path = os.path.join(STATIC_DIR, photo_filename)

    print(f"🚀 Playwright 前往網址 (防快取雙Y軸版): {url}")

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = await browser.new_context(
            viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 1300},
            ignore_https_errors=True,
            extra_http_headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache"}
        )
        page = await context.new_page()
        try:
            await page.goto(url, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=45000)
            await asyncio.sleep(2.0)

            # 🟢 智慧交易時段判定 (盤中 09:00~13:35 優先點擊 btn_query_live)
            current_hour_min = int(today.strftime("%H%M"))
            is_live_hours = (current_hour_min >= 900 and current_hour_min <= 1335)
            
            print("⚡ 正在進行智慧時段判定並模擬點擊聯動按鈕...")
            if is_live_hours:
                print("☀️ 當前為盤中交易時段，優先點擊 id='btn_query_live' (盤中即時隨動)...")
                btn_target = page.locator("#btn_query_live, #btn_query_realtime")
            else:
                print("🌙 當前為盤後非交易時段，優先點擊 id='btn_query_post' (盤後歷史分析)...")
                btn_target = page.locator("#btn_query_post")

            if await btn_target.count() > 0 and await btn_target.is_visible():
                await btn_target.first.click()
                print("🎯 成功定位並點擊聯動按鈕！")
            else:
                await page.evaluate("""
                    const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, input[type="button"], a'))
                        .find(el => el.textContent.includes('歷史') || el.textContent.includes('聯動') || el.textContent.includes('即時'));
                    if (btn) btn.click();
                """)

            await asyncio.sleep(4.5)

            # 畫面淨化 (擷取乾淨四大圖表)
            print("🧹 正在淨化畫面，去除上方 SQL 面板與資料表格...")
            await page.evaluate("""
                const p = document.getElementById('html-chart-price');
                const c = document.getElementById('html-chart-cross');
                const o = document.getElementById('html-chart-obv');
                const s = document.getElementById('html-chart-score');
                if (p && o && s) {
                    const container = document.createElement('div');
                    container.id = 'clean-charts-container';
                    container.style.backgroundColor = '#0c1827';
                    container.style.padding = '10px';
                    container.style.width = '100%';
                    container.appendChild(p);
                    if (c) container.appendChild(c);
                    container.appendChild(o);
                    container.appendChild(s);
                    document.body.insertBefore(container, document.body.firstChild);
                    document.querySelectorAll('body > *').forEach(el => {
                        if (el.id !== 'clean-charts-container') el.style.display = 'none';
                    });
                }
            """)
            await asyncio.sleep(1.5)
            await page.screenshot(path=output_path, full_page=True)
            print(f"✅ 截圖成功！(已套用雙 Y 軸最新畫面)")
            return output_path
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ 截圖失敗 [{clean_code}]: {e}")
            return None
        finally:
            await browser.close()

# 🔍【6. 60M 低檔金叉選股查詢】
# =========================================================================
def query_kd_cross_stocks():
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 10 代號, 名稱, 分組, 策略靈魂, ROUND([60M動能(OSC)], 2) AS [60M_OSC], ROUND([60M_K值], 1) AS [60M_K], 日線分, 短線氣象
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
    WHERE [短線氣象] LIKE N'%轉強%' OR [60M動能(OSC)] > 5.0
    ORDER BY [60M動能(OSC)] DESC, 日線分 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            return rows
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 查詢金叉失敗: {e}")
        return []
